listenings.title: Four study tips from students
intro: Radio ko'rsatuvida to'rt talaba imtihonga tayyorlanish usullarini aytmoqda. Savol: What does each student recommend? Uyda bir marta tinglang.
transcript: PRESENTER: Today four students tell us how they prepare for exams. Aziz, you first.
AZIZ: I always study with two friends. We test each other, and explaining things to someone else helps me remember them.
PRESENTER: Thanks. Lola?
LOLA: For me, the most important thing is sleep. I used to stay up all night, but now I go to bed early before an exam, and my marks have really improved.
PRESENTER: Interesting. Ben?
BEN: I make a plan. I write down every topic and give each one a day in my calendar, so I never have to rush at the end.
PRESENTER: And finally, Madina?
MADINA: I put my phone in another room. Without messages and social media, I can concentrate for much longer. I don't use any special apps — I just remove the problem.

tasks.title: What does each student recommend?
items: 1 Aziz
2 Lola
3 Ben
4 Madina
why: "I always study with two friends. We test each other".
"The most important thing is sleep ... go to bed early". Tuzoq: F — "used to stay up all night" — eski odat, endi emas.
"Give each one a day in my calendar".
"I put my phone in another room ... I just remove the problem". Tuzoq: C — "I don't use any special apps" — inkor.
tasks.note: Ortiqcha variantlar: C (study app — Madina inkor qilgan) va F (studying at night — Lolaning eski odati).

tasks.title: Chalg'ituvchi daftari
items: 2 F
4 C
answers: "I used to stay up all night"
why: Endi emas.
Inkor.

homework_intro: Bugun biz qutidagi variant audioda deyarli hech qachon aynan aytilmasligini ko'rdik — "a relative's influence" o'rniga "his uncle was a film student" eshitildi; uyda xuddi shu ishni yolg'iz o'zingiz bajarasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — 5-skript, "Four study tips from students": varaqning old tomonidagi A–F qutisini avval o'qing, har variantga bittadan sinonim o'ylang, keyin skriptni bir marta tinglang yoki uydagi birov sizga bir marta ovoz chiqarib o'qib bersin, 1–4 ga harflarni yozing va faqat shundan keyin varaqning orqasidagi transkriptni oching — bu 10 daqiqa oladi.

Ikkinchi vazifa — "Sinonim daftari": darsdagi tekshiruvda yozib olgan iboralaringiz asosida Track 5 va Track 14 qutilaridagi 12 ta variantni daftarga ko'chirib, har birining yoniga audioda qanday aytilganini yozasiz (a relative's influence — his uncle was a film student), ortiqcha variantlarga esa "aytilmagan" yoki "inkor qilingan" deb qo'yasiz; uchinchisi — "O'z matching mashqingiz": oilangizdagi 4 kishi haqida 4 gap va 6 variantli quti, 2 tasi ortiqcha bo'lsin.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato shu: so'z eshitilgani uchun harfni yozib qo'yish — Track 5 da Anna Pavlova haqida "her parents weren't wealthy" deyiladi, demak B (a lot of money) javob emas; har harfni yozishdan oldin gap tasdiqmi yoki inkormi, bir tekshiring.

O'z mashqingizda variantlarni gapdagi so'zlar bilan bir xil yozmang, paraphrase qiling; uchala vazifa birga taxminan yarim soat oladi, daftarni keyingi darsga to'liq yozilgan holda olib keling — dars boshida sherigingiz sizning mashqingizni tinglab moslaydi, men esa sinonim daftaringizni yig'ib tekshiraman.

homework.title: 5-skript: "Four study tips from students"
homework.instr: Uyda bir marta tinglang (yoki o'qitib eshiting), harflarni yozing, keyin transkript bilan tekshiring.
homework.answers: Javoblar Listening bo'limida.

homework.title: Sinonim daftari
homework.instr: Darsdagi tekshiruvda ("Paraphrase juftlari", "Chalg'ituvchi tahlili") daftarga yozib olgan iboralaringizdan foydalaning: Track 5 va Track 14 qutilaridagi 12 ta variant uchun audioda qanday aytilganini yozing (masalan: a relative's influence — his uncle was a film student).
homework.answers: 12 qator; ortiqcha variantlar uchun "aytilmagan / inkor" deb yozing.

homework.title: O'z matching mashqingiz
homework.instr: Oilangizdagi 4 kishi haqida 4 gap yozing va 6 variantli quti tuzing (2 tasi ortiqcha). Keyingi darsda sherigingiz tinglab moslaydi.
homework.answers: Ustoz variantlar paraphrase qilinganini tekshiradi.

kahoot.q: In a Listening matching task there are 4 questions and 6 options (A–F). How many options will you NOT use?
kahoot.explain: 6 variant va 4 savol bo'lsa, 2 ta variant ortiqcha qoladi.

kahoot.q: In Listening matching, in what order do you hear the people in Questions 1–4?
kahoot.explain: Odamlar (1–4) audioda savol tartibida keladi; variantlar (A–F) esa tartibsiz.

kahoot.q: What is the most useful thing to do with the options (A–F) before the recording starts?
options: Cross out the two longest ones
kahoot.explain: Variantlar audioda deyarli hech qachon aynan aytilmaydi, shuning uchun sinonimlarini oldindan o'ylash kerak.

kahoot.q: Option: 'a family member's help'. Which sentence from a recording matches it best?
options: My aunt showed me what to do.
My friends gave me some advice.
I learnt everything on my own.
My neighbour lent me his tools.
kahoot.explain: Aunt (xola yoki amma) — oila a'zosi; do'st va qo'shni oila a'zosi emas.

kahoot.q: A speaker says, 'People think I did it for attention, but that isn't true.' Is 'attention' the answer?
options: No — it is mentioned, then denied
Yes — it is the first idea heard
Only if no other option fits
kahoot.explain: Variant tilga olinib, keyin inkor qilinsa, u chalg'ituvchi — javob emas.

kahoot.q: Why do the options in the box rarely use the same words as the recording?
options: The box is written by students
The recording has no key words
kahoot.explain: IELTS sinonim va paraphrase ni tushunishni tekshiradi, shuning uchun so'z emas, ma'no tinglanadi.

kahoot.q: The question asks what HELPED each person succeed. A speaker describes a prize she won later. What should you do?
options: Move on to the next person
Write the first letter you hear
kahoot.explain: Savol sababni so'raydi; keyin qo'lga kiritilgan mukofot — natija, sabab emas.

kahoot.q: You missed the name of person 2, and now you hear person 3's name. What should you do?
options: Wait for the recording to repeat
Write the same letter for 2 and 3
kahoot.explain: Audio qayta qo'yilmaydi: keyingi ismni langar qilib davom eting, o'tkazib yuborilgan savolga oxirida taxmin yozing.

kahoot.q: Can you use the same letter twice in a matching task?
options: Only if the instructions allow it
Yes, whenever you are not sure
No, the letters must be in order
Only for the last two questions
kahoot.explain: Odatda har harf bir marta ishlatiladi; faqat "You may use any letter more than once" yozilgan bo'lsa takrorlash mumkin.

kahoot.q: Which phrase in a recording usually warns you that an option is a distractor?
options: '...which is why it worked so well.'
kahoot.explain: "but ... wasn't" — inkor: tilga olingan variant rad etiladi.

kahoot.q: A speaker says, 'I used to cycle to work, but now I take the bus.' How does she travel to work now?
kahoot.explain: "used to" — eski odat; hozirgi holat "now" dan keyin aytiladi.

kahoot.q: Option: 'a lucky chance'. Which sentence from a recording matches it best?
options: She planned it for many years.
They copied a friend's good idea.
kahoot.explain: "By accident" — tasodifan, ya'ni omad; qolganlari reja, mehnat yoki nusxa.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'My grandfather had a strong ___ on my choice of career.'
kahoot.explain: "have an influence on" — ta'sir ko'rsatmoq; "affect" — fe'l, bu yerda ot kerak.

kahoot.q: If a student 'stands out' in her class, she is…
kahoot.explain: "stand out" — boshqalardan ajralib turmoq, ko'zga tashlanmoq.

kahoot.q: A 'scholarship' is money that…
options: a bank lends to a company
kahoot.explain: "scholarship" — o'qish uchun beriladigan grant yoki stipendiya.

kahoot.q: 'Elderly people' are people who are…
kahoot.explain: "elderly" — keksa, yoshi ulug' (hurmatli, odobli so'z).

kahoot.q: A 'lasting' feeling is one that…
options: happens only once in a lifetime
kahoot.explain: "lasting" — uzoq davom etadigan, barqaror.

kahoot.q: An 'achievable' goal is a goal that you…
kahoot.explain: "achievable" — erishsa bo'ladigan, real maqsad.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'It's hard to concentrate ___ my homework when the TV is on.'
kahoot.explain: "concentrate on something" — biror narsaga diqqatni jamlamoq.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Loud music is a big ___ when I'm trying to read.'
kahoot.explain: "distraction" — diqqatni chalg'ituvchi narsa.

lessons.title: Listening: Pick from a List (Part 3 — discussion)
lessons.grammar_topic: Pick from a list (Part 3) — suhbatda ikki kishi KELISHGAN javoblarni tanlash
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ustoz bergan audiolar (CD2 Track 6 choosing a successful person, Track 15 personality tests) va 3 ta mualliflik skripti.
objectives: Part 3 suhbatida (2 kishi) "Choose TWO" savollarini ishlash.
Ikki so'zlovchi KELISHGAN fikrni ajratish: taklif — rad etish — kelishuv zanjirini kuzatish.
"Agree", "decide", "do next" kabi savol so'zlarini oldindan belgilash.
Kelishuv signallarini tanish: "Yeah, you're right", "I agree", "OK, let's...", "that's it".
13-darsdagi pick from a list ko'nikmasini qiyinroq, suhbat formatida mustahkamlash.
materials: Ikkala audio darsdan oldin ochib qo'yilsin: ielts5_22_choosing.mp3 (CD2 Track 6) va ielts5_22_personality.mp3 (Track 15) — kolonka ulangan, ovoz sinab ko'rilgan, ikkalasi ham 0:00 da to'xtatib turilsin, chunki har biri FAQAT BIR MARTA qo'yiladi.

Doskada dars boshlanmasdan turib: TAKLIF → RAD / KELISHUV uchta so'z katta qilib yozilsin ("Taklif, rad yoki kelishuv?" sinf mashqi shu uchtasiga quriladi), yoniga signal so'zlar ustuni — "Yeah, you're right / I agree / OK, let's... / That's a good idea" va "but / I'm not sure / I don't think we can ... yet".

Track 6 va Track 15 savol varaqasi (5–10 savollar, har biriga A–E variantlar) — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa; variantlar qo'lda bo'lmasa "Choose TWO letters" ishlamaydi, shuning uchun bu varaqada transkript BO'LMASIN.
"Planning a class trip" va "Tutor meeting — improving an essay" skriptlarining 1–4 savollari — har juftlikka bitta nusxa.

Ustoz uchun o'sha ikki skriptning to'liq transkripti chop etilgan holda (bu ikkisida audio yo'q — ustoz ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi): KATE/SAM va DR HALE/NODIR gaplari ikki xil rang yoki belgi bilan ajratilsin, ikkinchi rolni kuchli o'quvchi o'qib bersa bo'ladi.

"Choosing a club at university" (5-skript) uyga vazifa varaqasi — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa: 1-betda 1–4 savol va variantlar, 2-betda transkript (uyda kimdir o'qib berishi va tekshirish uchun, oldindan ochilmasin); o'quvchilar zanjir daftari va ruchka bilan kelsin.

Track 6 va Track 15 transkriptlari — faqat tinglash va tekshiruvdan KEYIN, dars oxirida har o'quvchiga bittadan tarqatiladi: uyga "Zanjir daftari" va "Kim haqida?" vazifalari shu transkriptlarga tayanadi.
timeline: Salomlashish; 21-dars uyga vazifasi: "Four study tips" kaliti (1 B · 2 A · 3 E · 4 D) tez aytiladi; juftlikda "O'z matching mashqingiz" — sherik 4 gapni tinglab harf moslaydi; sinonim daftarlari yig'iladi
Ustoz doskada: taklif → rad / kelishuv zanjiri, 6 bosqich, signal so'zlar, tipik xatolar

"Taklif, rad yoki kelishuv?" (5 daqiqa): ustoz gapni o'qiydi, o'quvchilar yorliq aytadi; signal so'zlar doskadagi ustunga yoziladi. Keyin rolli o'yin (10 daqiqa): juftlikda A taklif qiladi ("What about...?"), B e'tiroz bildiradi ("Yeah, but..."), A tushuntiradi, B rozi bo'ladi ("OK, let's...") yoki boshqa taklif beradi — mavzu: sinf kechasi yoki dam olish kuni rejasi; 2–3 juftlik sinf oldida aytadi, sinf qaysi taklif qabul qilinganini topadi
Track 6 savol varag'i (5–10): savollardagi kalit so'zlarni belgilash (criteria / agree to do before they meet again / agree are linked to success) va har A–E variantga sinonim o'ylash
BIR MARTA tinglash; kalit why bilan; "Zanjir tahlili" — kim taklif qildi, kim e'tiroz bildirdi, qanday kelishildi
O'quvchilar mustaqil: savollarni o'qish, BIR MARTA tinglash, tekshirish va "Kim haqida?" tahlili (kim gapirayotganini kuzatish)
"Planning a class trip" va "Tutor meeting — improving an essay" — ustoz bir marta o'qiydi (ikkinchi rolni kuchli o'quvchi); juftlikda tekshirish, zanjir va maqtov/o'zgarish tahlili

Xatolar daftari — ustunlar: savol | mening javobim | to'g'ri javob | sabab (AYTILMAGAN / TESKARI (inkor) / BOSHQA NARSA-ODAM / KUCHLI SO'Z / BOSHQA SON-VAQT / SO'Z CHEGARASI); Part 3 da qo'shimcha: "taklif edi, kelishuv emas"
Track 6 va Track 15 transkriptlari tarqatiladi; uyga vazifa: "Choosing a club at university", Zanjir daftari, Kim haqida?

intro: 13-darsda pick from a list asosan bitta so'zlovchi (monolog) yoki oddiy suhbat edi. Bu darsda — Part 3: ikki talaba muhokama qiladi, takliflar beriladi, ba'zilari qabul, ba'zilari rad qilinadi.
Savolda "Which TWO things do the students AGREE..." — bu eng muhim so'z. Bittasining taklifi yetarli emas; ikkinchisi rozi bo'lishi kerak.

Zanjir: 1) taklif ("What about cooking plov for the class party?") → 2) e'tiroz ("Isn't that a lot of work?" — "Not really, my mum can help.") → 3) kelishuv ("Oh, I see. Yeah, OK, let's cook plov."). Javob — oxirgi kelishuv.
Rad etish signallari: "I'm not sure", "but", "I don't think we can ... yet", "maybe it won't work". Bunday variant — chalg'ituvchi.
Kelishuv signallari: "Yeah, you're right", "I agree", "OK, I think that's it", "that's a good idea".
Ba'zan javob ikki kishining gapini birlashtirishdan chiqadi: biri "You need a good teacher" deydi, ikkinchisi "Yeah — I agree" deb qo'shadi.
presentation: Bittasi taklif qildi, ikkinchisi indamadi. Javobmi?
Ehtiyot bo'ling — kelishuv signalini kuting. Savol "agree" desa, ikkalasi rozi bo'lishi kerak.
Taklif rad etilib, keyin qabul qilindi.
Oxirgi fikr hisoblanadi: "Isn't that a lot of work?" — "Oh, I see. OK, let's cook plov" → qabul.
Variantdagi so'z audioda aytildi, lekin "not".
Bu chalg'ituvchi: "It isn't about the price" → "cost" varianti javob emas.
Part 3 da nechta kishi?
Odatda 2–3 (talabalar va o'qituvchi).
Javoblar tartibdami?
Savollar (5–6, 7–8, 9–10) tartibda; harflar ichida tartib yo'q.
Ikkala harfni topolmadim.
Ishonchli bittasini yozing, ikkinchisiga eng ehtimollisini.
notes: Track 6 — 21-darsdagi Track 5 suhbatining davomi (o'sha ikki talaba to'rt kishidan birini tanlaydi). Track 15 — 21-darsdagi Track 14 (Amy va Matt) ning davomi.
Kalit: Track 6 — 5–6 B, E; 7–8 B, C; 9–10 C, D. Track 15 — 5–6 B, C; 7–8 A, D; 9–10 A, E.
Har savoldan keyin o'quvchi zanjirni aytsin: kim taklif qildi → kim e'tiroz bildirdi → qanday kelishildi.

core: We need clear criteria for choosing the best project.
Eng yaxshi loyihani tanlash uchun bizga aniq mezonlar kerak.
Our school has many talented young musicians.
Maktabimizda ko'plab iste'dodli yosh musiqachilar bor.
Some young people want fame more than a good education.
Ba'zi yoshlar yaxshi ta'limdan ko'ra shuhratni ko'proq xohlaydi.
She was determined to pass the exam, so she studied every day.
U imtihondan o'tishga qat'iy bel bog'lagan edi, shuning uchun har kuni o'qidi.
He has a natural ability for maths, but he still practises a lot.
Uning matematikaga tug'ma qobiliyati bor, lekin baribir ko'p mashq qiladi.
At the end of the test, make a thorough check of all your answers.
Test oxirida barcha javoblaringizni puxta tekshirib chiqing.
Always write down the source of any information you use in an essay.
Inshoda foydalangan har qanday ma'lumotning manbasini doim yozib qo'ying.
My notes were so disorganised that I couldn't find anything.
Qaydlarim shunchalik tartibsiz ediki, hech narsani topa olmadim.
You should take your homework seriously if you want a higher band.
Yuqoriroq ball olishni istasangiz, uyga vazifaga jiddiy qarashingiz kerak.
Our tutor gave us a history assignment to finish by Monday.
O'qituvchimiz dushanbagacha tugatish kerak bo'lgan tarix bo'yicha yozma ish berdi.
Student membership of the sports centre is cheaper than adult membership.
Sport markaziga talabalik a'zoligi kattalar a'zoligidan arzonroq.
Swimming twice a week has improved my fitness.
Haftasiga ikki marta suzish jismoniy tayyorgarligimni yaxshiladi.
I usually study at home, but occasionally I go to the library.
Men odatda uyda o'qiyman, lekin ba'zan kutubxonaga boraman.
Some students think revision games are a waste of time, but they really help.
Ba'zi talabalar takrorlash o'yinlarini vaqtni behuda sarflash deb o'ylaydi, lekin ular haqiqatan ham foyda beradi.

class_ex.title: Taklif, rad yoki kelishuv?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz gapni o'qiydi; o'quvchi "taklif", "rad" yoki "kelishuv" deydi.
items: "Why don't we make a poster for our presentation?"
"Is there enough time to make one?"
"Oh, I see. Yeah, OK, let's make a poster."
"Yeah, but a video might take too long to make."
"I don't think we can print it today, do you?" — "No."
"Yeah — I agree."
why: Hali qaror yo'q — ikkinchi odamning javobini kuting.
Shubha — rad signali, lekin hali yakuniy qaror emas: keyingi gapda kelishuv keladi.
Kelishuv — javob shu (poster).
"but" — video varianti rad etildi.
Ikkalasi ham rad etdi — bugun chop etilmaydi.
Oldingi fikr qabul qilindi.
class_ex.note: Uch so'z doskada: TAKLIF → RAD / KELISHUV. E'tiroz (shubha) RAD ustuniga yoziladi, lekin u hali yakuniy qaror emas — oxirgi fikrni kuting. Javob faqat KELISHUV. Gaplar audiodan olinmagan: Track 6 dagi iqtiboslar faqat "Zanjir tahlili"da ochiladi.

listenings.title: CD2 Track 6. Choosing one of the four people
intro: 21-darsdagi ikki talaba endi to'rt kishidan birini tanlash uchun mezon (criteria) belgilaydi, keyingi qadamni va muvaffaqiyat sirini muhokama qiladi. Avval uch savol va variantlarni o'qing. Keyin BIR MARTA tinglang.
Ko'rsatma: Choose TWO letters, A–E, for each question.
transcript: WOMAN: OK, so we have to choose one of these four people.
MAN: It's going to be difficult.
WOMAN: Well, why don't we agree on some criteria that will help us?
MAN: Do you mean things like how old they were when they became successful?
WOMAN: Yeah – except I'm not sure how old they all were! Um, what about choosing a woman ...
MAN: Is it fair to select someone because of their gender? And look at celebrities – there are lots of women.
WOMAN: But it was different in the past.
MAN: Oh, I see. Yeah, OK, let's pick a woman.
WOMAN: Great. Right, well, they're all pretty talented, aren't they? Some have even won awards.
MAN: Yeah, but maybe their fame won't last for ever.
WOMAN: No ... so we should pick someone who's done something great on an international level.
MAN: Yeah, that changed the world ... OK, I think that's it. We've got our two criteria. So what do we need to do before we meet again?
WOMAN: Well, how much information have we got?
MAN: Quite a lot of detail about their lives, but not enough about what they did.
WOMAN: OK – so before we meet again, let's both find out as much as we can. It's always better to have too much information.
MAN: Yeah, you're right. What about pictures?
WOMAN: Yeah – I don't even know what this person looks like!
MAN: OK – well, we might get some from the library – but I can look on the Internet as well.
WOMAN: Once we've done that, we can get together and talk about the next stage.
MAN: Yeah – I don't think we can write the presentation for the seminar yet, do you?
WOMAN: No – anyway, it'll be fun working together.
MAN: Yeah! It's been quite an education doing this.
WOMAN: Yes – it's made me think about success and what it really means.
MAN: It isn't about money, is it?
WOMAN: No – and you don't have to be experienced to achieve it. It can just be luck.
MAN: But perhaps in most cases you need to have some natural ability.
WOMAN: Yeah – I agree. And I also think you do have to work hard and be determined.
MAN: Yeah – and really want to succeed.
WOMAN: No matter where you are or what you've done before.
MAN: Mm. It's quite a curious thing.

tasks.title: Questions 5–10: Choose TWO letters, A–E
tasks.instr: Faqat ikkala talaba KELISHGAN variantni tanlang.
items: 5–6 Which TWO criteria will the students use to choose a successful person? A) age B) gender C) individual talent D) fame E) global importance
7–8 Which TWO things do the students agree to do before they meet again? A) write a biography B) conduct more research C) find photographs D) write a talk E) plan a seminar
9–10 Which TWO things do the students agree are linked to success? A) wealth B) experience C) talent D) effort E) location
why: "Yeah, OK, let's pick a woman" (B — gender) va "someone who's done something great on an international level" — "Yeah, that changed the world" (E). A tuzoq: yosh taklif qilindi, lekin "I'm not sure how old they all were". C tuzoq: "they're all pretty talented" — hammasi iste'dodli, farqlamaydi. D tuzoq: "maybe their fame won't last for ever" — rad.

"Let's both find out as much as we can" — "Yeah, you're right" (B) va "What about pictures? ... we might get some from the library ... look on the Internet" (C). D tuzoq: "I don't think we can write the presentation yet" — "No" — rad. A, E aytilmagan.

"You need to have some natural ability" — "Yeah – I agree" (C) va "you do have to work hard and be determined" — "Yeah – and really want to succeed" (D). A teskari: "It isn't about money". B teskari: "you don't have to be experienced". E teskari: "no matter where you are".
tasks.note: Ustoz kaliti: 5–6 B,E · 7–8 B,C · 9–10 C,D. Bu mashqda har savolda taklif → rad → kelishuv zanjiri aniq ko'rinadi.

tasks.title: Zanjir tahlili
tasks.instr: Kim taklif qildi, kim rozi bo'ldi?
items: 5–6 B (gender)
5–6 D (fame)
7–8 D (write a talk)
9–10 C (talent)
answers: W taklif — M e'tiroz — M rozi
W: "all talented, won awards" — M: "fame won't last"
M: "can't write yet, do you?" — W: "No"
why: "Oh, I see. Yeah, OK, let's pick a woman".
Rad.
Ikkalasi rad qildi.
Kelishuv.

listenings.title: Track 15. Amy, Matt and personality tests
listenings.qtype: Pick from a list (5–10) — qo'shimcha mashq
intro: 21-darsdagi Amy va Matt suhbatining davomi: shaxsiyat testlari, Amyni nima baxtli qiladi va Matt keyin nima qiladi. Avval savollarni o'qing, keyin BIR MARTA tinglang.
Ko'rsatma: Choose TWO letters, A–E, for each question.
transcript: MATT: I've also found one of those personality tests on the Internet. You know, answer these questions to find out how happy you are.
AMY: Oh, those. They're a bit of a waste of time, aren't they? I did one on 'How healthy are you?' and the results were completely wrong.
MATT: But they're quite good fun though, aren't they?
AMY: Well, yes, especially if you do them with friends. I think it's important that you shouldn't take them seriously, though.
MATT: That's true.

AMY: Anyway, why should I do a test that tells me how happy or healthy or successful I am? I mean, I already know the answers, don't I? So, I'm not likely to get any surprises, like, oh, according to this test I'm happy – I didn't expect that!
MATT: OK, I take your point. So what makes you happy?
AMY: Oh, I don't know. Spending time with people I know and like, I guess. I need people around me.
MATT: Me too. But I need time on my own, as well.

AMY: That doesn't really bother me. I grew up in a big family, so I'm used to someone always being in the room. If I wanted to be alone, to get away from people, I had to go out for a walk or something. I still do that occasionally. In fact, that's one thing that makes me happy. A long walk in the countryside. And the advantage is that you're getting some exercise too, which is something I don't usually do.
MATT: But you go running, don't you?
AMY: Sometimes, but only because I feel I have to. Anyway, back to your assignment. You've got all the information you need ...
MATT: Not quite. I need to do a bit more research first.
AMY: OK, so you'll be off to the library, then?
MATT: I would if I knew I could find something useful, but you know how disorganised it is there. It's impossible to find what you want, especially when it comes to psychology books.
AMY: Oh, I know.
MATT: No, give me a computer and the Internet any day.
AMY: Well, good luck with that. If you get bored and want a break, you know where to find me.
MATT: Thanks, but if I don't get this done, I'll be in trouble.
AMY: Why don't you email Tony? He did a similar assignment last year, so he might have a few suggestions.
MATT: That's a good idea. Have you got his email address?
AMY: Sure, give me a moment while I look it up.
MATT: Thanks.

tasks.title: Questions 5–10: Choose TWO letters, A–E
tasks.instr: Kimning fikri so'ralayotganini eslang: 5–8 — Amy, 9–10 — Matt.
items: 5–6 What does Amy think about personality tests? A) They take too much time to do. B) They are not accurate. C) They are entertaining. D) They are too serious. E) They tell you unexpected things.
7–8 What TWO things make Amy happy? A) being with friends B) having time on her own C) going out with her family D) spending time outside E) keeping fit
9–10 What TWO things is Matt going to do next? A) get more information B) go to the library C) try to find some useful books D) take a short break E) ask someone for help
why: "The results were completely wrong" (B) va "especially if you do them with friends" — "quite good fun" ga rozi (C). A tuzoq: "a waste of time" — vaqt ko'p ketishi emas, befoyda degani. D teskari: "you shouldn't take them seriously" — testlar emas, odamlar jiddiy qaramasin. E teskari: "I'm not likely to get any surprises".

"Spending time with people I know and like ... I need people around me" (A) va "A long walk in the countryside" (D). B tuzoq: bu MATTga kerak ("I need time on my own"); Amy: "That doesn't really bother me". E tuzoq: "going running ... only because I feel I have to".

"I need to do a bit more research first" (A) va "Why don't you email Tony?" — "That's a good idea" (E). B, C tuzoq: kutubxona "disorganised ... impossible to find what you want" — bormaydi. D teskari: "if I don't get this done, I'll be in trouble".
tasks.note: Ustoz kaliti: 5–6 B,C · 7–8 A,D · 9–10 A,E. Asosiy tuzoq — 7–8 B: "time on my own" Matt uchun, Amy uchun emas. Kim gapirayotganini kuzating!

tasks.title: Kim haqida?
items: 7–8 B (time on her own)
7–8 E (keeping fit)
9–10 B (library)
answers: Matt: "I need time on my own"
"only because I feel I have to"
why: Amy emas.
Yoqtirmaydi.
Rad.

listenings.title: Planning a class trip
intro: Ikki talaba (Kate va Sam) sinf sayohatini rejalashtirmoqda (Part 3). Avval savollarni o'qing, keyin bir marta tinglang.
transcript: KATE: So, Sam, we need to decide where to take the class for the end-of-year trip.
SAM: Right. What about the science museum? Everyone went last year, though.
KATE: Exactly — they'd be bored. How about the national park? It's not too far, and we could walk to the lake.
SAM: Yes, I like that. It's cheap, too. But what if it rains?
KATE: There's a visitor centre with a café, so we'd have somewhere to go inside.
SAM: Perfect. OK, national park it is. Now, how do we get there? A coach?
KATE: A coach would be expensive for just twenty people. What about the train?
SAM: The station is a long walk from the park. I think we should hire two minibuses — the teachers can drive.
KATE: Good idea, that's much cheaper. And what should people bring?
SAM: Their own lunch, definitely. And good walking shoes.
KATE: Yes, and I'll ask everyone to bring a raincoat, just in case. Money isn't necessary — the café is included in the ticket.

tasks.title: Choose TWO letters, A–E
items: 1–2 Which TWO reasons do Kate and Sam give for choosing the national park? A) nobody has been there B) it is not expensive C) there is somewhere to go if it rains D) it has a science centre E) it is near the station
3–4 Which TWO things should the students bring? A) money for the café B) their own lunch C) a map D) suitable shoes E) a camera
why: "It's cheap, too" (B) va "There's a visitor centre with a café ... somewhere to go inside" (C). A aytilmagan. E teskari: "The station is a long walk from the park".
"Their own lunch, definitely" (B) va "good walking shoes" (D). A teskari: "Money isn't necessary". Raincoat ham kerak, lekin variantlarda yo'q.

tasks.title: Zanjir tahlili
items: science museum
coach
minibuses
why: Rad.
Rad.
Kelishuv.

listenings.title: Tutor meeting — improving an essay
intro: Talaba (Nodir) o'qituvchi (Dr Hale) bilan insho haqida gaplashmoqda (Part 3). Avval savollarni o'qing, keyin bir marta tinglang.
transcript: DR HALE: Come in, Nodir. I've read your essay on city transport.
NODIR: Thank you. Was it all right?
DR HALE: The ideas are good, and your research is very thorough. You've used a lot of recent sources, which is excellent.
NODIR: Oh, good. I spent a long time in the library.
DR HALE: It shows. But there are two areas to work on. First, the introduction is too long — you tell the reader everything before you start. Keep it to one short paragraph.
NODIR: OK. And the second?
DR HALE: Your conclusion just repeats what you've already said. It should give your own opinion.
NODIR: I see. Should I add more examples too?
DR HALE: No, you have plenty. And your grammar is fine — don't worry about that.
NODIR: So, I'll rewrite the introduction and the conclusion. Can I also make the charts clearer?
DR HALE: The charts are OK — nothing special, but they'll do. Just focus on those two parts and send it to me by Friday.

tasks.title: Choose TWO letters, A–E
items: 1–2 What TWO things does Dr Hale praise? A) the research B) the introduction C) the charts D) the use of recent sources E) the conclusion
3–4 What TWO things does Nodir agree to change? A) the introduction B) the grammar C) the examples D) the conclusion E) the charts
why: "Your research is very thorough" (A) va "used a lot of recent sources, which is excellent" (D). C tuzoq: "the charts are OK — nothing special" — bu maqtov emas: maqtov = aniq ijobiy so'z (thorough, excellent). B, E — o'zgartirish kerak.

"I'll rewrite the introduction and the conclusion" — "Just focus on those two parts". B teskari: "grammar is fine". C teskari: "you have plenty". E teskari: charts — "they'll do. Just focus on those two parts".

tasks.title: Maqtov yoki o'zgarish?
items: research, sources
introduction, conclusion
grammar, charts, examples
why: "thorough", "excellent".
"too long", "just repeats".
"fine", "OK — nothing special, but they'll do", "plenty".

listenings.title: Choosing a club at university
intro: Ikki birinchi kurs talabasi (Lina va Tom) klub tanlamoqda. Uyda bir marta tinglang.
transcript: LINA: Have you decided which club to join, Tom?
TOM: Not yet. I was thinking about the film club, but it meets on Friday nights, and I work then.
LINA: What about the hiking club? They go out every Sunday.
TOM: Sundays are good for me. And I want to get fitter.
LINA: Me too. And it's a great way to meet people from other courses.
TOM: True. Is it expensive?
LINA: The membership is only ten pounds a year, but you pay for transport on each trip.
TOM: That's fine. Let's both join. Should we buy special boots first?
LINA: I think we should wait. My friend said they lend boots to new members for the first month.
TOM: Great. And shall we go to the welcome meeting on Wednesday?
LINA: Definitely. They'll tell us about the first trip there.

tasks.title: Choose TWO letters, A–E
items: 1–2 Why do Lina and Tom choose the hiking club? A) it meets on a convenient day B) it is free C) they want to improve their fitness D) their friends are members E) it has good films
3–4 What TWO things do they agree to do? A) buy boots B) go to a meeting C) join the club D) pay for a trip now E) join the film club
why: "Sundays are good for me" (A) va "I want to get fitter" — "Me too" (C). B teskari: "ten pounds a year". D — Linaning do'sti faqat etik haqida aytgan; do'stlar a'zo ekani sabab sifatida aytilmagan.
"Let's both join" (C) va "shall we go to the welcome meeting?" — "Definitely" (B). A teskari: "we should wait ... they lend boots". E teskari: film club — Friday, Tom ishlaydi.

tasks.title: Kelishuv signallari
why: Kelishuv.
Kelishuv.

homework_intro: Bugun darsda taklif — rad — kelishuv zanjirini birga kuzatdik; uyda endi shu zanjirni o'zingiz topasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — "Choosing a club at university": varaqaning 1-betidagi 1–4 savol va variantlarni avval o'qing, keyin skriptni bir marta tinglang yoki uydagi birovga bir marta o'qitib bering, harflarni belgilang va faqat shundan keyin 2-betdagi transkriptni ochib tekshiring — 15 daqiqa.

Keyin "Zanjir daftari": dars oxirida berilgan Track 6 va Track 15 transkriptlaridan 6 ta taklifni yozing va har birining yoniga signal so'zini qo'ying — "Yeah, you're right" yoki "That's a good idea" bo'lsa kelishuv, "but" yoki "I'm not sure" bo'lsa rad; "Kim haqida?" da esa Track 15 dan 4 ta fikrni yozib, har birini Amy aytganmi yoki Matt aytganmi belgilang va "time on my own" tuzog'ini bir gap bilan tushuntiring — ikkalasiga 25 daqiqa.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato — taklifni javob deb yozib qo'yish: taklif hali javob emas, ikkinchi odam rozi bo'lguncha kuting.
Uchala vazifani ham keyingi darsga zanjir daftari bilan olib keling, dars boshida yig'aman, "Choosing a club" varaqasini ham qaytarasiz.

homework.title: 5-skript: "Choosing a club at university"
homework.instr: Uyda bir marta tinglang (yoki o'qitib eshiting), harflarni belgilang, keyin transkript bilan tekshiring.
homework.answers: Javoblar Listening bo'limida.

homework.title: Zanjir daftari
homework.instr: Darsda berilgan transkriptlardan foydalaning: Track 6 va Track 15 dan 6 ta taklifni yozing va har biri qabul qilindimi yoki rad etildimi — signal so'zi bilan belgilang (Yeah, you're right / but / I'm not sure / That's a good idea).
homework.answers: 6 qator, signal bilan.

homework.title: Kim haqida?
homework.instr: Darsda berilgan Track 15 transkriptidan foydalaning: Track 15 da Amy va Matt aytgan 4 ta fikrni yozing va har birini kim aytganini belgilang — 7–8-savoldagi tuzoqni (time on my own) tushuntiring.
homework.answers: Ustoz tekshiradi.

kahoot.q: A question says 'Which TWO things do the students AGREE to do?' When is an idea a correct answer?
options: When it is the first idea heard
kahoot.explain: "Agree" — ikkala so'zlovchi ham rozi bo'lishi kerak; bitta kishining taklifi yetarli emas.

kahoot.q: Which reply shows AGREEMENT?
kahoot.explain: "That's a good idea" — kelishuv signali; qolganlari shubha yoki rad.

kahoot.q: Which reply shows that a suggestion is REJECTED?
kahoot.explain: "I don't think that would work" — rad signali; qolganlari kelishuv.

kahoot.q: A: 'Let's meet on Monday.' B: 'I'm busy then. How about Tuesday?' A: 'Fine.' When will they meet?
kahoot.explain: Oxirgi kelishuv hisoblanadi: Monday rad etildi, Tuesday qabul qilindi.

kahoot.q: In a 'Choose TWO letters' task for Questions 5–6, how are the marks given?
options: One mark for each correct letter
One mark only if both are right
Two marks only if both are right
No marks unless in the right order
kahoot.explain: Har to'g'ri harf alohida 1 ball: 5–6 juftligida 2 ta ball bor.

kahoot.q: Does the order of the two letters matter in 'Choose TWO' questions?
options: Yes, it must follow the audio
kahoot.explain: Ikki harf istalgan tartibda yozilishi mumkin; muhimi — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri bo'lsin.

kahoot.q: The question asks what TOM wants. Lucy says, 'I'd love a bigger room.' Is 'a bigger room' Tom's answer?
options: Only if it is option A
kahoot.explain: Kim gapirayotganini kuzating: bu Lucyning istagi, Tomniki emas.

kahoot.q: Speaker A suggests an idea, but speaker B doesn't respond to it. Is it an 'agree' answer?
options: No, wait for a sign of agreement
Yes, if it was said first
kahoot.explain: Bitta kishining taklifi javob emas — ikkinchisining kelishuv signalini kuting.

kahoot.q: An idea is rejected at first but accepted at the end. Which opinion counts?
kahoot.explain: Suhbatda fikr o'zgarishi mumkin — oxirgi kelishuv hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: Which word in a question tells you that BOTH speakers must accept the idea?
kahoot.explain: "Agree" — kelishuv so'raladi; "mention" yoki "suggest" bitta kishining gapi bo'lishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: A speaker says, 'We don't need to book tickets in advance.' Which option does this rule out?
kahoot.explain: "don't need to" — inkor: chiptani oldindan olish rad etildi.

kahoot.q: 'Yeah, but...' at the start of a reply usually signals…
kahoot.explain: "Yeah, but..." — ko'pincha shubha yoki rad: taklif hali qabul qilinmagan.

kahoot.q: What is the singular form of 'criteria'?
kahoot.explain: "criteria" — ko'plik; birlik shakli "criterion" (mezon).

kahoot.q: 'Fame' means…
options: having a lot of money at home
being very good at a sport
kahoot.explain: "fame" — shuhrat, ko'p odam taniydigan bo'lish.

kahoot.q: If your notes are 'disorganised', they are…
kahoot.explain: "disorganised" — tartibsiz: hech qanday aniq tartib yo'q, kerakli narsani topish qiyin.

kahoot.q: A club 'membership' fee is money you pay to…
kahoot.explain: "membership" — a'zolik; a'zolik badali klubga a'zo bo'lish uchun to'lanadi.

kahoot.q: At university, an 'assignment' is…
options: a piece of work set by a tutor
a room where students can meet
a list of books in the library
kahoot.explain: "assignment" — o'qituvchi bergan yozma topshiriq.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Always check the ___ of the information you find online.'
kahoot.explain: "source" — manba: ma'lumot qayerdan olingani.

kahoot.q: 'We eat out occasionally' means we eat out…
kahoot.explain: "occasionally" — ba'zan, vaqti-vaqti bilan.

kahoot.q: Which verb completes the phrase? 'Scientists ___ research into how sleep affects memory.'
kahoot.explain: "do research" (yoki "carry out research") — to'g'ri birikma; "make research" xato.

lessons.title: Listening: Form Completion (Part 1 — review)
lessons.grammar_topic: Form completion — formani to'ldirish (takrorlash, qiyinroq)
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ustoz bergan audiolar (CD2 Track 7 Online Writing Course, Track 16 International Book Fair) va 3 ta mualliflik skripti.
objectives: 3-darsdagi form completion ko'nikmasini qiyinroq audiolarda takrorlash.
Harflab aytilgan ism va ko'cha nomlarini, postcode va telefon raqamlarini xatosiz yozish.
Tuzatish (correction) tuzog'ini ushlash: "TS?" — "No, TF"; "five-nine-two" — "No, five-two-nine".
Ikki raqam aytilganda qaysi biri formadagi qatorga tegishli ekanini ajratish (home / mobile / work).
Sinfda 4 ta mashq (2 ta ustoz audiosi + 2 ta skript), uyda 1 ta (5-skript, Seaview Hotel) bajarish.
materials: 1-mashq (Online Writing Course) va 2-mashq (International Book Fair) formalari — bo'sh holda chop etilgan, har o'quvchiga bittadan; javob kaliti alohida varaqda, faqat ustozda qoladi.

3-mashq (Oxford English Centre — Enrolment) va 4-mashq (FitLife — New member) formalari — har o'quvchiga bittadan; bu ikkisining skripti faqat ustozda, chunki audio yo'q — ustoz ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.

Audio darsdan oldin ochib qo'yiladi: ielts5_23_writing_course.mp3 (CD2 Track 7) va ielts5_23_book_fair.mp3 (Track 16); ovoz balandligi oxirgi partadan turib tekshiriladi, chunki har ikkisi BIR MARTA qo'yiladi.
Doskaga qo'ng'iroqdan oldin yoziladi: tuzatish signallari "No, ...", "Not quite", "Sorry, ...", "N for November, not M for Mike" va yonida "double L = LL, double seven = 77".

D-F-O-R-D." → RADFORD; 3) "LS14 7PF?" — "No, BF. B for Bravo." → LS14 7BF; 4) "BN21 4MT?" — "No, N for November, not M for Mike." → BN21 4NT; 5) "Oh-seven-nine-one-two, six-four-three, double eight-one?" — "No, four-six-three." → 07912 463 881. intro: Form completion — Part 1 ning eng ko'p uchraydigan turi: ikki kishi suhbati, biri ma'lumot so'raydi, ikkinchisi beradi. Forma suhbat tartibida to'ldiriladi (ALWAYS).
Harflab aytish: ism, familiya va ko'cha nomi deyarli har doim harflanadi. "Double L" = LL, "double seven" = 77. Harfni eshitgan zahoti yozing.
Postcode — harf va raqam aralash (masalan, BS8 1TF, CF10 3AT). Harflar ko'pincha tuzatiladi: "TS?" — "No, TF"; "M for Mike?" — "No, N for November".
Telefon raqami — guruhlab aytiladi va ko'pincha qayta o'qiladi. Xodim noto'g'ri takrorlasa, so'zlovchi tuzatadi — tuzatilgan raqam yoziladi.

Ikki raqam tuzog'i: so'zlovchi ikkita raqam aytadi, masalan "My mobile is 07700 900 123, and at home you can call 01632 960 457". Formadagi qator nomiga qarang (Mobile / Home / Work) — har raqam o'z qatoriga yoziladi.
Oxirgi qatorlar ko'pincha qo'shimcha izoh (message box, date of visit): ular suhbat oxirida, ba'zan boshqa so'zlar bilan aytiladi.

homework_intro: Bugun to'rtta formani eshitib to'ldirdik va har safar tuzatishni kutdik — uyga vazifa ham xuddi shu ish, lekin endi mening yordamimsiz.

Birinchi vazifa — "Hotel booking by phone": varaqdagi Seaview Hotel formasini oching, skriptni bir marta tinglang yoki uyda kimdir sizga bir marta o'qib bersin, oltita javobni yozing va faqat shundan keyin orqa tomondagi transkript bilan tekshiring; hammasi 10-15 daqiqa.

Ikkinchisi — "Harflab yozish": bugungi to'rt mashq va uyga skriptdagi barcha harflangan so'zlarni (Sachdeva, Wallace, Karimova, Bridges, Pereira, Rose Hill) yozib chiqing va har birida sizni adashtirgan harfni belgilang; uchinchisi — "Tuzatish daftari": oltita tuzatishni "noto'g'ri — to'g'ri" ko'rinishida, qaysi signal so'zdan bilganingiz bilan birga yozing.
Eng ko'p yo'l qo'yiladigan xato — transkriptni forma to'ldirilmasdan oldin ochib qo'yish: unda vazifadan foyda qolmaydi, avval quloq bilan yozing, keyin tekshiring.

Uchala vazifa ham keyingi darsning boshida daftarda topshiriladi: formada 6 javobdan 5 tasi to'g'ri bo'lsa 2 coin, harflashda barcha so'z to'g'ri bo'lsa yana 2 coin, tuzatish daftarining 6 qatori uchun 1 coin.

kahoot.explain: Formadagi qator nomiga qarang (Home / Mobile) — har raqam o'z qatoriga yoziladi.

kahoot.q: Which phrase usually signals a correction?
kahoot.explain: "No, ... actually" — tuzatish signali: undan keyingi shakl yoziladi.

kahoot.q: 'Is that B for Bravo?' — 'No, D for Delta.' Which letter is correct?
kahoot.explain: So'zlovchi B ni rad etib, D ni tasdiqlaydi — tuzatilgan harf yoziladi.

kahoot.q: Do capital letters matter in IELTS form completion answers?
options: No, but the spelling must be right
Yes, every word needs a capital
No, and the spelling does not matter
kahoot.explain: Katta-kichik harf uchun ball kesilmaydi, lekin imlo xato bo'lsa javob noto'g'ri hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: You miss an answer while listening. What should you do?
options: Move on to the next gap
Stop and wait for a repeat
Go back to the first gap
kahoot.explain: Audio qaytarilmaydi: keyingi savolga o'ting; oxirida bo'sh katakka mantiqiy taxmin yozing.

kahoot.q: The form says 'Interview: ____ June'. You hear 'on the fifth of June'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "June" formada bor — faqat sanani yozing: 5th (yoki 5).

kahoot.q: What should you do BEFORE the recording starts?
options: Predict the type of each answer
Write your answers in every gap
Count the words in the form
kahoot.explain: Har qatorda qanday ma'lumot (ism, raqam, sana, so'z) kerakligini oldindan bashorat qiling.

kahoot.q: To 'enrol' on a course means to…
kahoot.explain: Enrol — kursga rasman yozilish, ro'yxatdan o'tish.

kahoot.q: Your 'surname' is your…
kahoot.explain: Surname = last name = family name, ya'ni familiya.

kahoot.q: A 'brochure' is…
options: a form you fill in online
a short message on your phone
kahoot.explain: Brochure — kurs yoki xizmat haqida ma'lumot beruvchi kichik risola.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Could you ___ your surname for me, please?'
kahoot.explain: "Spell" — harflab aytmoq: "Could you spell that?" Part 1 da eng ko'p eshitiladigan so'rovlardan biri.

kahoot.q: An 'emergency contact' is a person who…
options: is called if something happens to you
teaches the classes at the gym
sells the tickets at the front door
checks your bank details each month
kahoot.explain: Emergency contact — sizga biror narsa bo'lsa, qo'ng'iroq qilinadigan odam.

kahoot.q: 'My teacher recommended this book.' Here 'recommended' means the teacher…
kahoot.explain: Recommend — tavsiya qilmoq, ya'ni yaxshi deb maslahat bermoq.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is a paraphrase of 'I'd like to book a room'?
options: I'd like to reserve a room
I'd like to read about a room
I'd like to clean a room
I'd like to leave a room
kahoot.explain: Book = reserve (band qilmoq). Paraphrase — bir xil ma'no, boshqa so'z.

kahoot.q: Which question asks for your date of birth?
kahoot.explain: Date of birth — tug'ilgan sana: "When were you born?"

lessons.title: Listening: Multiple Choice (Part 1 — review)
lessons.grammar_topic: Multiple choice (listening) — A, B yoki C (takrorlash, qiyinroq)
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ustoz bergan audiolar (CD2 Track 8 writing course, Track 17 book fair) va 3 ta mualliflik skripti.
objectives: 9-darsdagi listening MCQ ko'nikmasini qiyinroq audiolarda takrorlash.
Ko'pincha (USUALLY) uchala variant ham audioda tilga olinishini, ba'zan esa bir variant umuman aytilmasligini bilib, faqat savolga aniq javob beradiganini tanlash.
O'zgargan ma'lumotni ushlash: "it used to be £20, but it's £25 now".
So'zlovchining FIKRI yoki MASLAHATINI so'raydigan savollarni ishlash ("The woman says the cafés are ...").
Sinfda 4 ta mashq (2 ta ustoz audiosi + 2 ta skript), uyda 1 ta (5-skript, Choosing a phone plan) bajarish.
materials: CD2 Track 8 (ielts5_24_writing_course.mp3) va Track 17 (ielts5_24_book_fair.mp3) — qo'ng'iroqdan oldin qurilmada ochib, ovozi sinab ko'riladi; ikkalasi ham darsda faqat BIR MARTA qo'yiladi.
6-10-savollar (The writing course) va 8-12-savollar (Book Fair) A, B, C variantlari bilan — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa; transkriptlar alohida varaqda va faqat tinglab bo'lgandan keyin tarqatiladi.

Doska dars boshlanishidan oldin tayyor bo'lsin: "ko'pincha uchala variant ham tilga olinadi, ba'zan bittasi umuman aytilmaydi" qoidasi va 4 ta tuzoq nomi — eski raqam / rad etilgan / taklif-tanlov / baho.

"Tuzoqni toping" sinf mashqi uchun 5 ta kartochka kesib qo'yiladi: OLD tomonida ustoz o'qiydigan qisqa gap va savol (A, B, C), ORQA tomonida javob va tuzoq turi. Gaplar audiolardan olinmagan — Track 8 va Track 17 javoblari tinglashdan oldin ochilmaydi; audiodagi variantlar tahlili ("Uchala variant qayerda?", "Taklif yoki tanlov?") tinglangandan KEYIN Listening bo'limida qilinadi.

3 ta Jony Academy skripti (Booking a cooking class, Asking about a bike hire scheme, Choosing a phone plan) — audiosi yo'q. Sinfdagi ikkitasini (cooking class, bike hire) ustoz ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, ularning matni faqat ustozda turadi, o'quvchilarga faqat savollar beriladi. Uyga beriladigan 5-skript (Choosing a phone plan) uyga vazifa varag'iga chop etiladi: savollar old tomonda, transkript orqa tomonda — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa.
Har o'quvchida xatolar daftari va qalam — tahlil bosqichida har bir noto'g'ri javob sababi bilan yoziladi.
timeline: Salomlashish; 23-dars uyga vazifasi: "Hotel booking by phone" javoblari (6 ta) tez tekshiriladi, Harflab yozish va Tuzatish daftari yig'iladi
Ustoz doskada: listening MCQ qoidasi (ko'pincha uchala variant tilga olinadi, ba'zan bittasi umuman aytilmaydi), 4 tuzoq turi, 6 bosqich, tipik xatolar (misollar audiodan olinmagan)

"Tuzoqni toping" — 5 kartochka: ustoz avval savol va A, B, C variantlarini, so'ng gapni bir marta o'qiydi; o'quvchi javob harfini aytadi va qolgan ikki variant tuzoqmi yoki umuman aytilmaganmi — tushuntiradi; tuzoq turlari doskadagi ustunlarga yoziladi
Track 8 va Track 17 savol varaqlari: har savolda nima so'ralayotgani belgilanadi, A, B, C variantlardagi so'zlarga audioda qanday sinonim kelishi mumkinligi taxmin qilinadi
The writing course: savollarni o'qish, BIR MARTA tinglash, kalit why bilan; "Uchala variant qayerda?" tahlili
Book Fair: o'quvchilar mustaqil — savollarni o'qish, BIR MARTA tinglash, tekshirish va "Taklif yoki tanlov?" tahlili

"Booking a cooking class" va "Asking about a bike hire scheme" — ustoz bir marta ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (audio yo'q); juftlikda tekshirish: har savolda qolgan variantlar tuzoqmi yoki umuman aytilmaganmi
Xatolar daftari — ustunlar: savol | mening javobim | to'g'ri javob | sabab (AYTILMAGAN / TESKARI (inkor) / BOSHQA NARSA-ODAM / KUCHLI SO'Z / BOSHQA SON-VAQT / SO'Z CHEGARASI)
Uyga vazifa varag'i tarqatiladi: 5-skript "Choosing a phone plan", Uchala variant daftari, Tuzoq turlari; xatolar daftari to'ldiriladi

intro: Listening MCQ — savol va 3 variant (A, B, C). Savollar audio tartibida (ALWAYS). 23-darsdagi form completion audiolari shu yerda davom etadi: bir suhbat, ikki savol turi.

Birinchi qoida (9-darsdan): ko'pincha (USUALLY) uchala variant ham audioda biror shaklda tilga olinadi, lekin ba'zan bir variant umuman aytilmaydi — u ham chalg'ituvchi, uni tez o'chiring. Ehtiyot bo'ling: to'g'ri javob odatda boshqa so'zlar bilan (paraphrase) aytiladi — so'zma-so'z eshitilmagan variant hali "aytilmagan" degani emas; faqat MA'NOSI ham aytilmagan variantni o'chiring. Tanlashdan oldin savolga qayting: nima so'ralyapti?
Tuzoq 1 — o'zgargan raqam: "It used to be £20, but it went up to £25 last month". Hozirgi narx so'ralsa — £25.
Tuzoq 2 — rad etilgan variant: "I was going to join the tennis club, but in the end I chose swimming — the pool is closer to home" — tennis rad etildi, javob swimming.
Tuzoq 3 — so'zlovchining fikri: "The rooms are fine, I suppose, but the breakfast is really disappointing" — nonushta haqida so'ralsa, javob "poor"; "fine" xonalar haqida.
Tuzoq 4 — taklif va tanlov: "You can pay the whole amount now or in two parts." — "I'll pay in two parts, then." Xodim ikki imkoniyat taklif qiladi; javob — mijoz TANLAGANI (in two parts).
presentation: Uchala variant ham eshitildi.

Normal — bu ko'p uchraydi. Qaysi biri savolga aniq javob — shuni tanlang. Bir variantning ma'nosi umuman aytilmasa, u javob emas; lekin to'g'ri javob odatda boshqa so'zlar bilan aytiladi — so'zma-so'z eshitilmadi deb o'chirmang.
Narx ikki marta aytildi.
Savol nimani so'rayotganiga qarang — odatda hozirgi narx: "It used to be £20, but it's £25 now" → £25.
Ikki imkoniyat aytildi, qaysi biri?
Keyin "I'll go for that option" kabi tanlovni kuting.
So'zlovchi fikrini qanday bilaman?
"but", "unless", "to be honest", "I wouldn't recommend it" — baho so'zlari.
Savollar tartibdami?
Ha, ALWAYS.
Javobni o'tkazib yubordim.
Keyingi savolga o'ting; oxirida eng ehtimollisini belgilang.
notes: CD2 Track 8 — 23-darsdagi Track 7 (Alex, writing course) ning davomi; Track 17 — 23-darsdagi Track 16 (book fair) ning davomi. O'quvchilar suhbatni taniydi, e'tibor savol turiga qaratiladi.
Ustoz kaliti (faqat ustoz uchun): Track 8 — 6 B, 7 A, 8 B, 9 C, 10 C; Track 17 — 8 B, 9 A, 10 A, 11 C, 12 B.
Har savoldan keyin so'rang: "qolgan ikki variant audioda qanday eshitildi yoki umuman aytilmadimi?"
mistakes: "I thought about X, but ..." — X javob emas
Taklif qilingan variantni tanlov deb o'ylash

core: The course pack contains a workbook and a set of practice tests.
Kurs to'plamida ish daftari va bir nechta mashq testlari bor.
The course fee includes all the books and materials.
Kurs to'lovi barcha kitob va materiallarni o'z ichiga oladi.
If you cancel within two weeks, the school will refund your money.
Agar ikki hafta ichida bekor qilsangiz, maktab pulingizni qaytarib beradi.
I wanted the red phone, but I changed my mind and took the black one.
Men qizil telefonni xohlagandim, lekin fikrimdan qaytib, qorasini oldim.
Each lesson ends with a short writing assignment.
Har bir dars qisqa yozma topshiriq bilan tugaydi.
Every student has a personal tutor who checks their progress.
Har bir talabaning o'sishini kuzatib boradigan shaxsiy ustozi bor.
My teacher gives detailed feedback on every essay.
Ustozim har bir inshoga batafsil fikr-mulohaza bildiradi.
Her ambition is to study medicine in London.
Both hotels look nice, but I'll go for the one near the beach.
Ikkala mehmonxona ham yaxshi ko'rinadi, lekin men dengiz bo'yidagisini tanlayman.
You only need four ingredients to make this soup.
Bu sho'rvani tayyorlash uchun atigi to'rtta masalliq kerak.
The school has modern equipment in every classroom.
Maktabning har bir sinfxonasida zamonaviy jihozlar bor.
I signed a two-year contract with my mobile phone company.
Men mobil aloqa kompaniyam bilan ikki yillik shartnoma imzoladim.
We hired bikes and rode along the river.
Biz velosiped ijaraga olib, daryo bo'ylab yurdik.
The hotel offers its guests unlimited coffee and tea.
Mehmonxona mehmonlariga cheklanmagan miqdorda qahva va choy taklif qiladi.

class_ex.title: Tuzoqni toping
class_ex.instr: Ustoz avval savolni va A, B, C variantlarini o'qiydi (yoki doskaga yozadi), o'quvchilar ularni ko'rib oladi; so'ng qo'shtirnoq ichidagi gapni BIR MARTA o'qiydi. O'quvchi javob harfini aytadi, keyin qolgan ikki variant tuzoqmi (gapda tilga olindi, lekin javob emas) yoki umuman aytilmaganmi — shuni tushuntiradi.
items: "It was £60 last year and it's £70 this year. Next year it'll probably be £80." How much does the trip cost this year? A) £60 B) £70 C) £80
"I thought about the Spanish course, but in the end French seemed more useful." Which course does she choose? A) Spanish B) French C) German

"We have rooms with a balcony, rooms with a view of the park and quieter rooms on the ground floor." — "I need to sleep well, so I'll go for a quiet one." Which room does the guest choose? A) a room with a balcony B) a room with a park view C) a room on the ground floor

"The museum itself is interesting, but to be honest, you can never find a space in the car park." What does the speaker say about the car park? A) It is often full. B) It is interesting. C) It is free.
"Most people choose the monthly ticket, but I'm only here for a week, so the weekly one makes more sense." Which ticket does the speaker buy? A) a monthly ticket B) a weekly ticket C) a day ticket
why: Uchala raqam ham aytildi — savolga qayting: "this year" → £70. A — o'tgan yil, C — kelasi yil (taxmin).
Rad etilgan variant: "I thought about ..., but" — A rad etildi. C (German) umuman aytilmagan — darhol o'chiriladi.
Uchala variant ham tilga olindi; javob — mehmon TANLAGANI: "a quiet one" = ground floor ("quieter rooms"). A va B — faqat taklif.
Baho: "you can never find a space" = often full (paraphrase). B tuzoq: "interesting" — muzey haqida. C umuman aytilmagan.
Tuzoq: "most people choose" — boshqalarning tanlovi, so'zlovchiniki emas. C (day ticket) umuman aytilmagan.
class_ex.note: Gaplar audiolardan olinmagan: 1 va 3-bandda uchala variant ham eshitiladi, 2, 4, 5-bandda bittasi umuman aytilmaydi — ko'pincha uchalasi tilga olinadi, lekin har doim emas. Audiodagi variantlar tahlili tinglangandan keyin Listening bo'limida qilinadi. 4-bandda A so'zma-so'z aytilmagan, lekin ma'nosi aytilgan ("never find a space" = often full) — bu "aytilmagan" emas, paraphrase; C esa umuman aytilmagan. Mashq paytida bu bo'limni proyektorga chiqarmang (bandda gap matni yozilgan) — savol va A, B, C variantlarini ustoz o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi.

listenings.title: CD2 Track 8. The writing course — questions
intro: 23-darsdagi Alex endi yozuv kursi haqida savol beradi. Avval 6–10-savollar va variantlarni o'qing, kalit so'zlarni belgilang. Keyin BIR MARTA tinglang.
Ko'rsatma: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
transcript: ADVISOR: Now, you can see on our website that we have a lot of courses ... what are you interested in doing?
CALLER: Well, I don't want to publish anything. I just want to raise the standard of my own writing.
ADVISOR: Yes, it depends on whether you want to, you know, write creatively or for fun. We also have fiction writing – that includes writing children's stories.
CALLER: Well, I work in an advertising agency, so ... I'd like to write better so that ... well, I'd like my salary to rise.
ADVISOR: OK, so we can send you our brochure for business writing and if you think it'll be right for you, then you can enrol.
CALLER: Great. What happens after that?
ADVISOR: Then we send you the course pack.
CALLER: What does that contain?
ADVISOR: You get some books that will help you with your writing skills, an audio course on CDs and instructional DVDs to watch, and some lesson texts to read.
CALLER: OK. What if I change my mind?
ADVISOR: Well, you can send the materials back to us. You have 21 days to decide, and we'll refund your fees within that time.
CALLER: Ah, that's quite good. I see. So the enrolment fee includes the course materials?
ADVISOR: Yes, it does – for all our courses.
CALLER: So are there different fees for different courses?

ADVISOR: Yes, at the moment, your course is ... let me see. They've just raised the prices ... it was £340, but I think it's £375 now. Yes, fees rose a month ago, I'm afraid, um, by ten percent – most of our courses are now between three and four hundred pounds.
CALLER: OK, that's not bad – so, who will teach me?
ADVISOR: Well, before we decide that, you do your first written assignment. It's like a personal profile.
CALLER: So I write about things like my background and where I was brought up?
ADVISOR: No, it's the future we're interested in.
CALLER: Oh, OK, so ... what I want to get from the course, and how it will help me to achieve my ambitions?
ADVISOR: That's right. We get a picture of who you are and your needs and then we match you to a personal tutor who will teach you and work with you.
CALLER: That's a good idea. And how do I get that to you?
ADVISOR: Well, you send it in to us by post or through our website.
CALLER: What about lessons?
ADVISOR: There are 15 lessons altogether, and each one has an assignment.
CALLER: And what sort of feedback will I get?
ADVISOR: There's continuous online support, and part of that is a web-based facility for all the students on your programme to get together.
CALLER: Oh, so we can share ideas and things?
ADVISOR: That's right. With no need to go into a classroom or be tied to weekly schedules.
CALLER: OK. Thanks, I think that's all my questions.
ADVISOR: Don't hesitate to call if you have any more.
CALLER: OK, thanks. Bye.

tasks.title: Questions 6–10: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C
items: 6 The caller wants to do a writing course to help with A) his hobby. B) his job. C) his children's education.
7 What does the course pack include? A) multimedia items B) a list of books to buy C) lesson and assignment dates
8 How much does the course cost? A) £340 B) £375 C) £400
9 Alex's first assignment will be about his A) family life. B) school experiences. C) expectations of the course.
10 What does the feedback include? A) a tutorial B) an exercise C) a discussion group
why: "I work in an advertising agency ... I'd like my salary to rise". A tuzoq: "write creatively or for fun" — xodim taklifi. C tuzoq: "children's stories" — fiction kursining bir qismi.
"Books ... an audio course on CDs and instructional DVDs ... lesson texts". CD va DVD = multimedia. B tuzoq: kitoblar BERILADI, sotib olish ro'yxati emas. C — 15 ta dars aytilgan, sanalar emas.
"It was £340, but I think it's £375 now". A — eski narx. C tuzoq: "between three and four hundred pounds" — umumiy oraliq.
"What I want to get from the course, and how it will help me to achieve my ambitions?" — "That's right". A, B tuzoq: "my background and where I was brought up?" — "No, it's the future".

"A web-based facility for all the students on your programme to get together ... share ideas". A tuzoq: personal tutor bor, lekin "tutorial" feedback sifatida aytilmagan. B tuzoq: har darsda assignment bor — feedback emas.
tasks.note: Ustoz kaliti: 6 B · 7 A · 8 B · 9 C · 10 C. Eng yaxshi tuzoq — 9-savol: A va B birga rad etiladi ("No, it's the future").

tasks.title: Uchala variant qayerda?
tasks.instr: Rad etilgan variantlar audioda qanday eshitildi?
items: 6 A (hobby)
9 A/B (family, school)
why: Xodim taklifi.
Eski narx.
Rad.

listenings.title: Track 17. Book Fair — tickets, talks and food
intro: 23-darsdagi Angus endi chipta yuborish, muallif uchrashuvlari, yo'l va ovqat haqida so'raydi. Avval savollarni o'qing, keyin BIR MARTA tinglang.
Ko'rsatma: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
transcript: CALLER: How will you send the tickets?
ADVISOR: I can give you a couple of options. The first is by email, but of course you'll need to print them out yourself. Alternatively, there's 24 Hour Speedmail.
CALLER: What's that?
ADVISOR: Well, we send them to you by mail, and you'll get them the next day. We'll also send you a text message to your mobile to let you know they're on their way.
CALLER: I think I'll go for that option.
ADVISOR: Fine. Now, you had some questions?
CALLER: Yes, I understand that there are some talks being given by authors. There's one in particular I'd like to go to, by the novelist Sandra Harrington. Do you know what she'll be talking about?

ADVISOR: Well, she's got a new novel which just came out, so she'll be talking about that, and will probably read a few bits from it. She'll also be answering some questions about the book she wrote last year, er, I can't remember what it was called ...
CALLER: Fire and Eagles?
ADVISOR: That's the one. You'll probably remember she got into a bit of trouble because some people said she had copied another writer's ideas. So, it should be quite interesting.
CALLER: And do I need to book a place in advance if I want to go to one of the talks?

ADVISOR: You do, yes. You need tickets, and you can only get them in advance, by filling in a form on our website. You then pick them up from the ticket office when you arrive at the fair. We'll send you more information about the talks when we send you your tickets for the fair itself.
CALLER: How much are they?
ADVISOR: Oh, nothing, they're free.
CALLER: Great, thanks. And what's the best way of getting to the fair from the city centre?
ADVISOR: Are you driving?
CALLER: Probably not, what with the way the traffic is these days.
ADVISOR: Well, Duke's Court underground station is only a minute's walk away. Does that help?
CALLER: I'm only a short walk from a station at my end, so that's probably my best option. OK, one last question. Is there anywhere to eat at the fair?
ADVISOR: Oh, there are lots of cafés and restaurants there. They're generally OK, but unless you're prepared to spend a fortune on a sandwich and a cold drink, I'd go somewhere else.
CALLER: Such as?
ADVISOR: Well, you'll be much better off going to one of the cafés or restaurants in the streets nearby. Don't tell anyone I said that, though.
CALLER: I won't! Thanks. So, how should I pay for ...

tasks.title: Questions 8–12: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C
items: 8 How will the woman send the man's tickets? A) by email B) by post C) by text message
9 The author Sandra Harrington will A) tell people about her latest book. B) read extracts from one of her earlier books. C) explain where writers get their ideas from.
10 To go to one of the author talks, the man must A) reserve some tickets online before he goes. B) buy tickets from the Book Fair office. C) complete a form which the woman will send to him.
11 How will the man get to the fair from the city centre? A) by car B) on foot C) by public transport
12 The woman says that the cafés and restaurants at the Book Fair are A) very good. B) extremely expensive. C) better than other places in the area.
why: "24 Hour Speedmail ... we send them to you by mail" — "I think I'll go for that option". A tuzoq: birinchi taklif, tanlanmagan. C tuzoq: SMS faqat xabar beradi, chipta emas.

"She's got a new novel which just came out, so she'll be talking about that". B tuzoq: parchalarni YANGI kitobdan o'qiydi, eskisi haqida savollarga javob beradi. C tuzoq: "copied another writer's ideas" — janjal haqida, tushuntirish emas.
"You can only get them in advance, by filling in a form on our website". B tuzoq: ofisdan faqat OLADI, sotib olmaydi — bepul. C tuzoq: forma saytda, pochta bilan emas.
"Probably not [driving] ... Duke's Court underground station ... that's probably my best option". A teskari. B tuzoq: "a minute's walk" — stansiyadan yarmarkagacha, butun yo'l emas.

"Unless you're prepared to spend a fortune on a sandwich and a cold drink". Spend a fortune = extremely expensive. A tuzoq: "generally OK" — "very good" emas. C teskari: "much better off going to ... the streets nearby".
tasks.note: Ustoz kaliti: 8 B · 9 A · 10 A · 11 C · 12 B. Bu audioda deyarli har savolda ikkita imkoniyat taklif qilinadi — javob TANLANGANI (8, 11) yoki so'zlovchining BAHOSI (12).

tasks.title: Taklif yoki tanlov?
why: "I'll go for that option".
"my best option".
Baho — qimmat.

listenings.title: Booking a cooking class
intro: Mijoz oshpazlik darsiga yozilish uchun qo'ng'iroq qilmoqda. Avval savollarni o'qing, keyin bir marta tinglang.
transcript: STAFF: Good morning, The Kitchen Studio.
CALLER: Hi. I'm interested in your cooking classes. Which ones do you have?
STAFF: We do Italian, Indian and Japanese. The Italian class is the most popular, but it's full this month.
CALLER: Oh. What about Japanese?
STAFF: There are still a few places in that one.
CALLER: Great, I'll book that. How long is each class?
STAFF: It used to be two hours, but now it's three, because people wanted more time to eat what they'd made.
CALLER: Lovely. Do I need to bring anything?
STAFF: We provide all the ingredients and equipment. Just bring a container if you want to take food home.
CALLER: And the price?
STAFF: It's 45 pounds a class, or 160 for four if you book them together.

kahoot.q: In IELTS listening multiple choice, the questions follow…
options: an order chosen by the examiner
kahoot.explain: Savollar audio tartibida keladi — 6-savol javobi 7-savol javobidan oldin eshitiladi.

kahoot.q: You hear all three options (A, B and C) mentioned. What does this usually mean?
options: All three of them are correct

kahoot.q: Option C is never mentioned, not even in other words. Option C is…
kahoot.explain: Variant hatto boshqa so'zlar bilan ham aytilmagan bo'lsa, u javob bo'la olmaydi — uni o'chiring (to'g'ri javob esa odatda paraphrase bilan aytiladi).

kahoot.q: 'It used to cost £30, but now it's £35.' How much does it cost now?
kahoot.explain: Eski raqam tuzog'i: "used to ... but now" — hozirgi narx £35.

kahoot.q: 'I thought about the evening class, but I'll take the morning one.' Which class does the speaker choose?
kahoot.explain: "I thought about ..., but" — evening rad etildi, tanlov: morning.

kahoot.q: 'We can deliver it on Monday or Wednesday.' — 'Wednesday suits me better.' When will it be delivered?
kahoot.explain: Xodim ikki kunni taklif qiladi; javob — mijoz tanlagani (Wednesday). Tuesday umuman aytilmagan.

kahoot.q: Which phrase shows that the speaker has CHOSEN an option?
kahoot.explain: "I'll take / I'll go for ..." — tanlov; qolganlari faqat taklif yoki boshqalar fikri.

kahoot.q: 'The rooms are OK, but the staff are rather unfriendly.' What does the speaker criticise?
kahoot.explain: "but" dan keyingi qism — tanqid: staff. "OK" xonalar haqida, tanqid emas.

kahoot.q: Which word often introduces a contrast that changes the answer?
kahoot.explain: "However", "but", "actually" — fikr o'zgarishi signali; undan keyingi gap muhim.

kahoot.q: What should you do BEFORE the recording starts?
kahoot.explain: Savol va variantlardagi kalit so'zlarni belgilang — nima so'ralayotganini oldindan biling.

kahoot.q: 'The blue jacket is cheaper, but the black one fits better, so I'll take the black one.' Which jacket does the speaker buy?
kahoot.explain: "so I'll take the black one" — yakuniy tanlov; "cheaper" faqat taqqoslash.

kahoot.q: 'It was £50 last year and it's £55 this year.' The question asks about LAST year. The answer is…
kahoot.explain: Savol "last year" haqida — £50. Har doim ham oxirgi raqam javob emas: savolga qayting.

kahoot.q: A 'refund' is…
options: a fee for joining a course
kahoot.explain: Refund — to'langan pulni qaytarib berish.

kahoot.q: 'If you change your mind, you can send it back.' 'Change your mind' means…
kahoot.explain: Change your mind — fikridan qaytmoq, boshqa qaror qabul qilmoq.

kahoot.q: The course 'fee' is…
options: the money you pay for it
the teacher who runs the course
kahoot.explain: Fee — kurs yoki xizmat uchun to'lanadigan pul.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'a piece of work that a student must complete'?
kahoot.explain: Assignment — o'quvchi bajarib topshiradigan vazifa.

kahoot.q: 'Feedback' from a tutor is…
kahoot.explain: Feedback — ishingiz haqidagi fikr va izohlar.

kahoot.q: Which of these is 'equipment' in a gym?
kahoot.explain: Equipment — jihoz, asbob-uskuna: mashq qilish mashinasi. Trainer — odam, changing room — xona.

kahoot.q: 'I'll go for the cheaper option.' Here 'go for' means…
kahoot.explain: Go for (an option) — tanlamoq.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses 'hire' correctly?

We hired for bikes all day.
Bikes hired us for the day.
We hired to ride by the river.
kahoot.explain: Hire + narsa: "hire bikes" — velosiped ijaraga olmoq. "Hire" dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot keladi.

lessons.title: Reading: Matching Information
lessons.grammar_topic: Matching information — ma'lumot qaysi xatboshida? (+ table completion)
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ustoz matnlari (Speed reading, #28 Graphic novels) va mualliflik matnlari.
objectives: "Which paragraph contains the following information?" savolida ma'lumotni xatboshidan topish.
Matching headings va matching information farqini tushunish: sarlavha — asosiy g'oya; ma'lumot — xatboshi ichidagi bitta detal.
Savoldagi ma'lumot turini aniqlash: definition, example, reason, number, comparison, description.
"NB You may use any letter more than once" qoidasidan foydalanish.
Table completion bilan birgalikda ishlash (ikki savol turi bitta matnda).
materials: "Speed reading" matni A–H xatboshilari harflari ko'rinib turgan holda, 1–6 matching savollari va 7–13 "Chunking" jadvali (kataklari bo'sh) bilan — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa; bu darsning asosiy matni.
"Reading #28. Graphic novels" matni (A–H), 1–7 matching savollari va 8–14 jadvali glossariysi bilan — har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa (1-qo'shimcha reading).

"The long story of the umbrella" va "Why we forget" matnlari (A–E, glossariysi bilan) — har o'quvchiga bittadan; bu darsda audio yo'q. "Why we forget" Reading + speaking bosqichida o'quvchilarning o'zi o'qiydi (matching information xatboshi harflarini ko'rishni talab qiladi, shuning uchun matn ovoz chiqarib o'qilmaydi), keyin juftlikda "How do you study for exams?" savoli muhokama qilinadi.

Sinf mashqi "Ma'lumot turini ayting" uchun beshta savol alohida qirqilgan kartochka qilib tayyorlansin ("a definition of speed reading", "the fastest reading speeds", "the types of people who need to read more quickly", "why reading material should be interesting", "how a reader can become confused") — har juftlikka bitta to'plam.

Uyga vazifa varaqasi "How the bicycle was invented" (A–E matni va 1–6 savollari) — har o'quvchiga bitta, dars oxirida tarqatiladi; orqa tomonida Graphic novels xatboshilari uchun A dan H gacha sakkizta belgilangan bo'sh qator bo'lsin.

Doskada qo'ng'iroqqacha: ikki ustun — "HEADING = butun xatboshining asosiy g'oyasi" va "INFORMATION = xatboshi ichidagi bitta detal"; yonida ma'lumot turlari ro'yxati (ta'rif, raqam, sabab, misol, muammo, natija) va yirik harflar bilan "NEVER — savollar matn tartibida emas" hamda "NB You may use any letter more than once". O'quvchilarda xatolar daftari, qalam va xatboshi chetiga izoh yozish uchun marker; ustozda soat yoki sekundomer — "The long story of the umbrella" (2-qo'shimcha reading) 8 daqiqada, vaqt bilan bajariladi.

intro: Matching information — xatboshilar A–H harf bilan belgilangan. Savol: "Which paragraph contains the following information?" Siz har ma'lumot qaysi xatboshida ekanini topasiz.
Bu savol turi NEVER guruhida: savollar matn tartibida KELMAYDI. Shuning uchun uni odatda oxirida, boshqa savollardan keyin ishlagan ma'qul — matn allaqachon tanish bo'ladi.
Headings bilan farqi: heading butun xatboshining asosiy g'oyasini beradi; information esa xatboshi ichidagi bitta kichik detalni so'raydi (raqam, misol, sabab, ta'rif).

Savoldagi birinchi so'zlar ma'lumot TURINI aytadi: "a definition of" — ta'rif; "the types of people" — misollar ro'yxati; "why" — sabab; "the fastest reading speeds" — raqam. Shu turdagi gapni qidiring.
NB You may use any letter more than once — bitta xatboshi ikki savolga javob bo'lishi mumkin (Speed reading: 2 va 5 — ikkalasi A). Ba'zi xatboshilar esa umuman ishlatilmaydi.
Paraphrase juda kuchli: "the types of people who need to read more quickly" = "Professional workers ... students". Aynan so'z kutmang.
presentation: Savollar tartibdami?
Yo'q (NEVER). Shuning uchun uni oxirida ishlang.
Bitta harf ikki marta bo'ladimi?
Ha, agar "NB You may use any letter more than once" yozilgan bo'lsa.
Headingdan farqi nima?
Heading — asosiy g'oya; information — xatboshi ichidagi bir detal.
Savoldagi so'z bir necha xatboshida bor.
Ma'lumot TURINI tekshiring: savol ta'rifmi, sababmi, raqammi?
Vaqt ko'p ketyapti.
Har xatboshi uchun 3–4 so'zlik qisqa izoh yozing — keyin qidirish oson.
Ba'zi xatboshilar javob bo'lmaydimi?
Ha, bo'lmasligi mumkin.

readings.title: Speed reading
text: What is speed reading, and why do we need it?

A. _Speed reading is not just about reading fast._ It is also about how much information you can remember when you have finished reading. The World Championship Speed-Reading Competition says that its _top competitors average between 1,000 and 2,000 words a minute_. But they must remember at least 50 percent of this in order to qualify for the competition.

B. Nowadays, speed reading has become an essential skill in any environment where people have to master a large volume of information. _Professional workers_ need reading skills to help them get through many documents every day, while _students_ under pressure to deal with assignments may feel they have to read more and read faster all the time.

C. Although there are various methods to increase reading speed, _the trick is deciding what information you want first_. For example, if you only want a rough outline of an issue, then you can skim the material quickly and extract the key facts. However, if you need to understand every detail in a document, then you must read it slowly enough to understand this.

D. Even when you know how to ignore irrelevant detail, there are other improvements you can make to your reading style which will increase your speed. For example, most people can read much faster if they read silently. Reading each word aloud takes time for the information to make a complete circuit in your brain before being pronounced. Some researchers believe that as long as the first and last letters are in place, the brain can still understand the arrangement of the other letters in the word because it logically puts each piece into place.

E. Chunking is another important method. Most people learn to read either letter by letter or word by word. As you improve, this changes. You will probably find that you are fixing your eyes on a block of words, then moving your eyes to the next block of words, and so on. You are reading blocks of words at a time, not individual words one by one. You may also notice that you do not always go from one block to the next: sometimes you may move back to a previous block if you are unsure about something.

F. A skilled reader will read _a lot of words_ in each block. He or she will only look at each block for an instant and will then move on. _Only rarely_ will the reader's eyes skip back to a previous block of words. This reduces the amount of work that the reader's _eyes_ have to do. It also increases _the volume of information_ that can be taken in over a given period of time.

G. On the other hand, a _slow reader_ will spend a lot of time reading small blocks of words. He or she will _skip back often_, losing the flow and structure of the text, and _muddling their overall understanding_ of the subject. This irregular eye movement quickly makes the reader _tired_. Poor readers tend to dislike reading because they feel it is difficult to _concentrate_ and comprehend written information.

H. The best tip anyone can have to improve their reading speed is to practise. In order to do this effectively, a person must be _engaged in the material_ and want to know more. If you find yourself constantly having to re-read the same paragraph, you may want to switch to reading material that grabs your attention. _If you enjoy what you are reading, you will make quicker progress._

readings.title: Reading #28. Graphic novels
readings.qtype: Matching information (1–7) + Table completion (8–14) — qo'shimcha mashq
text: People who think graphic novels are just comics with a different name should think again

A. Graphic novels, as the name suggests, are books written and illustrated in the style of a comic book. The term graphic novel was first used in 1978 by author and artist Will Eisner to distinguish a comic novel he had written and illustrated from newspaper comic strips. He described graphic novels as consisting of 'sequential art' — a series of illustrations which, when viewed in order, tell a story.

B. Although today's graphic novels are a recent phenomenon, this basic way of telling stories has been used in various forms _for centuries. Early cave drawings, hieroglyphics and medieval tapestries_ are examples of this. _The term graphic novel is now generally used to describe_ any book in a comic format that resembles a novel in length and narrative development.

C. _Many adults feel that graphic novels are not the type of reading material that will help young people become good readers._ They believe that graphic novels are somehow a bad influence that prevent 'real' reading. In other words, they think that they are not 'real' books.

D. However, many quality graphic novels are now being seen as _a method of storytelling on the same level as novels, films or audio books_. From originally appealing to a small following of enthusiasts, they are now being accepted by librarians and teachers as proper literature for children and young adults. The main advantages are that they promote literacy, and attract and motivate young people to read.

E. How do we know this? In the last few years, teachers and school libraries have reported outstanding success getting children to read with graphic novels. Many have mentioned the motivational factor of the graphic novel. This has been especially true with children who are usually _reluctant_ to read, especially boys. The _colourful pictures_ attract them, and then encourage them to find out what the _story_ is about. Providing young people of all abilities with a wide range of reading materials, including graphic novels, can help them become lifelong readers.

F. Furthermore, one of the main benefits of a graphic novel is that it can help students who are learning a foreign _language_, and who are having problems improving their _reading skills_. This is because _the pictures provide clues to the meaning of the words_. Language learners are therefore more motivated by graphic novels, and will acquire new _vocabulary_ more quickly.

G. Many teachers have reported great success when they have used graphic novels with their students, especially _in the areas of English, social studies and art_. They have discovered that, just like traditional forms of literature, they can be useful tools for helping students examine aspects of history, science, literature and art.

H. The idea that graphic novels are too simple to be regarded as serious reading is no longer valid. The excellent graphic novels available today demand many of the same skills that are needed to understand traditional works of fiction. Often they actually contain _more sophisticated vocabulary_ than traditional books. Reading them can help students develop the skills that are necessary to read more challenging works.
