kahoot.q: In Matching sentence endings, how many endings are there usually?
kahoot.explain: Oxirlar ko'proq beriladi — 2–3 tasi ortiqcha va ular ataylab "to'g'ridek" yozilgan.

kahoot.q: Which ending fits 'The engineers hoped …' grammatically?
options: to finish the bridge by May.
kahoot.explain: "hope" dan keyin "to + fe'l" (yoki "that + gap") keladi; qolgan oxirlar grammatik jihatdan ulanmaydi.

kahoot.q: Which ending fits 'The old bridge …' grammatically?
kahoot.explain: "The old bridge" — birlik, shuning uchun "was"; "were" ko'plik ega uchun.

kahoot.q: Two endings fit a beginning grammatically. What should you do next?
options: Check the meaning in the text
Pick the ending with text words
kahoot.explain: Grammatika variantlarni kamaytiradi, oxirgi qarorni matndagi joy va ma'no hal qiladi.

kahoot.q: The answers to Matching sentence endings usually …
options: follow the order of the text.
come from the final paragraph only.
kahoot.explain: Javoblar odatda (USUALLY) matn tartibida keladi: 3-savol javobi 2-savol javobidan keyinroq turadi.

kahoot.q: An ending is true according to the text, but it is about a different person. Is it the answer?
options: No, it must fit this beginning
Yes, any true ending is correct
Yes, if it uses words from the text
Only when no other ending is true
kahoot.explain: Eng katta tuzoq — to'g'ri fakt, lekin BOSHQA odam haqida. "Aynan shu bosh haqidami?" deb so'rang.

kahoot.q: Text: 'The library opened in 1990 and was rebuilt in 2010.' Which ending fits 'In 1990, the library …'?
kahoot.explain: 1990 — ochilgan yil, qayta qurish esa 2010 da bo'lgan: bu "boshqa vaqt" tuzog'i.

kahoot.q: Text: 'The festival attracts thousands of tourists every summer.' Which ending means the same: 'Every summer, the festival …'?
kahoot.explain: Attracts thousands of tourists = very popular with visitors — oxir matndagi fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan beradi.

kahoot.q: Text: 'The council did not approve the plan.' Which ending fits 'The council …'?
kahoot.explain: "did not approve" = rejected; "approved the plan" — teskari tuzoq, matndagi so'zni takrorlagani uchun jozibali.

kahoot.q: An ending uses exactly the same words as the text. What should you think?
options: It may be a trap — check the meaning
It is always the correct answer to choose
It is never correct in this question type
It must be the answer to question 1
kahoot.explain: Aynan so'z mosligi ko'pincha tuzoq: kim yoki nima haqida ekanini va ma'noni tekshiring.

kahoot.q: How many times can you normally use each ending (A–G)?
kahoot.explain: Har oxir bir marta ishlatiladi; ishlatilgan harfni o'chirib qo'ying.

kahoot.q: What do you write on the answer sheet for this question type?
kahoot.explain: Javob — faqat oxirning harfi (A–G); gapni ko'chirib yozish shart emas.

kahoot.q: A disease that has been 'eradicated' has been …
kahoot.explain: eradicate — butunlay yo'q qilmoq, ildizi bilan yo'qotmoq.

kahoot.q: 'At first, many doctors were doubtful about the new treatment.' Doubtful means …
kahoot.explain: doubtful — shubhali, ishonchi komil emas.

kahoot.q: The patient was very ill, but after a week she began to …
kahoot.explain: recover — tuzalmoq, sog'aymoq (become well again).

kahoot.q: A 'voyage' is …
options: a short walk in a park
kahoot.explain: voyage — uzoq dengiz safari.

kahoot.q: Which word means all the people who work on a ship or a plane?
kahoot.explain: crew — kema yoki samolyot ekipaji; passengers — yo'lovchilar.

kahoot.q: Scientists tried a new 'approach' to the problem. 'Approach' here means …
options: a way of dealing with it
a long road leading to it
kahoot.explain: approach — yondashuv, biror ishni qilish usuli.

kahoot.q: In the past, a 'merchant' was a person who …
kahoot.explain: merchant — savdogar: mol sotib olib, sotgan odam.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'a system of connected roads or routes'?
kahoot.explain: network — tarmoq; highway esa bitta katta yo'l.

intro: Listening testi taxminan 30 daqiqa: 4 section, har birida 10 savol. Audio BIR MARTA eshittiriladi. Qog'oz imtihonda oxirida javoblarni varaqqa ko'chirish uchun 10 daqiqa beriladi (kompyuterda — 2 daqiqa tekshirish).
Section'lar qiyinlashib boradi: S1 — kundalik suhbat (mehmonxona), S2 — monolog (hayvonot parki), S3 — o'quv suhbati (talabalar va o'qituvchi), S4 — akademik ma'ruza, PAUZASIZ.
Har section oldidan va S1–S3 ichidagi pauzalarda savollarni o'qishga vaqt beriladi. Bu vaqtni keyingi qismni o'qishga sarflang, o'tgan javobni o'ylashga emas.
S1 boshida namuna (Example) bor: "Arrival date — 23rd August". Namuna eshittirilgach, audio boshidan qayta boshlanadi — ovozlarga ko'nikish uchun.

Bu testdagi savol turlari: form completion (3, 23-dars), note completion (5-dars), map/plan labelling (17-dars), multiple choice (9, 24-dars), chart/graph tanlash (MCQ ning rasmli ko'rinishi), sentence completion (12-dars), Part 4 notes (30-dars).
Chart/graph savolida (26–27) so'zlarni emas, NISBATLARNI tinglang: "kichik foiz", "yarmidan ko'pi", "birinchi o'rinda", "eng kam foydali".
Test tugagach ustoz javoblarni o'qiydi; har o'quvchi to'g'ri javoblar sonini sanaydi va jadval bo'yicha band ballni topadi.
presentation: Audio necha marta eshittiriladi?
Bir marta. Test paytida to'xtatilmaydi va qayta qo'yilmaydi.
Javobni qayerga yozaman?
Test paytida savol varag'iga, oxirgi 10 daqiqada javob varag'iga ko'chiring.
Javobni o'tkazib yubordim.
To'xtamang, keyingi savolga o'ting. Oxirida taxminiy javob yozing — bo'sh joy aniq 0 ball.
Katta-kichik harf muhimmi?
Yo'q. "SCOTLAND" ham, "Scotland" ham to'g'ri. Imlo esa muhim.
"2 weeks" yoki "two weeks"?
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: raqamni raqam yoki so'z bilan yozish mumkin.
Kalitdagi qavs nimani anglatadi?
"(very) clean" — "clean" ham, "very clean" ham qabul qilinadi.
Qancha to'g'ri javob — qaysi band?
Pastdagi jadvalga qarang: 16–17 = 5.0, 23–25 = 6.0, 30–31 = 7.0.
notes: Bu dars — birinchi to'liq Listening testi. Maqsad — imtihon ritmini his qilish va zaif savol turlarini aniqlash.
Audio 4 faylga bo'lingan. Imtihon sharoiti uchun ketma-ket qo'ying, oralarida to'xtatmang — section ichidagi o'qish pauzalari audioning o'zida bor.

Tahlilda har xato bitta sababga yoziladi: eshitmadim / paraphrase'ni tanimadim / tuzoqqa tushdim / imlo / so'z chegarasi. Eng ko'p uchragan sabab 34-darsgacha ishlanadi.

listenings.title: Part 1. CD2 Track 31. Atlas Hotel — booking and tourist survey
intro: Ayol mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qilib xona bron qiladi (1–5), keyin turizm boshqarmasi uchun qisqa so'rovnomaga javob beradi (6–10). Avval namuna eshittiriladi, keyin audio boshidan qayta boshlanadi.
Savol varag'i: Part 1 — ikki forma (Hotel Booking Form; Tourist Board — Questions for holidaymakers). Ko'rsatma: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
transcript: To'liq transkript — kitobning Audio script qismida (CD2 Track 31). Bu yerda — qisqacha mazmun va javoblar joyi.
Namuna. Ayol do'stining tavsiyasi bilan qo'ng'iroq qiladi; ular 23-avgustga chipta olishgan. Shu joyda namuna tugaydi va audio boshidan qayta boshlanadi.

1–5. Xodim o'tgan hafta ikki bron bekor qilingani uchun xona borligini aytadi. Oila o'tgan yili bir hafta qolgan va bu yetarli bo'lmagan — bu safar ikki hafta (1). Ikki bola uchun yonma-yon xona yo'q, xodim oilaviy xonani taklif qiladi (2). Familiya harflab aytiladi (3). Xodim "Angliyami?" deb so'raydi — ayol tuzatadi: Shotlandiya, Dunbar shahri (4). Telefon raqamida "double 9" bor (5). Safar maqsadi — dam olish (formada berilgan).

6–10. Oila avval kelgani uchun xodim turizm boshqarmasi so'rovnomasini o'tkazadi. Ayolga xarid va sayr yoqadi, lekin oila bo'lib eng ko'p suzishni yoqtirishadi (6). Plyajlar biroz gavjum, lekin asosiysi — juda toza (7). Sotuvchilar ba'zan haddan tashqari yordam berishga urinadi — suvenir sotishga (8). Ovqat mazali, ofitsiantlar xushmuomala va tez (9). Taklif: mahalliy avtobuslar bor, lekin ijaraga velosiped yo'q (10).

listenings.title: Part 2. CD2 Track 32. Orana Wildlife Park
intro: Park xodimi tashrif buyuruvchilarga Orana Wildlife Park haqida gapiradi (11–15), keyin xarita bo'yicha yo'l ko'rsatadi (16–20). Xaritada avval "Main Entrance", ma'lumot markazi (I) va kompasni toping: shimol — tepada, sharq — o'ngda.
Savol varag'i: Part 2 — notes (11–15) va plan (16–20, harflar A–I). Ko'rsatma: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER (11–15); Write the correct letter, A–I (16–20).
transcript: To'liq transkript — kitobning Audio script qismida (CD2 Track 32). Bu yerda — qisqacha mazmun va javoblar joyi.

11–15. Xodim "Orana" so'zi mahalliy maori tilida "xush kelibsiz" degani ekanini aytadi (11). Parkni xayriya tashkiloti boshqaradi. U uchta raqam aytadi: maydon — 80 gektar, hayvonlar — 400 ta, turlar — 70 ta (12). Hayvonlar asosan Yangi Zelandiya, Avstraliya, Afrika va Janubiy Amerikadan. Uch shoxli Rothschild jirafalarini soat 12 va 3 da qo'l bilan boqish mumkin (13). Sigir va echkilarni silash mumkin bo'lgan joy kun bo'yi ochiq — bolalar uchun (14). Gepardlar har kuni 3.40 da soatiga 70 km gacha tezlikda "mashq yugurishi"ni bajaradi (15).

16–20. (Pauzadan keyin) Xodim va tinglovchilar asosiy kirishda turibdi, ma'lumot markazi o'ngda. Ertalabki sayr 10.45 da meerkatlar qo'rasidan boshlanadi: bolalar maydonchasi yonidan o'tadi, birinchi qo'rada — otters, keyingi qo'rada — Yangi Zelandiya qushlari (16), keyin sudralib yuruvchilar va yo'lbarslar. Afrika qishlog'i: kirishdan o'ngga buriling, birinchi avtobus bekatidan o'ting — Afrika yovvoyi itlari qo'rasidan oldin (17). Piknik joyi — parkning eng sharqida, bir tomonda tuyaqushlar, boshqa tomonda buffalo (18). Tushdan keyingi sayr: g'arbdagi sherlar maskaniga (Conservation Centre yonida) boring, ikki avtobus bekatidan o'ting, ikkinchisidan keyin taxminan yarim km — uchrashuv joyi; zebradan o'tib ketsangiz — uzoqlab ketgansiz (19). Safari avtobusining birinchi bekati — Jomo's Café: to'g'ri qarshida, jirafalar oldida (20).

listenings.title: Part 3. CD2 Track 33. Study-skills course — survey results
intro: Ikki talaba — Sylvie va Daniel — o'qituvchi Mr Driver oldida o'tgan semestrdagi study-skills kursi bo'yicha so'rovnoma natijalarini taqdim qiladi. 26-savol — doiraviy diagramma (A–C), 27-savol — ustunli grafik (A–C): rasmga qarang.
Savol varag'i: Part 3 — MCQ 21–25, chartlar 26–27, gaplar 28–30. Ko'rsatma: Choose the correct letter A, B or C (21–27); NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS (28–30).
transcript: To'liq transkript — kitobning Audio script qismida (CD2 Track 33). Bu yerda — qisqacha mazmun va javoblar joyi.

21–25. Kurs ixtiyoriy bo'lgan: imtihon kursining majburiy qismi emas va imtihon uchun kerak ham emas, lekin Mr Driver boshqa darslarga yordam beradi deb tavsiya qilgan (21). Talabalar yuzma-yuz intervyu o'rniga email orqali so'rovnoma yuborishgan, chunki boshqa ishlar ko'p edi va bu tezroq bo'lardi (22); javob berganlar ulushi 70% atrofida. Kursda 33 talaba, 12 mashg'ulot — har dushanba ertalab (23). Daniel endi qiyin matnlar (masalan, iqtisodiyot matnlari) bilan ishlashga o'zini qodirroq his qiladi; boshqa talabalar esa ko'proq kitob o'qiy boshlagan (24). O'qituvchi Jenny ko'p uy vazifasi bergani uchun emas, qiziqarli maqolalar va g'oyalar bergani uchun yoqqan (25).

26–30. Umumiy baho: faqat kichik foiz foydasiz degan, qolganlari ijobiy; yarmidan ko'pi — taxminan 60% — "juda foydali" (26). Qismlar: speed reading — birinchi o'rinda, giving talks — eng kam foydali, note-taking — ancha foydali (27). Izohlar: qayd yozish ma'ruzalarda diqqatni jamlashga yordam bergan (28); qachon diagramma yordamida qayd yozish haqidagi ko'rsatma yoqqan (29); qog'oz chetidagi keng hoshiya o'tkazib yuborilgan fikrlarni qo'shishga va qaydni keyin o'qishga qulay (30).

tasks.title: Questions 21–27: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C
tasks.instr: Savollar audio tartibida. 26–27 — rasmdagi chartlar. Bu yerda savollar mazmuni o'zbekcha berilgan (ustoz uchun); o'quvchilar kitobdagi inglizcha savol varag'idan ishlaydi.
items: 21 Talabalar study-skills kursiga nega qatnashgan? A) o'quv dasturining majburiy qismi bo'lgani uchun B) imtihonga tayyorlanish uchun kerak bo'lgani uchun C) tutor tavsiya qilgani uchun
22 Sylvie va Daniel nega so'rovnomadan foydalangan? A) boshqa talabalar shu usulni afzal ko'rgan B) tayyorgarlik vaqtini qisqartirgan C) ko'proq ma'lumot olish mumkin bo'lgan
23 Talabalar kurs uchun sinfda qanchalik tez-tez uchrashgan? A) haftada bir marta B) haftada ikki marta C) har ish kuni
24 Danielga kurs nega yoqqan? A) o'ziga ishonchini oshirgan B) iqtisodiyot maqolalariga qaratilgan C) ko'proq kitob o'qishga undagan
25 Talabalarga Jennyning nimasi yoqqan? A) uy vazifalari B) tanlagan o'quv materiallari C) o'qitish uslubi
26 Qaysi doiraviy diagramma kursning umumiy foydasini ko'rsatadi? A) juda foydali ~60%, foydasiz ~25% B) juda foydali ~45%, foydali ~50% C) juda foydali ~60%, foydali ~30%, foydasiz ~10%
27 Qaysi grafik kurs qismlarining foydasini ko'rsatadi? A) speed reading > giving talks > note-taking B) speed reading > note-taking > giving talks C) note-taking > speed reading > giving talks
why: Kurs ixtiyoriy bo'lgan, lekin Mr Driver foydali deb tavsiya qilgan. A tuzoq: "compulsory" so'zi aytiladi, lekin inkor bilan. B tuzoq: imtihon uchun kerak emasligi aytiladi.
Intervyu o'rniga email orqali so'rovnoma — boshqa ishlar ko'p edi va bu tezroq edi. A — aytilmagan. C tuzoq: javob foizi (70%) yaxshi bo'lgan, lekin bu sabab emas, natija.
12 mashg'ulot, har dushanba ertalab. C tuzoq: haftaning qolgan kunlari — o'rganganini amalda qo'llash, dars emas.
Daniel endi qiyin matnlar bilan ishlashga o'zini qodirroq his qiladi. B tuzoq: iqtisodiyot — faqat qiyin matnlarga misol. C tuzoq: bu BOSHQA talabalarning fikri.
Ko'p uy vazifasi bergani uchun emas — qiziqarli maqolalar va g'oyalar bergani uchun. A tuzoq: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri rad etiladi. C — uslub haqida aniq gap yo'q.
Faqat kichik foiz foydasiz deb hisoblagan; yarmidan ko'pi (taxminan 60%) — juda foydali. A: foydasiz ulushi katta. B: "juda foydali" yarmidan kam.
Speed reading birinchi o'rinda, giving talks eng kam foydali, note-taking ancha foydali — o'rtada. A: note-taking eng past. C: note-taking eng baland.
tasks.note: Kitob kaliti: 21 C · 22 B · 23 A · 24 A · 25 B · 26 C · 27 B. Chart savolida uch belgi yetarli: "kichik foiz" (sariq), "yarmidan ko'pi — 60%" (ko'k), "birinchi / eng kam" (tartib).

listenings.title: Part 4. CD2 Track 34. Airport design — lecture
intro: Arxitektura ma'ruzasi: aeroport dizayni yillar davomida qanday o'zgargani. PAUZA YO'Q — boshida barcha qaydlarni o'qing va sarlavhalarni belgilang: Reasons for changes (33–35), Inside the building (36–37), The exterior of the building (38–40).
Savol varag'i: Part 4 — Airport Design notes. Ko'rsatma: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
transcript: To'liq transkript — kitobning Audio script qismida (CD2 Track 34). Bu yerda — qisqacha mazmun va javoblar joyi.

31–32. 1960–70-yillarda aeroportlar kam va juda oddiy bo'lgan — avtovokzalga o'xshagan (31): asosiy e'tibor reyslarga qaratilgan, yo'lovchilarga emas. Hozir katta aeroport kichik shaharga ("mini city") o'xshaydi — transport markazi va do'konlar birlashgan (32).

33–35. O'zgarishning ikki sababi. Birinchisi — yo'lovchilar sonining keskin o'sishi: ommaviy turizm (arzon paket turlar, arzon aviakompaniyalar, mehmonxonalar) (33) va uchrashuvlar uchun safar qiladigan xalqaro biznesning o'sishi (34). Ikkinchisi — aeroport mamlakatni birinchi ko'radigan joy, u mamlakat haqida birinchi taassurotni yaratadi (35); shuning uchun aeroportlar "gateways" deb ataladi.

36–40. Ichki dizayn: qorong'i, yopiq aeroportlar o'rniga atrofga qaragan katta, ochiq maydonlar — masalan, Pekin aeroporti, ko'p joy va yorug'lik (36). Poyezdlar dizaynga kiritilgan, yo'laklar keng, odamlar o'zini xotirjam his qiladi — zamonaviy sayohat stressi kamaygan (37). Tashqi ko'rinish atrofga moslashtirilgan: Norvegiyadagi Arctic Circle aeroportining tomi tog'lar shaklida (38); Tailand va Hindistondagi aeroportlar atrofida soyali bog'lar (39). Oxirida: maxsus shisha kunduzgi yorug'likni oshiradi va energiya sarfini kamaytiradi, zamonaviy texnologiya xarajatlarni ham qisqartiradi (40).

homework_intro: Bugun birinchi marta to'liq Listening testini imtihon sharoitida bajardik va band ballni jadvaldan topdik; uyga vazifa esa ball haqida emas — maqsad qaysi savol turida yiqilganingizni aniqlash.

Birinchi vazifa — "Xato tahlili jadvali": har bir xatoingizni bitta qatorga yozing (savol raqami — savol turi — mening javobim — to'g'ri javob — sabab: eshitmadim / paraphrase'ni tanimadim / tuzoqqa tushdim / imlo / so'z chegarasi), bunga 10–15 daqiqa yetadi.

Ikkinchisi — "Part 3 ni qayta tinglash": CD2 Track 33 ni kitob transkripti bilan qayta tinglang va 21–27 savollarning har birida rad etilgan variant transkriptning qayerida aytilganini qalam bilan belgilang, taxminan 20 daqiqa; uchinchisi — "Zaif tur takrori": jadvalda eng ko'p takrorlangan tur bo'yicha bitta eski skriptni qaytadan bajaring (form — 3/23-dars, map — 17-dars, MCQ — 9/24-dars, Part 4 — 30-dars).

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — xatolarni shunchaki sanab, sabab o'rniga "e'tiborsizlik" deb yozib qo'yish: sabab aniq bo'lmasa jadval befoyda, shuning uchun har qatorga yuqoridagi beshta sababdan roppa-rosa bittasini tanlang.

Uchala vazifa ham bitta daftarga yoziladi. Keyingi dars — to'liq Reading testi, shuning uchun daftarni dars boshida menga topshirasiz: test davomida tekshiraman va test tugagach, xato tahlilidan oldin qaytaraman. Barcha xatolar sababi bilan yozilsa 2 coin, Part 3 ning yettita savolida rad etilgan variantlar belgilansa 1 coin, zaif tur takrori esa keyingi darslardagi mashqlarga asos bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: How many times do you hear each recording in the IELTS Listening test?
kahoot.explain: Audio faqat BIR MARTA eshittiriladi va to'xtatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: In the paper-based test, how long do you get at the end to transfer your answers?
kahoot.explain: Qog'oz imtihonda oxirida 10 daqiqa ko'chirish vaqti bor; kompyuterda esa atigi 2 daqiqa tekshirish.

kahoot.q: Which part of the Listening test has no pause in the middle?
kahoot.explain: Part 4 (akademik ma'ruza) pauzasiz — boshida barcha qaydlarni o'qib oling.

kahoot.q: What is the best use of the pause before a new part begins?
options: Wait for the recording to start
kahoot.explain: Pauzada keyingi savollarni o'qing va har bo'sh joy turini (ism, raqam, ot) belgilang.

kahoot.q: Instructions: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Which answer is NOT acceptable?
kahoot.explain: "a narrow street" — 3 so'z (artikl ham so'z). "12 narrow streets" = 2 so'z + raqam, bu mumkin.

kahoot.q: How is a hyphenated word such as 'part-time' counted?
kahoot.explain: Chiziqcha bilan yozilgan so'z bitta so'z hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: A speaker gives a number as 'oh-seven-double-four'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "oh" = 0, "double four" = 44: raqam ikki marta yoziladi.

kahoot.q: The speaker says 'two suitcases'. You write 'two suitcase'. Is the answer correct?
options: Yes, if it is spelt correctly
Only in Part 1 of the test
kahoot.explain: Ko'plik -s tushib qolsa, javob noto'g'ri hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: Does it matter if you write an answer in CAPITAL letters?
options: No, but the spelling must be correct
Yes, capital letters are always wrong
Yes, only names can have capitals
No, and spelling does not matter
kahoot.explain: Katta-kichik harf ahamiyatsiz, imlo esa muhim: noto'g'ri imlo — 0 ball.

kahoot.q: You missed one answer while listening. What is the best thing to do?
options: Move on and guess at the end
Stop and wait for it again
Ask for the audio to be replayed
kahoot.explain: To'xtamang — keyingi savolga o'ting; oxirida mantiqiy taxmin yozing, bo'sh joy aniq 0 ball.

kahoot.q: The speaker says: 'The meeting is on Monday — sorry, I mean Tuesday.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: Tuzatilgan ma'lumot yoziladi: "sorry, I mean" dan keyingi so'z — javob.

kahoot.q: In a chart question, what is most useful to listen for?
options: Every single word on the chart labels
The names of all the speakers
The exact title of the chart
kahoot.explain: Chart savolida har bir so'zni emas, NISBAT va TARTIBni tinglang: "twice as many", "nearly all", "the second most popular".

kahoot.q: A 'holidaymaker' is a person who …
kahoot.explain: holidaymaker — dam oluvchi, ta'tildagi sayyoh.

kahoot.q: Tourists often buy a 'souvenir'. A souvenir is …
options: a small thing to remember a place
a ticket for a guided tour of the city
a map of the local area
a room in a small hotel
kahoot.explain: souvenir — esdalik sovg'a: joyni eslab turish uchun olinadigan buyum.

kahoot.q: A sign says 'Boats for hire'. This means you can …
options: rent a boat for a time
buy a boat at a low price
get a job on a boat
get a free ride on a boat
kahoot.explain: for hire — ijaraga: pul to'lab, vaqtincha foydalanish uchun.

kahoot.q: In a wildlife park, an 'enclosure' is …
options: an area with a fence for animals
a shop that sells animal food
a guide who looks after visitors
a bus that drives around the park
kahoot.explain: enclosure — o'ralgan joy, qo'ra (hayvonlar uchun).

kahoot.q: The natural home of an animal or a plant is called its …
kahoot.explain: habitat — hayvon yoki o'simlikning tabiiy yashash muhiti.

kahoot.q: Students sent a 'questionnaire' to 50 classmates. A questionnaire is …
options: a list of questions to answer
a short talk on a topic
a test that gives a final mark
kahoot.explain: questionnaire — so'rovnoma: odamlar javob beradigan savollar ro'yxati.

kahoot.q: The 'exterior' of a building is its …
kahoot.explain: exterior — tashqi qism; interior — ichki qism.

kahoot.q: The hotel had a free room because of a 'cancellation'. This means …
options: someone paid for two extra rooms
the hotel built a new room
kahoot.explain: cancellation — bekor qilish (bron, reys yoki uchrashuvni).

lessons.title: Reading: Full Reading Test (Passage 1–3)
lessons.grammar_topic: To'liq Reading testi — 3 passage, 40 savol, 60 daqiqa
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ustoz bergan Full Practice Reading (William Kamkwamba; White mountain, green tourism; Reading in a whole new way).
objectives: To'liq IELTS Reading testini imtihon sharoitida 60 daqiqada bajarish (javob varag'iga ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt YO'Q).
Vaqtni passage bo'yicha taqsimlash: P1 — 17 daqiqa, P2 — 20 daqiqa, P3 — 23 daqiqa.
1–31-darslarda o'rganilgan savol turlarini bitta testda qo'llash.
Natijani band ballga o'girish va o'z xatolarini savol turi bo'yicha tahlil qilish.
Mock test (34-darsdan keyingi alohida sessiya) uchun shaxsiy "zaif savol turlari" ro'yxatini tuzish.
materials: Savol varag'i: Full Practice Reading — uchala matn (William Kamkwamba; White mountain, green tourism; Reading in a whole new way) va 1–40 savollar bitta to'plamda, har o'quvchiga bitta nusxa; 1–5 uchun flow chart kataklari bo'sh, 19–22 uchun A–E variantlari va 37–40 uchun A–F oxirlari qutisi aniq ko'rinib tursin.
Javob varag'i (1–40) — har o'quvchiga bitta, qo'ng'iroqqacha stol ustida tayyor tursin: Reading'da ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt yo'q, o'quvchi javobni darhol shu varaqqa yozadi.

Javoblar kaliti (1–40) — rejaning Reading bo'limida (har passage savollarining Javob va Nega ustunlari); 5-bosqichda ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi. Kalitda 6-savol (FALSE), 24-savol (summer) va 32-savol (NOT GIVEN) oldindan belgilab qo'yilsin — bular testning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan uchtasi.

Xato tahlili jadvali: besh ustunli bo'sh varaqa (savol raqami, savol turi, mening javobim, to'g'ri javob, xato sababi 1–6) — har o'quvchiga bitta; 6-bosqichda to'ldiriladi va shu varaqa birinchi uyga vazifa bo'lib ketadi.

Doskada qo'ng'iroqqacha: vaqt rejasi soat raqamlari bilan (P1 — 17 daqiqa, P2 — 20 daqiqa, P3 — 23 daqiqa, testning tugash vaqti aniq yozilgan) va yonida yirik harflar bilan "KO'CHIRISH VAQTI YO'Q — javobni darhol varaqqa yoz". "To'g'ri javoblar → band" jadvali doskaning ikkinchi qanotiga yozilib, test tugaguncha yopiq tursin (yoki alohida qog'ozga yozib qo'yiladi va 5-bosqichda osiladi).

Ustozda soat yoki sekundomer — testning 17-daqiqasida ("Passage 2 ga o'ting") va 37-daqiqasida ("Passage 3 ga o'ting") vaqt e'lon qilinadi. O'quvchilar xatolar daftari, qalam va o'chirg'ich bilan keladi; ikkinchi uyga vazifa uchun 6, 19, 25 va 31-darslarning uyga vazifa matnlari ustozda zaxira nusxada bo'lsin — dars oxirida o'quvchining zaif turiga qarab beriladi.
timeline: 60 daqiqa, ko'chirish vaqti yo'q; doskada vaqt rejasi (P1 17, P2 20, P3 23 daqiqa); javob varag'i tarqatiladi; 32-darsning uyga vazifa daftarlari yig'ib olinadi (ustoz test davomida tekshiradi)
Imtihon sharoitida, savollar 1–40; ustoz 17-daqiqada "Passage 2 ga o'ting", 37-daqiqada "Passage 3 ga o'ting" deb e'lon qiladi
Ustoz 1–40 javoblarini o'qiydi, o'quvchi to'g'ri javoblarini sanaydi va jadval bo'yicha bandini topadi (sinf mashqi); oxirida 32-dars daftarlari izoh bilan qaytariladi — xato tahlilida kerak bo'ladi
Xato tahlili jadvali: har xatoga savol turi va sabab raqami (1–6) yoziladi; eng qiyin 6, 24 va 32-savollar paraphrase jadvali bilan birga tahlil qilinadi
Har o'quvchi ikkita zaif savol turini belgilaydi; uyga: xato tahlili jadvali, zaif tur takrori, Passage 3 paraphrase juftlari

intro: Reading testi 60 daqiqa davom etadi va Listening'dan farqli ravishda javobni ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt berilmaydi. Javoblarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob varag'iga yozing.

Passage'lar qiyinlashib boradi: P1 — eng oson (faktlar), P2 — o'rta (matching, pick from list), P3 — eng qiyin (muallif fikri, MCQ, sentence endings). Shuning uchun P1 ni tezroq ishlab, P3 ga ko'proq vaqt qoldiring.

Bu testdagi savol turlari: flow chart (4-dars), T/F/NG (6-dars), short answer (4-dars), matching information (25-dars), pick from a list (18-dars), sentence completion (15-dars), MCQ (11-dars), Y/N/NG (19-dars), sentence endings (31-dars).
Har passage boshida 1 daqiqa: sarlavha, qism sarlavhasi va savol turlarini ko'rib chiqing, so'z chegaralarini belgilang (TWO WORDS / ONE WORD and/or a NUMBER).
Bitta savolga 2 daqiqadan ortiq vaqt sarflamang. Belgilab qo'ying va oxirida qayting. Bo'sh joy qoldirmang — noto'g'ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi (jarima yo'q).
Test tugagach ustoz javoblarni o'qiydi; har o'quvchi to'g'ri javoblar sonini sanaydi va jadval bo'yicha band ballni topadi.
presentation: Javob varag'iga qachon yozaman?
Darhol. Reading'da ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt yo'q.
Savollarni qaysi tartibda ishlayman?
Passage tartibida. Passage ichida — avval tartibli turlar, keyin matching (NEVER guruhi).
Vaqt tugab qolsa?
Qolgan savollarga taxminiy javob yozing — bo'sh joy aniq 0 ball.
Katta-kichik harf muhimmi?
Yo'q. Lekin imlo muhim.
"39 feet" yoki "39"?
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: ko'rsatma "ONE WORD and/or a NUMBER".
Qancha to'g'ri javob — qaysi band?
Pastdagi jadvalga qarang: 23–26 = 6.0, 30–32 = 7.0.
notes: Bu dars — birinchi to'liq Reading testi. Maqsad ball emas, balki vaqtni boshqarish tajribasi va zaif savol turlarini aniqlash.
Test paytida ustoz vaqtni ikki marta e'lon qiladi: 17-daqiqada "Passage 2 ga o'ting", 37-daqiqada "Passage 3 ga o'ting".
Eng qiyin savollar: 6 (FALSE — NOT GIVEN emas), 24 (summer — ski season tuzoq), 32 (NOT GIVEN). Tahlilda shu uchtasiga alohida to'xtaling.
Tahlil bosqichida o'quvchi xatolarini savol turi bo'yicha jadvalga yozadi: masalan, "T/F/NG — 2 xato, matching info — 1 xato". Eng ko'p xato qilingan tur 34-darsgacha takrorlanadi.
Qo'shimcha matn berilmaydi: dars to'liq test va tahlildan iborat (5 daqiqa qoidalar, 60 daqiqa test, 45 daqiqa kalit va xato tahlili, 10 daqiqa vazifa).

readings.title: Passage 1. William Kamkwamba
readings.source: Jony Academy materiali — Full Practice Reading
text: At only 14 years old, William Kamkwamba built a series of windmills that could generate electricity in his African village, Masitala, in Malawi, south-eastern Africa.

In 2002, William Kamkwamba had to drop out of school, as his father, a maize and tobacco farmer, could no longer afford his school fees. But despite this setback, William was determined to get his education. He began visiting a local library that had just opened in his old primary school, where he discovered a tattered science book. With only a rudimentary grasp of English, he _taught himself basic physics_ – mainly by studying photos and diagrams. Another book he found there featured windmills on the cover and inspired him to try and build his own.

He started by constructing a _small model_. Then, with the help of a cousin and friend, he spent many weeks searching _scrap yards_ and found old tractor fans, shock absorbers, plastic pipe and bicycle parts, which he used to build the real thing.

For windmill blades, William cut some _bath pipe_ in two lengthwise, then heated the pieces over hot coals to press the curled edges flat. To bore holes into the blades, he stuck a nail through half a corncob, heated the metal red and twisted it through the blades. It took three hours to repeatedly heat the nail and bore the holes. He attached the blades to a _tractor fan_ using proper nuts and bolts and then to the back axle of a bicycle. Electricity was generated through the bicycle dynamo. When the wind blew the blades, the bike chain spun the bike wheel, which charged the dynamo and sent a current through wire to his house.

What he had built was a crude machine that produced 12 volts and _powered four lights_. When it was all done, the windmill's wingspan measured more than eight feet and sat on top of a rickety tower 15 feet tall that swayed violently in strong gales. He eventually replaced the tower with a sturdier one that stands _39 feet_, and built a second machine that watered a family garden.

The windmill brought William Kamkwamba _instant local fame_, but despite his accomplishment, he was still unable to return to school. However, news of his magetsi a mphepo – electric wind – spread beyond Malawi, and eventually things began to change. An education official, who had heard news of the windmill, came to visit his village and was amazed to learn that William had been out of school for five years. He arranged for him to attend secondary school at the government's expense and _brought journalists to the farm_ to see the windmill. Then a story published in the Malawi Daily Mail caught the attention of bloggers, which in turn caught the attention of organisers for the Technology Entertainment and Design conference.

In 2007, William spoke at the TED Global conference in Tanzania and got a standing ovation. Businessmen stepped forward with offers to fund his education and projects, and with money donated by them, he was able to put his cousin and several friends back into school and pay for some medical needs of his family. With the donation, he also _drilled a borehole for a well and water pump_ in his village and installed drip irrigation in his father's fields.

The water pump has allowed his family to expand its crops. They have abandoned tobacco and now grow maize, beans, soybeans, potatoes and peanuts. The windmills have also brought big lifestyle and health changes to the other villagers. 'The village has changed a lot,' William says. 'Now, the time that they would have spent going to fetch water, they are using for doing other things. And also the water they are drinking is clean water, so _there is less disease_.' The villagers have also _stopped using kerosene_ and can use the money previously spent on fuel to buy other things.

William Kamkwamba's example has inspired other children in the village to _pursue science_. William says they now see that if they put their mind to something, they can achieve it. 'It has changed the way people think,' he says.

readings.title: Passage 2. White mountain, green tourism
readings.qtype: Matching information (14–18) + Pick from a list (19–22) + Sentence completion (23–26)
readings.source: Jony Academy materiali — Full Practice Reading
text: The French Alpine town of Chamonix has been a magnet for tourists since the 18th century. But today, tourism and climate change are putting pressure on the surrounding environment. Marc Grainger reports.

A. The town of Chamonix-Mont-Blanc sits in a valley at 1,035 metres above sea level in the Haute-Savoie department in south-eastern France. To the north-west are the red peaks of the Aiguilles Rouges massif; to the south-east are the permanently white peaks of Mont Blanc, which at 4,810 metres is the highest mountain in the Alps. It's a typical Alpine environment, but one that is under increasing strain from the hustle and bustle of human activity.

B. Tourism is Chamonix's lifeblood. Visitors have been encouraged to visit the valley ever since it was discovered by _explorers_ in 1741. Over 40 years later, in 1786, Mont Blanc's summit was finally reached by a French doctor and his guide, and this gave birth to the sport of alpinism, with Chamonix at its centre. In 1924, it hosted the first Winter Olympics, and the cable cars and lifts that were built in the years that followed gave everyone access to the ski slopes.

C. Today, Chamonix is a modern town, connected to the outside world via the Mont Blanc Road Tunnel and a busy highway network. It receives up to 60,000 visitors at a time during the ski season, and _climbers, hikers and extreme-sports enthusiasts_ swarm there in the _summer in even greater numbers_, swelling the town's population to 100,000. It is the third most visited natural site in the world, according to Chamonix's Tourism Office and, last year, it had 5.2 million visitor bed nights – all this in a town with fewer than 10,000 permanent inhabitants.

D. This influx of tourists has put the local environment under severe pressure, and the authorities in the valley have decided to take action. Educating visitors is vital. _Tourists are warned not to drop rubbish_, and there are now recycling points dotted all around the valley, from the town centre to halfway up the mountains. _An internet blog reports environmental news_ in the town, and the 'green' message is delivered with all the tourist office's activities.

E. Low-carbon initiatives are also important for the region. _France is committed to reducing its carbon emissions by a factor of four by 2050._ Central to achieving this aim is a strategy that encourages communities to identify their carbon emissions on a local level and make plans to reduce them. Studies have identified that accommodation accounts for half of all carbon emissions in the Chamonix valley. Hotels are known to be inefficient operations, but those around Chamonix are now cleaning up their act. Some are using low-energy lighting, restricting water use and _making recycling bins available for guests_; others have invested in huge projects such as furnishing and decorating using locally sourced materials, using geothermal energy for heating and _installing solar panels_.

F. Chamonix's council is encouraging the use of renewable energy in private properties too, by making funds available for green renovations and new constructions. At the same time, public-sector buildings have also undergone improvements to make them more energy efficient and less wasteful. For example, _the local ice rink has reduced its annual water consumption_ from 140,000 cubic metres to 10,000 cubic metres in the space of three years.

G. Improving public transport is another feature of the new policy, as 80 percent of carbon emissions from transport used to come from private vehicles. While the Mont Blanc Express is an ideal way to travel within the valley – and see some incredible scenery along the route – it is much more difficult to arrive in Chamonix from outside by rail. There is no direct line from the closest airport in Geneva, so tourists arriving by air normally transfer by car or bus. However, at a cost of 3.3 million euros a year, Chamonix has introduced _a free shuttle service in order to get people out of their cars_ and into buses fitted with particle filters.

H. If the valley's visitors and residents want to know why they need to reduce their environmental impact, they just have to look up; the effects of climate change are there for everyone to see in _the melting glaciers_ that cling to the mountains. The fragility of the Alpine environment has long been a concern among local people. Today, 70 percent of the 805 square kilometres that comprise Chamonix-Mont-Blanc is protected in some way. But now, the impact of tourism has led the authorities to recognise that more must be done if the valley is to remain prosperous: that they must not only protect the natural environment better, but also _manage the numbers of visitors better_, so that its residents can happily remain there.

readings.title: Passage 3. Reading in a whole new way
readings.source: Jony Academy materiali — Full Practice Reading
text: As technology improves, how does the act of reading change?

Reading and writing, like all technologies, are constantly changing. In ancient times, authors often dictated their books. Dictation sounded like an uninterrupted series of words, so _scribes wrote these down in one long continuous string_, justastheyoccurinspeech. For this reason, text was written without spaces between words until the 11th century. This continuous script made books hard to read, so only a few people were accomplished at reading them aloud to others. Being able to read silently to yourself was considered an amazing talent; writing was an even rarer skill. In fact, in 15th-century Europe, only one in 20 adult males could write.

After Gutenberg's invention of the printing press in about 1440, mass-produced books changed the way people read and wrote. The technology of printing increased the number of words available, and more types of media, such as newspapers and magazines, _broadened what was written about_. Authors no longer had to produce scholarly works, as was common until then, but could write, for example, inexpensive, heart-rending love stories or publish autobiographies, even if they were unknown.

In time, _the power of the written word gave birth to the idea of authority and expertise_. Laws were compiled into official documents, contracts were written down and nothing was valid unless it was in this form. Painting, music, architecture, dance were all important, but the heartbeat of many cultures was the turning pages of a book. By the early 19th century, public libraries had been built in many cities.

Today, words are migrating from paper to computers, phones, laptops and game consoles. Some 4.5 billion digital screens illuminate our lives. Letters are no longer fixed in black ink on paper, but flitter on a glass surface in a rainbow of colors as fast as our eyes can blink. _Screens fill our pockets, briefcases, cars, living-room walls and the sides of buildings._ They sit in front of us when we work – regardless of what we do. And of course, these newly ubiquitous screens have changed how we read and write.

The first screens that overtook culture, several decades ago – the big, fat, warm tubes of television – reduced the time we spent reading to such an extent that it seemed as if reading and writing were over. Educators and parents worried deeply that the TV generation would be unable to write. But _the interconnected, cool, thin displays of computer screens launched an epidemic of writing_ that continues to swell. As a consequence, _the amount of time people spend reading has almost tripled since 1980_. By 2008, the World Wide Web contained more than a trillion pages, and that total grows rapidly every day.

But it is not book reading or newspaper reading, it is screen reading. Screens are always on, and, unlike books, we never stop staring at them. This new platform is very visual, and it is gradually merging words with moving images. You might think of this new medium as books we watch, or television we read. We also use screens to present data, and this encourages numeracy: _visualising data and reading charts, looking at pictures and symbols are all part of this new literacy_.

_Screens engage our bodies, too._ The most we may do while reading a book is to flip the pages or turn over a corner, but when we use a screen, we interact with what we see. In the futuristic movie Minority Report, _the main character stands in front of a screen and hunts through huge amounts of information as if conducting an orchestra_. Just as it seemed strange five centuries ago to see someone read silently, in the future it will seem strange to read without moving your body.

In addition, screens encourage more utilitarian (practical) thinking. A new idea or unfamiliar fact will cause a reflex to do something: to research a word, to question your screen 'friends' for their opinions or to find alternative views. _Book reading strengthened our analytical skills_, encouraging us to think carefully about how we feel. _Screen reading, on the other hand, encourages quick responses_, associating this idea with another, equipping us to deal with the thousands of new thoughts expressed every day. For example, _we review a movie for our friends while we watch it_; we read the owner's manual of a device we see in a shop before we purchase it, rather than after we get home and discover that it can't do what we need it to do.

Screens provoke action instead of persuasion. _Propaganda is less effective, and false information is hard to deliver in a world of screens_ because while misinformation travels fast, corrections do, too. On a screen, it is often easier to correct a falsehood than to tell one in the first place. _Wikipedia works so well because it removes an error in a single click._ In books, we find a revealed truth; on the screen, we assemble our own truth from pieces. What is more, a screen can reveal the inner nature of things. Waving the camera eye of a smartphone over the bar code of a manufactured product reveals its price, origins and even relevant comments by other owners. _It is as if the screen displays the object's intangible essence._ A popular children's toy (Webkinz) instills stuffed animals with a virtual character that is 'hidden' inside; a screen enables children to play with this inner character online in a virtual world.
In the near future, screens will be the first place we'll look for answers, for friends, for news, for meaning, for our sense of who we are and who we can be.

homework_intro: Bugun birinchi marta to'liq Reading testini imtihon sharoitida ishladik — uyga vazifa ham shundan kelib chiqadi: endi bizga ball emas, har bir xatoning sababi kerak.

Birinchi vazifa — "Xato tahlili jadvali": darsda boshlagan jadvalni uyda oxirigacha to'ldiring, har xato uchun savol raqami, savol turi, o'z javobingiz, to'g'ri javob va sabab raqami yozilsin (kurs bo'yicha yagona 6 sabab: 1 — topa olmadim, 2 — xato yozdim, 3 — vaqt yetmadi, 4 — savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim, 5 — taxmin qildim, 6 — bilardim, lekin o'zgartirdim) — 15–20 daqiqa oladi.

Ikkinchi vazifa — "Zaif tur takrori": jadvalda eng ko'p xato chiqqan turni oling va o'sha turni o'rgangan darsning uyga vazifa matnini qaytadan bajaring (T/F/NG bo'lsa 6-dars, Y/N/NG bo'lsa 19-dars, matching information bo'lsa 25-dars, sentence endings bo'lsa 31-dars); uchinchisi — "Passage 3 qayta o'qish": "Reading in a whole new way" matnini bu safar vaqtsiz, tinch o'qib chiqib, 10 ta paraphrase juftini yozasiz — chapda savoldagi so'z, o'ngda matndagi ibora (masalan, "can be found everywhere — screens fill our pockets"). Ikkalasi birga 30 daqiqacha oladi.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — jadvalga faqat "noto'g'ri" deb yozib qo'yish: sabab ustuni bo'sh qolsa, vazifa bajarilmagan hisoblanadi, chunki bizga necha xato qilganingiz emas, QAYSI turda xato qilganingiz kerak.

Uchala vazifani ham keyingi dars boshida daftar ochiq holda stolga qo'yasiz; men jadvalingizga qarab har biringizga ikkita zaif savol turini belgilab beraman — 34-darsdagi mock tayyorgarligida va undan keyingi mock testda aynan shularni kuzataman.

homework.title: Xato tahlili jadvali
homework.instr: Testdagi har xatoingizni jadvalga yozing: savol raqami — savol turi — mening javobim — to'g'ri javob — sabab raqami. Kurs bo'yicha yagona 6 sabab: 1 — javob joyini topa olmadim (paraphrase'ni tanimadim); 2 — topdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam); 3 — vaqt yetmadi; 4 — savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z chegarasi, FALSE va NOT GIVEN farqi); 5 — taxmin qildim; 6 — bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirib yubordim.
homework.answers: Ustoz jadval asosida har o'quvchiga 2 ta zaif savol turini belgilaydi.

homework.instr: Eng ko'p xato qilgan savol turingiz bo'yicha oldingi darsdan (masalan, 6, 19, 25 yoki 31-dars) uyga vazifa matnini qayta bajaring.

kahoot.q: In which task can the same paragraph letter be the answer to more than one question?
kahoot.explain: Matching information'da 'You may use any letter more than once' deyiladi: bitta xatboshi bir necha savolga javob bo'lishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: Why is it better to do matching information questions after the other questions on a passage?
options: The answers are not in text order
They are always the easiest ones
They carry more marks than others
Their answers are always in paragraph A
kahoot.explain: Matching information javoblari matn tartibida kelmaydi; boshqa savollarni ishlab, matnni tanib olgach qaytish osonroq.

kahoot.q: Sentence endings: 'Many people now work from home because…' Which ending is correct?
options: a faster way of travelling to work.
kahoot.explain: 'because' dan keyin ega va fe'li bor to'liq gap kerak: 'the internet makes it easy' — grammatika ham, ma'no ham mos.

kahoot.q: Time is almost up and three answer boxes are still empty. What should you do?
options: Write a guess in every box
Leave them empty to be safe
kahoot.explain: Noto'g'ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi, bo'sh katak esa aniq nol — har katakka taxmin yozing.

kahoot.q: In Academic Reading, about how many correct answers usually give Band 6.0?
kahoot.explain: Academic Reading jadvalida 23–26 to'g'ri javob — Band 6.0; 15–18 — 5.0; 30–32 — 7.0.

kahoot.q: If a family cannot 'afford' school fees, they…
kahoot.explain: Afford — (pulga) qurbi yetmoq; cannot afford — puli yetmaydi.

kahoot.q: A 'setback' is…
options: a problem that slows you down
a reward for your hard work
a comfortable seat at the back
kahoot.explain: Setback — to'siq, muvaffaqiyatsizlik: ishni orqaga suradigan muammo.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Small wind turbines can ___ electricity for a village.'
kahoot.explain: Generate electricity — elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarmoq (turg'un birikma).

kahoot.q: An 'influx' of tourists is…
kahoot.explain: Influx — ko'plab kelish, oqim: bir joyga birdaniga ko'p odam kelishi.

kahoot.q: 'Tourism is the town's lifeblood' means that tourism is…
kahoot.explain: Lifeblood — hayot manbai: shaharsiz yashay olmaydigan eng muhim narsa.

kahoot.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'prosperous'?
kahoot.explain: Prosperous — farovon, boy; wealthy ham 'boy, badavlat' degani.

kahoot.q: 'Carbon emissions' are…
options: laws about using coal and oil
kahoot.explain: Emissions — (zararli gaz) chiqarish, emissiya: havoga chiqariladigan gazlar.

kahoot.q: 'Mass-produced' goods are…
kahoot.explain: Mass-produced — ommaviy, fabrikada ko'p nusxada ishlab chiqarilgan.

lessons.title: Mock oldidan: imtihon kuni strategiyasi va vaqt boshqaruvi
lessons.grammar_topic: Mock testga tayyorgarlik — Listening Part 1–4 va Reading 3 passage uchun daqiqama-daqiqa reja, xom balldan band ballga o'tish
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — CRM dagi IELTS mock test bazasi (2026-09-26) va rasmiy xom ball → band jadvallari (Listening va Academic Reading, 40 savoldan).
objectives: Mock kunini aniq bilish: mock — alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa), Speaking esa alohida; har bo'lim qanday o'tadi va Writing'ni kim baholaydi.
Kompyuterdagi ekranni oldindan tanish qilish: 40 savol, taymer, javob katagi va sahifadan chiqish hisoblanishi.
Listening uchun reja: skript BIR MARTA o'qiladi, javob eshitilayotgan paytda yoziladi.
Reading uchun reja: P1 — 17, P2 — 20, P3 — 23 daqiqa, qaysi savol turidan boshlash, qaysi savolni tashlab ketib keyin qaytish.
Bilmagan savolda nima qilishni qoida darajasida o'zlashtirish: bo'sh katak — aniq nol.
40 savoldan olingan xom ballni o'zi band ballga o'gira olish va "30/40 nima degani" degan savolga javob bera olish.
Writing uchun reja: avval Task 2 — 40 daqiqa (kamida 250 so'z), keyin Task 1 — 20 daqiqa (kamida 150 so'z).
materials: Har o'quvchiga bitta bo'sh "Reading 60 daqiqa rejasi" varaqasi: uch ustun (Passage 1, Passage 2, Passage 3), har ustunda "boshlanadi" va "tugaydi" qatorlari bo'sh — 4-mashqda soat raqamlari bilan to'ldiriladi va mock kuniga olib boriladi.

Doskada qo'ng'iroqqacha yozib qo'yilgan xom ball → band jadvali: chap ustun Listening, o'ng ustun Academic Reading, o'rtada band. 1-mashqgacha yopiq tursin (varaq bilan berkitiladi), chunki 2-mashqda o'quvchilar jadvalni yoddan emas, o'qib ishlatishi kerak.

Ustozda: proyektor yoki bitta kompyuter — guruh test ekranidan mock havolasi ochilib, o'quvchilarga ekranning o'zi ko'rsatiladi (taymer qayerda, savollar ro'yxati qayerda, javob katagi qanday). Havola faqat ko'rsatish uchun ochiladi, test boshlanmaydi.
Sekundomer yoki telefon taymeri — 3-mashqda Part oralig'idagi 30–40 soniyani va 4-mashqda 17, 20 va 23 daqiqalik bo'laklarni real vaqtda ko'rsatish uchun.
Har o'quvchida 33-darsdagi to'ldirilgan xato tahlili jadvali — dars oxirida (8-bosqich, xulosa) har kim o'zining ikkita zaif savol turini shu jadvaldan topadi.
Bo'sh qog'oz va qalam har o'quvchida: Listening paytida ism va raqamlarni qoralama qilish odati bugun mashq qilinadi.
timeline: Yangi mavzu yo'q; maqsad — mock kunida o'zini qanday tutish

Mock — 34 va 35-darslar orasidagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (dars soniga kirmaydi): JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar; Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa; Speaking alohida (filial imkon bersa)
Proyektorda mock ekrani ko'rsatiladi: 40 savol, taymer, javob katagi; qat'iy rejim — to'liq ekran, sahifadan chiqish sanaladi
Skript bir marta o'qiladi; javob eshitilayotganda yoziladi (3-mashq)
Qaysi turdan boshlanadi, qaysi savol tashlab ketiladi (4-mashq)
Jadval ochiladi va o'qib chiqiladi (1-mashq, 8 daqiqa), keyin har o'quvchi xom balldan bandni topadi (2-mashq, 12 daqiqa)
Avval Task 2 — 40 daqiqa (250+ so'z), keyin Task 1 — 20 daqiqa (150+ so'z); kim va qaysi 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (6-mashq)
Telefon, sahifadan chiqish, qo'l ko'tarish, nonushta va uyqu
Reja varaqasi tekshiriladi, zaif ikki tur belgilanadi

intro: Mock — bu oddiy dars emas, imtihon repetitsiyasi. Bugun yangi mavzu o'rganmaymiz: bilganingizni imtihon xatti-harakatiga aylantiramiz. Bilimi bir xil bo'lgan ikki o'quvchidan yuqori ball olgani — vaqtini to'g'ri taqsimlagani.

Mockning o'zi — alohida 150 daqiqalik imtihon sessiyasi: u 34 va 35-darslar orasida o'tkaziladi va dars soniga kirmaydi. Test JonyOS da (Imtihonlar → Mock testlar), qat'iy rejimda, faqat kompyuterda ishlanadi. Tartib: Listening (~30 daqiqa), Reading (60 daqiqa), Writing (60 daqiqa); ekranda taymer yuradi. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, alohida kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa). 35-dars — natijalar tahlili darsi.

Listening: 4 ta Part, jami 40 savol. Yozuv qo'yilmaydi — skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va faqat bir marta o'qiydi. Skript examiner ekranida turadi, o'quvchiga hech qachon ko'rinmaydi. Shuning uchun "qaytadan eshitaman" degan narsa yo'q: javob eshitilayotgan paytning o'zida yoziladi.
Reading: 3 ta passage, jami 40 savol, 60 daqiqa. Ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt berilmaydi — javob to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ekranga yoziladi.

Listening ham, Reading ham avtomatik tekshiriladi. 40 savoldan nechta to'g'ri chiqqani rasmiy jadval bo'yicha o'zi band ballga aylanadi va guruh jurnaliga band bo'lib tushadi (0–9). Ustoz qo'lda hisoblamaydi, shuning uchun imlo va so'z chegarasi muhim.

Writing kompyuterda yoziladi: ikki vazifa — Task 1 (20 daqiqa, kamida 150 so'z) va Task 2 (40 daqiqa, kamida 250 so'z), ekranda so'z sanagich yurib turadi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner IELTS ning 4 mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi: Task Achievement / Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy (Task 2 ikki barobar og'ir). AI inglizcha izoh va grammatika hamda lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida uni tekshiradi (kerak bo'lsa o'zgartiradi), keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. 5.0 da Writing 36-darsdan boshlanadi, shuning uchun bu mockdagi Writing — diagnostika. Speaking yuzma-yuz, alohida o'tadi.
Har bo'limning 5 ta varianti bor (A–E) va havola ochilganda tizim qismlarni variantlar orasidan aralashtirib beradi. Ya'ni "shu variantni yodlab olaman" degan yo'l yo'q — faqat usul ishlaydi.

Xona qoidasi: telefon sumkada, stolda emas. Mock qat'iy rejimda o'tadi: to'liq ekran; boshqa oyna yoki ilovaga o'tish sanaladi — 2 marta chiqishga ruxsat bor, 3-marta chiqqan o'quvchi testdan chetlatiladi (examiner boshqa chegara qo'ymagan bo'lsa). Savolingiz bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi, qo'shni bilan gaplashilmaydi.
Javobsiz qoldirilgan katak — aniq nol. Noto'g'ri javob uchun jarima yo'q. Demak har katakda biror narsa turishi SHART: taxmin ham nolga qaraganda yaxshiroq.

Tekshiruvdan keyin examiner javob varag'ida har savol bo'yicha uchta narsani ko'radi: siz nima yozgansiz, to'g'ri javob nima edi va savolning mavzu belgisi. Shuning uchun keyingi darsda xatolar savolma-savol muhokama qilinadi — bugun yozib olgan rejangiz o'sha tahlilda ishlatiladi.
formulas: Listening ~30 + Reading 60 + Writing 60 = 150 daqiqa; Speaking alohida
Mock dars soniga kirmaydi — alohida sessiya ekanini ayting
"Bir marta o'qiladi" degan gapni ikki marta ayting
Reja varaqasi soat raqamlari bilan to'ldiriladi
Writing'ni AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi; 5.0 da bu diagnostika
presentation: Listening qayta qo'yiladimi?
Yo'q. Skriptni examiner bir marta o'qiydi. Javob eshitilayotgan paytda yoziladi.
Skriptni ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi, o'quvchiga hech qachon ko'rinmaydi.
Reading'da javobni ko'chirish uchun vaqt bormi?
Yo'q. Javob darhol ekranga yoziladi.
Bitta savolni tushunmadim, nima qilay?
Taxminiy javob yozib, belgilab qo'ying va davom eting. Vaqt qolsa qaytasiz. Bo'sh qoldirmaysiz.
30 ta to'g'ri javob qanday ball?
Listening'da 7.0, Reading'da ham 7.0. Lekin 32 ta to'g'ri Listening'da 7.5, Reading'da hali 7.0.
Ballni ustoz qo'yadimi?
Listening va Reading avtomatik hisoblanadi va jurnalga band bo'lib tushadi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi, examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi.
Variantni oldindan bilsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Har bo'limning 5 ta varianti bor va tizim qismlarni aralashtirib beradi.
Test paytida telefonga qarasam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Telefon sumkada. Sahifadan chiqish sanaladi: 3-marta chiqsangiz, testdan chetlatilasiz.
Imloda xato qilsam?
Avtomatik tekshiruvda xato imlo — noto'g'ri javob. Ism va joy nomlarini diqqat bilan yozing.
Kechqurun nima qilay?
Yangi mavzu o'rganmang. Erta yotib, ertalab nonushta qiling — charchoq 3–4 ta savolga teng.
Mock dars ichida bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Mock — 34 va 35-darslar orasidagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya, dars soniga kirmaydi: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. 35-dars — natijalar tahlili.
Writing'ni kim baholaydi?

JonyOS AI examiner — IELTS ning 4 mezoni bo'yicha (Task Achievement / Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy; Task 2 ikki barobar og'ir). Inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxati beriladi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi.
Speaking bo'ladimi?
Filial imkon bersa — alohida kuni, examiner bilan yuzma-yuz, har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon: Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy, Pronunciation.
notes: Bu dars mockdan oldingi oxirgi dars. Mockning o'zi (150 daqiqa) 34 va 35-darslar orasida alohida sessiyada o'tkaziladi va dars soniga kirmaydi; 35-dars — natijalar tahlili. Maqsad — bilim qo'shish emas, xatti-harakatni belgilash. Yangi savol turi kiritmang.
Ekranni albatta ko'rsating. Birinchi marta mock topshirayotgan o'quvchining ko'p vaqti "bu qayerda, bu qanday ishlaydi" degan savolga ketadi — bugun ko'rsatilsa, o'sha vaqt tejaladi.
Jadval dars boshida yopiq turadi. Avval o'quvchilar o'zlari "30 ta to'g'ri qancha bo'lar ekan" deb taxmin qilsin, keyin jadval ochilsin — shunda raqam esda qoladi.
Reja varaqasi dars oxirida ustozga ko'rsatiladi va o'quvchida qoladi: mock kuni shu varaqa stol ustida turadi.
Listening va Reading jadvallari bir xil EMAS. Buni alohida ta'kidlang: 32 ta to'g'ri Listening'da 7.5, Reading'da 7.0. O'quvchilar ko'pincha bitta jadvalni ikkalasiga ishlatib yuboradi.
"Bo'sh katak — nol" qoidasini sinf bilan ovoz chiqarib takrorlang. Bu dars beradigan eng qimmat bitta odat.

Keyingi darsda mockdan keyin examiner javob varag'i ochiladi va sinf savolma-savol tahlil qilinadi: kim nima yozgan, to'g'risi nima edi, savol qaysi mavzuga tegishli. Writing bo'yicha esa AI examiner izohi va 4 mezon bahosi asosida 20 daqiqalik feedback o'tkaziladi.

Birinchi vazifa — "Mening mock rejam": darsdagi varaqani toza ko'chirasiz, Listening uchun Part 1–4 bo'yicha nima qilishingizni va Reading uchun 17 + 20 + 23 taqsimotini soat raqamlari bilan, Writing uchun 40 + 20 daqiqani yozasiz, pastiga ikkita zaif savol turingizni qo'shasiz — 15 daqiqa yetadi.

intro: Bu — mockdan keyingi TAHLIL darsi. Mock imtihonining o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada o'tkaziladi; bu 120 daqiqada natijalar savol turi bo'yicha tahlil qilinadi, Writing izohi ko'rib chiqiladi va ikki haftalik reja tuziladi. Yangi mavzu o'rganilmaydi — bugun o'lchov rejaga aylantiriladi.

Mock sessiyasi: examiner JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan guruh uchun mockni ochadi, o'quvchilar qat'iy rejimda (faqat kompyuter, to'liq ekran) ishlaydi: Listening ~30 daqiqa, Reading 60 daqiqa, Writing 60 daqiqa — jami 150 daqiqa, bitta alohida sessiyada. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan: har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon bo'yicha; imkon bo'lmasa, 5.0 mockida Speaking yo'q.
Sessiyada Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi — bir marta va bir tekis tezlikda. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi va hech qachon o'quvchiga ko'rsatilmaydi.

Sessiya qoidasi: telefon sumkada, stolda emas. Qat'iy rejimda imtihon to'liq ekranda ishlanadi; ekrandan har bir chiqish (boshqa oyna yoki tab, to'liq ekrandan chiqish, sahifani yangilash) tizimda sanaladi: 2 tagacha chiqish qayd qilinadi, 3-chiqishda o'quvchi imtihondan avtomatik chetlatiladi va qayta kira olmaydi. Savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.
Mock natijasi ikki raqamdan iborat: XOM BALL (40 tadan nechtasi to'g'ri) va BAND (0 dan 9 gacha). Tizim xom ballni rasmiy jadval bo'yicha avtomatik bandga aylantiradi va guruh jurnaliga band yozadi.
Listening va Reading jadvallari BIR XIL EMAS. Masalan 26 ta to'g'ri javob: Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Shuning uchun "ikkalasida 26 ta topdim, demak bir xil" deyish noto'g'ri.

Band zinapoya kabi ko'tariladi: ba'zan bitta savol bandni yarim pog'onaga o'zgartiradi. Listeningda 29 ta = 6.5, 30 ta = 7.0. Ya'ni bitta savol — yarim band. Buni bilgan o'quvchi bo'sh javob qoldirmaydi.

Umumiy o'rtachani odatda BITTA bo'lim pastga tortadi. Avval qaysi bo'lim ekani aniqlanadi, keyin faqat shu bo'lim ichida ishlanadi. Hamma narsani birdan tuzatishga urinish — eng ko'p uchraydigan vaqt isrofi.

Xato javobning o'zi foyda bermaydi. Foydali bo'lishi uchun uning SABABI aniqlanishi kerak. Olti sabab bor va har biriga boshqacha davo kerak: 1) eshitmadim yoki topa olmadim; 2) eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam, sana); 3) vaqt yetmadi; 4) savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z limiti, NOT GIVEN va FALSE farqi); 5) taxmin qildim; 6) bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirib yubordim.
Sabab davoni belgilaydi: "eshitmadim" uchun ko'proq tinglash kerak, "xato yozdim" uchun esa imlo va raqam diktanti — bu butunlay boshqa mashq va bir hafta ichida natija beradi.

Examiner javoblar varaqasi har savol uchun uchta narsani ko'rsatadi: o'quvchi nima yozgan, to'g'ri javob nima edi va savolning MAVZU BELGISI. Mavzu belgisi bo'yicha saralansa, 13 ta alohida xato 3 ta naqshga aylanadi: masalan "Part 1 raqam va sana", "Matching Headings", "Passage 3 oxirgi savollari".
Naqsh ko'ringandan keyingina reja yoziladi. Reja aniq bo'lishi shart: nima qilinadi, qancha, qaysi kuni, kim tekshiradi va ikki haftadan keyin qaysi raqam o'zgarishi kerak.
Listening sessiyada faqat BIR MARTA eshittirilgan (yozuv yoki examiner o'qishi), shuning uchun "audioni yana eshitaman" deb bo'lmaydi — tahlil faqat javoblar varaqasi orqali qilinadi.
Har mock uchun 5 ta variant (A-E) bor va havola ochilganda tizim qismlarni variantlar orasida aralashtiradi. Ya'ni bitta varaqni yodlab qo'yib bo'lmaydi — faqat ko'nikma o'sadi.

WRITING natijasi: JonyOS AI examiner Writing'ni 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi — Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy; Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi. U inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi. Ustoz (examiner) 48 soat ichida bahoni tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, shundan keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Har mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi.

presentation: To'liq mock bitta darsga sig'adimi?

Yo'q. Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, kompyuterda): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa). Bu 120 daqiqalik dars — faqat natijalar tahlili.
Testni kim ochadi?
Examiner JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan guruh uchun ochadi, o'quvchi kompyuterda ishlaydi. Havolani o'quvchi o'zi qidirmaydi.
Listeningni kim o'qiydi?
Sessiyada yozuv bo'lmasa — examiner: skript bir marta, bir tekis tezlikda ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi va faqat examiner ekranida turadi.
Ekrandan chiqib ketsam nima bo'ladi?

Qat'iy rejim har chiqishni sanaydi va examiner ko'radi (sahifani yangilash ham chiqish hisoblanadi); 3-chiqishda tizim imtihondan avtomatik chetlatadi. Telefon sumkada turadi, savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.
Xom ball nima, band nima?
Xom ball — 40 tadan nechta to'g'ri javob. Band — shu xom ballning rasmiy jadval bo'yicha 0-9 dagi qiymati. Jurnalga band tushadi.
Listening va Reading jadvali bir xilmi?
Yo'q. 26 ta to'g'ri javob Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Reading jadvali qattiqroq.
Bitta savol bandni o'zgartiradimi?
Ha. Listeningda 29 ta = 6.5, 30 ta = 7.0. Shuning uchun bitta savolni ham bo'sh qoldirmaslik kerak.
Bo'sh qoldirsam yoki taxmin qilsam, farqi bormi?
Noto'g'ri javob uchun jarima yo'q. Bo'sh javob — kafolatlangan nol, taxmin esa ba'zan to'g'ri chiqadi. Hech qachon bo'sh qoldirilmaydi.
Imlo xatosi ham noto'g'ri sanaladimi?

Ha. "reseptionist" — noto'g'ri. Ma'noni bilganingiz ball bermaydi, yozilishi to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak. Sana FORMATI esa ahamiyatsiz: "20 September", "20th September", "September 20" — hammasi qabul qilinadi; lekin "Febuary" — xato.
Audioni yana eshitsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Listening sessiyada bir marta eshittirilgan, skript esa faqat ustozda turadi. Tahlil javoblar varaqasi orqali qilinadi.
Mock savollari keyingi safar takrorlanadimi?
Yo'q. 5 ta variant bor va tizim qismlarni aralashtirib beradi. Yodlash ishlamaydi.
Bandim tushib ketdi, nega?
Ball bo'limlar bo'yicha har xil chiqadi. Qaysi bo'lim va qaysi mavzu tortganini varaqadan ko'ring; "umuman yomon yozdim" degan xulosa foyda bermaydi.
Writing bandi qayerda?

Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (Task 2 ikki barobar), inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxatini beradi; ustoz 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Bugun Writing'ga 20 daqiqa ajratilgan (6-mashq).
Ikki haftada band ko'tariladimi?
Bitta bo'limda yarim band — ha, agar reja aniq bo'lsa. "Ko'proq mashq qilaman" degan reja hech narsani ko'tarmaydi.
notes: Maktab qarori: mock imtihoni — dars sonidan tashqaridagi ALOHIDA 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Bu 120 daqiqalik dars — natijalar e'lon qilingandan KEYINGI tahlil darsi. Writing natijasi examiner tekshirgandan keyin (48 soat ichida) chiqadi, shuning uchun darsni natijalar e'lon qilingandan keyin o'tkazing. "Sessiya kuni" deb belgilangan bandlar (materials, formulas 1–4) — imtihon kuni uchun.
Tahlil qismini examiner javoblar varaqasi ekranda ochiq turganda boshlang. Varaqasiz boshlamang — tahlil qiladigan material bo'lmaydi.
Sessiya kuni: Listening skriptini ikki marta o'qimang va tezlashtirmang. Bir marta, bir tekis tezlikda — ikkinchi o'qish natijani soxtalashtiradi va keyingi tahlilni ma'nosiz qiladi.
Sessiya kuni: test yurganda savolning mazmuni bo'yicha yordam bermang. Texnik savolga (ekran, havola, tugma) yordam beriladi, savolning javobiga — hech qachon.
Ballarni ovoz chiqarib e'lon qilmang va o'quvchilarni bir-biri bilan solishtirmang. Har kim faqat o'z varaqasi bilan ishlaydi; taqqoslash o'zining oldingi natijasi bilan qilinadi.
Ustoz "bu xatoning sababi bu" deb aytib yubormasin. Sababni o'quvchi o'zi tanlaydi — faqat u o'sha paytda nima bo'lganini biladi. Ustoz savol beradi: "yozolmadingmi, yoki eshitmadingmi?".

Eng qimmat sabab — 6-raqam ("bilardim, lekin o'zgartirdim"). Agar bir o'quvchida bu ikki martadan ko'p bo'lsa, unga qat'iy qoida beriladi: birinchi javob qoladi, o'zgartirish faqat matndan aniq dalil topilganda.
2-sabab ("eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim") eng tez tuzaladigan sabab: imlo va raqam diktanti bir-ikki hafta ichida natija beradi. Shuni birinchi bo'lib ko'rsating — o'quvchiga tez g'alaba kerak.
Mavzu belgisi bo'yicha saralashni ustoz ekranda ko'rsatib bersin: bir xil belgili xatolar yoniga tushganda o'quvchida "ha, demak muammo shunda" degan payt bo'ladi — darsning eng muhim daqiqasi shu.
Reja varaqasini ustoz imzolasin va nusxasini o'zida qoldirsin. Ikki haftadan keyin shu varaq bo'yicha hisobot so'raladi, aks holda reja qog'ozda qolib ketadi.
Bali past chiqqan o'quvchiga alohida bir og'iz gap ayting: mock — o'lchov asbobi, hukm emas. Xato qanchalik aniq nomlansa, shunchalik tez ketadi.
mistakes: Qaysi bo'lim, qaysi mavzu, qaysi sabab
Test paytida ekrandan chiqib telefonni ko'rish

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu xato qaysi sababdan?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz xato javobni o'qiydi, o'quvchi olti sababdan bittasini raqami bilan aytadi. Har javobdan keyin "demak nima qilish kerak" deb so'raladi.

Matching Headings da 5 ta savoldan 4 tasi xato, hammasi ketma-ket.

class_ex.title: 6-mashq: Writing — AI examiner izohi bo'yicha tahlil
class_ex.instr: Har o'quvchi examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasini ochadi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati. Besh qadamni daftarda bajaring. O'ng ustunda namuna (Aziz) — ko'chirmang, o'z natijangiz bilan ishlang.
items: 1-qadam. Task 1 va Task 2 uchun 4 mezon bo'yicha ballaringizni yozing: Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
2-qadam. Eng past mezonni belgilang. Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanishini eslang: qaysi task'dagi past ball Writing bandini ko'proq tushirgan?
3-qadam. Inglizcha izohdan eng muhim BITTA gapni toping va o'zbekchaga o'giring: examiner nimani so'rayapti?
4-qadam. Xatolar ro'yxatidan 5 ta xatoni tanlang: to'g'ri shaklini yozing va turini belgilang (grammatika yoki lug'at).
5-qadam. Eng past mezon uchun Writing darslarida (36–48) bajariladigan BITTA aniq odatni yozing.
answers: Aziz. Task 1: TA 5, CC 5, LR 5, GRA 5. Task 2: TR 5, CC 5, LR 5, GRA 4.
Eng past — GRA 4 (Task 2 da). Task 2 ikki barobar og'ir, shuning uchun aynan shu ball Writing bandini eng ko'p pastga tortgan.

"Frequent errors in subject-verb agreement and verb forms sometimes make your sentences hard to follow." → Ega-kesim mosligi va fe'l shakllaridagi tez-tez uchraydigan xatolar ba'zan gapni tushunishni qiyinlashtiradi: har gapda ega va kesimni tekshiring (GRA).

"people is" → "people are" (grammatika); "make a research" → "do research" (lug'at); "In the other hand" → "On the other hand" (lug'at); "more easier" → "easier" (grammatika); "I am agree" → "I agree" (grammatika).
Har body xatboshisidan keyin 2 daqiqa: har gapda ega-kesim mosligi va zamonni tekshiraman. 36-darsdagi "Mening zaif mezonim" varag'iga GRA ni yozaman.
why: Har mezonga faqat BUTUN ball qo'yiladi (masalan 5 yoki 6); .5 faqat o'rtacha — Writing bandida chiqadi.
Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi: Task 2 dagi 1 ball farq Writing bandiga Task 1 dagiga qaraganda ko'proq ta'sir qiladi.
Izoh inglizcha — tushunmagan so'zni ustozdan so'rang. Izohdan bitta aniq harakat chiqishi kerak.
Tuzatilgan xato — keyingi essayda takrorlanmaydigan xato. Grammatika xatolari GRA ga, so'z tanlash va birikma xatolari LR ga tegishli.
Odat kichik va aniq bo'lsin: "grammatikani yaxshilayman" emas, "har xatboshidan keyin 2 daqiqa tekshiraman".
class_ex.note: Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi), inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxatini beradi; ustoz (examiner) 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, natija shundan keyin e'lon qilinadi. Bu darsda faqat tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlanadi. 5.0 da Writing hali o'tilmagan (36-darsdan boshlanadi), shuning uchun bu ball — DIAGNOSTIKA: past ball xavotir emas, boshlang'ich nuqta. Ballni sinfda ovoz chiqarib aytmang.

homework_intro: Mock sessiyasida to'liq imtihonni topshirdingiz, bugun sinfda javoblar varaqasini savol-savol o'qib, har xatoga sabab qo'ydik va Writing izohini ko'rdik — uyda xuddi shu ishni oxirigacha, HAMMA xato bo'yicha qilasiz.

Birinchi vazifa "Xatolar daftari": har xato uchun beshta ustun — savol raqami, sizning javobingiz, to'g'ri javob, mavzu belgisi va sabab raqami; oxirida har sabab nechta marta chiqqanini sanaysiz va Writing ro'yxatidan yana 5 ta xatoni to'g'rilaysiz, bunga 30-35 daqiqa yetadi.
Ikkinchi vazifa — ikki haftalik rejani toza varaqqa ko'chirish: 6 qator, har qatorda aniq raqam, kunlik mashqning soati va haftalik mashqning kuni yozilgan bo'lsin, yana 15 daqiqa.
Uchinchi vazifa eng zaif mavzudan 10 savol: javobning yonida albatta DALILI bo'lsin — Listeningda qaysi so'z eshitilgan, Readingda matnning qaysi qatori.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — xatolarni ko'chirib yozib, sababini yozmaslik yoki "e'tiborsizlik" deb qo'yish; "e'tiborsizlik" sabab emas, olti sababdan bittasini tanlang.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; men sizning sabablar sonini rejangiz bilan solishtiraman.

homework.title: Xatolar daftari: har xatoga sabab
homework.instr: Javoblar varaqangizdagi HAR bir xato javobni daftarga ko'chiring. Har qator beshta ustundan iborat: savol raqami, mening javobim, to'g'ri javob, mavzu belgisi, sabab raqami (1-6). Oxirida har sabab nechta marta chiqqanini sanang. Writing: AI examiner ro'yxatidan 6-mashqda tuzatilmagan yana 5 ta xatoni to'g'ri shakli va turi (grammatika yoki lug'at) bilan yozing.
homework.answers: Ustoz keyingi dars boshida sabablar sonini tekshiradi. Eng ko'p chiqqan ikki sabab rejadagi ikki sabab bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart — bo'lmasa, reja noto'g'ri tuzilgan.

homework.title: Ikki haftalik reja — toza nusxa
homework.instr: 5-mashqdagi 6 qatorni reja varaqasiga o'z raqamlaringiz bilan toza ko'chiring. Kunlik mashq soati bilan, haftalik mashq kuni bilan ko'rsatilsin.
homework.answers: Reja ustoz tomonidan imzolanadi, nusxasi ustozda qoladi. Ikki haftadan keyin shu varaq bo'yicha hisobot: qaysi raqam o'zgardi, qaysisi o'zgarmadi.

intro: Task 2 — IELTS Writing ning ikkinchi va ASOSIY qismi. Kamida 250 so'z, taxminan 40 daqiqa. Ball jihatidan Task 1 dan IKKI BAROBAR og'ir: Writing bahosining uchdan ikki qismi shu essaydan chiqadi. Shuning uchun Task 1 ni 20 daqiqada tugatib, qolgan vaqtni Task 2 ga berish kerak.
250 so'zdan kam yozilsa jarima bor; ko'p yozish taqiqlanmagan, lekin 280-300 so'zdan oshgani odatda foyda bermaydi — xato ko'payadi, vaqt yetmaydi.
Ruchka ham, qalam ham mumkin (qog'oz imtihonda). Kompyuterda so'z sanagich bor, qog'ozda esa o'quvchi o'z qatoridagi so'z sonini bilishi kerak: odatda 10 qator taxminan 100 so'z.
General Training va Academic da Task 2 deyarli bir xil; GT da uslub biroz kamroq rasmiy bo'lishi mumkin, lekin qurilish bir xil.

5 TA SAVOL TURI: OPINION (to'liq o'z fikri), DISCUSSION (ikki tomon), OPINION+DISCUSSION (ikki tomon va o'z fikri), SITUATION (muammo-yechim / sabab-natija), TWO-PART (ikkita alohida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol, masalan "Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?" — har biriga alohida javob). Savol turini noto'g'ri tanish — eng qimmat xato: butun essay mavzuga tegishli bo'lsa ham, savolga javob bermagani uchun Task Response 5.0 ga tushadi.

BAHOLASH — 4 mezon, har biri 25%: Task Response (savolga javob), Coherence & Cohesion (tartib va bog'lanish), Lexical Resource (lug'at), Grammatical Range & Accuracy (grammatika). Umumiy ball — shu to'rttaning o'rtachasi.

7.0 ning kaliti: "hammasi mukammal" emas, balki "asosan to'g'ri, ba'zi kamchilik bor". Rasmiy jadvalda 7.0 uchun ataylab "some inaccuracies", "a few errors", "inappropriacies occur" deb yozilgan — ya'ni xatosiz yozish shart emas, xato KAM bo'lishi va tushunishga xalaqit bermasligi kerak.
presentation: Nega Task 2 muhimroq?
Balli ikki barobar: Writing bahosining uchdan ikki qismi shundan.
250 so'zdan kam yozsam?
Jarima bor — Task Response tushadi. 260-280 so'z eng xavfsiz.
Savol turini qanday bilaman?

Oxirgi so'roq gap(lar)ga qarang: "agree or disagree" — OPINION; "discuss both views" — ikkalasi; "problems and solutions" — SITUATION; ikkita alohida savol ("Why…? Is it positive or negative?") — TWO-PART.
Ikkala tomonni yozdim, lekin fikrim yo'q.
"Discuss both views AND give your own opinion" bo'lsa — fikr MAJBURIY. Yo'q bo'lsa ball tushadi.
7.0 uchun xatosiz yozish kerakmi?
Yo'q. Rasmiy jadvalning o'zida "a few errors" deb yozilgan — kam xato, tushunishga xalaqit bermaydigan xato.
4 mezondan qaysi biri eng og'ir?
Hammasi teng — har biri 25%. Lekin eng tez tushadigani Task Response: savolga javob bermaslik.
Uzun so'z ishlatsam ball ko'tariladimi?
Faqat TO'G'RI ishlatilsa. Noto'g'ri joyda ishlatilgan "kuchli" so'z Lexical Resource ni tushiradi.
notes: Bu — Writing bo'limining birinchi darsi. Maqsad: qoidalarni yodlash emas, TUSHUNISH. Har mezonni o'quvchi o'z so'zi bilan aytib bera olishi kerak.
7.0 ga urg'u beriladi, chunki markaz talabalarining ko'pchiligi 6.0-6.5 da qotib qoladi. Farq odatda bitta narsada: fikr ochib berilmagan (Task Response) yoki bog'lovchilar mexanik (Coherence).
Rasmiy jadvaldan uzun parcha o'qib bermang — har mezondan 2-3 ta kalit ibora oling, qolganini o'zbekcha tushuntiring. Jadvalning o'zi ustozda turadi.
Namuna essay tahlili — darsning eng qimmat qismi. To'rt yurishni ARALASHTIRMANG: har yurishda faqat bitta narsa qidiriladi, aks holda o'quvchi chalkashadi.

Agar ustozda slayd essayi bo'lsa (crime/punishment, 264 so'z), vaqt qolganda uni ham xuddi shu uch rang bilan takrorlang: sariq — lug'at, yashil — grammatika, siyoh — bog'lovchilar. Slayd tizimda yo'q, shuning uchun bu bosqich timeline'ga kiritilmagan.
Dars oxirida har o'quvchi "mening zaif mezonim" ni yozadi — 37-48-darslar shu ro'yxatga qarab olib boriladi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Savol turini aniqlang
class_ex.instr: Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; o'quvchi turini aytadi va QAYSI SO'Z shunday deyishga majbur qilganini ko'rsatadi.
items: Some people think children should start school at the age of four. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of working from home.
Some people prefer to live in a city, while others prefer the countryside. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Many young people in cities are overweight. What are the causes and what solutions can you suggest?
Is the increasing use of mobile phones by children a positive or a negative development?
Some believe universities should be free for everyone. Others say students should pay. Discuss both these views.
More and more people live alone. What factors contribute to this? Is it a realistic expectation that this will continue?
Do the advantages of studying abroad outweigh the disadvantages?
Traffic in big cities is getting worse. What problems does this cause and how can they be solved?
Some people say that money is the most important factor when choosing a job. To what extent do you agree?
why: "To what extent do you agree" — faqat o'z fikri, ikki tomon shart emas.
"advantages and disadvantages" — ikki tomon, fikr so'ralmagan.
"discuss both views AND give your own opinion" — ikki tomon va fikr.
"causes ... solutions" — muammo-yechim.
"positive or negative development" — baho berish, ya'ni fikr.
Faqat "discuss both" — o'z fikri so'ralmagan, lekin ikki tomon majburiy.

Ikkita alohida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol: "What factors contribute…?" va "Is it a realistic expectation…?" — har biriga alohida body bilan javob beriladi. Muammo-yechim juftligi emas, shuning uchun SITUATION emas.
"outweigh" — ikkala tomonni ko'rsatib, qaysi biri og'irligini aytish kerak. Bu savol BAHO talab qiladi: xulosada "ustunliklar og'irroq" yoki "kamchiliklar og'irroq" degan aniq hukm bo'lishi shart.
Ikki qism: muammolar va yechimlar. Ikkalasiga ham javob shart.
Fikr so'ralyapti; qarshi tomonni bitta xatboshida ko'rsatish mumkin, lekin asosiy fikr aniq bo'lishi kerak.
class_ex.note: Doskada 5 ustun turadi: OPINION, DISCUSSION, OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION, TWO-PART. Har savol o'z ustuniga yoziladi.
