readings.title: Namuna essay (Band 8 darajasi): qat'iy jazo va sud qarori
readings.qtype: Discuss both views + opinion — to'rt tomonlama tahlil
readings.book_ref: Savol turi — OPINION + DISCUSSION. Ustoz slaydidagi essay bilan bir xil savolga yozilgan, lekin matn Jony Academy'niki.
text: SAVOL: Some people believe that there should be fixed punishments for each crime. Others argue that the circumstances of an individual crime, and the motivation for committing it, should always be taken into account. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Whether every offence should carry a set penalty, or whether judges should weigh up why a crime was committed, is a question that divides legal experts. While a rigid tariff has obvious attractions, I would argue that the context of an offence must shape the sentence.

Supporters of fixed penalties point to consistency. If the punishment for a particular offence is laid down in advance, two people who commit the same act receive the same sentence, regardless of who their lawyer is or which judge hears the case. This predictability also acts as a deterrent, because potential offenders know exactly what they risk. Sentencing hearings, moreover, become far shorter, which saves courts a considerable amount of money that could be redirected into policing or victim support.

Those who favour flexibility, however, argue that identical acts are rarely identical crimes. A woman who steals food for her children and a gang member who robs a shop for profit have both broken the same law, yet most people would hesitate to punish them in the same way. Taking motive and circumstances into account allows courts to recognise coercion, desperation or genuine remorse, and it leaves room for rehabilitation rather than pure retribution. Without that discretion, the law risks being obeyed but not respected.

In my view, fairness matters more than administrative convenience. A sensible compromise is to set clear sentencing ranges for each offence and to let judges move within them once they have examined the motives involved. This preserves consistency while ensuring that the punishment genuinely fits both the crime and the person who committed it.
paraphrases: a set penalty / a rigid tariff
why a crime was committed / motive
I would argue / In my view

homework_intro: Bugun biz beshta savol turini va to'rtta baholash mezonini ochdik; uyga vazifa ham xuddi shu ikkitasini mustahkamlaydi, faqat endi yordamsiz, yolg'iz o'zingiz bajarasiz.

Birinchi ikkitasi qisqa: "Mening zaif mezonim" da mock Writing natijangizdagi (35-dars) to'rt mezon ballariga qarab eng past mezonni yozib, sababini 2 gapda tushuntirasiz (5 daqiqa); "Savol turlari daftari" da esa vazifadagi 8 ta Task 2 savolining har biriga turini va turni belgilab bergan kalit so'zni yozasiz — 8 qator, taxminan 15 daqiqa.

Uchinchisi — bugun tahlil qilgan 265 so'zlik namuna essayni QO'LDA to'liq ko'chirib yozing va undan 10 ta yangi so'z yoki iborani lug'at daftariga o'zbekcha ma'nosi bilan chiqaring; bunga 30-35 daqiqa ketadi, ko'chirish qurilmani qo'l bilan his qilish uchun kerak.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — savol turini mavzuga qarab taxmin qilish: turni faqat OXIRGI so'roq gap(lar) belgilaydi (TWO-PART da ikkita savol), shuning uchun "discuss both views", "causes and solutions" kabi kalit so'zni savolning o'zidan ko'chirib yozing, yodingizdan yozmang.
Uchalasi ham keyingi dars boshida daftar bilan topshiriladi: zaif mezon varaqlarini men yig'ib olaman, ko'chirilgan essaydan esa 5 daqiqalik og'zaki so'rov bo'ladi.

homework.title: "Mening zaif mezonim"
homework.instr: Mock Writing natijangizdagi (35-dars, 6-mashq) to'rt mezon ballariga qarang: eng past mezonni yozing va NEGA shundayligini 2 gapda tushuntiring (AI izohidan bitta misol keltiring). Mockda qatnashmagan bo'lsangiz — o'zingizga eng qiyin tuyulgan mezonni yozing.
homework.answers: Ustoz ro'yxatni yig'adi — 37-48-darslar shu bo'yicha olib boriladi.

homework.title: Savol turlari daftari
homework.instr: Quyidagi 8 ta Task 2 savolining har biriga turini yozing (OPINION, DISCUSSION, OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION, TWO-PART) va turni belgilagan kalit so'zni savolning o'zidan ko'chiring.
items: Some people think that all school leavers should do a year of community work before starting university. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that zoos are cruel and should be closed. Others think zoos help to protect wild animals. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In many countries, fewer people read books for pleasure than in the past. What are the causes of this, and what solutions can you suggest?
More and more people now buy their clothes online instead of in shops. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
Many couples today are choosing to have children later in life. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?
Some people say that public libraries are no longer needed because of the internet. Others believe they are still important. Discuss both these views.
Some people argue that the best way to improve public health is to build more sports centres. Do you agree or disagree?
Many young people now get most of their news from social media. Why is this the case? Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
why: "To what extent do you agree or disagree" — faqat o'z fikri.
"Discuss both views and give your own opinion" — ikki tomon va o'z fikri.
"causes … solutions" — sabab-yechim.
"advantages and disadvantages" — ikki tomon, o'z fikri so'ralmagan.
Ikki alohida savol: "Why is this happening?" va "positive or negative development?".
Faqat "Discuss both these views" — o'z fikri so'ralmagan, ikki tomon majburiy.
"Do you agree or disagree" — o'z fikri.
Ikki alohida savol: "Why is this the case?" va "Do the advantages … outweigh …?" (baho talab qilinadi).

kahoot.q: What is the minimum length of an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay?
kahoot.explain: Task 2 — kamida 250 so'z; 150 so'z — Task 1 talabi.

kahoot.q: How much does Task 2 count in the Writing score compared with Task 1?
options: It counts three times as much
kahoot.explain: Task 2 ikki barobar og'ir: Writing bahosining uchdan ikki qismi shundan chiqadi.

kahoot.q: In the exam, about how long should you spend on Task 2?
kahoot.explain: Task 1 ga 20 daqiqa, Task 2 ga taxminan 40 daqiqa ajratiladi.

kahoot.q: What is the best way to identify the Task 2 question type?
options: Look at the topic and guess the type from it
Count the sentences in the prompt
Check the first word of the prompt
kahoot.explain: Turni mavzu emas, SO'NGGI so'roq gap yoki ko'rsatma belgilaydi.

kahoot.q: '…Discuss both views and give your own opinion.' What must the essay include?
options: Both views and a clear opinion
Only the view you agree with
kahoot.explain: Ikki qarash ham ochiladi va o'z fikri aniq aytiladi — fikr bo'lmasa Task Response tushadi.

kahoot.q: 'Many teenagers sleep too little. What are the causes, and what solutions can you suggest?' Which type is this?
kahoot.explain: Sabab + yechim juftligi — SITUATION: bir xatboshida sabablar, ikkinchisida yechimlar.

kahoot.q: 'Why do many young people move abroad? Is this a positive or negative development?' Which type is this?
kahoot.explain: Ikki alohida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol (Why…? + positive or negative?) — TWO-PART: har biriga alohida javob beriladi.

kahoot.q: 'Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of online shopping.' Do you have to give your opinion?
options: No, but cover both sides fully
Yes, in every single body paragraph
Yes, but only in the conclusion
kahoot.explain: "advantages and disadvantages" — ikki tomon so'raladi, o'z fikri so'ralmagan; lekin xulosa baribir kerak.

kahoot.q: How is each of the four Writing criteria marked?
options: With letters from A to F
kahoot.explain: Har mezonga faqat butun ball (0–9) qo'yiladi; .5 faqat o'rtacha (umumiy) ballda chiqadi.

kahoot.q: Which criterion checks paragraphing and the linking of ideas?
kahoot.explain: Xatboshilash va bog'lovchilar — Coherence and Cohesion (CC) mezoni.

kahoot.q: A student uses a rare, 'impressive' word in the wrong context. What usually happens?
kahoot.explain: Noto'g'ri joyda ishlatilgan "kuchli" so'z Lexical Resource'ni tushiradi — so'z faqat to'g'ri ishlatilsa foyda beradi.

kahoot.q: An essay for Task 2 has only 225 words. What is the most likely result?
options: The essay is not marked at all
Nothing, because length is not checked
Only the grammar score is lowered
kahoot.explain: 250 so'zdan kam yozilsa jarima bor — Task Response bali pasayadi.

kahoot.q: 'Judges should take the circumstances into account.' What does 'take … into account' mean?
kahoot.explain: take into account — hisobga olmoq, e'tiborga olmoq.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct collocation: 'People who ___ a crime should be punished.'
kahoot.explain: "commit a crime" — tabiiy birikma; "make/do a crime" deyilmaydi.

kahoot.q: What is a 'compromise'?
options: an agreement where both sides give a little
a decision that one side forces on the other side
a punishment that is fixed before the trial
a strong refusal to change your opinion
kahoot.explain: compromise — murosa: har ikki tomon biroz yon beradi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Namuna essay tahlili — 4 mezon bo'yicha baholash
lessons.grammar_topic: Band 5.5 va Band 7.5 essaylarni solishtirib, har mezonga butun ball qo'yish
lessons.vocab_topic: Baholash mezonlari amalda: 6.0 dan 7.0 ga qanday chiqiladi
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — ikkala namuna essay ham bitta savolga Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan; baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: 36-darsda o'rganilgan 4 mezonni AMALDA qo'llash: essayga ball qo'yish.
Bir xil savolga yozilgan ikki essayni solishtirib, 5.5 va 7.5 farqini ko'z bilan ko'rish.
Har mezon uchun 3 tadan tekshiruv savolini yod olish (o'z essayini shu savollar bilan tekshirish).
A essaydagi (Band 5.5) aniq kamchiliklarni topib, ularni qaysi mezonga tegishli ekanini aytish.
Bitta zaif xatboshini 7.0 darajasiga ko'tarib qayta yozish.
materials: Ikkala essay nusxasi (quyida) — har o'quvchiga, yonida bo'sh ustun: "ball va sabab".
36-darsdagi 4 mezon kartochkalari — doskada turadi.
Rasmiy IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (ochiq hujjat, ielts.org, 2023-yil may tahriri) — 5, 6 va 7 qatorlari yonma-yon chop etiladi.
Har o'quvchining "mening zaif mezonim" varaqasi (36-darsdagi uyga vazifa).
timeline: 36-darsdagi kartochkalar; "zaif mezonim" varaqalari (36-dars uyga vazifasi) yig'iladi
Mezonga faqat butun ball, o'rtacha hisobi; 2-mashq (5 daqiqa): bitta zaif mezon butun bahoni tortadi
1-topshiriq jadvali: har mezonga butun ball, sababi bilan
2-topshiriq: ibora, kamchilik, qaysi mezon (13 daqiqa); 3-mashq: kamchilik — mezon va band (7 daqiqa)
Juftlikda, B essay tarqatilishidan OLDIN; avval o'zlari yozadi, keyin o'ng ustundagi namuna ko'rsatiladi
A ning 2-xatboshisi: fikr, sabab, misol, natija; 2 ta variant doskada tuzatiladi
1-topshiriq: ball; 2-topshiriq: mezon-mezon nima o'zgardi; 4-5-mashq variantlari B dagi gaplar bilan solishtiriladi
Har kim 35-dars mock essayiga o'zi ball qo'yadi

intro: Imtihon tekshiruvchisi essayni o'qib chiqib, har mezonga ALOHIDA ball qo'yadi — faqat BUTUN ball (5, 6, 7 …); mezonga 5.5 yoki 6.5 qo'yilmaydi. Keyin to'rttasining o'rtachasi olinadi va yarim ball faqat shu yerda chiqadi. Masalan 7 + 6 + 7 + 6 = 26, o'rtachasi 6.5.
Shuning uchun BITTA zaif mezon butun bahoni pastga tortadi. Uchta mezonda 7, bittasida 5 bo'lsa — 26 : 4 = 6.5, ya'ni natija 7.0 ga yetmaydi.
Ballni "yaxshi yozilganga o'xshaydi" deb emas, JADVALGA qarab qo'yish kerak. Har mezon uchun uchta oddiy tekshiruv savoli bor (1-mashq) — shu savollarga javob berilsa, ball o'zidan chiqadi.

6.0 va 7.0 farqi katta emas, lekin ANIQ: 6 da fikr bor-u ochilmagan, bog'lovchi bor-u mexanik, murakkab gap bor-u xatoli. 7 da esa fikr ochilgan, bog'lovchi o'z joyida, murakkab gaplarning ko'pi xatosiz.
Bugungi ikkala essay BITTA savolga yozilgan va g'oyalari ham o'xshash. Farq faqat YOZILISHIDA — aynan shuning uchun solishtirish juda aniq ko'rinadi.
O'quvchi o'z essayini shu usulda baholay olsa, o'sish tezlashadi: u endi "nimani tuzatishim kerak" degan savolga aniq javob beradi.
presentation: Ball qanday chiqadi?
To'rt mezonning o'rtachasi: 7+6+7+6 = 26, 26 : 4 = 6.5.
Bitta mezonda 5 bo'lsa?
Umumiy ball keskin tushadi. Shuning uchun zaif mezon ustida ishlanadi.
Uzun essay ko'proq ball oladimi?
Yo'q. 250-280 so'z yetarli; uzunligi emas, sifati sanaladi. Lekin 250 dan kam bo'lsa — jarima: 200 atrofidagi essayda TR odatda 5 dan oshmaydi (A essay — 199 so'z).
A essay yomonmi?
Yomon emas — u 5.5. Savolga javob bergan, tushunarli. Lekin 250 so'zga yetmagan, fikr ochilmagan va grammatik xatolar takrorlanadi.
Nega "Moreover" ko'p bo'lsa yomon?
Bog'lovchi mexanik bo'lib qoladi. Jadvalda CC 7 uchun "flexibly" deyilgan — o'rinli va xilma-xil.
O'zimning essayimni o'zim baholay olamanmi?
Ha, 12 ta tekshiruv savoli bilan. Lekin ustoz bahosi bilan solishtirib turish kerak.
Grammatikam kuchsiz, nima qilay?
Avval xatosiz ODDIY gap yozing, keyin murakkabini qo'shing. GRA 7 da "error-free sentences are frequent" deyilgan.
notes: Bu dars 36-darsning davomi: u yerda mezon TUSHUNTIRILGAN, bu yerda AMALDA qo'llanadi. 36-darssiz boshlamang.
Ballni ustoz aytib yubormasin — o'quvchilar o'zi qo'ysin, keyin solishtirilsin. Xato qo'yilgan ball ham foydali: sababi muhokama qilinadi.

A essay ataylab zaif yozilgan — Band 5.5 (TR 5, CC 6, LR 6, GRA 5): xatolar tabiiy va tanish (he study, find job, Moreover takrori, "It depends" xulosasi), hajmi 199 so'z. Bu — markaz talabalarida eng ko'p uchraydigan holat.

B essay o'sha savolga 7.5 darajasida yozilgan. DIQQAT: B dagi fikrlar A dagiga o'xshash — farq faqat ochib berilishi, bog'lanishi va tilida. Buni ta'kidlang: "yangi g'oya o'ylab topish shart emas, borini to'g'ri yozish kerak".

4- va 5-mashq B essay tarqatilishidan OLDIN bajariladi, aks holda o'quvchi B dagi tayyor gapni ko'chiradi. 5-mashqda o'quvchilar A ning 2-xatboshisini qayta yozadi; yaxshi variantlar doskaga yoziladi va guruh bilan tuzatiladi, keyin B essayning 2-xatboshisi bilan solishtiriladi.

Uyga vazifada har kim 35-dars mock imtihonidagi Writing Task 2 essayiga o'zi ball qo'yadi va AI examiner bahosi bilan solishtiradi (mockda qatnashmaganlar yangi savolga essay yozadi). Keyingi darslar shu natijaga qarab yo'naltiriladi.

readings.title: A ESSAY — Band 5.5 darajasi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (o'qitish uchun ataylab zaif yozilgan — Band 5.5, 199 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people think that university students should be free to choose any subject they like. Others believe students should only study subjects that are useful for the future, such as science and technology. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Nowadays, students in university can choose any subject which they want to study. Some people think this is good, but other people think students must study only useful subjects like science and technology. In this essay I will discuss both views and give my opinion.

Firstly, many people believe that students should study what they like. The reason is that when a student likes his subject, he study better and he is more happy. Moreover, a person who study art or history can also find job. Moreover, it is not fair to tell young people what they must do, because they are adults and they know their life.

On the other hand, some people think that only useful subjects are important. Firstly, the country needs engineers and doctors. If there are no engineers, the country can not develop and people will have many problem. Moreover, science students find job easily and they get good salary. This is very important thing for family.

In conclusion, there are advantages and disadvantages in both views. I think that maybe the government can support science subjects, but also students must be free to choose. It depends on the situation and on the student.
paraphrases: can choose any subject which they want
useful subjects ("for the future" tushib qolgan)
glossary: advantages and disadvantages — foyda va zarar
it depends — bog'liq (xulosada ishlatilsa, noaniq pozitsiya belgisi)

readings.title: B ESSAY — Band 7.5 darajasi
readings.book_ref: Savol A essay bilan bir xil. G'oyalar ham o'xshash — farq faqat ochib berilishi, bog'lanishi va tilida.
text: Universities in many countries now allow undergraduates to select almost any course, while others argue that places should be reserved for subjects with obvious economic value, such as engineering or medicine. Although practical skills clearly matter, I believe that students learn best when they are allowed to follow their own interests.

Those who support free choice point to motivation. Students who are genuinely interested in their subject tend to work harder and to give up less easily, which is reflected in both their results and their willingness to keep studying. A student who loves history, for example, will read far beyond the reading list, and the research skills gained in that process are valued by employers in almost every sector. Restricting choice, by contrast, risks producing graduates who are qualified but unmotivated.

There is, however, a reasonable argument on the other side. Every economy depends on a steady supply of engineers, doctors and technicians, and without them infrastructure and healthcare quickly deteriorate. Graduates in these fields also tend to find work sooner and to earn more, which for many families is the decisive consideration when tuition fees are high. Countries that have allowed such shortages to develop have often been forced to recruit specialists from abroad at considerable expense.

In my view, these two positions can be reconciled. Rather than closing courses, governments can make shortage subjects more attractive through scholarships, paid internships and guaranteed employment schemes, leaving the final decision to the student. This approach protects the professions a country needs while respecting the simple fact that people rarely excel at work they did not choose.

homework_intro: Bugun biz A essayga ham, B essayga ham mezon-mezon ball qo'ydik — uyda xuddi shu ishni o'z essayingizga qilasiz.

Birinchi vazifa "O'z essayingga ball qo'y": 35-dars mock imtihonidagi Writing Task 2 essayingizni oching (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar), to'rt mezonga o'zingiz BUTUN ball qo'ying, har ballga bittadan sabab yozing va AI examiner bahosi bilan solishtiring; shu bilan birga 1-mashqdagi 12 tekshiruv savolini daftaringiz oxiriga ko'chirib qo'ying — ikkalasiga 20 daqiqa yetadi. Mockda qatnashmagan bo'lsangiz, avval vazifadagi savolga 40 daqiqada yangi essay yozasiz.
Keyin A essayning 3-xatboshisini 5-mashqdagi tartib bilan qayta yozing: asosiy fikr, sabab, misol, natija — kamida to'rt gap, yana 20 daqiqa.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — ball qo'yib, sababini yozmaslik yoki o'ziga ortiqcha ball qo'yish; har ball yonida "nega aynan shunday" degan bitta jumla bo'lsin.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi darsning boshida yig'iladi; men ballaringizni o'z bahom bilan solishtiraman.

homework.title: O'z essayingga ball qo'y
homework.instr: 35-dars mock imtihonidagi Writing Task 2 essayingni och (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar). To'rt mezonga BUTUN ball qo'y, HAR BALLGA bittadan sabab yoz va AI examiner bahosi bilan solishtir. Mockda qatnashmagan bo'lsang — shu savolga 40 daqiqada yangi essay yoz va unga ball qo'y: "Some people believe that all teenagers should do unpaid work in their local community for a few hours each week. To what extent do you agree or disagree?"
homework.answers: Ustoz ballarni o'z bahosi bilan solishtiradi — farq katta bo'lsa, sababi muhokama qilinadi.

homework.title: A essayning 3-xatboshisini qayta yozing
homework.instr: 5-mashqdagi tartib bilan: asosiy fikr, sabab, misol, natija. Kamida 4 gap.
homework.answers: Namuna — B essayning 3-xatboshisi.

homework.title: 12 ta tekshiruv savoli
homework.instr: 1-mashqdagi 12 savolni daftaringizga ko'chiring va har essaydan keyin shu ro'yxat bo'yicha o'zingizni tekshiring.
homework.answers: Keyingi darslarda shu ro'yxat ishlatiladi.

kahoot.q: How is each of the four Writing criteria (TR, CC, LR, GRA) scored?
kahoot.explain: Har mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi; .5 faqat to'rt mezonning o'rtachasida chiqadi.

kahoot.q: Which of these is one of the four Task 2 marking criteria?
kahoot.explain: To'rt mezon — TR, CC, LR va GRA; Fluency va Pronunciation esa Speaking mezonlari.

kahoot.q: An essay gets TR 6, CC 5, LR 6 and GRA 5. What band does the essay get?
kahoot.explain: 6 + 5 + 6 + 5 = 22, 22 : 4 = 5.5 — to'rt mezonning o'rtachasi olinadi.

kahoot.q: Three criteria get 8, but GRA gets 6. What band does the essay get?
kahoot.explain: 8 + 8 + 8 + 6 = 30, 30 : 4 = 7.5 — bitta zaif mezon butun bahoni pastga tortadi.

kahoot.q: A Task 2 essay has only about 200 words. Which criterion is penalised?
kahoot.explain: 250 so'zdan kam essay TR da jazolanadi; 200 atrofida bo'lsa TR odatda 5 dan oshmaydi.

kahoot.q: A writer starts nearly every sentence with 'In addition'. Which criterion suffers most?
kahoot.explain: Bog'lovchini mexanik takrorlash CC ni tushiradi; 7 uchun bog'lovchilar o'rinli va xilma-xil bo'lishi kerak.

kahoot.q: Essay question: 'Is working from home good for employees?' Which conclusion gives the clearest position?
options: In my view, the benefits clearly outweigh the risks.
Some people agree with this and some people disagree.
There are many advantages and also disadvantages.
Both sides are right in some ways, I suppose.
kahoot.explain: Xulosada aniq pozitsiya bo'lishi shart; ikki tomonga og'adigan noaniq xulosa TR ni tushiradi.

kahoot.q: Which plan makes a Task 2 body paragraph fully developed?
options: One example and no main idea
kahoot.explain: 7 uchun har fikr sabab va misol bilan ochiladi; aytilgan, lekin ochilmagan fikr — 6 belgisi.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Everyone who works hard deserves a fair reward.
Everyone who work hard deserves a fair reward.
Everyone who works hard deserve a fair reward.
Everyone who working hard deserves a fair reward.
kahoot.explain: 'Everyone' birlik: ergash gapdagi fe'l ham, asosiy fe'l ham -s oladi (works, deserves).

kahoot.q: Which sentence is a complex sentence with no errors?
options: Students who enjoy their course tend to work harder.
Students enjoy their course, and so they work very hard.
Students who enjoys their course works harder.
Students enjoying course, they work more hard.
kahoot.explain: Sifatlovchi ergash gap (who …) xatosiz ishlatilgan; 'and so' bilan bog'langan gap esa murakkab emas, qo'shma gap.

kahoot.q: Your teacher writes 'ideas insufficiently developed'. What should you add?
kahoot.explain: 'Insufficiently developed' — TR izohi: fikrga sabab va aniq misol qo'shilsa, TR ko'tariladi.

kahoot.q: A student uses the word 'good' in almost every sentence. Which criterion is affected most?
kahoot.explain: Bitta so'zni qayta-qayta ishlatish so'z boyligi kamligini ko'rsatadi, ya'ni LR tushadi.

kahoot.q: What is an 'undergraduate'?
options: A university student taking a first degree
A lecturer who teaches at a university
A school pupil who is preparing for university
A graduate studying for a doctorate
kahoot.explain: Undergraduate — bakalavr talabasi, ya'ni birinchi darajani olayotgan talaba.

kahoot.q: If a country's roads 'deteriorate', they ___.
kahoot.explain: Deteriorate — yomonlashmoq.

kahoot.q: A 'shortage' of engineers means there are ___.
kahoot.explain: Shortage — taqchillik, yetishmovchilik.

kahoot.q: 'Price was the decisive factor in our choice.' 'Decisive' means ___.
kahoot.explain: Decisive — hal qiluvchi, ya'ni yakuniy tanlovni belgilaydigan.

kahoot.q: What are 'tuition fees'?
options: Money paid for a course of study
Money paid to rent a student flat
Money given to students as a prize
Money paid for books and stationery
kahoot.explain: Tuition fees — o'qish uchun to'lanadigan pul (kontrakt).

kahoot.q: Which verb means 'to bring two different ideas together so that both can work'?
kahoot.explain: Reconcile — murosaga keltirmoq, kelishtirmoq.

kahoot.q: 'She excels at maths.' What does 'excel' mean?
kahoot.explain: Excel at — biror sohada a'lo natija ko'rsatmoq.

kahoot.q: When there are not enough nurses, hospitals often ___ staff from abroad.
kahoot.explain: Recruit — ishga yollamoq, xodim jalb qilmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Paraphrasing Skills
lessons.grammar_topic: Savolni o'z so'zi bilan qayta yozish va essay ichida takrorni yo'qotish
lessons.vocab_topic: Uch yo'l: sinonim, so'z turkumi, gap qurilishi — va ularni birlashtirish
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha savol matnlari, namuna essay va mashq gaplari Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan. Mavzu oilasi: sayyohlik, kichik shaharlar va tarixiy meros.
objectives: Task 2 savolini kalit bo'laklarga ajratib, har bo'lakni alohida paraphrase qila olish.
Uch yo'lni farqlash: sinonim almashtirish, so'z turkumini o'zgartirish, gap grammatikasini o'zgartirish.
Xavfsiz sinonim bilan xavfli sinonimni ajratish: birikmaga tushmaydigan so'z ballni tushiradi.
Yomon paraphrase belgilarini tanib olish: ko'chirilgan so'zlar va noto'g'ri birikma.
Bitta savolni uchala yo'lni birlashtirib, bitta tabiiy gapda qayta yozish.
Essay ichida kalit so'zni (masalan "tourists") uch-to'rt xil ifoda bilan almashtirish.
materials: Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi namuna essay bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan, kirish xatboshisi ostiga chiziq tortilgan holda.
"Zaif kirish" varaqasi (3-topshiriq matni) — har juftlikka bittadan, ustiga yozish uchun keng joy qoldirilgan.
Doskaga darsdan oldin yozib qo'yiladi: UCH YO'L — 1) sinonim 2) so'z turkumi 3) gap qurilishi. Butun dars davomida o'chirilmaydi.

Doska va marker: 4-mashq boshida doskaning pastki qismiga savol yoziladi — "In many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply." Xuddi shu savol namuna essayda ham ishlatiladi, shuning uchun dars oxirigacha turadi.

1-mashq uchun 18 ta kartochka (6 kalit so'z + 6 xavfsiz + 6 xavfli sinonim) — qirqib, aralashtirib stolga qo'yiladi. Kalit so'zlar: tourists, historical buildings, money, the number of tourists has increased, small towns, governments. Xavfsiz: visitors, heritage sites, funding, a rise in visitor numbers, smaller towns, the authorities. Xavfli: aliens, ancient buildings, cash, the amount of tourists, little cities, politicians.

5 ta Task 2 savol matni chop etilgan varaq — har o'quvchiga bittadan: 1) kichik shaharlardagi sayyohlik (4-mashq va namuna essay savoli), 2) meros binolarini ta'mirlash puli (5-mashq), 3) muzeyga kirish haqi, 4) arzon aviachiptalar, 5) an'analarning yo'qolishi — oxirgi uchtasi uyga vazifaning 1-topshirig'i uchun.
Bo'sh A4 varaqlar — 5-mashqda yetti bosqichni ketma-ket yozish uchun, har juftlikka ikkitadan.
timeline: Doskaga yoziladi: "Nowadays, students in university can choose any subject which they want to study" (37-darsdagi A essay kirishi) — savol deyarli ko'chirilgan, shu sababli bu gap ball bermaydi
Ustoz "Tushuntirish" bo'limining 1-5 bandini aytib beradi: ko'chirilgan so'z sanalmaydi, so'z soni kamayadi; doskadagi UCH YO'L har biriga bittadan misol bilan ko'rsatiladi
1-mashq, kartochkalar bilan: xavfsiz va xavfli sinonim
4-mashq: har variantga YAXSHI, O'RTACHA yoki YOMON hukmi
5-mashq: bitta savol yetti bosqichda qayta yoziladi
Juftlikda yoziladi, ikki variant doskaga chiqariladi

intro: Paraphrase — savolni O'Z SO'ZI bilan qayta aytish. Kirish xatboshining birinchi gapi aynan shu ish uchun ishlatiladi; ikkinchi gapda pozitsiya aytiladi.
Nega kerak: tekshiruvchi savoldan ko'chirilgan so'zlarni HISOBGA OLMAYDI. Ular so'z sonidan ham chiqariladi — 260 so'z yozib, 230 so'zga baholanishingiz mumkin.

Uch yo'l bor va ularni birga ishlatish kerak: 1) SINONIM (tourists — visitors), 2) SO'Z TURKUMI (has increased — there has been an increase), 3) GAP QURILISHI (aktiv — passiv, ergash gap — ot iborasi).
Faqat sinonim almashtirish yetarli emas: gap tuzilishi o'sha-o'sha qolsa, ko'chirma his qilinadi. Faqat qurilishni o'zgartirish ham yetarli emas: so'zlar o'sha-o'sha qoladi.

XAVFSIZ sinonim — birikmaga tushadigan so'z. XAVFLI sinonim — lug'atdan olingan, lekin bu gapda ishlamaydigan so'z: "the amount of tourists", "alien tourists", "little cities". Bunday xato — 37-darsda ko'rganimizdek — Lexical Resource ni 6 ga tushiradi.
Qoida: agar so'zga ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa — ALMASHTIRMANG. Noto'g'ri sinonim takrordan ko'ra ko'proq ball yo'qotadi.

Ba'zi so'zlar umuman almashtirilmaydi: atoqli otlar, raqamlar, "government", "environment", "technology" kabi asosiy terminlar. Ularni har gapda takrorlamaslik uchun olmosh yoki umumlashtiruvchi ot ishlatiladi (tourists — they — this group).

Paraphrase faqat kirishda emas: butun essay bo'yicha kalit so'zni 3-4 xil ifoda bilan aytish kerak. Aks holda bitta so'z qayta-qayta takrorlanadi: 37-darsdagi A essayda "people" 6 marta, "think" 4 marta.
Vaqt: paraphrase ga 3 daqiqadan ko'p sarflamang. Mukammal emas, TABIIY va XATOSIZ bo'lsa yetarli.
Tekshiruv: paraphrase yozib bo'lgach, savolni yopib, o'z gapingizni o'qing. Ma'no o'zgarganmi? O'zgargan bo'lsa — Task Response tushadi, bu sinonimdan ko'ra qimmatroq.
formulas: "the money spent on restoring historical buildings" bitta bo'lak
has increased — there has been an increase
Some people say — It is sometimes argued
presentation: Savoldagi hamma so'zni almashtirish shartmi?
Yo'q. "government", "environment" kabi terminlar va raqamlar qoladi. Boshqalari o'zgaradi.
Bitta so'zni ham almashtira olmasam?
Unda gap qurilishini o'zgartiring: aktivni passivga aylantiring yoki ergash gapni ot iborasiga.
Paraphrase qancha uzun bo'lishi kerak?
Savol bilan taxminan bir xil. Uzaytirish shart emas, ANIQ bo'lsin.
Noto'g'ri sinonim yozsam nima bo'ladi?
Lexical Resource tushadi, ba'zan Task Response ham — ma'no o'zgarsa. Takrordan ko'ra yomonroq.
Tezaurusdan so'z olsam bo'ladimi?

Faqat ilgari ko'rgan va birikmasini bilgan so'zni oling. "Alien" ham lug'atda "foreign" deb turadi, lekin odam haqida u huquqiy yoki salbiy ohangli so'z ("chet el fuqarosi", "begona"): sayyohlar haqida essayda qo'pol va noo'rin eshitiladi.
Essay ichida ham paraphrase kerakmi?
Ha. Bitta kalit so'zni 3-4 xil ifoda bilan ayting, aks holda LR 6 da qoladi.
Paraphrase ga qancha vaqt beraman?
3 daqiqa. Qolgan vaqt fikrga va tanaga sarflanadi.
Kirishda "In this essay I will discuss" yozsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. 37-darsda ko'rdik: bu gap ball qo'shmaydi, faqat so'z sarflaydi.
notes: MAVZU OILASI: bu darsda faqat SAYYOHLIK, KICHIK SHAHARLAR va TARIXIY MEROS mavzusidagi savollar ishlatilgan (5 ta savol matni: kichik shaharlardagi sayyohlik, meros binolarini ta'mirlash puli, muzeyga kirish haqi, arzon aviachiptalar, an'analarning yo'qolishi). Ta'lim, texnologiya, jinoyat va atrof-muhit mavzulari boshqa darslarga qoldirilgan — 36 va 37-darslar universitet mavzusida edi, takrorlanmasin.
Bu dars 36 va 37-darsning davomi: mezonlar (36) va ularni amalda qo'llash (37) allaqachon o'tilgan. Mezonlarni QAYTA TUSHUNTIRMANG, faqat "bu qaysi mezonni ko'taradi" deb eslatib turing.
Eng katta xavf — o'quvchi tezaurus ochib, tanimaydigan so'zni yozishi. Butun dars davomida qoidani takrorlang: ishonch yo'q bo'lsa, almashtirmang.
1-mashqdagi kartochkalar aralash tarqatiladi: o'quvchi xavfsiz sinonimni topishi va xavflisini chetga surishi kerak. O'yin tarzida tezroq o'tadi.
4-mashqda hukmni ustoz aytmasin. O'quvchi "YAXSHI / O'RTACHA / YOMON" deb aytsin, keyin sababini topsin. Xato hukm ham foydali — muhokama qilinadi.
Namuna essay ataylab 7.5 darajasida yozilgan va unda "tourists" so'zi bir marta ham takrorlanmagan: visitors, travellers, outsiders, people. Buni o'quvchi o'zi sanasin.
Zaif kirish (3-topshiriq) — markaz talabalarida eng ko'p uchraydigan holat: savol ko'chirilgan, ustiga "Nowadays" qo'shilgan. Shuni tuzatish darsning eng qimmatli 10 daqiqasi.
Uyga vazifada uchta yangi savol beriladi; keyingi darsda ular to'liq kirish xatboshisiga aylantiriladi, shuning uchun vazifa daftarda saqlanishi shart.

core: Always paraphrase the question in the first sentence of your introduction.
Kirishning birinchi gapida savolni doim o'z so'zingiz bilan qayta ifodalang.
The old city is an important part of the country's heritage.
Eski shahar mamlakat merosining muhim qismi.
The council plans to restore the old bridge next year.
Shahar kengashi keyingi yil eski ko'prikni ta'mirlab, asl holiga keltirmoqchi.
In my view, the benefits of tourism outweigh its costs.
The main drawback of cheap flights is the damage to the environment.
Arzon reyslarning asosiy kamchiligi — atrof-muhitga yetkazadigan zarari.
Visitors often show a genuine interest in local crafts.
Sayyohlar ko'pincha mahalliy hunarmandchilikka chin dildan qiziqish bildiradi.
tirband (transport yoki odam bilan to'lib ketgan)
In summer, the narrow streets of the old town become congested.
Yozda eski shaharning tor ko'chalari tirband bo'lib qoladi.
Many jobs in tourism are seasonal and end in October.
Sayyohlikdagi ko'p ishlar mavsumiy bo'lib, oktabrda tugaydi.
Local residents complained about the noise from the new hotel.
Mahalliy aholi yangi mehmonxonadan chiqayotgan shovqindan shikoyat qildi.
Young families can no longer afford houses in the town centre.
Yosh oilalarning endi shahar markazidan uy olishga qurbi yetmaydi.
The festival attracts thousands of visitors every year.
Festival har yili minglab mehmonlarni jalb qiladi.
Tourism is the main source of income for the village.
Sayyohlik qishloq uchun asosiy daromad manbai.
Small museums often depend on funding from the government.
Kichik muzeylar ko'pincha davlat ajratadigan mablag'ga bog'liq.
Provincial towns often have fewer hotels than the capital.
Viloyat shaharlarida ko'pincha poytaxtdagiga qaraganda mehmonxonalar kamroq.
Large numbers of visitors put pressure on local water supplies.
Sayyohlarning ko'pligi mahalliy suv ta'minotiga og'irlik tushiradi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Xavfsiz sinonim va xavfli sinonim
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi so'zga ishonchli sinonim tanlang. Har qatorda XAVFLI variant ham bor — nega ishlamasligini ayting.
items: tourists
historical buildings
money (davlat mablag'i)
the number of tourists has increased
small towns
governments
answers: heritage sites / historic architecture / buildings of historical importance
there has been a rise in visitor numbers
smaller towns / provincial towns / towns outside the big cities
why: XAVFLI: "aliens" — odam haqida huquqiy yoki salbiy ohangli so'z ("chet el fuqarolari", "begonalar"; kundalik tilda "o'zga sayyoraliklar"); sayyohlar haqida qo'pol eshitiladi. "excursionists" — juda kitobiy, deyarli ishlatilmaydi.
XAVFLI: "ancient buildings" — faqat juda qadimiy binolar uchun; "old houses" — ma'noni tushiradi.
XAVFLI: "cash" — og'zaki va qo'ldagi naqd pulni bildiradi.
XAVFLI: "the amount of tourists" — amount sanaladigan ot bilan ishlatilmaydi.
XAVFLI: "little cities" — bunday birikma yo'q; "villages" — ma'no torayadi.
XAVFLI: "politicians" — bu alohida shaxslar (siyosatchilar), "government" esa boshqaruv organi; ma'no siljiydi.
class_ex.note: Qoida doskada qoladi: ISHONCH YO'Q BO'LSA — ALMASHTIRMANG. Noto'g'ri sinonim takrordan ko'ra ko'proq ball yo'qotadi, chunki u Lexical Resource ni tushiradi, ma'no o'zgarsa — Task Response ni ham.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: So'z turkumini o'zgartiring
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi gapni o'ngdagidek qayta yozing: fe'lni otga, sifat yoki ravishni ot iborasiga aylantiring. Ma'no o'zgarmasin — yangi ma'no beradigan so'z (steady, considerable kabi) qo'shmang.
items: The number of foreign visitors has increased.
Tourism damages historic town centres.
It is important to protect traditional crafts.
Many people now travel abroad cheaply.
Local councils should fund small museums.
Tourists spend a lot in local shops.
answers: There has been an increase in the number of foreign visitors.
Tourism causes damage to historic town centres.
The protection of traditional crafts should be a priority.
Many people can now travel abroad at low cost.
Small museums should receive funding from local councils.
Visitor spending in local shops is substantial.
why: Fe'l (increased) otga (an increase) aylandi. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan almashinuv.
Fe'l (damages) otga aylandi: causes damage to. Ega va ma'no o'zgarmadi.
Sifat (important) otga (a priority); fe'l (protect) otga (the protection).
Ravish (cheaply) ot iborasiga aylandi: at low cost. Yangi ma'no qo'shilmadi.
Fe'l (fund) otga (funding); ega almashdi. Diqqat: "should" saqlanadi — uni tashlab yuborsangiz taklif oddiy bayonga aylanadi va ma'no o'zgaradi.
Fe'l (spend) otga (spending); "a lot" o'rniga "substantial".
class_ex.note: Diqqat: otga aylantirganda gapning EGASI ko'pincha o'zgaradi. Shuning uchun bu yo'l ko'pincha qurilishni ham o'zgartiradi — ikki yo'l bir vaqtda bajarilgan bo'ladi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Gap qurilishini o'zgartiring
class_ex.instr: Aktivni passivga, ergash gapni ot iborasiga, "but" ni "Although" ga aylantiring. Asosiy o'zgarish — QURILISH: so'zlarni iloji boricha saqlang, kerak bo'lsa bir-ikki so'zning shakli yoki sinonimi o'zgarishi mumkin. Ma'no o'sha-o'sha qolsin.
items: Local families build these guest houses.
Some people say that museums should be free.
Because tourism grew very quickly, the town changed.
If governments protect heritage sites, more visitors will come.
Tourism brings money, but it harms old towns.
People visit these villages because they are quiet.
answers: These guest houses are built by local families.
It is sometimes argued that entry to museums should cost nothing.
The rapid growth of tourism changed the town.
Government protection of heritage sites will attract more visitors.
Although tourism generates income, it harms old towns.
These villages attract visitors because of their peace and quiet.
why: Aktiv — passiv. Eng oddiy o'zgarish.
Aktiv — shaxssiz passiv. "Some people say" ni doim shunday yozish mumkin; "often" yoki "widely" emas, "sometimes" — "some people" ko'pchilik degani emas.
Ergash gap — ot iborasi. Gap qisqardi va kuchaydi.
Shart ergash gapi ot iborasiga aylandi va ega bo'ldi (Government protection of …); "will" saqlandi.
but — Although; ergash gap oldinga chiqdi. "brings money" — "generates income" (sinonim), "harms" saqlandi: ma'no o'zgarmadi.
Sabab ergash gapi (because they are quiet) ot iborasiga aylandi (because of their peace and quiet); ega ham almashdi. Kuchli o'quvchi uchun: "The appeal of these villages lies in their tranquillity."
class_ex.note: Uchinchi yo'l eng kuchlisi: u bir vaqtning o'zida Grammatical Range ni ham ko'taradi. Lekin gap XATOSIZ bo'lishi shart — murakkab gapdagi xato foyda emas, zarar keltiradi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Bu paraphrase yaxshimi?
class_ex.instr: SAVOL doskada: In many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply. Har variantga hukm qo'ying: YAXSHI, O'RTACHA yoki YOMON — va sababini ayting.
items: Nowadays, in many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply.
These days, the amount of foreign tourists that visit small towns has grown fast.
Many nations have seen a sharp rise in the quantity of alien tourists.
Tourists from foreign countries are now visiting small towns in large numbers.
Smaller towns in many parts of the world now receive far more visitors from abroad than in the past.
There has been a marked increase in the number of international visitors to provincial towns.
In many countries small towns have become very popular with tourists recently.
why: Savoldan so'zma-so'z ko'chirilgan, faqat "Nowadays" qo'shilgan. Bu so'zlar sanalmaydi.
"amount" sanaladigan ot bilan ishlatilmaydi; "grown fast" og'zaki. Ustiga yangi xato qo'shildi.
"alien" odam haqida huquqiy yoki salbiy ohangli so'z — sayyohlar haqida qo'pol eshitiladi; "quantity" ham odamlar soni uchun ishlatilmaydi (the number of). Ikki jiddiy birikma xatosi.
Tushunarli va xatosiz, lekin "tourists", "foreign", "small towns" o'zgarmagan. Faqat qurilish o'zgardi.
Sinonim, so'z turkumi va qurilish — uchalasi ham ishlatilgan, ma'no saqlangan.
Fe'l otga aylangan, "foreign" — "international", "small" — "provincial". Tabiiy birikmalar.
Til to'g'ri ("popular with", "popular for" emas), lekin ma'no biroz siljidi: "mashhur bo'ldi" va "sayyohlar soni oshdi" bir xil emas. Qurilish ham savolga yaqin.
class_ex.note: XULOSA: yomon paraphrase ning ikki sababi bor — 1) KO'CHIRMA, 2) noto'g'ri BIRIKMA. Ikkinchisi xavfliroq, chunki u yangi xato qo'shadi. Har hukmdan keyin "qaysi mezon tushdi" deb so'rang.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Uchala yo'lni birlashtiring
class_ex.instr: SAVOL: Some people believe that the money spent on restoring historical buildings would be better used to build modern housing. Quyidagi bosqichlarni A4 varaqqa ketma-ket yozing.
items: 1-bosqich: savolni bo'laklarga ajrating.
2-bosqich: tegilmaydigan so'zlarni belgilang.
3-bosqich: sinonim tanlang.
4-bosqich: so'z turkumini o'zgartiring.
5-bosqich: gap qurilishini o'zgartiring.
6-bosqich: birlashtiring.
7-bosqich: savolni yopib, o'z gapingizni o'qing.
answers: Some people believe / the money spent on restoring historical buildings / would be better used / to build modern housing
Bu savolda atoqli ot ham, raqam ham yo'q; lekin "historical buildings" va "modern housing" — savolning ikki asosiy tushunchasi
restoring historical buildings — restoring heritage buildings; modern housing — new homes
the money spent on — investment in / spending on
Some people believe that — It is sometimes argued that
It is sometimes argued that investment in the restoration of heritage buildings should instead be directed towards new homes.
Ma'no bir xilmi? Ha — ikkalasida ham "meros pulini uy-joyga sarflash" g'oyasi bor
why: To'rt bo'lak. Har biri alohida ishlanadi.
Ularni almashtirish mumkin, faqat yangi ifoda aynan shu narsani bildirishi shart.
Ikkalasi ham ishonchli, tanish birikma. "restoring" ni "preserving" ga almashtirmang: ta'mirlash va saqlash bir xil ish emas.
Fe'l iborasi ot iborasiga aylandi.
Aktiv — shaxssiz passiv.
Birorta ham ko'chirilgan bo'lak qolmadi, ma'no o'zgarmadi.
Bu oxirgi tekshiruv har doim bajariladi.
class_ex.note: Bu yetti bosqich imtihonda 3 daqiqada bajariladi — lekin darsda sekin va yozma qilinadi. Bir-ikki haftadan keyin o'quvchi bosqichlarni ichida bajaradi va faqat natijani yozadi.

readings.title: JONY ACADEMY NAMUNA ESSAY — paraphrase qanday ishlaydi
readings.qtype: Band 7.5 darajasidagi essay, kirishiga alohida e'tibor
readings.source: Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan namuna (287 so'z). Mavzu: kichik shaharlardagi sayyohlik.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: In many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
text: Smaller towns in many parts of the world now receive far more visitors from abroad than they did a generation ago. Although this trend creates genuine difficulties for the people who live there, I would argue that the economic and cultural gains are greater, provided that local councils manage the change sensibly.

The clearest benefit is financial. When travellers stay even one or two nights, they spend money in guest houses, cafes and craft workshops, and that income keeps small businesses open in places where young people would otherwise leave in search of work. A village near my own city, for example, began offering guided walks through its orchards and now employs a dozen people all year round, several of whom moved to the capital years ago and have since returned. A second gain is cultural: when outsiders show real interest in local weaving, cooking or music, younger residents begin to see these traditions as valuable rather than old-fashioned.

The drawbacks, however, are real. Narrow streets that were never designed for coaches become congested; house prices rise beyond what local families can afford; and quiet places can lose the very atmosphere that attracted people to them in the first place. Some communities also discover that the jobs created are seasonal and poorly paid.

In my view, these are problems of management rather than problems of tourism itself. Limiting the number of vehicles allowed into a historic centre, reserving a proportion of housing for permanent residents and training local guides all reduce the damage while protecting the income. For this reason I believe the benefits of the change outweigh its costs, as long as the decisions are taken by the communities concerned and not only by travel companies.
paraphrases: in many parts of the world
than they did a generation ago (qiyoslash orqali)
the gains are greater / the benefits ... outweigh its costs
glossary: a generation ago — bir avlod oldin
reserve a proportion of — bir qismini ajratib qo'ymoq
the communities concerned — tegishli mahalliy aholi

tasks.title: 1-topshiriq: Kirish gapidagi paraphrase jadvali
tasks.instr: Savoldagi har bo'lak essayda qanday aytilgan va qaysi yo'l ishlatilgan? Avval o'quvchilar to'ldiradi, keyin solishtiriladi.
tasks.note: Diqqat: bitta gapda uchala yo'l ham ishlatilgan. Savoldan ko'chirilgan bitta ham ibora yo'q, lekin ma'no aynan o'sha. Mana shu — kuchli kirish gapi.
head: Savoldagi ibora
Essaydagi ifoda
Qaysi yo'l ishlatilgan
rows: in many parts of the world
Sinonim ;; "countries" o'rniga "parts of the world" ;; ma'no saqlangan
Sinonim va so'z turkumi ;; "the number of ... has risen" o'rniga qiyoslovchi "far more" ;; "foreign" o'rniga "from abroad"
Gap qurilishi ;; ega butunlay almashdi: sayyoh emas, shahar ega bo'ldi ;; eng kuchli o'zgarish

Gap qurilishi ;; o'sish fe'l bilan emas, QIYOSLASH bilan berilgan ;; "sharply" ma'nosi "far more" da saqlangan
