the economic and cultural gains are greater
So'z turkumi va sinonim ;; so'roq gap tasdiq gapga aylandi ;; "advantages" o'rniga "gains"

tasks.title: 2-topshiriq: Kalit so'z essayda qanday almashtirilgan?
tasks.instr: Essay bo'ylab yuring va bitta tushuncha necha xil aytilganini sanang. Har javobni essaydan topib ko'rsating.
items: tourists (sayyohlar)
small towns (kichik shaharlar)
money (pul)
advantages (foydalar)
disadvantages (zararlar)
local people (mahalliy aholi)
answers: visitors from abroad / travellers / outsiders / people
Smaller towns / a village / quiet places / communities
income / spend money / house prices / poorly paid
difficulties / drawbacks / the damage / its costs
the people who live there / local families / younger residents / permanent residents / the communities concerned
why: To'rt xil ifoda, birorta ham "tourists" emas. LR shundan ko'tariladi.
Har safar boshqa so'z, ma'no bir xil.
Bitta so'z emas, butun ma'no maydoni ishlatilgan. Diqqat: "spend money" da "money" saqlangan — bu tabiiy fe'l birikmasi, har so'zni majburan almashtirish shart emas.
Kirishda, tanada va xulosada uch xil.
To'rt xil ifoda.
Beshta ifoda — bu essaydagi eng ko'p takrorlanadigan tushuncha edi.
tasks.note: Uyga vazifa 2 shu mashqning davomi: o'quvchi o'z essayidagi eng ko'p takrorlangan so'zni topib, unga uchtadan muqobil yozadi.

tasks.title: 3-topshiriq: Zaif kirishni tuzating
tasks.instr: Quyida XUDDI SHU savolga yozilgan zaif kirish berilgan. Har qatorda nima noto'g'ri ekanini ayting, keyin butun kirishni qayta yozing.
items: Nowadays, in many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply.
In this essay I will discuss the advantages and the disadvantages.
I think advantages are more than disadvantages.
Butun kirish: 3 gap, 33 so'z, yangi ma'lumot yo'q
TUZATILGAN VARIANT (namuna)
answers: Pozitsiya bor, lekin til zaif; "outweigh" kerak
Tekshiruvchi uchun faqat oxirgi gap qiymatga ega

Smaller towns in many parts of the world now attract far more visitors from abroad than they once did. Although this puts real pressure on local residents, I believe the economic and cultural benefits are greater.
why: Bu 14 so'z sanalmaydi va so'z sonidan chiqariladi.
37-darsda ko'rgan edik — so'z sarflaydi, fikr qo'shmaydi.
"advantages are more" tabiiy birikma emas — LR va GRA tushadi.
33 so'zdan 14 tasi ko'chirma — sanaladigani 19 so'z. TR ham, LR ham 6 dan oshmaydi.
Ikki gap: paraphrase va pozitsiya. Ko'chirma yo'q, bo'sh gap yo'q.
tasks.note: Ikkita juftlikning varianti doskaga yoziladi va guruh bilan tuzatiladi. Ustoz o'z variantini ENG OXIRIDA ko'rsatadi — aks holda hamma uni ko'chiradi.

homework_intro: Bugun biz savolni uch yo'l bilan qayta yozishni o'rgandik: sinonim, so'z turkumi va gap qurilishi — uyda xuddi shu uch yo'lni yangi savollarda ishlatasiz.
Birinchi vazifa: varaqadagi uchta Task 2 savolini paraphrase qiling; har savol uchun bitta gap yozing va yoniga qavs ichida qaysi yo'llarni ishlatganingizni belgilang — taxminan 20 daqiqa.

Ikkinchi vazifa: 35-dars mock imtihonidagi Writing Task 2 essayingizni (37-darsda ball qo'ygan essayingizni) oching, eng ko'p takrorlangan beshta so'zni toping va har biriga uchtadan muqobil ifoda yozing — 15 daqiqa.
Uchinchi vazifa: varaqadagi beshta yomon paraphrase ni tuzating va har birining yoniga xato sababini bitta so'z bilan yozing: KO'CHIRMA yoki BIRIKMA — 10 daqiqa.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — tezaurusdan tanimagan so'z olish; ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa, o'sha so'zni almashtirmang, buning o'rniga gap qurilishini o'zgartiring.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; keyingi darsda aynan shu paraphrase lar to'liq kirish xatboshisiga aylantiriladi, shuning uchun ularni yo'qotmang.

homework.title: Uchta savolni paraphrase qiling
homework.instr: Har savolni bitta gapda qayta yozing. Yoniga qaysi yo'llarni ishlatganingizni belgilang: 1 sinonim, 2 so'z turkumi, 3 gap qurilishi.
items: Some people think museums should be free for everyone, while others argue that visitors should pay an entrance fee.
Cheap air travel allows more people to visit distant countries, but it also harms the environment.
Traditional festivals and customs are disappearing in many countries because of tourism.
answers: Opinion is divided over whether admission to museums ought to be free of charge or whether those who enter should be required to pay.
Although low-cost flights have made long-haul destinations accessible to more people, they also cause environmental damage.
In many societies, long-established celebrations and local traditions are being lost as a result of tourism.
why: 1+2+3 ishlatilgan. "free" — "free of charge", "visitors" — "those who enter", aktiv — passiv.
1+2+3 ishlatilgan. "but" — "Although", "harms" — "cause damage". Diqqat: "environment" almashtirilmadi — bu asosiy termin, faqat sifatga aylandi.
1+2+3 ishlatilgan. "because of" — "as a result of", "countries" — "societies", "disappearing" — "being lost" (passiv).
homework.note: Har javobda "environment", "tourism", "museums" kabi asosiy terminlar saqlanganiga e'tibor bering — ular almashtirilmaydi, faqat atrofidagi so'zlar o'zgaradi.

homework.title: O'z essayingdagi takrorni toping
homework.instr: 35-dars mock essayingni (37-darsda ball qo'ygan essayingni) och, eng ko'p takrorlangan 5 so'zni sanab chiq va har biriga 3 tadan muqobil ifoda yoz.
items: important
people
good
think
problem
answers: individuals / residents / the public / young adults
why: Eng ko'p takrorlanadigan so'z. "very important" ni butunlay tashlang.
Aniqroq so'z doim kuchliroq — kim haqida gapirayotganingizni ayting.
"good" akademik essayda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.
"I think" o'rniga "In my view" yoki "I would argue".
Har xatboshida boshqa so'z ishlating.
homework.note: Ustoz tekshiradi: muqobil so'zlar o'quvchining o'z essayidagi GAPGA tushadimi? Tushmasa — bu xavfli sinonim, qayta tanlanadi.

homework.title: Beshta yomon paraphrase ni tuzating
homework.instr: Har birini tuzating va sababini bitta so'z bilan yozing: KO'CHIRMA yoki BIRIKMA.
items: Nowadays the amount of tourists in small towns is increasing.
In many countries the number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has risen sharply these days.
Many nations must save their ancient buildings from alien tourists.
The government should give cash for restoring historical buildings.
Some people believe that the money spent on restoring historical buildings would be better used for other things.
answers: The number of visitors to smaller towns is rising.
Many countries have seen a sharp rise in the number of international visitors to provincial towns.
Many countries need to protect their heritage sites from the pressure of international tourism.
The authorities should provide funding for the restoration of historic buildings.
It is sometimes argued that spending on heritage restoration would be put to better use elsewhere.
why: BIRIKMA. "amount" sanaladigan ot bilan ishlatilmaydi.
KO'CHIRMA. Savol to'liq ko'chirilgan, oxiriga "these days" qo'shilgan.
BIRIKMA. "alien" odam haqida huquqiy yoki salbiy ohangli so'z — sayyohlar haqida qo'pol; "ancient" faqat juda qadimiy binolar uchun.
BIRIKMA. "cash" og'zaki; "give cash for" tabiiy birikma emas.
KO'CHIRMA. Savolning yarmi o'zgarmagan, "other things" esa noaniq.
homework.note: Sabablar taqsimoti: 2 ta KO'CHIRMA, 3 ta BIRIKMA. Agar o'quvchi hammasini "ko'chirma" desa — birikma xatolarini ko'rmayapti, ular bilan alohida ishlang.

normativ: 3 gap, har biriga yo'l belgisi qo'yilgan

kahoot.q: What are the three main ways to paraphrase a Task 2 question?
options: Synonyms, word forms and sentence structure
Longer words, more commas and rare idioms
Copying the question and adding 'Nowadays' to it
Changing the numbers, names and key terms
kahoot.explain: Paraphrase uch yo'l bilan qilinadi: sinonim, so'z turkumi va gap qurilishi — yaxshisi uchalasi birga.

kahoot.q: Which words should you usually NOT replace when you paraphrase?
options: Every noun and verb in the question
Only the first and last words
kahoot.explain: Atoqli otlar, raqamlar va 'technology', 'environment' kabi asosiy terminlar almashtirilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Change the verb into a noun: 'Crime has fallen.'
options: There has been a fall in crime.
kahoot.explain: Fe'l (has fallen) otga aylandi (a fall in), ma'no esa o'sha-o'sha qoldi.

kahoot.q: Which is a correct passive version of 'Volunteers run the local library'?
options: The local library is run by volunteers.
The local library is ran by volunteers.
The local library runs by volunteers.
Volunteers are running by the local library.
kahoot.explain: Passiv: be + V3, ya'ni 'is run by'; 'ran' — V2, passivda ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Which is a more academic way to write 'Some people think that…'?
kahoot.explain: Shaxssiz passiv: It is + V3 + that — 'It is sometimes argued that…'; 'some people' ko'pchilik emas, shuning uchun 'widely' emas.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct phrase for a countable noun.
kahoot.explain: Sanaladigan ot bilan 'the number of', sanalmaydigan ot bilan 'the amount of' ishlatiladi.

kahoot.q: 'Because prices rose quickly, sales fell.' Which version uses a noun phrase instead of the clause?
options: The rapid rise in prices led to lower sales.
Prices rose quickly, so sales fell.
Sales fell because prices rose quickly.
Because of the prices rose quickly, sales fell.
kahoot.explain: Ergash gap (Because prices rose quickly) ot iborasiga aylandi: the rapid rise in prices.

kahoot.q: You are not sure a synonym fits the sentence. What is the best thing to do?
options: Keep the word and change the structure
Use the rarest word in the dictionary
Pick the first word the translator gives
Leave a blank and move on
kahoot.explain: Ishonch yo'q bo'lsa almashtirmang: so'zni qoldirib, gap qurilishini o'zgartiring.

kahoot.q: Question: 'More people now work from home.' Which paraphrase CHANGES the meaning?
options: Home working has become more common.
A growing number of people work remotely.
Working from home is increasingly common.
kahoot.explain: 'Everyone' — mutlaq so'z, savolda esa 'more people'; ma'no o'zgarsa TR tushadi.

kahoot.q: Why is copying long phrases from the question a problem?
options: It makes the essay far too formal
It uses up too much ink
kahoot.explain: Savoldan ko'chirilgan so'zlar baholanmaydi va so'z sonidan ham chiqariladi.

kahoot.q: About how long should you spend paraphrasing the question in the exam?
kahoot.explain: Paraphrase ga taxminan 3 daqiqa yetadi; qolgan vaqt fikr va body uchun kerak.

kahoot.q: Where should you vary the key words of the question?
options: Nowhere — always repeat the key words
kahoot.explain: Kalit so'z butun essay bo'yicha 3-4 xil ifoda bilan aytiladi, aks holda LR tushadi.

kahoot.q: In summer the narrow streets become 'congested'. 'Congested' means ___.
kahoot.explain: Congested — tirband, transport yoki odam bilan to'lib ketgan.

kahoot.q: 'Seasonal' jobs are jobs that ___.
options: last only part of the year
pay more than most office jobs
last for the whole of a career
kahoot.explain: Seasonal — mavsumiy, ya'ni faqat yilning ma'lum davrida bo'ladigan.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'a disadvantage'?
kahoot.explain: Drawback — kamchilik, salbiy tomon.

kahoot.q: If the benefits 'outweigh' the costs, the benefits are ___.
kahoot.explain: Outweigh — ustun bo'lmoq: foyda zarardan ko'proq.

kahoot.q: A 'genuine' difficulty is ___.
kahoot.explain: Genuine — haqiqiy, chin.

kahoot.q: 'Local families can no longer afford houses.' This means they ___.
options: do not like them any more
are not allowed to sell them
kahoot.explain: Afford — (pulga) qurbi yetmoq.

kahoot.q: To 'restore' an old building means to ___.
options: repair it to its original state
knock it down and build again
sell it to a private owner
kahoot.explain: Restore — ta'mirlab, asl holiga qaytarmoq.

kahoot.q: Quiet villages often ___ visitors from the city.
kahoot.explain: Attract — jalb qilmoq, o'ziga tortmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Planning Your Essay (Everything Before Writing)
lessons.grammar_topic: Qalam qog'ozga tegishidan oldingi besh daqiqa: savolni belgilash, pozitsiya, ikki sabab, to'rt qatorli reja
lessons.vocab_topic: Reja tuzish — TOPIC / KEYWORD / INSTRUCTION, pozitsiya, ikkita chuqur sabab, 4 qatorli reja
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha savollar, rejalar va namuna essay Jony Academy tomonidan shu dars uchun yozilgan. Baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: Savolni uch belgi bilan belgilash: TOPIC (mavzu), KEYWORD (cheklov so'zi), INSTRUCTION (topshiriq so'zi).
INSTRUCTION so'ziga qarab essayda nima bo'lishi SHART ekanini ayta olish.
Yozishdan oldin pozitsiyani tanlash va uni bitta gapda yozish.
Beshta yuzaki fikr o'rniga ikkita ochiladigan sabab topish.
To'rt qatorli reja yozish: pozitsiya, body 1 fikri, body 2 fikri, xulosa.
O'zgalarning rejasiga qarab "shu rejadan essay yozib bo'ladimi?" degan savolga javob berish.
materials: 1-mashq uchun: beshta savol chop etilgan varaq (savollar 1-mashqda to'liq berilgan) — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa; savollar orasida keng joy qoldiring, chunki ustiga belgi qo'yiladi.
Har o'quvchida oddiy qalam VA bitta rangli qalam bo'lsin: TOPIC tagiga chiziq, KEYWORD ga doira, INSTRUCTION ga yulduzcha — belgi rangli qalamda qo'yiladi.
3-mashq uchun: "Ikkita chuqur sabab" varaqasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa (guruh 12 kishi bo'lsa 12 nusxa); varaqda chapda 5 ta yuzaki fikr, o'ngda bo'sh joy.
4-mashq uchun: uchta savol chop etilgan varaq — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa; orqa tomonida uchta bo'sh "4 qatorli reja" ramkasi.

5-mashq uchun: oltita reja kartochkasi (A, B, C, D, E, F) — kartochkalar matni 5-mashqda to'liq yozilgan, O'SHA HOLICHA (javobsiz) ko'chirib chop etiladi va qirqiladi; har juftlikka oltitadan bo'lsin (6 juftlik uchun 36 kartochka).
Reading tabidagi namuna essay va uning rejasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa; essay yonida bo'sh ustun: "bu xatboshi rejaning qaysi qatoridan chiqdi".
Doskaga darsdan OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: 4 qatorli reja ramkasi (POZITSIYA / BODY 1 / BODY 2 / XULOSA) va uch belgi (TOPIC / KEYWORD / INSTRUCTION). Dars oxirigacha o'chirilmaydi.
Sekundomer yoki telefon taymeri — 4-mashqda 10 daqiqa aniq o'lchanadi.
timeline: Uch savol bilan eslatiladi: 1) Task 2 nechta mezon bo'yicha baholanadi? 2) 37-darsdagi A essay qaysi mezonlarda ball yo'qotdi va nega? 3) Ikkita ochilgan fikr yaxshimi yoki beshta yuzaki fikr? Javoblar doskaga yozilmaydi, og'zaki
40 daqiqaning taqsimoti: 5 reja + 30 yozish + 5 tekshirish; rejasiz yozish nega sekinroq
5 daqiqa: TOPIC / KEYWORD / INSTRUCTION doskada tushuntiriladi; 10 daqiqa: 1-mashq varaqda bajariladi va doskada solishtiriladi
2-mashq: har topshiriq so'ziga qanday skelet mos keladi
3-mashq: 5 yuzaki fikrdan 2 ta ochiladigan sabab yasaladi
Ustoz doskada bepul transport savoliga reja tuzadi, ovoz chiqarib o'ylaydi — so'zma-so'z skript: "Savol turi" tabi → "Ustoz uchun eslatma", 4-band
Taymer bilan, mustaqil; keyin 5 daqiqa tekshiriladi
5 daqiqa essay ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi, 10 daqiqa ikkala task birga bajariladi

intro: Task 2 ga 40 daqiqa beriladi. Shundan 5 daqiqa REJAGA ketadi, taxminan 30 daqiqa yozishga, 5 daqiqa tekshirishga (aniq taqsimot 40-darsda beriladi: 5 reja + 4 kirish + 22 body + 3 xulosa + 6 tekshirish). Rejasiz boshlagan o'quvchi 40 daqiqani ham yetkazmaydi — chunki yo'lda to'xtab, "endi nima yozaman" deb o'ylaydi.
Reja vaqtni yemaydi, TEJAYDI. Rejasi bor o'quvchi yozayotganda faqat GAP tuzadi; rejasi yo'q o'quvchi bir vaqtning o'zida gap ham tuzadi, fikr ham o'ylaydi — ikkinchisi ikki barobar sekin.

Har savolda uch narsa bor: TOPIC — nima haqida; KEYWORD — mavzuning qaysi qismi haqida (cheklov); INSTRUCTION — sizdan nima talab qilinadi. Uchalasi belgilanmasa, essay savolga emas, mavzuga javob bo'lib qoladi — 37-darsda ko'rgan A essayda aynan shu edi.
Eng qimmat xato — KEYWORD ni tashlab ketish. "young people in big cities" savolida faqat "young people" haqida yozilsa, TR darhol 5-6 ga tushadi.

INSTRUCTION so'zi essayning SKELETINI belgilaydi: "agree or disagree" — bitta pozitsiya; "discuss both views and give your opinion" — ikki qarash va sizning fikringiz; "problems and solutions" — muammo va yechim juft-juft; "advantages and disadvantages" — ikkala tomon va tarozi; ikki qismli savol (TWO-PART: "Why is this happening? Is it positive or negative?") — har savolga alohida javob, odatda har biriga bitta body.
POZITSIYA yozishdan OLDIN tanlanadi. 36-darsda aytilgani kabi, yozib turib fikrini o'zgartirgan o'quvchi kirishi bilan xulosasi zid essay yozadi — bu TR ni tushiradigan eng keng tarqalgan kamchilik.

To'g'ri javob yo'q: siz rozi bo'lasizmi yoki yo'qmi — baho o'zgarmaydi. Baho faqat SHU fikrni qanchalik ochib berganingizga qarab qo'yiladi. Shuning uchun "to'g'ri" fikrni emas, ochish OSON bo'lgan fikrni tanlang.
Ikkita chuqur sabab beshta yuzaki fikrdan har doim yuqori ball oladi. 37-darsdagi B essayda ham ikkitagina fikr bor edi — lekin har biri sabab, misol va natija bilan ochilgan.

To'rt qatorli reja shunchaki kalit so'zlardan iborat: to'liq gap yozish shart emas, vaqt ketadi. Lekin har qator O'ZBEKCHA emas, INGLIZCHA kalit so'z bilan yozilsa yaxshi — yozayotganda tarjima qilib o'tirmaysiz.
Reja yetarlimi yoki yo'qmi — bitta savol bilan tekshiriladi: "shu qatorga qarab men uch-to'rt gap yoza olamanmi?" Javob "yo'q" bo'lsa, qator hali fikr emas, mavzu.
formulas: TOPIC tagiga chiziq, KEYWORD ga doira, INSTRUCTION ga yulduzcha
"Mostly agree: free transport helps, but only with investment"
Har biriga "nega?" deb ikki marta so'rang
Uch marta javob bersa — sabab chuqur
presentation: Reja yozishga vaqt ketadi-ku, ulgurmasam-chi?
Aksincha: reja 5 daqiqa oladi, lekin yozishni 10 daqiqaga tezlashtiradi. Rejasiz o'quvchi har xatboshi boshida to'xtaydi.
Rejani tekshiruvchi ko'radimi, unga ball qo'yiladimi?
Ko'radi, lekin ballga kirmaydi. Rejani o'chirish ham shart emas — tekshiruvchi faqat essayga ball qo'yadi.
Reja inglizchami yoki o'zbekchami?
Inglizcha kalit so'z bilan. O'zbekcha yozsangiz, yozayotganda tarjima qilasiz — bu vaqt yo'qotish.
Ikkitagina sabab kammi?
Kam emas. Ikkita ochilgan sabab beshta yuzaki fikrdan yuqori ball oladi — 37-darsdagi B essayda ham ikkita fikr bor edi.
Pozitsiyani yozib turib o'zgartirsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'lmaydi. Kirish bilan xulosa zid bo'lib qoladi va TR tushadi. Shuning uchun pozitsiya AVVAL tanlanadi.
Men rozi emasman, lekin rozi bo'lgan tomonni yozish osonroq. Qaysi birini yozay?
Yozishga oson bo'lganini. Baho fikringizga emas, ochib berilishiga qo'yiladi.
Ikkala tomonni ham yoqtirsam, "partly agree" desam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin sharti bor: qaysi qismiga rozi, qaysi qismiga yo'q — bu aniq aytilishi kerak. "It depends" esa pozitsiya emas.
Reja qog'ozning qayeriga yoziladi?

Qog'oz imtihonda — savol varag'ining bo'sh joyiga yoki javob varag'ining eng tepasiga, keyin ustidan chiziq tortib qo'yasiz. Kompyuterda topshirilsa — zalda beriladigan qoralama qog'ozga yoziladi, ekranga emas; qoralama tekshirilmaydi.
Rejada misolni ham o'ylab qo'yish kerakmi?
Ha, ikki-uch so'z bilan. Yozayotganda misol izlab to'xtash — eng ko'p vaqt yeydigan holat.
notes: Bu dars 36 va 37-darslarning davomi. 36-darsda savol turlari va mezonlar, 37-darsda A/B essay tahlili bo'lgan. Bugun ularni QAYTA TUSHUNTIRMANG — faqat eslatib o'ting (birinchi 10 daqiqa).

Ishlatilgan mavzu oilasi: SHAHAR, TRANSPORT VA SHAHAR HAYOTI — tirbandlik, jamoat transporti, shahar markazi, chekka hududlar, velosiped yo'llari, shahar bog'lari, uydan ishlash, havo sifati. 36-darsda jinoyat va jazo, 37-darsda ta'lim (universitet fanlari) mavzusi ishlatilgan. 40 va 41-darslarda ham shu transport oilasi ataylab davom etadi: tanish mavzuda o'quvchi g'oya qidirishga emas, yangi ko'nikmaga (kirish, body xatboshi) e'tibor qaratadi. 42-darsdan boshlab boshqa mavzular keladi (ish va bandlik, meros, texnologiya, sog'liq), shunda o'quvchi bir xil mavzuda qolib ketmaydi.

5-bosqich ("nega?" deb ikki marta so'rash) — darsning yuragi. Ustoz buni doskada JONLI qilib ko'rsatsin: fikrni aytadi, o'ziga "nega?" deb savol beradi, javob beradi, yana "nega?" deydi. O'quvchi shu ovozli o'ylashni ko'rishi kerak.

"4 qatorli reja: jonli namuna" bosqichi (10 daqiqa) AYNAN Reading tabidagi savolga tuziladi, chunki keyin o'sha rejadan chiqqan essay o'qiladi. Ustoz doskada ovoz chiqarib shunday gapiradi: (1) "TOPIC — bepul jamoat transporti va tirbandlik. KEYWORD — all public transport, free, main cause. INSTRUCTION — to what extent agree or disagree, demak bitta pozitsiya." (2) "Pozitsiyam: mostly agree, but only with investment — birinchi qatorga yozdim." (3) "Birinchi sabab: cost. Nega? Chipta pul turadi. Nega bu muhim? Chunki haydovchi benzin bilan to'rtta chiptani solishtiradi. Uch gap chiqdi — demak sabab chuqur. Misol: weekend free-bus." (4) "Ikkinchi sabab: capacity. Bepul, lekin qirq daqiqada bir keladigan avtobus kerakmi? Yo'q. Nega? Sig'im pul turadi, pul chiptadan kelardi. Demak soliq. Misol: 40 minutes, half a kilometre." (5) "Xulosa: half a policy — fares fall as service improves." Taymerga qarang: shu to'rt qator besh daqiqada tugashi kerak.
Jonli namunadan keyin doskadagi to'rt qator O'CHIRILMAYDI — namuna essay tarqatilganda o'quvchi essayni o'sha qatorlar bilan yonma-yon ko'radi. Aynan shu solishtirish darsning asosiy xulosasi.
4-mashqda taymer ALBATTA ishlatilsin. 10 daqiqada uchta reja — bu imtihon tezligiga yaqin. Ulgurmagan o'quvchilar bo'lsa, bu normal: keyingi darslarda yana takrorlanadi.
5-mashqdagi kartochkalar juftlikda muhokama qilinadi. Ustoz javobni oldindan aytmasin — juftliklar o'z qarorini aytsin, keyin sabab bilan solishtirilsin.

Namuna essay (tirbandlik va bepul jamoat transporti) rejadan chiqqan holda yozilgan. Ustoz essayning o'zini emas, REJA BILAN ESSAY ORASIDAGI BOG'LIQLIKNI ko'rsatsin: har xatboshi rejaning bitta qatoridan chiqqan.
Guruh kuchli bo'lsa, oxirgi 10 daqiqada bitta rejadan bitta body xatboshini yozdirish mumkin (37-darsdagi 5-mashq tartibi bilan). Guruh zaif bo'lsa buni qilmang — reja mashqlari o'zi yetarli.
mistakes: Savolni bir marta o'qib, yozishni boshlash
Ikki marta o'qib, uch belgi qo'yish
Beshta fikr yozib, hech birini ochmaslik
Kirish va xulosa zid bo'lib qoladi
Reja bor-u, essay boshqa yo'lga ketadi

how: CORE — shu darsdagi namuna essay, rejalar va sinf mashqlaridan olingan 14 ta so'z. Ularni namuna essaydan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing: har o'quvchi o'z shahridagi transport haqida 2 ta so'z bilan reja qatori yozadi.
core: Bus fares in our city rose again this year, so more people are driving to work.
Shahrimizda avtobus yo'l haqi bu yil yana oshdi, shuning uchun ko'proq odam ishga mashinada bormoqda.
Congestion in the city centre is worst between eight and nine in the morning.
Shahar markazidagi tirbandlik ertalab soat sakkiz bilan to'qqiz orasida eng kuchli bo'ladi.
A commuter who starts work at eight cannot wait forty minutes for a bus.
Ishni soat sakkizda boshlaydigan qatnovchi avtobusni qirq daqiqa kuta olmaydi.
The metro is running at full capacity during the rush hour.
Tig'iz soatlarda metro to'liq sig'imda ishlamoqda.
Ticket sales are the main source of revenue for the bus company.
Chipta savdosi avtobus kompaniyasining asosiy daromad manbai.
The government pays a subsidy so that students can travel at half price.
Talabalar yarim narxda yurishi uchun davlat subsidiya to'laydi.
Shorter intervals between trains would attract more passengers.
Poyezdlar orasidagi oraliq qisqarsa, ko'proq yo'lovchi jalb qilinadi.
Rent and transport can absorb half of a young worker's salary.
Ijara va transport yosh xodim maoshining yarmini yeb qo'yishi mumkin.
If the city abolishes fares, it must find the money somewhere else.
Agar shahar yo'l haqini bekor qilsa, pulni boshqa joydan topishi kerak.
Nobody wants to stand on an overcrowded bus for an hour.
Hech kim tiqilinch avtobusda bir soat tik turishni xohlamaydi.
The new bus route connects residential areas with the business district.
Yangi avtobus yo'nalishi turar-joy hududlarini ishbilarmonlik markazi bilan bog'laydi.
Free public transport would have to be paid for through taxation.
Bepul jamoat transporti soliqlar hisobidan moliyalashtirilishi kerak bo'lardi.
Many families move to the suburbs because houses there are cheaper.
Ko'p oilalar shahar chekkasiga ko'chadi, chunki u yerda uylar arzonroq.
In my view, the benefits of cycle lanes outweigh the cost of building them.
Menimcha, velosiped yo'laklarining foydasi ularni qurish xarajatidan ustun keladi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Savolni belgilang — TOPIC, KEYWORD, INSTRUCTION
class_ex.instr: Har savolda uch belgini toping (5 daqiqa mustaqil, 5 daqiqa doskada solishtirish). Savollar varaqda tarqatiladi, belgi varaqning o'zida qo'yiladi.
class_ex.note: Eng ko'p yo'qoladigan belgi — KEYWORD. "city centres", "in many cities", "quickly" kabi so'zlar tashlab ketilsa, essay savolga emas, mavzuga javob bo'ladi. Har savolda KEYWORD ga doira chizishni odat qildiring.
head: Savol
TOPIC (mavzu)
KEYWORD (cheklov)
INSTRUCTION (topshiriq)
rows: Some people believe that city centres should be closed to private cars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
city centres (butun shahar emas) ;; closed (kamaytirish emas, yopish)
To what extent do you agree or disagree — bitta aniq pozitsiya
In many cities, people are moving from the centre to the suburbs. What are the causes of this, and what problems does it create?
in many cities ;; moving OUT (ichkariga emas)
causes + problems (SITUATION: sabab va oqibat) — ikki qism, ikkalasi ham shart
Some people think governments should spend money on new roads, while others believe the money is better spent on cycling lanes and pavements. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
new roads VA cycling lanes/pavements — ikkala aniq variant
Discuss both views + your own opinion — ikki qarash va sizning fikringiz
Many city parks are being replaced by shopping centres. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
city parks (qishloq emas) ;; are being replaced (bo'lishi mumkin emas, bo'lmoqda)
outweigh — baho talab qilinadi: qaysi tomon OG'IR ekanini aniq aytish shart
In some countries the number of people working from home is rising quickly. Why is this happening, and is it a positive or a negative development?
TWO-PART (ikki qismli savol): Why + positive or negative — sabab VA baho, ikkalasi ham shart

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: INSTRUCTION so'zi qanday skelet talab qiladi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz topshiriq so'zini aytadi, o'quvchi essayda nima bo'lishi SHART ekanini aytadi.
items: To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
What are the causes and what are the effects?
What problems does this cause and what solutions can you suggest?
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Is this a positive or a negative development?
Why is this happening, and is it a good thing?
answers: Bitta aniq pozitsiya + 2 ta sabab + xulosada o'sha pozitsiya
Body 1 — birinchi qarash, Body 2 — ikkinchi qarash, xulosa — SIZNING fikringiz
Har muammoga MOS yechim, juft-juft bog'lanadi
Ikkala tomon + QAYSI BIRI og'irroq ekanini aniq aytish (baho talab qilinadi)
TWO-PART (ikki qismli savol): sabab + baho; har qismga alohida body xatboshi
why: "Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri" deyish mumkin emas.
O'z fikrini aytmaslik — eng ko'p uchraydigan yo'qotish.
Faqat sababni yozib, oqibatni unutish — savolning yarmiga javob berish; TR odatda 5 dan oshmaydi.
Yechim muammodan kelib chiqmasa, bog'liqlik buziladi.
Faqat ro'yxat qilish yetarli emas — taroziga qo'yish kerak.
"Both positive and negative" deyish pozitsiya emas.
Ikki savol — ikki javob. Bitta qism butunlay tushib qolsa, TR odatda 5 dan oshmaydi.
class_ex.note: Qoida: INSTRUCTION da nechta savol bo'lsa, essayda shuncha qism bo'ladi. Savolni barmoq bilan sanang: ikki savol bo'lsa — ikki body xatboshi (sabab + oqibat, muammo + yechim yoki TWO-PART dagi ikki alohida savol).

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Beshta yuzaki fikrdan ikkita chuqur sabab
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi yuzaki fikrni oling va "nega?" deb ikki marta so'rab, o'ngdagidek ochiq sababga aylantiring.
items: Public transport is expensive for families.
Buses are slow.
Cars cause pollution.
Cycling is healthy.
City centres are crowded.
answers: Cost is the real barrier: a monthly travel card takes a visible share of a family budget, so a driver compares petrol with four tickets and chooses the car.
Frequency decides everything: a bus every forty minutes cannot serve a commuter with a fixed start time, however cheap the ticket is.
Short urban trips are the worst offenders: a cold engine on a two-kilometre journey emits far more per kilometre than the same car on an open road.
A daily commute by bicycle turns exercise into a routine that costs no extra time, which is why gym memberships are abandoned but commuting habits survive.
Space is finite: a single parked car takes up as much kerb space as ten bicycles or a bus shelter, so every parking bay is a decision about who the street belongs to.
why: Zanjir: Fikr — "expensive" (bu hali sifat). Nega? — oylik yo'l kartasi oila byudjetining sezilarli qismini oladi. Nega muhim? — haydovchi benzinni to'rtta chipta bilan solishtirib, mashinani tanlaydi. Zanjir oxirida tayyor, ochilgan sabab chiqdi — kalitdagi gap aynan shu.
Bir so'zli shikoyat aniq mexanizmga aylandi.
Umumiy gap aniq holatga toraydi — misol o'zidan chiqadi.
"Foydali" o'rniga — nega aynan ishlaydi.
Taqqoslash va o'lchov chuqurlik beradi.
class_ex.note: Usul (zanjir: Fikr → Nega? → Nega muhim?): fikrni ayting, o'zingizga "nega?" deb so'rang, javob bering, yana "nega?" deng. Uch marta javob bera olsangiz — sabab chuqur, undan uch-to'rt gap chiqadi. Bir martadan keyin javob tugasa — bu fikr emas, sifat.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Uchta savolga 10 daqiqada reja
class_ex.instr: Har savolga 4 qator: POZITSIYA / BODY 1 / BODY 2 / XULOSA. Inglizcha kalit so'z bilan, har savolga 3 daqiqadan.
items: 1-savol: Some people believe that city centres should be closed to private cars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
2-savol: In many cities, people are moving from the centre to the suburbs. What are the causes of this, and what problems does it create?
3-savol: Some people think governments should spend money on new roads, while others believe the money is better spent on cycling lanes and pavements. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
answers: POZITSIYA: agree, but only if a working alternative comes first • BODY 1: space — parked cars take the pavement, pedestrian streets raise shop income • BODY 2: condition — closure fails without frequent buses; example: a market street cut off from transport • XULOSA: agree, provided transport comes first

POZITSIYA: bu savolda pozitsiya emas, javob rejasi • BODY 1 (causes): housing cost, space for families, remote work removed the daily commute • BODY 2 (problems): longer car journeys, empty centres at night, cost of new roads and pipes • XULOSA: causes are economic, problems are shared by everyone

POZITSIYA: lanes give more movement per som spent • BODY 1 (roads view): freight, hospitals, regions without rail need roads • BODY 2 (cycling view): a lane costs a fraction of a road and carries more people in the same width • XULOSA: roads between cities, lanes inside them
why: INSTRUCTION bitta pozitsiya talab qiladi; "partly agree" ham pozitsiya, agar sharti aytilsa.
Ikki savolli topshiriq — ikki body, har biri bitta savolga.
"Discuss both views" — ikkala qarash o'z xatboshisida, o'z fikri xulosada.
class_ex.note: 10 daqiqada uchta reja — imtihon tezligi. Ulgurmasangiz xavotir olmang, lekin qaysi qatorda to'xtaganingizni belgilab qo'ying: eng ko'p to'xtash BODY 2 da bo'ladi, chunki ikkinchi sabab har doim qiyinroq topiladi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Bu rejadan essay yozib bo'ladimi?
class_ex.instr: Har kartochkadagi rejani o'qing va qaror qiling: YOZSA BO'LADI, DEYARLI, LEKIN ZAIF (kichik tuzatish yetadi) yoki HALI BO'LMAYDI. Sababini ayting.
items: A kartochka. Savol: city centres closed to cars. Reja: "Pozitsiya: agree. Body 1: traffic. Body 2: pollution. Xulosa: good idea."

B kartochka. Savol: city centres closed to cars. Reja: "Pozitsiya: agree if buses run first. Body 1: space — one parked car blocks the pavement; example: a market street with no room to walk. Body 2: shops earn more on walkable streets; example: a pedestrian street after the cars left. Xulosa: agree, transport first."
C kartochka. Savol: working from home — why + positive or negative. Reja: "Body 1: reasons — internet, cost, traffic. Body 2: more reasons — flexible hours, no office rent. Xulosa: it depends."

D kartochka. Savol: new roads vs cycling lanes. Reja: "Pozitsiya: lanes give more movement per som. Body 1: roads are necessary for freight and for regions without rail. Body 2: a lane costs far less and moves more people in the same width; example: one car lane rebuilt as a cycle lane — same width, several times more people per hour. Xulosa: roads between cities, lanes inside them."

E kartochka. Savol: city parks replaced by shopping centres — outweigh? Reja: "Pozitsiya: disadvantages are heavier. Body 1: parks are free and used by everyone. Body 2: shopping centres bring jobs. Xulosa: parks are more important."
F kartochka. Savol: city centres closed to cars. Reja: "1 traffic. 2 pollution. 3 noise. 4 accidents. 5 parking. 6 shops. 7 tourists. 8 old buildings. 9 buses. 10 taxis. 11 delivery lorries."
why: "Traffic" va "pollution" — mavzu, fikr emas. Bu qatorlardan uch gap chiqmaydi; har qatorga "nega?" qo'shilishi kerak.
Har qatorda fikr, sabab va misol bor. Yozuvchi hech qayerda to'xtamaydi. Diqqat: reja to'liq inglizcha — aynan shunday bo'lishi kerak.
Ikkinchi savolga ("positive or negative") javob yo'q — ikkala body ham sabab haqida. "It depends" pozitsiya emas.
Ikkala qarash ham bor, o'z fikri xulosada aniq, misol tayyor.
Skelet to'g'ri, lekin misol yo'q va "outweigh" taroziga qo'yilmagan. Har body ga bittadan misol qo'shilsa — yozsa bo'ladi.

O'n bir qator, lekin birortasi ochilmagan va pozitsiya ham yo'q. 270 so'zga o'n bir fikr sig'maydi — ikkitasi (masalan 5 parking va 6 shops) tanlanadi, har biriga sabab va misol qo'shiladi, qolgani o'chiriladi.
class_ex.note: Tekshiruv savoli bitta: "shu qatorga qarab uch-to'rt gap yoza olamanmi?" Javob "yo'q" bo'lsa — qator hali mavzu, fikr emas. Bu savolni o'z rejangizga ham har safar bering.

readings.title: NAMUNA: Reja va undan chiqqan essay
readings.qtype: Rejaning har qatori qanday xatboshiga aylandi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (287 so'z) va uni yozgan 4 qatorli reja
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: In many large cities, private cars are the main cause of traffic congestion. Some people believe that making all public transport free would solve this problem. To what extent do you agree or disagree? — REJA (5 daqiqada yozilgan): POZITSIYA — mostly agree, but only with investment in capacity. BODY 1 — cost is the real barrier: ticket vs petrol, weekend free-bus experiments. BODY 2 — a free but overcrowded service is useless: capacity costs money, tax must replace fares. XULOSA — agree, but half a policy: fares fall as the service improves.
text: Traffic congestion in large cities grows worse each year, and one proposal that is frequently raised is to remove fares from buses and trains completely. I largely agree that free travel would persuade a significant number of drivers to leave their cars at home, although I believe the measure only works if the network itself is expanded at the same time.

The strongest argument in favour of free transport concerns cost. For a family in a middle-income city, a monthly travel card can absorb a noticeable share of the household budget, so a driver who already owns a car often calculates that petrol for a short trip is cheaper than four separate tickets. Removing the fare destroys that calculation overnight. Cities that have experimented with free buses at weekends report fuller vehicles and quieter roads almost immediately, which suggests that price, rather than habit, keeps many people behind the wheel.

A free service that is already overcrowded, however, simply becomes an unpleasant one. If buses run every forty minutes and stop half a kilometre from the nearest residential block, no fare reduction will attract a commuter who values arriving on time. The deeper problem is capacity, and capacity costs money — money that fares currently provide. Any government that abolishes tickets must therefore replace that revenue from taxation, and it must spend the new budget on additional routes and shorter intervals rather than on the subsidy alone.

In conclusion, I agree that free public transport can reduce car use, but I would treat it as one half of a policy rather than a complete answer. Fares should fall only as quickly as the service improves; otherwise cities will have built a cheap system that nobody wishes to use.
paraphrases: a driver who already owns a car / behind the wheel
remove fares completely / abolishes tickets / free travel
To what extent do you agree
I largely agree ... although / one half of a policy rather than a complete answer
glossary: absorb a share of the budget — byudjetning bir qismini yeb qo'ymoq

tasks.title: Har xatboshi rejaning qaysi qatoridan chiqdi?
tasks.instr: Essayni o'qing va har xatboshini reja qatori bilan juftlang. Bu darsning asosiy xulosasi: essay yangi narsa emas, rejaning ochilgan ko'rinishi.
tasks.note: Diqqat: reja 4 qator, essay 4 xatboshi. Yozuvchi hech qayerda "endi nima yozaman" demagan — chunki har xatboshining fikri, sababi va misoli allaqachon rejada turgan. Aynan shuning uchun rejali essay tezroq yoziladi.
head: Reja qatori (5 daqiqada yozilgan)
Qaysi xatboshi
Yozayotganda nima qo'shildi
rows: POZITSIYA — mostly agree, but only with investment
Savol o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytildi ;; pozitsiya "although" bilan cheklandi ;; jami 2 gap
BODY 1 — cost is the real barrier: ticket vs petrol
Fikr gapi, sabab (oilaviy byudjet), hisob (benzin va 4 chipta), misol (dam olish kunlari bepul avtobus), xulosa gapi ;; 4 gap
BODY 2 — free but overcrowded is useless: capacity costs money
Qarshi holat, aniq o'lchov (40 daqiqa, yarim kilometr), asosiy sabab (sig'im pul turadi), yechim (soliq va yangi yo'nalishlar) ;; 4 gap
XULOSA — half a policy, fares fall as service improves
Pozitsiya takrorlandi va o'zgarmadi ;; oxirgi gapda ogohlantirish ;; 2 gap

tasks.title: Rejada BOR edi va rejada YO'Q edi
tasks.instr: Qaysi narsa rejada turgan, qaysi biri yozayotganda qo'shilgan? Bu farq muhim: rejaga hamma narsani yozish shart emas.
items: Pozitsiya (mostly agree, but only with investment)
Ikkita asosiy sabab (cost, capacity)
Misollar (weekend free buses, forty minutes, half a kilometre)
"which suggests that price, rather than habit, keeps many people behind the wheel"
"otherwise cities will have built a cheap system that nobody wishes to use"
Bog'lovchilar (however, therefore, although)
Kirishdagi qayta aytish (paraphrase)
why: Pozitsiya har doim rejada bo'ladi — yozayotganda o'zgartirilmaydi.
Ikkita sabab — rejaning yuragi.
Rejada ikki so'z: "weekend free-bus". Aniq gap yozayotganda tuzildi.
Bu xatboshining xulosa gapi — yozayotganda o'zidan chiqdi.
Oxirgi ogohlantirish gapi ham yozish paytida qo'shildi.
Bog'lovchi rejaga yozilmaydi — u yozish paytida, o'z joyida tanlanadi.
Paraphrase yozayotganda tuziladi, lekin savol belgilangani uchun oson kechdi.
tasks.note: Xulosa: rejaga FIKR, SABAB va MISOL NOMI yoziladi. Gaplar, bog'lovchilar va paraphrase yozayotganda tug'iladi — shuning uchun reja 5 daqiqadan oshmaydi.

homework_intro: Bugun biz essay yozmadik — bugun biz YOZISHDAN OLDINGI besh daqiqani o'rgandik: savolni belgilash, pozitsiyani tanlash, ikkita chuqur sabab va to'rt qatorli reja.
Uyda birinchi vazifa: to'rtta yangi savolga faqat reja tuzasiz, essay yozmaysiz; har savolga 5 daqiqa, jami 20 daqiqa, telefon taymerini qo'yib ishlang.
Ikkinchi vazifa: o'z rejalaringizni 5-mashqdagi savol bilan tekshirasiz — "shu qatordan uch-to'rt gap chiqadimi?"; chiqmagan qatorni qizil qalam bilan tuzatasiz.
Uchinchi vazifa: shu rejalardan BITTASINI tanlab, faqat BODY 1 xatboshisini yozasiz — to'rt gap: fikr, sabab, misol, natija.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — reja o'rniga darrov essay yozib yuborish; bu hafta ataylab reja mashq qilinadi. Hamma vazifa daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi.

homework.title: To'rtta savolga reja tuzing
homework.instr: Har savolga 4 qatorli reja: POZITSIYA / BODY 1 / BODY 2 / XULOSA. Inglizcha kalit so'z bilan, har savolga 5 daqiqa. 1) Some cities have banned tall buildings in the historic centre. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development? 2) In many large cities, air quality is getting worse. What are the causes and what can be done? 3) Some people think that city bicycle-sharing schemes are a waste of public money, while others see them as essential. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. 4) Public parks in growing cities are becoming smaller. To what extent is this a problem?
homework.answers: Namuna rejalar (o'quvchiniki boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin — skelet va chuqurlik muhim, so'zlar emas). 1-savol: POZITSIYA — positive, if the height simply moves to a new district. BODY 1 — the old centre is the reason people come at all; example: one tower that breaks a low skyline. BODY 2 — nothing is lost, because offices can rise two metro stops away; example: a new business district outside the ring. XULOSA — positive, provided the city decides in advance where height is allowed. 2-savol: POZITSIYA — causes are mostly transport, so the solution must start there. BODY 1 (causes) — old vehicles, short urban trips, winter heating, construction dust. BODY 2 (solutions) — vehicle age limits, bus lanes, planting along main roads; example: one bus lane replaces forty cars. XULOSA — no single measure is enough; transport rules plus green space. 3-savol: POZITSIYA — essential, but only where the stations meet the metro. BODY 1 (waste view) — empty docks, repair costs, almost no users in winter. BODY 2 (essential view) — bicycles cover the 2-3 km trip that buses serve badly; example: docking stations beside metro exits. XULOSA — not a waste where it closes a real gap in the network. 4-savol: POZITSIYA — a serious problem, and it falls on the people with no alternative. BODY 1 — for families in flats the park is the only free space; example: a block with no yard of its own. BODY 2 — a park that shrinks stops working: no shade, no room for sport, traffic noise reaches every bench. XULOSA — the problem is real, and only land rules keep parks from disappearing. Ustoz tekshirganda uch narsaga qaraydi: (1) INSTRUCTION ning HAR QISMIGA javob bormi, (2) har qatorda fikr bormi yoki faqat mavzumi, (3) kamida bitta misol belgilanganmi.

homework.title: Rejalaringizni o'zingiz tekshiring
homework.instr: Har qatorga 5-mashqdagi savolni bering: "shu qatordan uch-to'rt gap chiqadimi?" Chiqmasa — qator yonida qizil qalam bilan tuzatilgan variantini yozing.
homework.answers: Tipik tuzatish: "Body 1: pollution" (mavzu) -> "Body 1: short urban trips pollute most because a cold engine burns more fuel per kilometre; example: 2 km school run" (fikr, sabab, misol). Har savolda kamida bitta qator tuzatilishi kerak — birorta ham tuzatish chiqmasa, o'quvchi o'ziga juda yumshoq qaragan.

homework.title: Bitta rejadan BODY 1 xatboshisini yozing
homework.instr: To'rt rejadan bittasini tanlang va faqat BODY 1 xatboshisini yozing: fikr gapi, sabab, misol, natija — kamida 4 gap, taxminan 80-100 so'z (kursdagi to'liq body xatboshi o'lchami).
homework.answers: Namuna (bicycle-sharing, "essential" qarashi): Shared bicycles are most useful on the short journeys that buses serve badly. A trip of two or three kilometres is too long to walk comfortably but too short to justify waiting fifteen minutes at a stop, and it is exactly this distance that fills city streets with cars. A scheme with docking stations beside metro exits turns that gap into a five-minute ride. As a result, the existing network carries more passengers without a single new bus being bought. Yozgandan keyin 37-darsdagi 12 ta tekshiruv savoli bilan o'zini tekshirsin.

normativ: 4 savol, har biri 4 qator, misoli belgilangan
Har savolda kamida bitta tuzatish qizil qalamda

kahoot.q: In the 40 minutes for Task 2, about how long should planning take?
kahoot.explain: Reja 5 daqiqa oladi, lekin yozishni tezlashtiradi: 5 reja + 30 yozish + 5 tekshirish.

kahoot.q: The question is about 'teenagers in big cities', but you write about all teenagers. Which part have you ignored?
kahoot.explain: "in big cities" — cheklov (KEYWORD); u tushib qolsa, essay savolga emas, mavzuga javob bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: Which part of a Task 2 question tells you WHAT TO DO (agree, discuss, suggest)?
kahoot.explain: INSTRUCTION — topshiriq so'zi; u essayning skeletini belgilaydi.

kahoot.q: Which of these is a real POSITION to write in your plan?
options: Agree, but only if buses improve
It depends on many different things
There are good and bad sides here
I will discuss both views below
kahoot.explain: Pozitsiya — aniq tomon (sharti bilan bo'lishi mumkin); "it depends" pozitsiya emas.

kahoot.q: When should you choose your position?
kahoot.explain: Pozitsiya rejada, yozishdan OLDIN tanlanadi — aks holda kirish va xulosa zid bo'lib qoladi.

kahoot.q: How many main reasons does a strong Task 2 plan usually need?
kahoot.explain: Ikkita ochilgan sabab beshta yuzaki fikrdan yuqori baholanadi.

kahoot.q: Which plan line is an IDEA, not just a topic?
options: cheap tickets pull drivers off roads
the problem of traffic in big cities
kahoot.explain: G'oya — sabab bilan aytilgan fikr; qolganlari faqat mavzu nomi, ulardan 3-4 gap chiqmaydi.

kahoot.q: A quick test for each plan line: can you write ___ from it?
kahoot.explain: Qatordan 3-4 gap chiqmasa, u hali fikr emas, mavzu.

kahoot.q: In which form is it best to write your plan?
kahoot.explain: Inglizcha kalit so'zlar: to'liq gap vaqt yeydi, o'zbekcha reja esa yozayotganda tarjima talab qiladi.

kahoot.q: 'Why are more people shopping online? Is this a positive trend?' What must the essay contain?
kahoot.explain: Ikki qismli (TWO-PART) savol: ikki savol — ikki javob; bittasi tushib qolsa, TR tushadi.

kahoot.q: 'Does home delivery bring more benefits than drawbacks?' What must your essay state clearly?
options: an equal list of both sides
kahoot.explain: "More benefits than drawbacks" (outweigh) — baho talab qilinadi: qaysi tomon og'irroq ekani aniq aytiladi.

kahoot.q: Does the examiner give marks for your plan?
options: No, only the essay is marked
Yes, up to one full band
Only if it is in English
kahoot.explain: Reja ballga kirmaydi — tekshiruvchi faqat essayga ball qo'yadi.

kahoot.q: A bus 'fare' is ...
kahoot.explain: fare — yo'l haqi, chipta narxi.

kahoot.q: If a bus is 'overcrowded', it ...
kahoot.explain: overcrowded — haddan tashqari gavjum, tiqilinch.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'money that a company or government earns'?
kahoot.explain: revenue — daromad, tushum; subsidy esa davlat yordami.

kahoot.q: To 'abolish' ticket fares means to ...
kahoot.explain: abolish — butunlay bekor qilmoq.

kahoot.q: A 'commuter' is someone who ...
options: drives a bus for a living
kahoot.explain: commuter — har kuni ishga (o'qishga) qatnovchi odam.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct word: 'The metro runs at full ___ during rush hour.'
kahoot.explain: run at full capacity — to'liq sig'imda (quvvatda) ishlamoq.

kahoot.q: A government 'subsidy' for student travel is ...
options: a tax on every ticket sold
kahoot.explain: subsidy — narxni arzonlashtirish uchun davlat to'laydigan pul.

kahoot.q: 'The benefits outweigh the costs' means the benefits are ...
kahoot.explain: outweigh — ahamiyati bo'yicha ustun kelmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Incredibly Fast Introductions
lessons.grammar_topic: Kirish xatboshisi — ikki gap, to'rt daqiqa: paraphrase va thesis
lessons.vocab_topic: Tez va aniq kirish; kirishga kirmaydigan to'rt narsa; har savol turiga o'z thesisi
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — namuna essay va barcha kirish variantlari Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan; talablar rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: Kirishni IKKI gapda va TO'RT daqiqada yozishni o'rganish.
1-gap: savolni o'z so'zi bilan aytish (paraphrase) — ko'chirmasdan, lekin ma'noni buzmasdan.
2-gap: thesis — savolga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob; besh savol turining (OPINION, DISCUSSION, OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION, TWO-PART) har biriga o'z shakli.
Kirishga KIRMAYDIGAN to'rt narsani tanib olish: bo'sh muqaddima, "In this essay I will discuss", lug'at ta'rifi, o'ylab topilgan statistika.
Zaif kirishni ko'rib, nimasi ortiqcha va nimasi yetishmayotganini aytib bera olish.
Taymer ostida yozib, 4 daqiqada tugatishni odatga aylantirish.
materials: 3-mashq uchun "Yettita kirish" varaqasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa (12 kishilik guruhga 12 nusxa); har kirish yonida ikkita bo'sh ustun: "ortiqcha nima bor" va "nima yetishmayapti".

4-mashq uchun A va B kirish matni — ustoz darsdan oldin ikkalasini (matni 4-mashq ko'rsatmasida) alohida A4 varaqqa ko'chiradi va sinfda ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; jadval doskaga uch ustun qilib chiziladi.
Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi reading bloki) — har juftlikka 1 nusxa; kirish qismi ramka bilan ajratib chizilgan.

Doskaga darsdan OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: "1-gap = paraphrase, 2-gap = thesis, jami 4 daqiqa" va besh savol turi nomi (OPINION / DISCUSSION / OPINION+DISCUSSION / SITUATION / TWO-PART) — 2-mashq shu besh ustunga yoziladi.
A4 varaqda "TAQIQLANGAN GAPLAR" ro'yxati (to'rtta gap) — darsning 5-bosqichida doskaga osiladi va dars oxirigacha turadi.
5-mashq uchun taymer: telefon sekundomeri yoki devor soati; uchta Task 2 savoli alohida kartochkalarga qirqib yozilgan (matni 5-mashqda) — har juftlikka uchtadan.
timeline: 37-darsdagi "In this essay I will discuss" gapi eslatiladi; doskadagi shart o'qiladi: 2 gap, 4 daqiqa
39-darsdagi 5+30+5 aniqlashtiriladi: reja 5, kirish 4, body 22, xulosa 3, tekshirish 6 — daftarga yoziladi
1-mashq birga bajariladi; 38-darsdagi uch yo'l eslatiladi, har javob doskada tuzatiladi
2-mashq; doskadagi besh ustunga thesislar yoziladi (SITUATION ustuniga ikkita)
"TAQIQLANGAN GAPLAR" varaqasi osiladi, har biriga sabab aytiladi
Varaqadagi yettita kirish; o'quvchi kamchilikni va tuzatishni aytadi
Ustoz ikkala kirishni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, jadval doskada to'ldiriladi
Reading bloki: ikki gap qismlarga ajratiladi, so'ng ataylab buziladi
4 daqiqa, 3 daqiqa 30 soniya, 3 daqiqa; har raunddan keyin juftlik tekshiradi
Eng yaxshi ikki kirish doskaga ko'chiriladi; vazifa aytiladi

intro: Kirishga alohida ball qo'yilmaydi, lekin tekshiruvchi essayni aynan shundan boshlaydi: birinchi ikki gapda savolga javob ko'rinmasa, Task Response bo'yicha taassurot darhol pasayadi. Shuning uchun kirish TEZ va ANIQ bo'lishi kerak — chiroyli emas.

40 daqiqa shunday taqsimlanadi: 5 daqiqa reja, 4 daqiqa kirish, 22 daqiqa ikkita body xatboshi, 3 daqiqa xulosa, 6 daqiqa tekshirish — kursning yagona Task 2 standarti (42-darsda ham shu). Bu — 39-darsdagi taxminiy "5 reja + 30 yozish + 5 tekshirish" taqsimotining aniq shakli: yozish 4 + 22 + 3 = 29 daqiqa, tekshirishga 6 daqiqa qoladi. Kirishga 8-10 daqiqa sarflagan o'quvchi ikkinchi body xatboshini tugatolmaydi — tugallanmagan essay esa TR ni odatda 5 ga tushiradi.

Kirish faqat IKKI gap: birinchisi savolni o'z so'zi bilan aytadi, ikkinchisi savolga javob beradi. Uchinchi gap faqat OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION va TWO-PART turlarida oqlanadi; to'rtta gap hech qachon kerak emas.

Paraphrase — so'zlarni sinonimga almashtirish emas, GAPNI qayta qurish. 38-darsdagi uch yo'l shu yerda ham ishlaydi: sinonim, so'z turkumini o'zgartirish (cycling -> commuting by bicycle) va gap qurilishini o'zgartirish (ega almashadi yoki gap passivga o'giriladi). Savoldagi ayrim so'zlarni (traffic, government, university) almashtirmasa ham bo'ladi: majburan almashtirilgan so'z ma'noni buzsa, Lexical Resource tushadi.

Thesis — savolga TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI javob. Besh savol turida besh xil: OPINION da aniq tomon; DISCUSSION da ikkala qarash (fikr so'ralmagan bo'lsa ham bittasini kuchliroq qo'yish mumkin); OPINION+DISCUSSION da ikki qarash va o'z fikri bitta gapda; SITUATION da muammo va chora (yoki sabab va natija) sanab o'tiladi — bu body rejasini ham beradi; TWO-PART da (ikki alohida savol, masalan "Why is this happening? Is it positive or negative?") ikkala savolga ham qisqa javob beriladi — har javob bitta body xatboshisiga aylanadi.

Kirishga KIRMAYDIGAN to'rt narsa: (1) "Nowadays the world is changing very fast" kabi bo'sh muqaddima — hech qanday ma'lumot bermaydi; (2) "In this essay I will discuss" — 37-darsda ko'rdik, ball qo'shmaydi, faqat so'z yeydi; (3) lug'at ta'rifi ("Traffic congestion refers to...") — tekshiruvchi so'zni biladi; (4) o'ylab topilgan statistika ("According to statistics, 78%...") — manbasi yo'q raqam ishonchni yo'qotadi va TR ni tushiradi.
Kirish hajmi — 35-50 so'z. 30 so'zdan kam bo'lsa thesis odatda aniq emas; 60 so'zdan oshsa body dan vaqt o'g'irlanadi.

Kirishdagi pozitsiya xulosadagi pozitsiya bilan BIR XIL bo'lishi shart. 37-darsdagi A essay aynan shu yerda yiqildi: kirishida pozitsiya umuman aytilmagan ("In this essay I will discuss both views"), xulosasida esa "It depends" deb yozilgan — ya'ni ikkala uchida ham fikr yo'q.
Tezlik faqat mashq bilan keladi: savolni o'qish va turini aniqlash 30 soniya, ikki gapni yozish 3 daqiqa, o'qib chiqish 30 soniya. Shu tartib bugun uch marta takrorlanadi.
formulas: 39-darsdagi taxminiy 5+30+5 ning aniq shakli (42-darsda ham shu)
38-darsdagi uch yo'l: sinonim, so'z turkumi, gap qurilishi
Har buzilgandan keyin asl variant qaytadan o'qiladi
Vaqt tugadi — gap yarim qolsa ham qalam qo'yiladi
presentation: Kirish uchun alohida ball bormi?
Yo'q, alohida ball yo'q. Lekin Task Response va Coherence bo'yicha birinchi taassurot aynan shundan boshlanadi.
Uch gap yozsam bo'ladimi?
OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION va TWO-PART da mumkin. To'rt gap — ko'p: body dan vaqt oladi.
Savoldagi hamma so'zni almashtirishim kerakmi?
Yo'q. "Traffic", "government", "university" kabi so'zlarni qoldirish mumkin. Noto'g'ri sinonim ma'noni buzadi va LR ni tushiradi.
Statistika yozsam kuchli ko'rinadimi?
Aksincha. Manbasiz raqam ("78% of people") ishonchni yo'qotadi. "Many residents" deb yozing — xavfsiz va yetarli.
Fikrimni kirishda aytsam, xulosada nima qoladi?
Xulosada o'sha pozitsiya boshqa so'z bilan takrorlanadi va sabab qisqa eslatiladi. Fikrni yashirib yurish TR ni tushiradi.
Kirishni essayning oxirida yozsam bo'ladimi?
Mumkin, lekin tavsiya etilmaydi: vaqt yetmay qolsa essay kirishsiz qoladi. 39-darsdagi rejadan keyin darhol yozing.
4 daqiqada ulgurmayapman, nima qilay?
Avval faqat 1-gapni 2 daqiqada yozishni mashq qiling. Ikki hafta kundalik mashqdan keyin ikki gap o'zi 4 daqiqaga tushadi.
DISCUSSION da fikrim so'ralmasa, thesisda nima yozaman?
Ikkala qarashni bitta gapda ko'rsating va qaysi biri kuchliroq ekanini bildiring — bu xato emas, xulosani aniq qiladi.
notes: Bu dars 36-39 darslarning davomi: savol turlari va baholash mezonlari 36-darsda berilgan, 37-darsda amalda qo'llangan, paraphrase 38-darsda, reja esa 39-darsda o'rganilgan. Bularning hech biri QAYTA tushuntirilmaydi, faqat eslatiladi. O'quvchi besh turni ajrata olmasa, 36-darsdagi ustunlarni 3 daqiqada ko'rsatib o'ting.

1-mashq — 38-darsning takrori emas, tatbiqi: u yerda gaplar umuman paraphrase qilingan, bu yerda faqat KIRISHNING BIRINCHI GAPI yoziladi. Shuni ochiq ayting, aks holda o'quvchi "buni o'tganmiz" deb e'tiborini yo'qotadi.

Mavzu oilasi: TRANSPORT VA SHAHAR HAYOTI — shahar markazini avtomobilsiz qilish, bepul jamoat transporti, velosiped yo'laklari, yo'l qurilishi, yakka haydovchilik. 39 va 41-darslarda ham shu oila ishlatilgan — ataylab: tanish mavzuda o'quvchi faqat yangi ko'nikmaga (kirish) e'tibor qaratadi. 42-darsdan boshlab boshqa mavzular keladi (ish va bandlik, meros, texnologiya, sog'liq).
Taymerni ustoz o'zi boshqaradi va ovoz chiqarib sanaydi: "bir daqiqa qoldi", "o'ttiz soniya". Vaqt tugaganda qalam qo'yiladi — gap yarim qolsa ham. Maqsad mukammal kirish emas, TEZLIK odati.

3-mashqdagi kirishlar markaz talabalarining haqiqiy xatolari asosida yozilgan: bo'sh muqaddima, ta'rif, reja e'loni, o'ylab topilgan raqam. O'quvchi o'z daftaridan shu gaplarni topsa — darsning eng foydali daqiqasi shu bo'ladi.

4-mashqdagi A va B kirish bitta savolga yozilgan, lekin namuna essayning kirishi ham shu savolga yozilgan — ya'ni sinf bitta savolga IKKITA kuchli kirish ko'radi. Buni kamchilik deb emas, imkoniyat deb ayting: bitta savolga bir nechta to'g'ri kirish bo'ladi. Namuna essayda ataylab uchinchi body (shart: "The policy does come with a condition attached") bor — bugun faqat kirish tahlil qilinadi; o'quvchi uchun standart o'zgarmaydi: 4 xatboshi (kirish, 2 body, xulosa). O'quvchi so'rasa: IELTS xatboshi sonini belgilamaydi, 5 xatboshi xato emas — lekin 40 daqiqada 4 xatboshili reja eng xavfsizi.
Eng yaxshi ikki kirish dars oxirida doskaga ko'chiriladi va guruh bilan sanaladi: nechta gap, nechta so'z, taqiqlangan gap bormi. Bu baho emas, tekshiruv.
Keyingi darsga tayyorgarlik: uyga vazifadagi kirishlar yig'iladi va eng ko'p uchragan uchta kamchilik keyingi darsning birinchi 5 daqiqasida ko'rsatiladi.

how: CORE — shu darsdagi namuna essay, kirishlar va model gaplardan olingan 14 ta so'z. Ularni namuna essaydan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing: har o'quvchi 2 ta so'z bilan transport mavzusida bitta kirish gapi yozadi.
core: Privately owned vehicles are not allowed in the old town after ten in the morning.
Ertalab soat o'ndan keyin eski shaharga shaxsiy avtomobillar kiritilmaydi.
The central district becomes very quiet once the offices close.
Idoralar yopilgach, markaziy tuman juda sokin bo'lib qoladi.
Lower speed limits are a simple measure to make streets safer.
Tezlik chegarasini pasaytirish ko'chalarni xavfsizroq qilishning oddiy chorasidir.
Exhaust fumes from buses and lorries make the air in narrow streets unhealthy.
Avtobus va yuk mashinalarining chiqindi gazlari tor ko'chalardagi havoni zararli qiladi.
The street was closed to traffic and handed over to pedestrians.
Ko'cha transport uchun yopilib, piyodalarga berildi.
Café owners said their takings rose after the street became car-free.
Kafe egalari ko'cha mashinasiz bo'lgach, savdo tushumi oshganini aytishdi.
People stop using buses that are unreliable and often late.
Odamlar ishonchsiz va tez-tez kechikadigan avtobuslardan foydalanishni to'xtatadi.
A car ban can work, provided that buses run every few minutes.
Avtobuslar har bir necha daqiqada qatnasagina, mashinalarni taqiqlash samara beradi.
The city has to tackle air pollution before it gets any worse.
Shahar havo ifloslanishini yanada yomonlashmasidan oldin hal qilishga kirishishi kerak.
Several cities have banned cars from their historic centres.
Bir nechta shahar tarixiy markazlariga mashinalar kirishini taqiqlagan.
Before closing roads, the city must offer drivers a real alternative.
Yo'llarni yopishdan oldin shahar haydovchilarga haqiqiy muqobil taklif qilishi kerak.
The new ring road brought only temporary relief to the town centre.
Yangi halqa yo'l shahar markaziga faqat vaqtinchalik yengillik olib keldi.
Their reluctance to cycle is easy to understand on such busy roads.
Shunday gavjum yo'llarda ularning velosipedda yurishni istamasligini tushunish oson.
In my view, the new parking charge is fully justified.
Menimcha, yangi to'xtash joyi to'lovi to'liq asosli.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Savolni o'z so'zingiz bilan ayting
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi savol gapini o'ngdagidek qayta yozing. Avval o'zlari urinib ko'rishsin, keyin doskada tuzatiladi. Har javobdan keyin so'rang: 38-darsdagi qaysi yo'l ishlatildi — sinonim, so'z turkumi yoki gap qurilishi?
items: Many city centres are now closed to private cars.
Governments should spend more money on public transport.
Some people think this is the best way to reduce pollution.
Cycling to work is becoming more popular.
Traffic congestion is a serious problem in large cities.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
answers: Private vehicles are now banned from a number of city centres.
Governments ought to invest more heavily in buses and trains.
There are those who regard this as the most effective means of tackling pollution.
Commuting by bicycle is increasingly common.
Heavy traffic causes real difficulties in major urban areas.
why: Gap qurilishi: ega almashdi (city centres -> private vehicles), closed to -> banned from, many -> a number of.
should spend more money -> ought to invest more heavily; "public transport" aniqlashtirildi.

Gap qurilishi: some people think -> there are those who regard ... as ("some" "many" ga ham, "people" "experts/commentators" ga ham aylanmadi); the best way to reduce -> the most effective means of tackling.
So'z turkumi o'zgardi: cycling -> commuting by bicycle; becoming more popular -> increasingly common.
Ot ibora fe'lga aylandi: is a serious problem -> causes real difficulties; "heavy traffic" — congestion ning xavfsiz muqobili.
Savolning ko'rsatmasi kirishga ko'chirilmaydi — unga thesis bilan javob beriladi.
class_ex.note: Qoida: har so'zni emas, GAPNI o'zgartiring. Ikki-uch o'zgarish yetarli. Noto'g'ri tanlangan sinonim ma'noni buzadi va LR ni tushiradi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Har savol turiga thesis
class_ex.instr: Doskadagi besh ustunga thesislar yoziladi (SITUATION ustuniga ikkita: muammo-chora va sabab-natija). Savolni ustoz o'qiydi, o'quvchi thesisni aytadi; oxirgi ZAIF NAMUNA ustunga yozilmaydi — nega thesis emasligi aytiladi.
items: OPINION — City centres should be completely closed to private cars. To what extent do you agree?
DISCUSSION — Some say free public transport would end congestion; others say only higher fuel taxes work. Discuss both views.
OPINION+DISCUSSION — Some believe cycle lanes are the best answer to urban traffic; others believe wider roads are needed. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
SITUATION (muammo va chora) — Traffic in many large cities is getting worse every year. What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
SITUATION (sabab va natija) — More and more people drive to work alone. What are the causes of this and what effects does it have?
TWO-PART (ikki qismli savol) — More and more people in cities are using electric scooters for short trips. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or a negative development?
ZAIF NAMUNA — There are both advantages and disadvantages, and it depends on the country.
answers: I strongly agree that closing central districts to private cars entirely is justified, because it makes these areas both cleaner and safer.
Although free travel would certainly attract passengers, the argument for making driving expensive is the more convincing one.
While wider roads bring short-term relief, I believe that investment in cycle lanes offers cities a more lasting solution.
This trend wastes millions of working hours and damages public health, but congestion charges and better bus networks could reverse it.
Poor transport links outside city limits and inflexible working hours explain this habit, which in turn raises both pollution levels and household costs.
Scooters are spreading because they are cheap and faster than buses over short distances, and I see this as a largely positive development for congested streets.
why: Aniq tomon va ikkita sabab — body rejasi ham shu yerda; savoldagi "completely" ham tushib qolmagan (entirely).
Ikkala qarash bitta gapda; fikr so'ralmagan bo'lsa ham kuchliroq tomon ko'rsatilgan.
Ikki qarash va o'z fikri — hammasi bitta gapda.
Ikki muammo va ikki chora — ikkita body xatboshining rejasi.
Sabab va natija ikkalasi ham thesisda ko'rinadi.
Ikki savol — ikki javob bitta gapda: sabab (cheap, faster than buses) va baho (largely positive). Har javob keyin bitta body xatboshisiga aylanadi.
Pozitsiya yo'q; 37-darsdagi "It depends" xatosi — TR odatda 5 dan oshmaydi (37-darsdagi A essay ham TR 5 olgan).
class_ex.note: Thesis savolning so'roq qismiga javob beradi; so'roq gapi ikkita bo'lsa (TWO-PART), ikkalasiga ham. Savol turini noto'g'ri o'qigan o'quvchi to'g'ri thesis yozolmaydi — shuning uchun avval tur, keyin thesis.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Zaif kirishni toping
class_ex.instr: Har kirish ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi; o'quvchi "ortiqcha nima bor" va "nima yetishmayapti" degan ikki savolga javob beradi.
items: Nowadays, transport is a very important topic in the modern world and it is discussed by many people.
Traffic congestion refers to a situation in which too many cars are on the road at the same time.
In this essay I will discuss both views and then I will give my own opinion.
According to statistics, 78% of city residents support car-free streets.
Many city centres are closed to private cars. Some people think this is good and others think it is bad.
I think cars are bad.
Firstly, cars cause pollution. Secondly, they cause noise. And they are dangerous for children.
answers: Bo'sh muqaddima: birorta ham ma'lumot yo'q
Lug'at ta'rifi — tekshiruvchi bu so'zni biladi
Reja e'loni: 16 so'z sarflanadi, fikr qo'shilmaydi
Savol ko'chirilgan, ikkinchi gap esa savolni yana takrorlaydi
Thesis bor, lekin juda oddiy va sababsiz
why: O'chiriladi; o'rniga darhol paraphrase yoziladi.
O'chiriladi; ta'rif hech qachon ball qo'shmaydi.
Thesis bilan almashtiriladi.
Raqamsiz aytiladi: "Many residents support...".
Paraphrase va aniq pozitsiya kerak.
Sabab qo'shiladi, lug'at ko'tariladi: "I largely agree that... because...".
Bu gaplar 2-xatboshiga ko'chiriladi, kirishda umumiy pozitsiya qoladi.
class_ex.note: Yettitasining oltitasi bitta kasallikdan: kirish savolga JAVOB bermayapti (faqat oltinchisida javob bor, lekin u juda zaif). Tekshiruv savoli bitta — "shu ikki gapni o'qib, mening fikrimni bilib bo'ladimi?".

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Ikki kirishni yonma-yon qo'ying
class_ex.instr: Ikkala kirish BITTA savolga yozilgan. SAVOL: Many city governments have closed their central streets to private cars. Some people believe this is the most effective way to improve life in large cities. To what extent do you agree or disagree? — A KIRISH (zaif, 4 gap, 63 so'z): "Nowadays transport is a very important topic in the modern world and everybody talks about it. Many city governments have closed their central streets to private cars and some people think this is the best way to improve life in large cities. About 80% of people agree with this idea. In this essay I will discuss both sides and give my own opinion." — B KIRISH (kuchli, 2 gap, 41 so'z): "A growing number of city authorities no longer allow privately owned vehicles into their central districts. In my view, this is the most effective means of improving urban life, because it makes such areas both cleaner and considerably safer for pedestrians." Ustoz ikkalasini ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, farqni o'quvchi topadi, jadval doskada to'ldiriladi.
class_ex.note: Diqqat: B kirish A dan QISQA, lekin kuchliroq. Uzunlik kuch emas — aniqlik kuch. Shu xulosa doskaga yozib qo'yiladi. Quyidagi namuna essayning kirishi ham xuddi shu savolga yozilgan, lekin boshqacha — bitta savolga bir nechta to'g'ri kirish bo'ladi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Taymer bilan uch raund
class_ex.instr: Har raundda ustoz savol kartochkasini beradi va taymerni ishga tushiradi. Vaqt tugaganda qalam qo'yiladi. Keyin juftlik bir-birini tekshiruv ro'yxati bo'yicha tekshiradi.
items: 1-raund, 4 daqiqa. Savol: Some people think that city governments should make all public transport free. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
2-raund, 3 daqiqa 30 soniya. Savol: In many countries cycling is far less common than driving. What are the reasons for this, and what could be done to encourage cycling?
3-raund, 3 daqiqa. Savol: Some argue that building more roads is the only way to reduce traffic; others believe this simply attracts more drivers. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Har raunddan keyingi tekshiruv ro'yxati (juftlikda, 1 daqiqa)
answers: It is sometimes suggested that city authorities should remove fares from all forms of public transport. I largely agree with this proposal, since free travel would take cars off the road and would ease the pressure on families with low incomes.

In a great many countries the bicycle remains a rare sight, while the car dominates everyday travel. Unsafe streets and long distances explain this reluctance, although protected cycle lanes and secure parking could change it.

Building new roads is sometimes presented as the only real cure for congested cities, yet critics claim that extra lanes fill up almost immediately. While additional capacity brings temporary relief, I believe that improving buses and trains is the more sensible investment.
1) Ikki (ko'pi bilan uch) gapmi? 2) Savol ko'chirilmaganmi? 3) Thesis savolga javob beryaptimi? 4) To'rt taqiqdan biri bormi? 5) 35-50 so'zmi?
why: 41 so'z, ikki gap: paraphrase ("some people think" -> "it is sometimes suggested"; "all public transport" saqlangan) va aniq pozitsiya.
35 so'z, ikki gap. SITUATION turi: sabab ham, chora ham thesisda.

42 so'z, ikki gap. OPINION+DISCUSSION: birinchi gapda ikki qarash ("some argue" ->"is sometimes presented"; "the only way" -> "the only real cure"; "roads" saqlangan — "motorways" ma'noni toraytirardi), ikkinchisida o'z fikri.
Beshtasiga ham "ha" bo'lsa — kirish tayyor.
class_ex.note: Har raundda vaqt QISQARADI: 4 -> 3.5 -> 3 daqiqa. Maqsad mukammal gap emas, tezlik odati. Ulgurmagan o'quvchi tushkunlikka tushmasin — birinchi haftada bu normal holat. Imkon bo'lsa, 3-raundni kompyuterda (so'z sanagichi bor oddiy matn muharririda) yozdiring — imtihon kompyuterda topshirilishi ham mumkin.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — kirish qanday ishlaydi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 7.5 darajasida yozilgan, 251 so'z; kirishi 40 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Many city governments have closed their central streets to private cars. Some people believe this is the most effective way to improve life in large cities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
text: A number of large cities have recently banned privately owned vehicles from their central districts. I largely agree that this is the single most effective measure available to city authorities, although it only works when the alternatives are genuinely ready.

The clearest gain is in the quality of the air that people breathe. Exhaust fumes from slow-moving traffic collect in exactly those narrow streets where pedestrians spend most of their time, so removing the vehicles has an immediate effect that no other policy can match. A city which closes ten central streets can measure the difference within weeks, whereas cleaner engines take a decade to reach the majority of drivers.

Streets without cars also change the way a city is used. Space that once held parked vehicles becomes seating, market stalls and cycle lanes, and small businesses generally report higher takings once shoppers are able to walk freely. Accidents involving children and elderly pedestrians fall sharply, which for most families matters far more than the inconvenience of parking further away.

The policy does come with a condition attached, however. Where bus and tram services are unreliable, a ban simply pushes traffic into the surrounding neighbourhoods and punishes workers who have no other way of reaching the centre. Such schemes therefore have to be introduced alongside frequent public transport and sensible delivery arrangements for shops.
Overall, I believe that closing central streets is the strongest instrument cities currently possess, provided that it is paired with transport which residents can actually rely on.
paraphrases: city governments have closed their central streets
large cities have recently banned ... from their central districts
the single most effective measure available
the quality of the air / the way a city is used
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
I largely agree ... although (thesis; ko'rsatma ko'chirilmagan)

tasks.instr: Ustoz buzilgan variantni o'qiydi, o'quvchi nima yo'qolganini va qaysi mezon tushishini aytadi.
items: Nowadays, cars are a very big problem in the modern world.
Many city governments have closed their central streets to private cars.
In this essay I will look at both sides of this question.
Traffic congestion can be defined as a situation in which vehicles move very slowly.
Studies show that 83% of residents support these bans.
I agree with this idea.

answers: Mavzu ham, pozitsiya ham yo'q; 11 so'z behuda ketdi
Thesis bor, lekin sababsiz va zaif
why: TR va CC.
LR va TR.
TR — savolga javob yo'q.
TR — so'z sarflanadi, fikr qo'shilmaydi.
TR — ishonch yo'qoladi.
LR va TR — "largely agree ... because" darajasiga ko'tarilishi kerak.
