homework_intro: Bugun biz kirishni ikki gapda va to'rt daqiqada yozishni mashq qildik — uyda xuddi shu ishni taymer bilan yana uch marta qilasiz.
Birinchi vazifa: berilgan uch savolga uchta kirish; har biriga qat'iy 4 daqiqa, telefonda taymer qo'ying va sarflangan vaqtni kirish yoniga yozib qo'ying.

Ikkinchi vazifa: 37-darsda ball qo'ygan essayingizning (35-dars mockidagi Writing Task 2 essayi; mockda bo'lmaganlar uchun — 37-darsda uyda yozilgan yangi essay) kirishini oling va uni ikki gapda qayta yozing; eski va yangi variantni yonma-yon qo'ying, ostiga "nima o'zgardi" deb bitta jumla yozing.
Uchinchi vazifa qisqa: daftar oxiriga "Kirishga KIRMAYDI" ro'yxatini (to'rtta) va har savol turiga bittadan thesis shablonini ko'chiring — bu ro'yxat imtihongacha ishlatiladi.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — taymersiz yozib, "men baribir ulguraman" deb o'ylash; vaqtsiz yozilgan kirish tekshirilmaydi, shuning uchun vaqtni albatta yozib qo'ying.

homework.title: Uchta kirish — taymer bilan
homework.instr: Har savolga IKKI gapli kirish, qat'iy 4 daqiqa. Savollar: 1) Some people believe that city centres should be reserved for pedestrians only. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 2) In many cities public transport is crowded and unreliable. What problems does this cause and what could be done about it? 3) Some think that cheap air travel should be taxed more heavily; others say it gives ordinary people freedom. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Har kirish yoniga sarflangan vaqtni yozing.
homework.answers: Namuna kirishlar (ustoz solishtirish uchun ishlatadi; o'quvchining varianti boshqacha bo'lsa ham to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin). 1) "It is sometimes argued that the heart of a city ought to be given over entirely to those on foot. I largely agree with this position, because pedestrian streets are safer for children and noticeably better for the shops that line them." — 42 so'z, OPINION. 2) "Buses and trains in a great many cities are overcrowded and rarely run on time. This drives commuters back into their cars and costs employers countless working hours, although more frequent services and proper funding would go a long way towards putting this right." — 44 so'z, SITUATION (muammo va chora). 3) "Low-cost flights are seen by some as a fair target for taxation, while others regard cheap air fares as a genuine freedom for ordinary families. Although the environmental case for taxation is strong, I believe that any new charge must fall on frequent flyers rather than the annual holidaymaker." — 49 so'z, OPINION+DISCUSSION. Ustoz avval VAQTga, keyin ikki gap shartiga, so'ng thesisning savol turiga mosligiga qaraydi.

homework.title: Eski kirishni qayta yozing
homework.instr: 37-darsdagi uy vazifasida o'zingiz ball qo'ygan essayning kirishini oling: 35-dars mock imtihonidagi Writing Task 2 essayingiz (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar); mockda qatnashmagan bo'lsangiz — 37-darsning uy vazifasida yozgan yangi essayingiz. Ikki gapda qayta yozing va eski variant bilan yonma-yon qo'ying. Ostiga "nima o'zgardi" deb bitta jumla yozing.
homework.answers: Javob har o'quvchida har xil. Tekshirish mezoni: savol ko'chirilmagan, thesis savolga javob beryapti, to'rt taqiqdan biri ham yo'q, hajmi 35-50 so'z. Namuna sifatida 4-mashqdagi A -> B o'zgarishi ko'rsatiladi.

homework.title: To'rt taqiq va besh thesis shabloni
homework.instr: Daftar oxiriga ko'chiring: "Kirishga KIRMAYDI" ro'yxati (4 ta) va har savol turiga bittadan thesis shabloni (5 ta).
homework.answers: Taqiqlar — bo'sh muqaddima; "In this essay I will discuss"; lug'at ta'rifi; o'ylab topilgan statistika. Shablonlar — 2-mashqdagi javoblardan har turga bittadan (OPINION, DISCUSSION, OPINION+DISCUSSION, SITUATION, TWO-PART).

normativ: Har biri 2 gap, 4 daqiqada, vaqti yozilgan
Eski va yangi yonma-yon, izohi bilan

kahoot.q: How many sentences should a Task 2 introduction usually have?
kahoot.explain: Kirish — ikki gap: paraphrase va thesis.

kahoot.q: About how long should you spend writing the introduction?
kahoot.explain: Kirishga 4 daqiqa: ortiqcha har daqiqa body dan o'g'irlanadi.

kahoot.q: What is the job of the FIRST sentence of an introduction?
kahoot.explain: 1-gap savolni o'z so'zingiz bilan qayta aytadi (paraphrase).

kahoot.q: What is a thesis statement?
options: A direct answer to the question
A general remark about the world
A definition of the key term
A promise to discuss both views
kahoot.explain: Thesis — savolga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob; u 2-gapda turadi.

kahoot.q: Which opening sentence should you AVOID?
options: Nowadays, the world is changing very fast.
More adults are returning to education.
Remote work is now common in many firms.
kahoot.explain: "Nowadays, the world is changing..." — bo'sh muqaddima: hech qanday ma'lumot bermaydi.

kahoot.q: Why should you avoid 'In this essay I will discuss...'?
options: It adds words but no answer
It is far too informal for IELTS
It makes the essay too short
kahoot.explain: Reja e'loni so'z yeydi, lekin savolga javob bermaydi — o'rniga thesis yoziladi.

kahoot.q: A student writes: 'According to statistics, 65% of people agree.' What is the problem?
kahoot.explain: O'ylab topilgan statistika ishonchni yo'qotadi; "many people" yetarli.

kahoot.q: Which is the best paraphrase of 'Many people now work from home'?
options: A large number of employees now work remotely.
Many people now work from their own home.
Few employees are now allowed to work remotely.
Working from home is now a serious problem.
kahoot.explain: Ma'no saqlangan, gap qayta qurilgan; "few" ma'noni teskari qiladi, "serious problem" esa fikr qo'shadi.

kahoot.q: When you paraphrase the question, do you have to change every word?
options: No, key terms can stay the same
kahoot.explain: "traffic", "government" kabi asosiy so'zlar qolishi mumkin; majburiy sinonim ma'noni buzadi.

kahoot.q: An essay asks 'To what extent do you agree?'. What must the thesis show?
kahoot.explain: OPINION savolida thesis aniq tomonni ko'rsatadi.

kahoot.q: A question asks 'Why is this happening? Is it positive or negative?' What should the thesis do?
kahoot.explain: TWO-PART savolda thesis ikkala savolga ham qisqa javob beradi.

kahoot.q: Your introduction says you 'largely agree'. What must the conclusion say?
options: The same position, in new words
kahoot.explain: Kirish va xulosadagi pozitsiya bir xil bo'lishi shart — aks holda TR tushadi.

kahoot.q: What is a sensible length for a Task 2 introduction?
kahoot.explain: 35-50 so'z: kamroq bo'lsa thesis noaniq, ko'proq bo'lsa body dan vaqt ketadi.

kahoot.q: 'Exhaust fumes' are ...
kahoot.explain: exhaust fumes — mashina dvigatelidan chiqadigan gazlar.

kahoot.q: A shop's 'takings' are ...
kahoot.explain: takings — savdo tushumi, do'kon topgan pul.

kahoot.q: Choose the word: 'Lower speed limits are a simple ___ to improve safety.'
kahoot.explain: measure — chora, tadbir.

kahoot.q: An 'unreliable' bus service is one that ...
options: only runs in the city centre
kahoot.explain: unreliable — ishonchsiz: vaqtida kelishiga ishonib bo'lmaydi.

kahoot.q: 'The ban works, provided that buses are frequent.' Here 'provided that' means ...
kahoot.explain: provided that — shu shart bilanki, faqat ... bo'lsa.

kahoot.q: Which verb goes with 'a problem' in formal writing: '___ a problem'?
kahoot.explain: tackle a problem — muammoni hal qilishga kirishmoq.

kahoot.q: 'Their reluctance to cycle' means they are ...
kahoot.explain: reluctance — istamaslik, ikkilanish.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Building Body Paragraphs — xatboshining to'rt harakati
lessons.grammar_topic: Body xatboshi qurilishi: Fikr (topic sentence) - Tushuntirish - Misol - Bog'lash
lessons.vocab_topic: Bitta xatboshi = bitta fikr; fikrni isbotlash zanjiri va "Xo'sh, nima bo'ldi?" savoli
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — namuna essay, barcha gaplar va mashq bandlari Jony Academy tomonidan shu dars uchun yozilgan. Baholash 36-37 darslardagi rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bilan bir xil.
objectives: Body xatboshining to'rt harakatini nomi bilan aytish: Fikr, Tushuntirish, Misol, Bog'lash.
Bitta xatboshiga BITTA asosiy fikr qo'yish qoidasini amalda qo'llash va ortiqcha g'oyani topib tashlash.
Topic sentence yozish: da'vo bo'lsin, savol yoki mavzu e'loni bo'lmasin.
Fikrni shunchaki aytib qo'ymay, sabab zanjiri bilan tushuntirish (kamida ikki qadam).
Aralashib ketgan gaplardan to'g'ri tartibdagi xatboshi yig'ish.
Yalang'och topic sentence'dan to'liq, besh gapli xatboshi qurish.
materials: Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi reading bloki) — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa A4 da, o'ng chekkasida bo'sh ustun: "qaysi harakat?".
3-mashq uchun aralash gaplar: A dan F gacha 6 gap alohida qirqilgan kartochkalar, har juftlikka 1 to'plam (12 kishilik guruhga 6 to'plam) — dars boshlanishidan oldin qaychi bilan qirqiladi.
Doskaga darsdan OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: to'rt harakat zanjiri "FIKR - TUSHUNTIRISH - MISOL - BOG'LASH" va uning ostida katta harflar bilan "XO'SH, NIMA BO'LDI?".
5-mashq uchun yalang'och topic sentence yozilgan varaqchalar — har juftlikka bittadan, kamida 6 ta; matnlari 5-mashqning izohidan olinadi.
2-mashqning jadvali uchun: ustoz doskada 3 ustunli bo'sh jadval chizadi (Zaif topic sentence / Muammo / Kuchli variant), o'quvchilar daftariga ko'chiradi.
Ikki rangli marker: ko'k — topic sentence, qizil — misol gaplari (namuna essayda belgilash uchun).
timeline: 37-darsdagi 4 mezon eslatiladi; "fikr bor-u ochilmagan" muammosi doskaga yoziladi
Doskadagi zanjir; har harakatga bittadan namuna gap ustoz tomonidan yoziladi
Og'zaki, butun guruh bilan; har javobda "nimadan bildingiz" so'raladi
Reading bloki o'qiladi, ko'k va qizil marker bilan belgilanadi, keyin ikkala jadval to'ldiriladi
Reading blokining uchinchi topshirig'i: olti savol butun guruh bilan
Jadval daftarga; zaif gapni juftlikda to'g'rilash
Kartochkalar juftlikda teriladi, keyin doskada tekshiriladi
Yozma, juftlikda; ustoz aylanib yurib ko'rsatma beradi
Doskada tekshirish, xulosa va uyga vazifa
2-3 xatboshi o'qiladi va to'rt harakatga ajratiladi; zanjir takrorlanadi, vazifa kirish matni o'qiladi

intro: Body xatboshi — essayning ishchi qismi. Kirish va xulosaga alohida ball qo'yilmaydi, lekin ular pozitsiyani (TR) va tuzilmani (CC) ko'rsatadi; ballning asosiy qismi aynan shu ikki body xatboshida yig'iladi.
Har body xatboshi to'rt harakatdan iborat: FIKR (topic sentence), TUSHUNTIRISH (nega shunday), MISOL (aniq holat), BOG'LASH (demak, savolga javobim shu).
Qoida: bitta xatboshi — bitta fikr. Ikkinchi g'oya paydo bo'lsa, u yangi xatboshiga ketadi yoki umuman tashlanadi. 37-darsdagi A essayda aynan shu qoida buzilgan edi.

Topic sentence DA'VO bo'lishi shart. "Nowadays transport is important" — mavzu e'loni, da'vo emas. "Should cities charge drivers?" — savol, da'vo emas. Tekshirish usuli: shu gapga rozi bo'lish yoki rozi bo'lmaslik mumkinmi? Mumkin bo'lsa — bu topic sentence.
Topic sentence ichida xatboshining g'oyasi TURISHI kerak; o'quvchi faqat shu gapni o'qib, xatboshi nima haqda ekanini bilib olsin.
Tushuntirish — eng ko'p tashlab ketiladigan harakat. O'quvchi fikrni aytadi va darrov misolga o'tadi. Holbuki ball aynan "nega shunday" degan zanjirda: sabab, keyin sababning natijasi.
Zanjir kamida ikki qadam bo'lsin: X shunday, chunki Y; Y esa Z ga olib keladi. Bir qadamli tushuntirish 6.0 darajasida qoladi.
Misol statistika bo'lishi shart emas va raqam o'ylab topish kerak emas. Aniq odam, aniq joy, aniq harakat yetarli: "a nurse leaving hospital at one in the morning".

Bog'lash gapi "Xo'sh, nima bo'ldi?" savoliga javob beradi: bu fikr savolga qanday javob berayotganini aytadi. Xatboshi misol bilan tugasa, o'quvchi fikrni o'zi yig'ishi kerak bo'lib qoladi — bu TR ni tushiradi.
To'liq xatboshi 4-5 gap, 80-100 so'z atrofida. Uzunlik emas, zanjirning to'liqligi sanaladi: to'rt harakat bo'lsa, shuncha o'zidan chiqadi.

notes: Bu dars 36 va 37 darslarning davomi: 36 da savol turlari va mezonlar, 37 da tayyor essaylar baholangan. Bugun o'quvchi birinchi marta SINFDA, tayyor matnsiz, yalang'och fikrdan to'liq body xatboshini to'rt harakat bo'yicha o'zi quradi (37-darsda tayyor xatboshi qayta yozilgan, 39-darsning uyga vazifasida o'z rejasidan BODY 1 yozilgan, 40-darsda faqat kirish yozilgan — bugun shu tajriba to'rt harakat tizimiga solinadi) — shuning uchun yozish vaqti (5-mashq) qisqartirilmasin.

Mavzu oilasi: SHAHAR TRANSPORTI va tirbandlik (bepul jamoat transporti, markazga kirish uchun haq, velosiped yo'laklari, tungi avtobuslar, parkovka narxi). 36-darsda jinoyat va jazo, 37-darsda ta'lim, 38-darsda turizm mavzusi edi; 39-40-darslar esa shu transport oilasida (39-darsda deyarli shu savol bo'yicha reja tuzilgan). Shuning uchun o'quvchi mavzuni taniydi: vaqt yangi g'oya qidirishga emas, xatboshi qurilishiga sarflansin. 42-darsdan boshlab boshqa mavzular keladi (ish, meros, texnologiya, sog'liq); transport 47-darsda yana qaytadi.
To'rt harakat nomini ustoz doim BIR XIL so'z bilan aytsin: Fikr, Tushuntirish, Misol, Bog'lash. Nom o'zgarsa, o'quvchi chalkashadi.

3-mashqdagi E gapi ataylab ortiqcha: u havo sifati haqida, xatboshi esa velosiped yo'lagi haqida. Kartochkalarni terayotganda ko'pchilik uni ham qo'shib yuboradi — shu xato darsning eng foydali daqiqasi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — bepul jamoat transporti
readings.qtype: Jony Academy namuna essayi, Band 7.5 darajasi
readings.source: Jony Academy uchun shu dars maqsadida yozilgan (311 so'z). Ikkala body xatboshi ham to'rt harakat bilan qurilgan.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: In many large cities, private cars are the main cause of traffic congestion and air pollution. Some people believe that the best solution is to make public transport free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
text: Traffic in large cities has grown heavy enough to damage the air people breathe and to lengthen every journey they make, and the same proposal returns whenever the problem is discussed: remove the fare from buses and trains altogether. I agree that free travel would move some drivers out of their cars, but I do not believe it can reduce congestion on its own.

The strongest argument for removing fares is that price is the first thing many families compare. A family that already owns a car treats petrol as the only extra cost of driving, so four bus tickets can look like the more expensive choice even when they are not. A household setting off for the market on a Saturday morning is a clear case: the petrol has already been paid for, while the tickets are a fresh expense. Removing the ticket price therefore attacks the very calculation that keeps such families in their vehicles.

Free travel alone, however, cannot repair a network that is slow or unreliable. Commuters choose a route by total journey time rather than by price, and a bus trapped in the same queue of cars saves them nothing, so for them the fare was never the real barrier. A service that runs only every forty minutes will stay empty however little it costs, because the waiting time is the true fare for anyone who is late for work. Unless cities also build separate bus lanes and increase the frequency of services, they are simply giving away seats on a network that people were already avoiding.

In my view, fares should be reduced or removed only as one part of a wider plan. Money spent on free tickets is wasted if it is not matched by investment in speed and reliability, since these are what actually persuade a driver to leave the car at home.

traffic has grown heavy / the same queue of cars
remove the fare from buses and trains / free travel / removing the ticket price
only one part of a wider plan (muallif pozitsiyasi bilan o'zgartirilgan)

Ikkinchi vazifa: aralashgan yetti gapdan to'g'ri tartibdagi xatboshini yig'asiz va ortiqchasini chiqarib, nega ortiqcha ekanini bir jumlada yozasiz, 10 daqiqa.
Uchinchi vazifa: beshta topic sentence'ga beshta aniq misol o'ylab topasiz — raqam yoki tadqiqot emas, aniq odam va aniq holat bo'lsin, 15 daqiqa.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; men har xatboshini to'rt harakatga ajratib, qaysi harakat yetishmayotganini chetiga yozib beraman.

homework.title: Ikkita to'liq xatboshi yozing
homework.instr: Quyidagi ikki topic sentence'ni oling va har biriga to'liq xatboshi yozing. Birinchisi: Free school buses would remove most of the morning traffic around city schools. Ikkinchisi: Raising parking prices in the centre is fairer than banning cars altogether. Har xatboshida 4-5 gap va to'rttala harakat bo'lsin.
homework.answers: Tekshirish mezoni: birinchi gap da'vomi? Tushuntirish kamida ikki qadammi? Misolda aniq odam yoki joy bormi? Oxirgi gap fikrga qaytadimi? Namuna tuzilish — 5-mashqdagi tungi avtobus xatboshisi va namuna essayning 2-xatboshisi.

homework.title: Aralashgan xatboshini tartiblang
homework.instr: Gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda ko'chiring, ortiqchasini chiqarib tashlang va nega ortiqcha ekanini bir jumlada yozing. A) Drivers who pay nothing for a parking space treat the centre as free storage. B) Free parking in the city centre is the hidden subsidy that keeps traffic high. C) A shop owner who arrives at eight and leaves at seven occupies one space for eleven hours without paying anything. D) Public transport in most cities has improved over the last ten years. E) That space could otherwise serve twenty short visits by customers who actually spend money. F) Charging for parking therefore does not punish drivers; it simply asks them to pay for land they are already using. G) Land in the centre is the most expensive land a city owns, yet it is given away by the hour.
homework.answers: To'g'ri tartib: B (fikr) - G (tushuntirish, birinchi qadam) - A (tushuntirish, ikkinchi qadam) - C (misol) - E (misolning natijasi) - F (bog'lash). Ortiqcha gap: D — jamoat transportining yaxshilanishi boshqa g'oya, bu xatboshi esa bepul parkovka haqida.

homework.title: Misol banki
homework.instr: Quyidagi beshta topic sentence'ga beshta ANIQ misol yozing; har misolda aniq odam yoki oila, aniq joy va aniq harakat bo'lsin. Raqam yoki tadqiqot o'ylab topmang. 1) Covered, well-lit bus stops attract passengers as effectively as new buses do. 2) Delivery vans block narrow city streets more often than private cars do. 3) A city that charges for parking should spend the money on its buses, not on new roads. 4) Free travel helps students more than any other group. 5) Shops on a street closed to cars usually take more money, not less.
homework.answers: Yaxshi misolning uchta belgisi bor: aniq odam (a nurse, a parent, a first-year student), aniq joy yoki vaqt (at one in the morning, two kilometres from the school gate), aniq harakat (leaves the car at home, lets the child cycle). Namuna: A first-year student who travels in from a village four days a week spends a large part of her monthly allowance on transport. Misolda "many people" yoki "some studies show" bo'lsa — qayta yoziladi.

normativ: To'rttala harakat bor, har birida 4-5 gap
Tartib to'g'ri, ortiqcha gap sababi bilan chiqarilgan
Besh misol, har birida aniq odam va aniq holat

kahoot.q: What are the four moves of a body paragraph, in the right order?
kahoot.explain: Avval fikr (da'vo), keyin nega (tushuntirish), keyin aniq holat (misol), oxirida savolga ulash (bog'lash).

kahoot.q: Which sentence is a real topic sentence (a claim someone could disagree with)?
options: Night buses reduce the need to own a car.
Transport is an important modern topic.
Should cities run more buses at night?
In this paragraph I will discuss buses.
kahoot.explain: Faqat "Night buses reduce the need to own a car" da'vo; qolganlari mavzu e'loni, savol va reja e'loni — ularga rozi bo'lish yoki bo'lmaslik mumkin emas.

kahoot.q: Which topic sentence is too general to develop in one paragraph?
options: Cities are good places for everybody.
Bus lanes make buses faster at rush hour.
Parking fees push short trips onto buses.
Night trams help people who work late.
kahoot.explain: "Good places for everybody" o'lchanmaydi va bitta xatboshida ochib bo'lmaydi; qolgan uchtasida bitta aniq g'oya bor.

kahoot.q: A paragraph about night buses suddenly mentions bicycle theft. What should you do?
options: Cut it or give it its own paragraph
Keep it to show a wider range of ideas
Make it the new topic sentence
Add a statistic to support it
kahoot.explain: Bitta xatboshi — bitta fikr: ikkinchi g'oya yangi xatboshiga ketadi yoki tashlanadi.

kahoot.q: Which words usually signal the EXPLANATION move?
kahoot.explain: because / since / so sabab zanjirini ochadi — tushuntirish belgisi.

kahoot.q: Paragraph idea: parks make city life healthier. Which is the best EXAMPLE?
options: A clerk who jogs in the park at lunch feels less tired.
Many people in big cities like parks and green places.
Studies prove that 90% of city people love their parks.
Parks are a very good thing for everybody in the city.
kahoot.explain: Yaxshi misolda aniq odam, aniq vaqt va aniq harakat bor; o'ylab topilgan foiz va umumiy gap misol emas.

kahoot.q: An explanation with 'two steps' means ...
options: a reason, then what that reason leads to
two separate examples from different countries
two topic sentences in the same paragraph
one reason written twice in other words
kahoot.explain: Zanjir: X, chunki Y; Y esa Z ga olib keladi — sabab va sababning natijasi.

kahoot.q: Paragraph idea: street lights make parks safer at night. Which is the best LINK sentence?
options: Lighting therefore keeps parks usable after dark.
Also, parks need more benches and rubbish bins.
For example, my aunt walks her dog there at six.
Should every park in the city have lights, then?
kahoot.explain: Bog'lash gapi fikrga qaytadi (therefore) va yangi g'oya qo'shmaydi; qolganlari yangi fikr, misol yoki savol.

kahoot.q: Which phrase is a typical start for the LINK sentence at the end of a paragraph?
kahoot.explain: In this way / therefore / which is why — fikrni savolga ulaydi; For instance misol boshlaydi.

kahoot.q: Where should the topic sentence usually go in an IELTS body paragraph?
kahoot.explain: Tekshiruvchi tez o'qiydi: xatboshining fikri birinchi gapda turishi kerak.

kahoot.q: A paragraph argues that school gardens teach healthy eating. Which sentence does NOT belong?
options: Many pupils now play computer games at home.
Pupils who grow carrots are keen to eat them.
The garden makes eating vegetables a daily habit.
It therefore shapes what children choose to eat.
kahoot.explain: Kompyuter o'yinlari boshqa g'oya; qolgan uchtasi misol, tushuntirish va bog'lash vazifasini bajaradi.

kahoot.q: Should you invent statistics for your examples?
options: No, a specific person and case is enough
Yes, but only round numbers like 50%
No, examples are not needed at all
kahoot.explain: O'ylab topilgan raqam ishonchni buzadi; aniq odam va aniq holat yetarli.

kahoot.q: A bus 'fare' is ...
kahoot.explain: fare — yo'l haqi, chipta narxi.

kahoot.q: A 'commuter' is someone who ...
kahoot.explain: commuter — har kuni ishga yoki o'qishga qatnovchi odam.

kahoot.q: 'Traffic congestion' is closest in meaning to ...
options: a ban on all private cars
a fine for driving too fast
kahoot.explain: congestion — tirbandlik: yo'l mashinalarga to'lib, harakat sekinlashadi.

kahoot.q: If a bus route has a high 'frequency', the buses ...
kahoot.explain: frequency — qanchalik tez-tez qatnashi (qatnov zichligi).

kahoot.q: Complete: 'For many students, the price of a monthly pass is the main ___ to using the metro.'
kahoot.explain: the main barrier to (doing) something — biror ishga asosiy to'siq.

kahoot.q: Building a wider road only 'postpones' traffic jams. This means it ...
options: moves them to a later time
makes them much worse at once
kahoot.explain: postpone — keyinga surmoq: muammo yo'qolmaydi, faqat kechroq qaytadi.

kahoot.q: A 'subsidy' for public transport is ...
options: money the state pays to keep fares low
a law that bans cars from the centre
a fine for parking in a bus lane
kahoot.explain: subsidy — davlat to'laydigan yordam puli; shu tufayli chipta arzon bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: A 'reliable' bus service is one that ...
kahoot.explain: reliable — ishonchli: jadvalda aytilgan vaqtda keladi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Quick Conclusions — uch daqiqada ikki gapli xulosa
lessons.grammar_topic: Xulosa xatboshisi — ikki gap, uch daqiqa: pozitsiyani yangi so'z bilan takrorlash va yopish
lessons.vocab_topic: Jamlanma va takror farqi; xulosaga yangi fikr kirmaydi; vaqt tugayotgandagi favqulodda xulosa
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — savollar, namuna essay, barcha xulosa variantlari va mashq bandlari shu dars uchun Jony Academy tomonidan yangidan yozilgan; mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) dan. Mavzu oilasi: ISH VA BANDLIK (to'rt kunlik ish haftasi, avtomatlashtirish, uydan ishlash, nafaqa yoshi).
objectives: Xulosani IKKI gapda va UCH daqiqada yozishni odatga aylantirish.
1-gap: pozitsiyani YANGI so'z bilan takrorlash va ikki body fikrini bitta gapga jamlash.
2-gap: yopuvchi gap — natija, shart yoki tavsiya; yangi fikr emas.
Jamlanma (summary) bilan takrorni (repetition) farqlash: kirishni ko'chirish nega ball qo'shmaydi.
Xulosaga yangi fikr kiritish, pozitsiyani yumshatish va "It depends" bilan tugatish — uchala xatoni tanib olish.
Vaqt tugayotganda bir gapli favqulodda xulosa yozib, essayni tugallangan holda topshirish.
materials: 4-mashq varaqasi "To'rt reja va to'rt xulosa" — har juftlikka 1 nusxa (12 kishilik guruhga 6 nusxa); to'rt reja chap ustunda, to'rtta xulosa (1-4) o'ng ustunda aralash tartibda bosilgan.
Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi reading bloki) — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa; oxirgi xatboshisi ramka bilan ajratilgan, yoniga bo'sh ustun: "qaysi gap nima qilyapti".
Doskaga darsdan OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: "1-gap = pozitsiya + ikki sabab, 2-gap = yopuvchi gap, jami 3 daqiqa, 35-50 so'z" va yonida "XULOSAGA KIRMAYDI: yangi fikr / kirishning nusxasi / It depends".
2-mashq uchun A4 da bosilgan "Oltita zaif xulosa" varaqasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa, yonida "nimasi noto'g'ri" ustuni bo'sh.
5-mashq uchun taymer (telefon sekundomeri yoki devor soati) va uchta savol kartochkasi — matni 5-mashqda, har juftlikka uchtadan qirqib beriladi.
timeline: 40 va 41-darslar eslatiladi; doskadagi shart o'qiladi: 2 gap, 3 daqiqa, 35-50 so'z
Xulosa nima qiladi va nima qilmaydi
Uch taqiq doskaga yoziladi; tugallanmagan essay jarimasi tushuntiriladi
1-mashq birga bajariladi, har qism doskada belgilanadi
2-mashq: varaqadagi oltita xulosa, har biriga tashxis va mezon
3-mashq: kirish gapi va xulosa varianti yonma-yon yoziladi
Reading bloki: oxirgi xatboshi qismlarga ajratiladi, so'ng ataylab buziladi
Varaqa bilan juftlikda; har tanlovga sabab aytiladi
3 daqiqa, 2 daqiqa 30 soniya, 2 daqiqa; har raunddan keyin juftlik tekshiradi
Bir gapli xulosa doskada yoziladi; vazifa aytiladi

intro: Xulosa uchun alohida ball yo'q, lekin xulosasiz essay tugallanmagan hisoblanadi va Task Response darhol tushadi. Tekshiruvchi oxirgi xatboshini o'qib, "bu odam nima demoqchi edi" degan savolga javob topishi kerak.

40 daqiqa shunday taqsimlanadi: 5 reja, 4 kirish, 22 ikkita body, 3 xulosa, 6 tekshirish. Xulosaga 3 daqiqadan ortiq vaqt ketsa, tekshirish vaqti yo'qoladi — bu esa GRA dagi oddiy xatolarni tuzatilmagan qoldiradi.
Xulosa faqat IKKI gap. 1-gap: pozitsiyani YANGI so'z bilan takrorlash va ikki body xatboshining javobini bitta gapga jamlash. 2-gap: yopuvchi gap — natija, shart yoki tavsiya.

JAMLANMA va TAKROR farqi shu: takror — kirishdagi gapni qayta yozish (bir xil so'z, bir xil tuzilish); jamlanma — ikki body xatboshida ISBOTLANGAN narsani bir gapda siqib aytish. Kirishda "I believe X" deyilgan bo'lsa, xulosada X o'sha holicha emas, isbotdan keyingi ko'rinishida turadi: "X, provided that Y".

Xulosaga YANGI FIKR kirmaydi. Yangi fikr aytilsa, tekshiruvchi uni ochilmagan fikr deb hisoblaydi va Task Response tushadi: essay yangi mavzu bilan tugab qoladi. Xayolingizga ajoyib fikr kelsa ham — qalamni to'xtating, u fikr bu essayga kech keldi.

Pozitsiya kirishda qanday bo'lsa, xulosada ham SHUNDAY bo'lishi shart. 37-darsdagi A essay aynan shu yerda yiqilgan edi: kirishda pozitsiya umuman yo'q edi ("In this essay I will discuss both views and give my opinion"), xulosada esa "maybe" va "It depends on the situation". Ikkala tomonni birdek yoqlab tugatish — pozitsiya yo'qligining belgisi.
Signpost bitta bo'ladi: In my view / Overall / On balance / To conclude. Uchtasini ketma-ket yozish ("In conclusion, to sum up, finally") — CC bo'yicha mexanik bog'lanish belgisi.

Vaqt tugayotgan bo'lsa (2 daqiqadan kam qoldi): BIR gapli xulosa yozing — "Overall, + pozitsiya + eng kuchli sabab". Bir gapli xulosa xulosasiz essaydan ancha yuqori: birinchisi tugallangan, ikkinchisi tugallanmagan.
Xulosa hajmi — 35-50 so'z. 25 so'zdan kam bo'lsa odatda ikki body jamlanmagan; 70 so'zdan oshsa body qayta aytilyapti degani.
formulas: Yangi fikr / kirish nusxasi / It depends
Vaqt tugadi — qalam qo'yiladi, keyin tekshiriladi
presentation: Xulosaga alohida ball beriladimi?
Yo'q. Lekin xulosasiz essay tugallanmagan sanaladi va Task Response keskin tushadi.
Xulosani kirishdan ko'chirsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Bir xil so'z bilan takrorlash LR ni tushiradi. Ma'no o'sha, so'z boshqa bo'lsin.
Xulosada misol keltirsam-chi?
Kerak emas. Misol body xatboshiniki. Xulosada misol paydo bo'lsa, u ochilmagan yangi fikrga o'xshab qoladi.
Yangi fikr aytsam nima bo'ladi?
TR tushadi: essay ochilmagan fikr bilan tugaydi. Fikr yaxshi bo'lsa ham — bu essayga kech.
Ikkala tomonni birdek yoqlab tugatsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. "Both sides are right" va "It depends" — pozitsiya yo'qligining belgisi, 6.0 chegarasi.
Vaqtim tugadi, nima qilay?
Bir gapli xulosa: "Overall, + pozitsiya + eng kuchli sabab". Yarim daqiqa atrofida yetadi va essay tugallangan bo'ladi.
Ikkinchi body xatboshini tugatolmadim, xulosa yozaymi?
Ha, avval xulosa. Yarim xatboshi va xulosa — xulosasiz essaydan yuqori baholanadi.
Xulosa necha so'z bo'lsin?
35-50 so'z. Kam bo'lsa jamlanma yo'q, ko'p bo'lsa body qaytarilyapti.
notes: Bu dars 40-darsning (kirish) juftligi: o'sha yerdagi "ikki gap, to'rt daqiqa" shartining oxirgi ko'rinishi. 41-darsdagi body xatboshilari bilan qo'shilsa, o'quvchida butun essay skeleti tayyor bo'ladi.

Ishlatilgan mavzu oilasi: ISH VA BANDLIK — to'rt kunlik ish haftasi, mashina o'rnini egallagan ishchini qayta o'qitish, uydan ishlash, nafaqa yoshi, ish soatlarini qonun bilan cheklash, birinchi ish o'rni. 36-darsda jinoyat va jazo, 37-darsda ta'lim, 38-darsda turizm, 39-41-darslarda transport, 43 va 48-darslarda tarixiy binolar va muzeylar, 44-darsda texnologiya va onlayn xizmatlar, 45-46-darslarda sog'liq, 47-darsda shahar transporti va tarixiy markaz mavzusi ishlatilgan — shuning uchun bugun ish va bandlik olindi: Writing blokining namuna essaylarida bu mavzu boshqa uchramaydi.
Ustoz xulosani o'zi yozib bermasin: avval o'quvchi yozadi, keyin doskada tuzatiladi. Eng tez o'rganiladigan joy — o'quvchi o'z xulosasidagi "It depends" ni o'zi topib olgan payt.

2-mashqdagi oltita zaif xulosa ataylab markaz o'quvchilarida eng ko'p uchraydigan variantlar: kirishning nusxasi, yangi fikr, ikki tomonni birdek yoqlash, bo'sh umumiy gap, uzun qayta hikoya, signpost to'plami.
5-mashqda vaqt QISQARADI: 3 -> 2.5 -> 2 daqiqa. Maqsad chiroyli gap emas, ODAT. Birinchi raundda ulgurmaslik normal holat.
Dars oxirida doskada bitta gap qolsin: "Xulosa yangi narsa aytmaydi — u aytilganni yopadi". Uyga vazifa shu gap bilan beriladi.
mistakes: "In conclusion, to sum up, finally" — mexanik

how: CORE — namuna essay va xulosa mashqlaridan olingan 15 ta so'z (ish va bandlik). Namuna essaydan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing; uyga vazifadagi uchta xulosada kamida 3 tasini ishlating.
core: Shorter meetings often improve productivity in an office.
Qisqaroq yig'ilishlar ko'pincha ofisdagi mahsuldorlikni oshiradi.
The factory's output fell when one shift was cancelled.
Bitta smena bekor qilinganda zavodning mahsulot hajmi kamaydi.
Some firms compress forty hours of work into four days.
Ba'zi firmalar qirq soatlik ishni to'rt kunga jamlaydi.
When the deadline is far away, people tend to stretch out simple tasks.
Muddat uzoq bo'lsa, odamlar oddiy ishlarni cho'zib yuborishga moyil bo'ladi.
The hospital needs to recruit twenty new nurses this year.
Kasalxona bu yil yigirmata yangi hamshirani ishga olishi kerak.
She resigned because her working hours were far too long.
U ish soatlari haddan tashqari uzun bo'lgani uchun ishdan bo'shadi.
Hiring extra drivers would sharply increase the company's wage bill.
Qo'shimcha haydovchilarni ishga olish kompaniyaning ish haqi xarajatini keskin oshiradi.
kam foyda (sotuvdan qoladigan foyda ulushi kichik)
Small shops work on narrow margins, so every extra cost hurts them.
Kichik do'konlar kam foyda bilan ishlaydi, shuning uchun har bir qo'shimcha xarajat ularga zarar qiladi.
After a year of temporary work, he was finally offered a permanent contract.
Bir yillik vaqtinchalik ishdan keyin unga nihoyat doimiy shartnoma taklif qilindi.
Nurses on the night shift start work at eight in the evening.
Tungi smenadagi hamshiralar ishni kechki soat sakkizda boshlaydi.
The bank retrained its cashiers to work in customer support.
Bank kassirlarini mijozlarga yordam bo'limida ishlash uchun qayta o'qitdi.
Many countries are slowly raising the retirement age.
Ko'plab mamlakatlar nafaqa yoshini asta-sekin oshirmoqda.
Automation has replaced many jobs on factory assembly lines.
Avtomatlashtirish zavod konveyerlaridagi ko'plab ishchilarning o'rnini egalladi.
A well-trained workforce attracts new investment to a region.
Yaxshi tayyorlangan ishchi kuchi hududga yangi sarmoya jalb qiladi.
A paid internship gives graduates their first real work experience.
Haqli amaliyot bitiruvchilarga birinchi haqiqiy ish tajribasini beradi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Ikki gapli xulosa — shakl
class_ex.instr: Ustoz namuna xulosani gap-gap ochadi, o'quvchilar har qismni daftarga sxema qilib ko'chiradi. SAVOL: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay.
items: 1-gapning boshi: pozitsiya, YANGI so'z bilan
1-gapning davomi: ikki body fikrining jamlanmasi
2-gap: yopuvchi gap (natija, shart yoki tavsiya)
Signpost tanlovi
Hajmi va vaqti
answers: In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, but not everywhere at once ...
... it suits firms whose output depends on thinking, while shift-based sectors would need extra staff.
Introduced in this way, the reform protects services that cannot shrink their hours and still frees a day for most employees.
In my view / Overall / On balance / To conclude
why: Kirishdagi fikr — boshqa so'z bilan va isbotdan keyingi ko'rinishda.
Ikki xatboshi BIR gapga siqiladi, qaytadan tushuntirilmaydi.
Yangi fikr emas — aytilganning natijasi.
Bittasi yetadi; uchtasi ketma-ket — CC belgisi.
Uzun xulosa tekshirish vaqtini yeydi.
class_ex.note: Sxema daftarga shunday yoziladi: 1-gap = POZITSIYA va ikki sabab; 2-gap = YOPUVCHI GAP. Shu ikki qator imtihongacha ishlatiladi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Bu xulosa nimasi bilan yiqiladi?
class_ex.instr: Varaqadagi oltita xulosa bitta savolga yozilgan: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay. Har biriga tashxis qo'ying va mezonni ayting.
items: In conclusion, some people think a four-day week is good and other people think it is bad. Both sides have strong arguments.
In conclusion, companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay because it is a good idea.
To sum up, in conclusion, finally, I want to say that a shorter week is better.
Overall, a shorter week is worth trying. Moreover, the government should also reduce taxes on small businesses and build more childcare centres.
In conclusion, as I said in the introduction, I strongly believe that a four-day week is the best solution for all companies in every country.
To conclude, it depends on the company and on the situation, so it is difficult to say.
answers: Uchta signpost ketma-ket, ustiga bo'sh gap
Kirishning nusxasi va haddan tashqari umumiy da'vo
why: TR — o'z fikri aytilmagan, 6.0 chegarasi.
LR va TR — jamlanma emas, takror.
CC — mexanik bog'lanish.
TR — essay ochilmagan fikr bilan tugadi.
LR va TR — haddan tashqari umumlashtirish ("for all companies in every country"); bu mavzu 45-darsda chuqur o'rganiladi.
TR — 37-darsdagi A essay xatosi.
class_ex.note: Har tashxisdan keyin o'quvchi zaif xulosani BIR gapda tuzatib aytsin. Tuzatish doskaga yozilmaydi — og'zaki va tez.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Jamlanma va takror — yonma-yon
class_ex.instr: Chapda kirishdagi thesis gapi. O'ngga xulosa varianti yozing: ma'no o'sha, so'z boshqa, ustiga body da isbotlangan shart qo'shilgan.
items: I largely agree that a four-day week would benefit both employees and the firms that employ them.
I believe that employers, not the state, should pay for retraining workers replaced by machines.
While home working suits experienced staff, I believe junior employees need time in an office.
I disagree that raising the retirement age blocks opportunities for younger workers.
In my opinion, governments should set a legal limit on weekly working hours.
answers: In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, provided that it begins in the sectors where output is not measured in hours.
On balance, the cost of retraining belongs with the companies that benefit from automation, since the alternative is a bill paid by everyone else.
Overall, remote work is the better arrangement for most established employees, but new staff still learn fastest beside colleagues they can watch.
To conclude, older employees leaving later does not close the door on younger ones, because experienced staff and new graduates rarely compete for the same posts.
In my view, a legal ceiling on working hours remains necessary, as firms under commercial pressure rarely impose such limits on themselves.
why: Bir xil pozitsiya, boshqa so'z, ustiga shart.
"Employers" -> "the companies that benefit from automation".
Ikki tomon saqlandi, pozitsiya aniq qoldi.
Inkor pozitsiya sababi bilan yopildi.
"Set a legal limit" -> "a legal ceiling ... remains necessary".
class_ex.note: Qoida: xulosa kirishdan UZUNROQ emas, ANIQROQ bo'ladi — unda body da isbotlangan shart yoki chegara ko'rinadi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Rejani o'z xulosasiga moslang
class_ex.instr: Chapda to'rt essay rejasi (savol, pozitsiya, ikki body fikri). O'ngdagi to'rt xulosadan har rejaga mosini toping va NEGA shu ekanini ayting.
items: A REJA. Savol: employers should be required to retrain workers replaced by machines. Pozitsiya: agree. BODY 1 — ishsizlikning narxi butun jamiyatga tushadi. BODY 2 — kadrni tashqaridan izlashdan ko'ra o'zinikini qayta o'qitgan arzon.

B REJA. Savol: the retirement age should be raised. Pozitsiya: agree, but gradually. BODY 1 — tajriba juda erta yo'qotilyapti. BODY 2 — yosh xodimlar boshqa lavozimlarga kiradi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri raqobat yo'q.

C REJA. Savol: do the advantages of working from home outweigh the disadvantages? Pozitsiya: advantages outweigh, but not for new staff. BODY 1 — yo'lda ketadigan vaqt tejaladi, mahsuldorlik oshadi. BODY 2 — yangi xodim yonida o'rganadigan odam bo'lmasa sekin o'sadi.

D REJA. Savol: should governments limit weekly working hours by law? Pozitsiya: agree, cheklov qonun bilan bo'lsin. BODY 1 — uzoq ish haftasi sog'liq va xavfsizlikka zarar. BODY 2 — bozor bosimi ostida kompaniya o'zini o'zi cheklamaydi.
why: Ikkala sabab ham bitta gapda: kompaniya foydasi ("costs less than hiring from outside") va jamiyat narxi ("spares the whole country a heavy bill").
"As long as it is raised step by step" — rejadagi "gradually" sharti boshqa so'z bilan; 2-gap BODY 2 ni yopadi: yosh xodimlar bir xil lavozim uchun raqobatlashmaydi.
Ikkinchi gap aynan "junior staff" chegarasini yopadi.
"Rarely set such limits themselves" — ikkinchi body fikrining siqilgan shakli.
class_ex.note: Tekshirish usuli: xulosani o'qib, rejadagi POZITSIYA va IKKI SABABni topish. Topilmasa — bu xulosa boshqa essayniki. Har juftlik javobini sabab bilan aytadi.
box: 1-xulosa. On balance, the advantages of working from home outweigh the drawbacks for established staff, whose output tends to rise once the daily commute disappears. Younger employees, however, still need regular time beside colleagues they can learn from, and any sensible policy should say so.

2-xulosa. Overall, the firms that replace people with machines should also pay to prepare them for new work, since this costs less than hiring from outside and spares the whole country a heavy bill. Handled this way, automation raises output without leaving a generation behind.

3-xulosa. To conclude, a legal ceiling on weekly hours remains necessary, because companies under commercial pressure rarely set such limits themselves. Without one, the longest week quietly becomes the normal week for everyone in the industry.

4-xulosa. In my view, a later retirement age is reasonable as long as it is raised step by step, since experience is currently lost far too early. Managed in this way, the change keeps skilled staff at work without blocking younger employees, who rarely compete for the same posts.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Taymer bilan uch raund
class_ex.instr: Har raundda savol va pozitsiya beriladi, o'quvchi FAQAT xulosa yozadi. Vaqt tugaganda qalam qo'yiladi. Har raunddan keyin juftlik tekshiruv ro'yxati bo'yicha baholaydi.
items: 1-raund, 3 daqiqa. Savol: Some companies now allow employees to choose their own working hours. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Pozitsiya: advantages outweigh, but core hours are needed.

2-raund, 2 daqiqa 30 soniya. Savol: Some people think that robots will make many jobs disappear and that governments should slow down automation. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Pozitsiya: disagree with slowing it down, agree with protecting workers.

3-raund, 2 daqiqa. Savol: In many countries young people find it difficult to get their first job. What are the causes and what could be done? Pozitsiya: sabab — tajriba va boshlang'ich lavozim yo'q; chora — haqli amaliyot va soliq yengilligi.
Har raunddan keyingi tekshiruv ro'yxati (juftlikda, 1 daqiqa)
answers: On balance, letting staff choose their own hours brings more gains than problems, since people concentrate best at different times of day. A short band of shared hours in the middle of the day is enough to keep teams working together.

In my view, holding back automation would simply move the advantage to countries that do not, so the sensible response is to protect workers rather than machines. Funded retraining, not delay, is what keeps a workforce employable.

Overall, the difficulty young people face comes less from a lack of ability than from a lack of first posts in which ability can be shown. Paid internships and tax relief for firms that create entry-level roles would open that first door.
1) Ikki gapmi? 2) Pozitsiya aniqmi? 3) Yangi fikr yo'qmi? 4) Kirishdan so'zma-so'z ko'chirilmaganmi? 5) 35-50 so'zmi?
why: Pozitsiya va shart, keyin yopuvchi gap.
Yangi fikr yo'q — ikki body jamlangan.
SITUATION turi: sabab ham, chora ham bitta jamlanmada.
Beshtasiga ham "ha" bo'lsa — xulosa tayyor.
class_ex.note: Vaqt qisqaradi: 3 -> 2.5 -> 2 daqiqa. Ulgurmagan o'quvchiga ayting: imtihonda ham aynan shu bosim bo'ladi, shuning uchun mashq shu tezlikda qilinadi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — xulosa qanday ishlaydi
readings.qtype: DISCUSSION va OPINION savoli, to'liq essay
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 7.5 darajasida yozilgan, 271 so'z; xulosasi 2 gap, 50 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that companies should move to a four-day working week without reducing pay. Others argue that this would damage productivity and cost jobs. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: The idea of compressing the working week into four days, with salaries left untouched, has moved from the margins of debate into serious discussion in a number of countries. Although the risks for smaller firms are real, I believe that a shorter week would benefit both employees and the organisations that employ them.

Supporters argue that most office work is limited not by hours but by concentration. Long weeks encourage staff to stretch tasks out, to attend meetings that decide nothing, and to spend the final afternoon clearing an inbox rather than producing anything of value. A firm that removes a day usually finds that the meetings disappear first and that the work which genuinely matters is still finished. Employers also report that rested staff resign less often, which saves the considerable expense of recruiting and training replacements.

The opposing case rests on the industries where output is tied directly to time. A bus cannot be driven, a patient cannot be treated and a production line cannot be run in fewer hours simply because a policy has changed, so hospitals, factories and transport companies would have to hire additional staff to cover the missing day. For a small business with narrow margins that extra wage bill may be impossible, and the likely response is either higher prices or fewer permanent contracts.

In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing, but not everywhere at once: it suits firms whose output depends on thinking, while shift-based sectors would need extra staff. Introduced in this way, the reform protects services that cannot shrink their hours and still frees a day for most employees.
paraphrases: compressing the working week into four days / a shorter week
output is tied directly to time (uchinchi xatboshi)
I believe (kirishda) va In my view (xulosada) — bitta pozitsiya, ikki xil so'z
glossary: stretch a task out — ishni cho'zmoq

tasks.instr: Ikki gap, ikki vazifa. Ustoz jadvalni doskada to'ldiradi, o'quvchilar nusxada belgilaydi.
tasks.note: Diqqat: xulosada birorta ham yangi mavzu yo'q. Hamma narsa yuqorida aytilgan — faqat siqilgan holda.

tasks.title: Shu xulosani ataylab buzing
tasks.instr: Ustoz buzilgan variantni o'qiydi, o'quvchi nima yo'qolganini va qaysi mezon tushishini aytadi.
items: In conclusion, I believe that a four-day working week would benefit both employees and the organisations that employ them.
Overall, a shorter week is worth pursuing. In addition, governments should also introduce free childcare and better public transport so that parents can work.
To conclude, both sides of this argument are strong and it depends on the type of company.
In conclusion, to sum up, finally, a four-day week is a very good idea for the modern world.

In my view, a shorter week is worth pursuing. In the second paragraph I explained that meetings disappear, and in the third paragraph I explained that hospitals and factories cannot do this, because a bus cannot be driven in fewer hours and a patient cannot be treated in fewer hours.
Xulosa umuman yozilmagan, essay uchinchi xatboshida tugagan.
answers: Kirishning so'zma-so'z nusxasi; body da isbotlangan shart yo'qolgan
Uchta signpost va bo'sh umumiy gap
Body qayta hikoya qilindi ("In the second paragraph I explained..."), misollar qaytarildi, yopuvchi gap yo'q
why: LR va TR — jamlanma emas, takror.
TR — ochilmagan fikr bilan tugash.
TR — 37-darsdagi "It depends" xatosi.
CC va LR.

tasks.note: Har buzilgan variantdan keyin asl ikki gap qaytadan o'qiladi. Farq aynan shu qiyoslashda eng aniq ko'rinadi.

tasks.title: Vaqt tugayapti — bir gapli favqulodda xulosa
tasks.instr: Ustoz "2 daqiqa qoldi" deydi, o'quvchi shu essayga BIR gapli xulosa aytadi. Shakl: Overall va pozitsiya va eng kuchli sabab.

1 daqiqa qoldi
Ikkinchi body xatboshisi yarim qoldi, 2 daqiqa bor
Vaqt tugadi, xulosa umuman yozilmadi
answers: Overall, a shorter week is worth pursuing in the sectors where output is not measured in hours.
Overall, a shorter week is worth trying, but not in every industry at once.
Body ni to'xtating va xulosani yozing: Overall, a shorter week is worth pursuing where output does not depend on hours.
Endi hech narsa qilib bo'lmaydi, TR jarimasi qoladi
why: 17 so'z, taxminan yarim daqiqa — essay tugallangan.
14 so'z. Pozitsiya bor — shu yetadi.
Yarim xatboshi va xulosa — to'liq xatboshi va xulosasiz essaydan yuqori.
Shuning uchun xulosa hech qachon oxirgi daqiqaga qoldirilmaydi.
tasks.note: Qoida doskaga yoziladi: "Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — xulosaniki. Body tugamasa ham xulosa yoziladi."

homework_intro: Bugun biz xulosani ikki gapda va uch daqiqada yozdik — uyda xuddi shu ishni taymer bilan yana uch marta qilasiz.

Birinchi vazifa: darsda bo'lmagan uchta yangi savolga uchta xulosa (avval pozitsiya va ikki sababni bir qatorda yozasiz); har biriga qat'iy 3 daqiqa, telefonda taymer qo'ying va sarflangan vaqtni xulosa yoniga yozib qo'ying.

Ikkinchi vazifa: mock imtihondagi Writing Task 2 essayingizning (u bo'lmasa — 37-darsda ball qo'ygan essayingizning yoki 2-mashqdagi zaif xulosalardan birining) xulosasini oling va uni bugungi shakl bilan qayta yozing; eski va yangi variantni yonma-yon qo'ying, ostiga "nima o'zgardi" deb bitta jumla yozing.
Uchinchi vazifa qisqa: daftar oxiriga "XULOSAGA KIRMAYDI" ro'yxatini (uchta) va besh savolli tekshiruv ro'yxatini ko'chiring — bular imtihongacha ishlatiladi.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — taymersiz yozib, "men baribir ulguraman" deb o'ylash; vaqtsiz yozilgan xulosa tekshirilmaydi, shuning uchun sarflangan vaqtni albatta yozib qo'ying.

homework.title: Uchta xulosa — taymer bilan
homework.instr: Har savolga IKKI gapli xulosa, qat'iy 3 daqiqa. Taymerni yoqishdan oldin savol yoniga pozitsiyangizni va ikki sababni bir qatorda yozing (bu — essay rejangiz o'rnida). Savollar: 1) Some people think that employers should not contact their staff by email or phone outside working hours. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 2) More and more people now work as freelancers instead of having a full-time job with one employer. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? 3) Some people believe that a high salary is the most important thing in a job, while others think that job satisfaction matters more. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Har xulosa yoniga sarflangan vaqtni yozing.
homework.answers: Namunalar 4 va 5-mashqda hamda namuna essay xulosasida. Ustoz avval VAQTga, keyin ikki gap shartiga, so'ng pozitsiyaning aniqligiga qaraydi; yangi fikr chiqsa darhol belgilanadi.

homework.title: Eski xulosani qayta yozing
homework.instr: Mock imtihonda yozgan Writing Task 2 essayingizning xulosasini oling (JonyOS: Imtihonlar → Mock testlar). U bo'lmasa — 37-darsning uyga vazifasida o'zingiz ball qo'ygan essayning xulosasini; ikkalasi ham bo'lmasa — 2-mashqdagi zaif xulosalardan birini (1-6) oling. Bugungi shakl bilan qayta yozing: 1-gap pozitsiya va ikki sabab, 2-gap yopuvchi gap. Eski va yangi variantni yonma-yon qo'ying, ostiga "nima o'zgardi" deb bitta jumla yozing.
homework.answers: Javob har o'quvchida har xil. Tekshirish mezoni: kirishdan so'zma-so'z ko'chirilmagan, yangi fikr yo'q, pozitsiya kirishdagi bilan bir xil, hajmi 35-50 so'z.

homework.title: Uch taqiq va besh tekshiruv savoli
homework.instr: Daftar oxiriga ko'chiring: "XULOSAGA KIRMAYDI" ro'yxati (yangi fikr / kirishning nusxasi / It depends) va 5-mashqdagi besh savolli tekshiruv ro'yxati. Ostiga bir gapli favqulodda xulosa shaklini yozing.
homework.answers: Taqiqlar — yangi fikr; kirishning so'zma-so'z nusxasi; "It depends" va ikkala tomonni birdek yoqlash. Tekshiruv savollari — 1) Ikki gapmi? 2) Pozitsiya aniqmi? 3) Yangi fikr yo'qmi? 4) Ko'chirilmaganmi? 5) 35-50 so'zmi? Favqulodda shakl — Overall va pozitsiya va eng kuchli sabab.

normativ: Har biri 2 gap, 3 daqiqada, vaqti yozilgan
Eski va yangi yonma-yon, izohi bilan

kahoot.q: In a two-sentence conclusion, what does sentence 1 do?
options: States your view and sums up both reasons
Introduces a new argument for the first time
Copies the thesis from the introduction
Gives a detailed example from real life
kahoot.explain: 1-gap: pozitsiya yangi so'z bilan va ikki body sababining jamlanmasi.

kahoot.q: What does sentence 2 of the conclusion usually give?
options: A brand-new reason for your view
A statistic from a recent study
A question for the reader to think about
kahoot.explain: 2-gap — yopuvchi gap: natija, shart yoki tavsiya; yangi fikr emas.

kahoot.q: In this course's 40-minute plan for Task 2, about how long should the conclusion take?
kahoot.explain: Xulosaga 3 daqiqa; undan keyin 6 daqiqa tekshirishga qoladi.

kahoot.q: Which of these should NOT appear in a conclusion?
kahoot.explain: Yangi fikr ochilmagan bo'lib qoladi va Task Response tushadi.

kahoot.q: Why does copying the introduction word for word lose marks?
options: It is repetition, not a summary
It makes the essay too short
kahoot.explain: Takror — bir xil so'z va tuzilish; jamlanma esa body'da isbotlangan narsani yangi so'z bilan siqadi.

kahoot.q: Which conclusion keeps a clear position?
options: Overall, online shopping helps more than it harms.
To conclude, it really depends on the person and place.
In conclusion, both sides have very good points.
Finally, this question is very hard to answer.
kahoot.explain: Faqat "helps more than it harms" aniq tomon oladi; "it depends", "both sides" va "hard to answer" — pozitsiya yo'qligi belgisi.

kahoot.q: Your introduction said 'I believe X'. In the conclusion, the position should be ...
kahoot.explain: Pozitsiya o'zgarmaydi, faqat boshqa so'z bilan va isbotdan keyingi ko'rinishda aytiladi.

kahoot.q: You have less than two minutes left. What should you do?
options: Stop and hand in the essay
kahoot.explain: Bir gapli xulosa essayni tugallangan qiladi; xulosasiz essay tugallanmagan hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: What is the one-sentence emergency conclusion formula?
options: In conclusion + a new idea + an example
To sum up + a question + a statistic
Firstly + the thesis copied word for word
kahoot.explain: Overall, + pozitsiya + eng kuchli sabab — bitta gap, yarim daqiqa atrofida yoziladi.

kahoot.q: A conclusion of 80 words most likely means the writer ...
options: has used too few linking words
has forgotten to give a position
kahoot.explain: 70 so'zdan oshgan xulosa odatda body'ni qayta hikoya qiladi.

kahoot.q: What is the recommended length of a Task 2 conclusion in this course?
kahoot.explain: 35-50 so'z: kam bo'lsa jamlanma yo'q, ko'p bo'lsa body qaytarilyapti.

kahoot.q: Intro: 'Children should learn to cook at school.' Which conclusion summarises rather than repeats?
options: Overall, cooking classes are worth the time, as they build healthy habits.
In conclusion, I strongly believe that children should learn to cook at school.
To sum up, children should learn cooking at school, as I said before.
Finally, I think that children really should learn to cook at school.
kahoot.explain: "Cooking classes are worth the time, as they build healthy habits" pozitsiyani yangi so'z bilan aytib, sababni ham jamlaydi; qolgan uchtasi kirishning takrori.

kahoot.q: To 'compress' the working week means to ...
options: fit the same work into fewer days
add one extra working day every week
move the work to another country
kahoot.explain: compress — siqmoq: o'sha ishni kamroq kunga jamlash.

kahoot.q: Staff who 'resign' ...
kahoot.explain: resign — o'z xohishi bilan ishdan bo'shamoq.

kahoot.q: A company that 'recruits' more staff ...
kahoot.explain: recruit — yangi xodimni ishga olmoq.

kahoot.q: 'Productivity' is closest in meaning to ...
kahoot.explain: productivity — ma'lum vaqtda qancha ish bajarilishi (mahsuldorlik).

kahoot.q: A small business with 'narrow margins' ...
options: makes only a small profit on sales
has very small offices in the city
sells its goods in only one street
kahoot.explain: narrow margins — sotuvdan qoladigan foyda juda kam.

kahoot.q: A 'permanent contract' is a job agreement that ...
options: can be ended on any day
kahoot.explain: permanent contract — muddatsiz, doimiy mehnat shartnomasi.

kahoot.q: To 'retrain' workers means to ...
options: teach them skills for a new job
pay them to stay at home instead
move them to a new office building
make them work longer hours each day
kahoot.explain: retrain — yangi ish uchun qayta o'qitmoq.

kahoot.q: A firm's 'wage bill' is ...
options: the total it pays its staff
a tax on all of the firm's profits
kahoot.explain: wage bill — xodimlarga to'lanadigan jami ish haqi xarajati.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Cohesive Devices and Referencing — bog'lovchilar va orqaga ishora
lessons.grammar_topic: Coherence & Cohesion mezonini ko'tarish: kerakli bog'lovchilar, ularning o'rni, this/these/such/the former/the latter va substitution
lessons.vocab_topic: Mexanik bog'lanishdan tabiiy bog'lanishga: 6.0 dan 7.0 ga
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — namuna essay, xatboshilar va barcha mashq gaplari Jony Academy tomonidan shu dars uchun yozilgan; mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) dan.
objectives: Essayda haqiqatan kerak bo'ladigan bog'lovchilarning QISQA ro'yxatini bilish: qo'shish, qarama-qarshilik, sabab-natija, misol, xulosa — har guruhga 3-4 tadan.
"Firstly / Moreover / Moreover" zanjiri nega Band 6 belgisi ekanini tushunish va shu zanjirni buzishni mashq qilish.
Bog'lovchini faqat gap boshiga emas, kerak bo'lganda GAP ICHIGA ham qo'yishni o'rganish — 7-band tavsifidagi "flexibly" (egiluvchan) belgilaridan biri; gap boshidagi "However," xato emas.
this, these, such, the former, the latter va olmoshlar bilan o'quvchini adashtirmasdan orqaga ishora qilish.
Yalang'och "this" ni "this + OT" ga aylantirish — 6.0 dan 7.0 ga o'tishdagi eng arzon tuzatish.
Bitta otni qayta-qayta takrorlamaslik: one/ones, do so, such, umumiy ot bilan almashtirish (substitution).
materials: 2-mashq uchun "Haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi" varaqasi: 7 gapli asl matn chap ustunda, o'ng ustun bo'sh — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa (12 kishilik guruhga 12 nusxa).
Namuna essay nusxasi ([reading] bloki): har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa, xatboshilari raqamlangan (1-4), chetida qalam uchun bo'sh maydon.
5-mashq uchun kesiladigan kartochkalar: 12 ta kartochka (6 juft — takrorli gap / almashtirilgan variant), har 2 kishiga bitta to'plam; darsdan OLDIN qaychilab qo'yiladi.
Doskaga darsdan oldin besh ustun chiziladi va sarlavhalari yoziladi: QO'SHISH — QARAMA-QARSHILIK — SABAB-NATIJA — MISOL — XULOSA. Ustunlar bo'sh qoldiriladi, 1-mashqda o'quvchilar to'ldiradi.
Doskaning chap burchagiga katta qilib yoziladi va dars oxirigacha o'chirilmaydi: "this + OT". 4-mashq va uyga vazifa shunga tayanadi.
Ikki rangli marker: namuna essayda bog'lovchilar bir rang bilan, ishoralar (this / such / the latter / it) boshqa rang bilan belgilanadi.
timeline: 37-darsdagi CC kamchiligi eslatiladi; bugun faqat shu mezon ustida ishlanadi
Besh munosabat guruhi tushuntiriladi: qo'shish, qarshilik, sabab-natija, misol, xulosa
Ustoz munosabatni aytadi, o'quvchi iborani tanlab doskadagi ustunga yozadi
Varaqa tarqatiladi, har gap tuzatiladi, keyin xatboshi qisqartiriladi
Referencing: this / these / such / former / latter
Har javobda ustoz oldingi gapga chiziq tortadi
Namuna essay: bog'lovchi va ishoralarni belgilash
Ikki rangli marker bilan (340 so'z), keyin ikki task bajariladi: 8 ta bog'lovchi va 9 ta ishora bandi

intro: 37-darsdagi A essayning (umumiy Band 5.5, CC 6) CC mezonidagi asosiy kamchiligi "bog'lovchilar mexanik" edi. Bugun aynan shuni tuzatamiz. Qoida oddiy: bog'lovchi KO'P bo'lgani uchun emas, KERAKLI joyda turgani uchun ball beradi.

Tekshiruvchi bog'lovchini sanamaydi. U gaplar orasidagi MUNOSABAT to'g'ri ko'rsatilganmi, shunga qaraydi. Aslida sabab bo'lgan joyga "Moreover" qo'yilsa — bu xato, garchi bog'lovchi "chiroyli" bo'lsa ham.

Kerakli bog'lovchilar soni kam: qo'shish (in addition, also, furthermore), qarama-qarshilik (however, by contrast, although, while, whereas), sabab-natija (because, since, as a result, consequently, which means that), misol (for example, for instance, such as, in particular), xulosa (overall, on balance, in my view). Shu yigirmatacha ibora butun essayga yetadi.

Band 6 ning eng aniq belgisi — har gap yoki har xatboshining bir xil so'z bilan boshlanishi: Firstly ... Moreover ... Moreover ... Also. Jadvalda bu "mechanical" deb ataladi va CC ni 6.0 da ushlab turadi.

7-band tavsifida bog'lovchilar, ishora va substitution "flexibly" — egiluvchan, turli yo'l bilan ishlatilishi aytiladi. Uning belgilaridan biri: bog'lovchi gap boshida ham, gap ICHIDA ham tura oladi. "However, museums are expensive" ham to'g'ri; "Museums, however, are expensive" — xuddi shu ma'no, lekin matnga turlilik qo'shadi. Gap boshidagi "However," xato emas — muammo HAMMA bog'lovchi gap boshida turib, bir xil qolipda takrorlanganda paydo bo'ladi.
Bog'lovchi — bog'lanishning faqat YARMI. Ikkinchi yarmi REFERENCING: o'quvchini oldingi gapga qaytaradigan so'zlar (this, these, such, the former, the latter, it, they, its, the two positions).

Eng ko'p uchraydigan referencing xatosi — yalang'och "this": "This is a problem" degan gapda nima problem ekani noaniq. Tuzatish bitta so'z: "This policy is a problem". Ot qo'shilishi bilan gap aniqlashadi va LR ham ko'tariladi.
the former / the latter FAQAT ikkita narsa sanalganda ishlatiladi, tartibi qat'iy: former — birinchisi, latter — ikkinchisi. Uchta narsa sanalgan bo'lsa ishlatilmaydi.
Substitution — otni takrorlamay turib unga qaytish: "a new building ... a cheaper one", "such schemes", "these measures", "do so". Bu bir vaqtning o'zida CC ni ham, LR ni ham ko'taradi.
Ogohlantirish: ishora ANIQ bo'lishi shart. Oldingi gapda ikkita ko'plik ot bo'lsa, "they" o'quvchini adashtiradi — bunday joyda otni takrorlagan yaxshiroq. Aniqlik chiroylilikdan ustun.
formulas: Avval ovoz chiqarib o'qing — kulgili eshitiladi
Har gapga: kerakmi, ko'chirilsinmi, olib tashlansinmi
This decision, this shift, these taxes
one / do so / such / umumiy ot
presentation: Nechta bog'lovchi ishlatsam bo'ladi?
Har xatboshiga 1-2 ta yetarli. 250-300 so'zli essayda jami 6-8 ta — normal. 15 ta bo'lsa, odatda ortiqcha (overuse) va mexanik ko'rinadi — tekshiruvchi sanamaydi, lekin buni sezadi.
"Firstly, Secondly, Finally" ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin faqat HAQIQIY ro'yxat bo'lganda va bitta essayda bir marta. Har xatboshini "Firstly" bilan boshlash — xato.
"Moreover" umuman yomonmi?
Yo'q. Bitta essayda bir marta — normal. Ikki marta, ayniqsa ketma-ket — Band 6 ning eng tanilgan belgisi.
Bog'lovchini gap ichiga qo'ysam, vergul kerakmi?
Ha, ikki tomondan: "Museums, however, are expensive". "therefore" esa ega va fe'l orasida vergulsiz ham yuradi: "The council therefore postponed it".
"This" dan keyin har doim ot kerakmi?
Har doim emas, lekin ko'pchilik holatda kerak. Qaysi otni qo'yishni topa olmasangiz — demak gapingiz ham hali noaniq.
the former / the latter ni uchta narsaga ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q, faqat ikkitada. Uchta bo'lsa otni takrorlang yoki "the first of these" deng.
Bir xil otni takrorlash har doim xatomi?
Yo'q. Aniqlik birinchi o'rinda. Almashtirganda ma'no chalkashsa, otni takrorlang — bu LR ni tushirmaydi.
"In conclusion" yozsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin "Overall" yoki "On balance" kuchliroq eshitiladi. Muhimi — undan keyin yangi fikr emas, xulosa kelsin.
Bog'lovchilarni umuman ishlatmasam-chi?
Unda matn uzuq-yuluq bo'ladi va CC yana tushadi. Maqsad — kam, lekin aniq.
notes: Bu dars 36- va 37-darslarga tayanadi: 36 da mezonlar tushuntirilgan, 37 da A (Band 5.5) va B (Band 7.5) essaylar solishtirilgan. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang — "bugun faqat CC ni ko'taramiz" deb boshlang.

MAVZU OILASI: namuna essay va sinf mashqlari — TARIXIY BINOLAR, MUZEYLAR VA SHAHAR BYUDJETI; uyga vazifa — OMMAVIY KUTUBXONALAR. Diqqat: meros va muzey mavzusi blokda yana uchraydi — 38 (sayyohlik va meros), 47 (tarixiy markazlar) va 48 (muzeylarga kirish) darslarida, shuning uchun bu darsda e'tibor mavzuga emas, bog'lanish vositalariga qaratiladi — such projects, the former / the latter, "this + OT" har qanday mavzuda xuddi shunday ishlaydi. Blokdagi boshqa mavzular: 36 — jinoyat va jazo, 37 — ta'lim, 39–41 — shahar transporti, 42 — ish, 44 — texnologiya va onlayn xizmatlar, 45–46 — sog'liq.

Eng katta xavf — o'quvchi darsdan "bog'lovchi yomon ekan" degan xulosa bilan chiqishi. Yo'q: bog'lovchi kerak, lekin kam va o'z joyida. 2-mashqning tuzatilgan variantida ham bog'lovchi bor — buni alohida ta'kidlang.
Doskadagi "this + OT" qatori butun dars davomida o'chirilmasin: 4-mashq, namuna essay tahlili va uyga vazifa — uchalasi ham shunga tayanadi.
5-mashq kartochkalari darsdan oldin qaychilanadi. Vaqt kam bo'lsa kartochkasiz og'zaki ham bo'ladi, lekin albatta juftlikda bajarilsin.
Namuna essayda ataylab Samarqand va Buxoro misol qilingan: o'quvchi o'z shahri haqida yozganda ham xuddi shu qurilmalar ishlashini ko'rsating.

Kuchli guruh uchun qo'shimcha: o'quvchilar namuna essaydagi HAMMA bog'lovchini o'chirib tashlasin va matn qanchalik tushunarli qolganini tekshirsin. Ko'p qismi tushunarli qoladi — chunki asosiy bog'lanish ishoralar orqali qilingan. Bu darsning asosiy xulosasi.
Agar guruh zaif bo'lsa, 5-mashqni qisqartiring va 2-mashqqa 5 daqiqa qo'shing: haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi — eng ko'p foyda beradigan mashq.

Namuna essayning 4-xatboshisi — O'Z FIKRI xatboshisi (Discuss both views): unda murosa sharti asoslanadi, shuning uchun "such conversions cost less..." kabi dalil shu yerda turishi mumkin. XULOSA vazifasini faqat oxirgi gap ("Heritage money, in other words, ...") bajaradi va u yangi fikr qo'shmaydi. O'quvchilarga ayting: alohida xulosa xatboshisi yozsangiz, unda yangi dalil keltirmang.

readings.title: Namuna essay: Tarixiy binolar va shahar byudjeti
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 8 darajasi, 340 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: In many cities, historic buildings are being restored and converted into museums and cultural centres at considerable public expense. Some people argue that this money should be spent instead on services that residents use every day. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Across the region, disused factories, railway stations and merchants' houses are being restored and reopened as museums, galleries and cultural centres. Because such projects absorb a large share of municipal budgets, many residents ask whether the same money would do more good in schools, clinics and public transport. Both the case for restoration and the residents' objection are reasonable, although in my view public money for heritage can be justified whenever the restored building is given real work to do.

The case for conversion rests on a simple asymmetry between old buildings and new ones: the former cannot be replaced once they are gone, whereas the latter can be built on almost any empty plot. A nineteenth-century station, flattened for a car park, is lost permanently; a sports hall is not. Restored buildings also tend to recover part of their own cost, since visitors who arrive for an exhibition go on to eat, shop and stay overnight nearby. Samarkand and Bukhara owe much of their tourist income to precisely this kind of investment, and the jobs it creates are local and difficult to move abroad.

Those who object, however, are not arguing against history. Their point is one of timing: a family waiting eighteen months for a clinic appointment is unlikely to feel served by a new gallery, however elegant. Municipal budgets are fixed, and every som spent on stonework is a som not spent on nurses. This objection deserves an answer rather than a dismissal, because the districts asked to wait are usually the poorest ones.

The two positions are easier to reconcile than they appear. Where a restored building is given a working function, such as a library, a clinic or a training centre inside the old walls, the city keeps its architecture and gains a service at the same time, and such conversions cost less than the two separate projects they replace. Heritage money, in other words, should be judged not by the beauty of the result but by what the building is asked to do afterwards.
