Zanjir ikki bo'g'inli: this kind of investment -> it. "the jobs" esa ishora emas, YANGI ma'lumot (investitsiya yaratadigan ish o'rinlari) — "it" uni oldingi gapga bog'laydi.
Egalik olmoshi ham bog'lash vositasi bo'la oladi.
Bir xatboshi bitta otga yig'ildi — eng kuchli usul.
Son + umumiy ot — eng aniq orqaga ishora turi.
"such" yana ro'yxatni yig'di, takrorga yo'l qo'ymadi.
Takror ham vosita bo'la oladi: bu yerda u qarama-qarshilikni kuchaytiryapti.
tasks.note: Sanang: jadvalda 8 ta bog'lovchi, bu yerda esa 8 ta orqaga ishora va ustiga bitta ataylab qilingan takror bor. Ya'ni bog'lanishning kamida yarmi bog'lovchi bilan emas, ISHORA bilan qilingan. Band 6 essayda esa buning teskarisi bo'ladi. Darsning asosiy xulosasi shu — doskaga yozing.

homework_intro: Bugun ko'rdikki, bog'lanish ikki narsadan iborat: bog'lovchi va orqaga ishora — va kuchli essayda ikkinchisi ko'proq ish bajaradi.

Birinchi vazifa — kutubxonalar haqidagi haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi: yettita gapning har birini tuzatasiz, keyin butun xatboshini 3-4 gapga qisqartirib daftarga ko'chirasiz; bunga 20 daqiqa yetadi.
Ikkinchi vazifada sakkizta juft gap bor: har birida noaniq ishorani ot qo'shib aniqlashtirasiz — "this" dan keyin qaysi otni qo'yishni topa olsangiz, vazifa bajarilgan hisoblanadi.
Uchinchi vazifa o'z essayingiz ustida: 37-darsda baholagan essayingizni oling, har bog'lovchini doira ichiga oling, har ishorani tagiga chizing va daftardagi uchta savolga javob yozing.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — bog'lovchini boshqa bog'lovchiga almashtirib qo'yish; ko'p joyda vazifa ALMASHTIRISH emas, uni butunlay OLIB TASHLASH. Uchala vazifa daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi.

homework.title: 1-vazifa: Haddan ziyod bog'langan xatboshi (kutubxonalar)
homework.instr: Har gapni tuzating: ortiqcha bog'lovchini olib tashlang yoki gap ichiga ko'chiring. Oxirida butun xatboshini 3-4 gapga qisqartirib ko'chiring.
items: Firstly, public libraries are very important in the modern world.
Moreover, they give free books to poor people.
Moreover, they have internet and computers.
Furthermore, students can study there quietly.
In addition, libraries organise events for children.
Therefore, in my opinion, governments should not close libraries.
Also, this is a big problem in many countries.
answers: Public libraries still matter, even in a city full of screens.
They give free access to books for families who could not otherwise buy them.
They also provide internet access and computers.
Students, in addition, can study there in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers.
Many libraries also run reading clubs and events for children.
For these reasons, governments should keep their public libraries open.
why: "Firstly" hech qanday ro'yxat boshlamayapti; "very important" — bo'sh ibora.
Bog'lovchi kerak emas — gaplar mazmunan o'zi bog'langan.
Ikkinchi "Moreover" — Band 6 belgisi; "also" fe'ldan oldin turadi.
Bog'lovchi gap ICHIGA ko'chdi va fikr ochildi.
To'rtinchi qo'shish belgisi olib tashlandi. "however" kerak emas: bu gap oldingi fikrga qarshi emas, shunchaki QO'SHIMCHA ma'lumot beradi — fe'ldan oldingi "also" yetadi.
"Therefore" va "in my opinion" ketma-ket — ikkita belgi ortiqcha, bittasi yetadi.
Yalang'och "this" + bo'sh gap: hech narsa qo'shmaydi, faqat so'z sarflaydi.
homework.note: Tuzatilgan xatboshining namunasi: Public libraries still matter, even in a city full of screens. They give free access to books for families who could not otherwise buy them and also provide internet access and computers. Students, in addition, can study there in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers. For these reasons, governments should keep their public libraries open. DIQQAT: bu qisqartmada 5-gap (bolalar tadbirlari) tushib qolgan — vazifa 3-4 gap talab qiladi, shuning uchun bu to'g'ri; xohlagan o'quvchi uni "...in a quiet space that a shared flat rarely offers, while younger children can join reading clubs there." deb qo'shishi mumkin. Javoblar — NAMUNA (bittasi): o'quvchi yangi mazmun qo'shishi shart emas. Mezon: (1) xatboshida gap boshida ko'pi bilan bitta bog'lovchi; (2) har bog'lovchi to'g'ri munosabatni ko'rsatadi; (3) ma'no saqlangan; (4) yalang'och "this" qolmagan.

homework.title: 2-vazifa: "this + OT" — ishorani aniqlashtiring
homework.instr: Har juft gapdagi ishorani tekshiring. Noaniq bo'lsa, ot qo'shib tuzating; to'g'ri bo'lsa, "to'g'ri" deb yozing va sababini bitta jumlada ayting.
items: The mayor cancelled the restoration grant. This surprised everyone.
Tourists and residents both use the old square. They complain about the noise.
The city built a museum and a car park. The former is still empty.
Heritage taxes were introduced in three regions. These were unpopular.
The council spent two years on the plan. It was a waste.
Some councils publish their budgets online. Councils that do not publish their budgets online lose public trust.
The library closed in March. This is why the reading club moved to a cafe.
The new hall cost less than the old hall.
answers: The two years spent on the plan were a waste.
Councils that do not do so lose public trust.
To'g'ri: "This is why" — ruxsat berilgan holat
The new hall cost less than the old one.
why: Yalang'och "this" — bekor qilinganimi, grantning o'zimi noaniq edi.
"They" ikkala guruhga ham tegishli bo'lib qolgan.
Ikkita narsa sanalgan, tartib to'g'ri.
"These" — soliqlarmi, viloyatlarmi? Ot qo'shildi.
"It" — reja ham, ikki yil ham bo'lishi mumkin edi.
Substitution: "do so" butun fe'l guruhini oldi.
"this" butun oldingi gapga qaytmoqda.
"one" — takrorlangan otning o'rnini bosdi.
homework.note: Har javobda bitta savolga javob bering: o'quvchi bir o'qishda nimaga qaytayotganini tushunadimi? Javoblar — NAMUNA: boshqa aniq ot bilan tuzatilgan variant ham to'g'ri (masalan 1-gapda "This decision" yoki "This move", 5-gapda "The plan was a waste").

homework.title: 3-vazifa: O'z essayingizni tekshiring
homework.instr: 37-darsda baholagan o'z essayingizni oling. Har bog'lovchini doira ichiga oling, har ishorani (this, these, such, it, they) tagiga chizing, keyin uchta savolga yozma javob bering.
homework.answers: 1) Nechta bog'lovchi gap BOSHIDA turibdi? Yarmidan ko'pi bo'lsa, kamida uchtasini gap ichiga ko'chiring. 2) Bir xil bog'lovchi necha marta takrorlangan? Ikki martadan ko'p bo'lsa, boshqasiga almashtiring yoki olib tashlang. 3) Nechta yalang'och "this" bor? Har biriga ot qo'shing. Tuzatilgan essay keyingi darsga olib kelinadi va ustoz eski variant bilan solishtiradi.

normativ: 7 gap tuzatilgan va qisqartirilgan xatboshi ko'chirilgan
8 juft gap, har birida ot qo'shilgan yoki "to'g'ri" izohlangan
Bog'lovchi va ishoralar belgilangan, 3 savolga javob yozilgan

kahoot.q: Which sentence punctuates 'however' correctly in the middle of a sentence?
kahoot.explain: Gap ichidagi "however" ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.

kahoot.q: Which linker shows a RESULT?
kahoot.explain: "as a result" oldingi gapdan kelib chiqqan oqibatni ko'rsatadi; whereas — qarshilik, for instance — misol.

kahoot.q: Which linker contrasts two ideas INSIDE one sentence?
kahoot.explain: "whereas" bitta gap ichida ikki fikrni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi: "Old towers are unique, whereas new ones are not."

kahoot.q: What must come after 'such as'?
options: a full clause with a verb
kahoot.explain: "such as" dan keyin OT keladi: "cities such as Khiva", gap emas.

kahoot.q: Every paragraph starts with 'Firstly', 'Moreover', 'Moreover' or 'Also'. How do the band descriptors describe this linking?
kahoot.explain: Bir xil qolipdagi bog'lovchilar zanjiri descriptor'da "mechanical" deyiladi — bu Band 6 belgisi.

kahoot.q: 'Bus fares rose again in May. This is a problem.' How can you make 'This' clearer?
kahoot.explain: Yalang'och "this" ga ot qo'shiladi: "This rise is a problem" — nima muammo ekani aniq bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: 'The city built a school and a hospital. The latter was finished first.' What was finished first?
kahoot.explain: the latter — sanalgan ikki narsaning IKKINCHISI, ya'ni hospital.

kahoot.q: When should you use 'the former' and 'the latter'?
options: when exactly two things are named
when three or more things are named
kahoot.explain: the former / the latter faqat IKKITA narsa sanalganda ishlatiladi; uchta bo'lsa otni takrorlang.

kahoot.q: Choose the best word: 'I lost my old phone, so I bought a new ___.'
kahoot.explain: "one" takrorlangan birlikdagi sanaladigan otning (phone) o'rnini bosadi.

kahoot.q: 'Some towns recycle plastic. Towns that do not ___ pay more for waste collection.' What fills the gap?
kahoot.explain: "do so" butun fe'l guruhini (recycle plastic) takrorlamasdan almashtiradi.

kahoot.q: 'Parents told teachers about the new timetable. They were unhappy with it.' What is the problem?
kahoot.explain: Oldingi gapda ikkita ko'plik ot (parents, teachers) bor, "they" qaysi biri ekani noaniq — otni takrorlang: "The parents were unhappy with it."

kahoot.q: Is it wrong to begin a sentence with 'However,'?
options: No, it is fine if not overused
Yes, it is always a serious error
No, but only in the conclusion
kahoot.explain: Gap boshidagi "However," xato emas; muammo — hamma bog'lovchi gap boshida turib, mexanik takrorlanishi.

kahoot.q: 'Disused factories' are factories that ...
kahoot.explain: disused — ishlatilmay qolgan, endi ishlamaydigan.

kahoot.q: To 'restore' an old building means to ...
options: repair it to its original state
knock it down and build a new one
sell it to a private owner
kahoot.explain: restore — eski holatiga qaytarib ta'mirlamoq.

kahoot.q: 'The station was converted ___ a museum.' Choose the preposition.
kahoot.explain: convert something INTO something — biror narsani boshqa narsaga aylantirmoq.

kahoot.q: A 'municipal' budget belongs to ...
kahoot.explain: municipal — shahar (shahar hokimiyati)ga tegishli.

kahoot.q: 'This objection deserves an answer.' An objection is ...
options: a plan for a new building
kahoot.explain: objection — e'tiroz, biror narsaga qarshi fikr.

kahoot.q: To 'reconcile' two positions means to ...
options: choose the stronger of the two
kahoot.explain: reconcile — ikki qarashni murosaga keltirmoq, bir-biriga moslashtirmoq.

kahoot.q: 'Heritage' is closest in meaning to ...
options: things passed down from the past
kahoot.explain: heritage — o'tmishdan qolgan meros: binolar, an'analar, madaniyat.

kahoot.q: 'Such projects absorb a large share of the budget.' Here 'absorb' means ...
kahoot.explain: absorb (pul, vaqt) — katta qismini yutib yubormoq, sarflab qo'ymoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Developing Ideas, Using Examples
lessons.grammar_topic: Fikrni ochish zanjiri (because / which means / for example / as a result) va misol tanlash
lessons.vocab_topic: Band 6 va Band 7 orasidagi eng katta farq: aytilgan fikr va ochilgan fikr
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — namuna essay va barcha misol gaplar Jony Academy tomonidan shu dars uchun yozilgan; baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023), Task Response qatori bo'yicha.
objectives: Band 6 va Band 7 orasidagi asosiy farqni bitta jumlada ayta olish: fikr aytilgan emas, OCHILGAN bo'lishi kerak.
Ochish zanjirini yod olish: FIKR (topic sentence) va uning ustiga to'rt bo'g'in — sabab (because), ma'nosi (which means), misol (for example), natija (as a result).
Yassi (rivojlantirilmagan) gapni zanjir bo'yicha to'liq xatboshiga aylantirish.
Kuchli misolning uchta belgisini (aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq) tanib olish va zaif misolni tuzatish.
To'qilgan statistikaning xavfini tushunish va uni xavfsiz ifoda bilan almashtirish.
Misol xatboshida BITTA gap bo'lishini bilish (juda zarur bo'lsa — ikkita qisqa gap).
materials: Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi [reading] bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan, chetida keng bo'sh joy qoldirilgan: zanjir bo'g'inlari shu yerda belgilanadi.
Doskaga DARSDAN OLDIN yozib qo'yiladi: because, which means, for example, as a result — to'rt katak ustma-ust, o'qlari bilan. 5-mashqda shu katakchalar ustiga so'z soni yoziladi.

3-mashq uchun kartochkalar: 9 ta misol gapi qirqilgan holda, 6-8 to'plam (har juftlikka bitta) — o'quvchilar "kuchli" va "zaif" ustunlariga ajratadi. Gaplar aynan 3-mashq ro'yxatidan ko'chiriladi; kartochkada faqat ingliz gapi turadi, javob (KUCHLI/ZAIF) yozilmaydi.
2-mashq uchun yassi gaplar varaqasi: 2-mashqdagi 5 ta yassi gap (faqat chap ustun, javobi yozilmagan), har birining tagida to'rt qatorli bo'sh joy — har o'quvchiga bittadan nusxa.
Ustozda: 37-darsdagi A essay (umumiy Band 5.5) nusxasi — kirishda "misol yo'q" kamchiligini eslatish uchun kerak bo'ladi.
Ikki xil rangli marker: doskada va namuna essay nusxasida sababni va misolni alohida rangda ajratib ko'rsatish uchun.
4-mashqdagi 6 ta xavfli gap: ustoz ularni darsdan oldin doskaning chetiga yozib qo'yadi yoki birma-bir diktovka qiladi — alohida varaq kerak emas.
timeline: 37-darsdagi A essay ochiladi, "misol yo'q" kamchiligi eslatiladi; doskada yassi va ochilgan ikki gap solishtiriladi
Doskadagi to'rt katak: because, which means, for example, as a result — ustoz bitta fikrni sinf bilan birga ochib beradi
Har bo'g'in qaysi ishni bajaradi; iboralar daftarga jadval qilib ko'chiriladi
Juftlik 1- va 3-gapni ochadi, ikkalasi doskada birga tekshiriladi; qolgan uchtasi namuna sifatida o'qiladi
Kartochkalar ikki ustunga ajratiladi, har qaror uchun sabab aytiladi
Xavfli gaplar xavfsiz akademik ifodaga aylantiriladi
Har body xatboshida fikr va to'rt bo'g'in rangli marker bilan belgilanadi, keyin jadval to'ldiriladi
Qaysi gap qancha joy egallaydi; misol uchdan biridan oshmasligi o'lchab ko'rsatiladi
Zanjir doskadan o'chirilmaydi; uch vazifa o'qib beriladi

intro: 37-darsda ko'rdik: A essay (umumiy Band 5.5, TR 5) savolga javob bergan, xatboshilari ham bor edi, lekin birorta ham misol yo'q edi. Descriptor tili bilan aytganda — "ideas are insufficiently developed". Bugun aynan shuni tuzatamiz.
Band 6 o'quvchisi fikrni AYTADI: "Online services save time." Band 7 o'quvchisi shu fikrni OCHADI: nega shunday, bu nimani anglatadi, qanday holatda, oqibati nima.

Xatboshi FIKR (topic sentence) bilan boshlanadi, keyin uning ustiga to'rt bo'g'inli zanjir quriladi: 1) sabab (because / since / the reason is that), 2) ma'nosi yoki oraliq natija (which means that / this means that / in practice), 3) misol (for example / for instance / in many cities), 4) yakuniy natija (as a result / therefore / consequently). Doskadagi to'rt katak ham aynan shu to'rt bo'g'in.
Har bo'g'inni alohida bog'lovchi bilan boshlash shart emas — muhimi FIKR HARAKATI: umumiydan aniqqa, aniqdan oqibatga. Bog'lovchi shunchaki shu harakatni ko'rsatib turadi.
Kuchli misolning uchta belgisi bor: ANIQ (nima, qayerda, qanday natija bilan), ISHONARLI (hayotda bo'lishi mumkin), MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ (aynan shu fikrni isbotlaydi, boshqasini emas).

To'qilgan statistika xavfli: "According to statistics, 78.4% of teenagers..." degan gap tekshiruvchiga ishonarsiz ko'rinadi, ko'pincha til xatosi bilan keladi va fikrni umuman ochmaydi. Aniq foiz o'rniga "a large proportion", "in many cities", "many young people" kabi ehtiyotkor ifoda ishlatiladi — ball tushmaydi, xavf esa yo'qoladi.

Shaxsiy tajriba MUMKIN, lekin akademik ohangda: "my friend Dilnoza said" emas, "In my own city, many older people still queue at the bank to pay bills that younger residents pay by phone". Ya'ni shaxsiy tajriba umumiy holatga aylantiriladi.

Misol xatboshini egallab olmasligi kerak. Asosiy o'lchov — GAP SONI: to'rt-besh gaplik xatboshida misol BITTA gap (juda zarur bo'lsa ikkita qisqa gap). So'z bo'yicha bu odatda xatboshining chorak qismidan uchdan bir qismigacha chiqadi; foizni sanab o'tirish shart emas. Misoldan keyin ALBATTA fikrga qaytiladi ("as a result", "this suggests that"), aks holda misol osilib qoladi.
Diqqat: bu dars yangi G'OYA o'ylab topish haqida emas. 37-darsda ko'rganimizdek, B essaydagi (Band 7.5) g'oyalar A essaydagi (Band 5.5) bilan bir xil edi — farq faqat ochib berilishida.
formulas: Nega? Bu nimani anglatadi? Qanday holatda? Oqibati nima?
because, which means, for example, as a result
presentation: Har xatboshida misol shartmi?
Body xatboshilarining har birida bitta aniq misol bo'lsin. Kirish va xulosada misol shart emas.
Misol yolg'on bo'lsa, ball tushadimi?
Tekshiruvchi faktni tekshirmaydi. Lekin ishonarsiz misol (aniq foiz, mashhur nom) fikrni ochmaydi va ko'pincha til xatosi bilan keladi — shuning uchun amalda ball tushadi.
Raqam ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Aniq foiz emas, ehtiyotkor ifoda: a large proportion, many young people, in many cities. Ma'no saqlanadi, xavf yo'qoladi.
"I" deb yozsam bo'ladimi?
Ha. "In my view" va "In my own city" mumkin. "My friend said" kabi tasodifiy shaxsiy gap esa misol bo'la olmaydi.
Misol qancha uzun bo'lsin?
Bitta gap. Xatboshi 4-5 gap bo'lsa, bitta misol gapi yetadi; ikkita bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham qisqa bo'lsin, aks holda fikr ko'milib ketadi.
Misoldan keyin nima yoziladi?
Fikrga qaytiladi: as a result, this suggests that, therefore. Misol osilib qolmasligi kerak.
Bir xatboshida ikkita misol bo'lsa?
Bo'ladi, lekin ikkalasi ham qisqa bo'lsin. Ko'pincha bitta ochilgan misol ikkita yuzaki misoldan kuchliroq.
"For example" ni har xatboshida takrorlasam?
Almashtiring: for instance, in many cities, one such case is, a town that... — 37-darsdagi CC talabi aynan shu.
G'oya topolmasam nima qilaman?
Yangi g'oya izlamang. Borini oching: nega, ma'nosi, misol, natija — to'rt savol har doim fikr chiqaradi.
notes: Bu dars 36 va 37-darslar ustiga quriladi: 36 da savol turlari va mezonlar, 37 da baholash berilgan. Bu yerda faqat BITTA mezon — Task Response ning "extends and supports main ideas" qismi ochiladi. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang.

Mavzu oilasi: TEXNOLOGIYA VA ONLAYN XIZMATLAR (davlat xizmatlarining internetga o'tishi, telefon orqali to'lov, smartfon va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar, onlayn dars, keksalar va internet). Bu dars ataylab texnologiyaga o'tkazildi: tarixiy binolar, muzeylar va meros mavzusi 38, 43, 47 va 48-darslarda ishlatilgan, texnologiya esa Writing blokida namuna essay mavzusi sifatida boshqa uchramaydi. Savol turi ham boshqa: "To what extent do you agree or disagree?" (qisman qo'shilish) — 43-darsdagi "Discuss both views" dan farqli. Uyga vazifadagi misollar banki ataylab besh xil mavzuda.
Eng katta xato — ustozning o'zi zanjirni to'ldirib yuborishi. Ustoz faqat to'rt savolni beradi (Nega? Ma'nosi nima? Misol? Oqibati?), javobni o'quvchi aytadi.
3-mashqdagi kartochkalar bilan ishlaganda "zaif" deb ajratilganlarini shu yerda TUZATTIRING: har zaif misol yonida kuchli varianti og'zaki aytilsin.
2-mashqda o'quvchilar ko'pincha faqat sababni yozib to'xtaydi. Shunda "va bu nimani anglatadi?" deb so'rang — uchinchi va to'rtinchi bo'g'in shundan chiqadi.

Namuna essay shu dars uchun Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan. Undagi har body xatboshi ATAYLAB zanjir bo'yicha qurilgan, shuning uchun bo'g'inlar oson topiladi. Buni oldindan aytmang — o'quvchilar o'zi topsin.
5-mashqdagi so'z sonlari taxminiy o'lchov, qat'iy qoida emas. Maqsad — misolning xatboshini bosib ketmasligini ko'z bilan ko'rsatish.
Uyga vazifa keyingi darsning boshida yig'iladi; zanjiri to'liq bo'lmagan ishlar qaytariladi va shu darsda tuzatiladi.
mistakes: Fikrni aytib, keyingi fikrga o'tib ketish
Har fikrga sabab va misol qo'shish
"Technology is useful because it is very useful" — bo'sh aylana
A large proportion, in many cities
Bitta gap, ko'pi bilan ikkita qisqa gap
As a result / this suggests that
Osilib qolgan misol TR ni ko'tarmaydi
"Google is a famous company" hech narsani isbotlamaydi
For instance, in many cities, one such case

how: CORE — namuna essay va mashqlardan olingan 14 ta so'z (texnologiya va davlat xizmatlari). Ularni namuna essaydan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing: har o'quvchi 2 ta so'z bilan "sabab + misol" juftligini tuzadi.
core: Many public services, such as paying taxes, can now be used online.
Soliq to'lash kabi ko'plab davlat xizmatlaridan endi onlayn foydalanish mumkin.
You can now apply for a new passport on the government website.
Endi yangi pasport olish uchun davlat saytida ariza berishingiz mumkin.
Online forms have reduced the amount of paperwork for small businesses.
Onlayn shakllar kichik bizneslar uchun qog'ozbozlikni kamaytirdi.
It is now possible to register a small business online.
Endi kichik biznesni onlayn ro'yxatdan o'tkazish mumkin.
My grandfather still prefers to pay his bills in person at the bank.
Bobom hali ham to'lovlarini bankka o'zi borib qilishni afzal ko'radi.
My sister pays the electricity bill on our grandmother's behalf.
Singlim elektr uchun pulni buvimiz nomidan to'laydi.
Many older people rely on their children to use online services.
Ko'plab keksalar onlayn xizmatlardan foydalanishda farzandlariga tayanadi.
Online lessons are very difficult without a reliable internet connection.
Barqaror internet aloqasisiz onlayn darslar juda qiyin kechadi.
A website that is too complicated may exclude older users.
Juda murakkab sayt keksa foydalanuvchilarni chetda qoldirishi mumkin.
Online fraud often targets the most vulnerable people, such as pensioners.
Onlayn firibgarlik ko'pincha nafaqaxo'rlar kabi eng himoyasiz odamlarni nishonga oladi.
Many people choose online shopping mainly for its convenience.
Ko'pchilik onlayn xaridni asosan qulayligi uchun tanlaydi.
Loud music can distract you when you are doing your homework.
Uy vazifasini qilayotganingizda baland musiqa sizni chalg'itishi mumkin.
I turn off the notifications on my phone before I start studying.
O'qishni boshlashdan oldin telefonimdagi bildirishnomalarni o'chirib qo'yaman.
Some advertisements mislead people about the real price of a product.
Ba'zi reklamalar odamlarni mahsulotning haqiqiy narxi haqida yanglishtiradi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Fikr va zanjirning to'rt bo'g'ini
class_ex.instr: Har bo'g'in qanday ishni bajaradi va qaysi iboralar bilan boshlanadi. Daftarga jadval qilib ko'chiriladi.
items: Fikr (topic sentence) — zanjir boshlanadigan nuqta
Sabab
Ma'nosi (oraliq natija)
Misol
Yakuniy natija
answers: Xatboshining asosiy da'vosi. Bitta gap, bitta fikr. Bog'lovchi kerak emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytiladi.
Nega shunday ekanini aytadi. because / since / the reason is that / this is largely because
Sababning amaliy oqibatini ochadi. which means that / this means that / in practice
Fikrni aniq holatga tushiradi. for example / for instance / in many cities / one such case is
Misoldan fikrga qaytaradi va xatboshini yopadi. as a result / therefore / this suggests that
why: Bu bo'g'in emas, zanjir osiladigan mix; bu gap bo'lmasa, CC ham, TR ham tushadi.
Band 6 o'quvchisi ko'pincha aynan shu yerda to'xtaydi.
Eng ko'p tushirib qoldiriladigan bo'g'in.
Aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq bo'lsin.
Bu gap bo'lmasa, misol osilib qoladi.
class_ex.note: To'rt savol — to'rt bo'g'in: Nega? Bu nimani anglatadi? Qanday holatda? Oqibati nima? Shu to'rt savolni har fikrga bering.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Yassi gapni zanjir bilan oching
class_ex.instr: Chapda yassi gap berilgan. Uni to'rt bo'g'in bo'yicha to'liq xatboshiga aylantiring. Har juftlik faqat 1- va 3-gapni yozadi (14 daqiqa), so'ng ikkalasi doskada birga tekshiriladi (6 daqiqa); qolgan uchtasi namuna sifatida ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi va uyda foydalaniladi.
items: Online lessons are useful for students in remote villages.
Smartphones distract pupils in class.
Paying by phone helps small shops.
Children should learn basic coding at school.
Social media is harmful to teenagers.
answers: Online lessons are useful for students in remote villages because they give access to teachers who would never travel so far. This means that a talented pupil is no longer limited to the subjects that the local school happens to offer. A village student preparing for a university entrance exam, for example, can now join an evening course run by a teacher in the capital. As a result, the gap between rural and urban pupils can begin to narrow, at least for those with a stable internet connection.

Smartphones distract pupils in class because every notification competes with the teacher for their attention. This means that even a short message can break a pupil's concentration, and getting back into the task takes time. A school that asks pupils to leave their phones in a box at the classroom door, for instance, often finds that pupils ask more questions and finish more work. As a result, a simple rule about phones may improve learning more than an expensive new piece of equipment.

Paying by phone helps small shops because it removes the need to handle and count large amounts of cash. This means that shopkeepers make fewer mistakes with change and worry less about theft. A market stallholder who accepts payment by phone, for example, no longer has to close the stall early to take the day's cash to the bank. As a result, small traders can compete more easily for customers who rarely carry notes and coins.

Children should learn basic coding at school because it teaches them to break a large problem into small, logical steps. This means that the benefit goes far beyond computers, since the same habit helps in mathematics and even in planning an essay. A pupil who has built a simple game, for instance, has had to test an idea, find what went wrong and try again many times. As a result, coding lessons can develop patience and problem-solving skills that are useful in almost any future job.

Social media can be harmful to teenagers because many apps are designed to keep users scrolling for as long as possible. This means that time which used to be spent on sleep, homework or friends quietly disappears into a screen. A teenager who checks their phone in bed, for example, often falls asleep much later than they intended and wakes up tired. As a result, poor sleep can affect both their mood and their marks at school, even if they never see anything harmful online.
why: Sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija — to'rttasi ham joyida. Misol bitta gap; natija ehtiyotkor ("can begin to", "at least for those").
Misol aniq holat (telefonlar qutisi), lekin to'qilgan raqamsiz — shuning uchun xavfsiz.
"A market stallholder" — ko'z oldiga keladigan aniq odam; foiz yoki soxta raqam kerak bo'lmadi.
Misol "for instance" bilan gap ICHIDA kirdi; natija gapi fikrga qaytib, xatboshini yopdi.
Yassi gapdagi mutlaq da'vo ("is harmful") ochilganda "can be harmful" ga yumshadi: fikrni ochish ko'pincha uni aniqroq va ehtiyotkorroq qiladi.
class_ex.note: Tekshiruv uchun uch savol: to'rtta bo'g'in bormi? Misol nechta gap? Oxirgi gap fikrga qaytdimi? Shu uch savol bilan o'quvchi o'z ishini o'zi baholaydi. Javoblar — NAMUNA (bittasi): boshqa sabab va misol bilan yozilgan xatboshi shu uch savolga "ha" javobini bersa va unda to'qilgan raqam yoki mutlaq da'vo (always, everyone, never) bo'lmasa, to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Bu misol kuchlimi yoki zaifmi?
class_ex.instr: Kartochkalarni "kuchli" va "zaif" ustunlariga ajrating. Har qaror uchun sababini ayting: aniqmi, ishonarlimi, mavzuga bog'liqmi.
items: For example, in 2022 exactly 71.6 per cent of teenagers in the region used social media every day.
For example, a farmer with a smartphone can compare prices in several markets before deciding where to sell the harvest.
For example, my cousin Jasur plays computer games every evening.
For example, many studies show that technology is important.
For example, a town that put free Wi-Fi in its library found that many more teenagers began to study there after school.
For example, Google is a very famous company.
For example, when the local bank closed its branch, many older customers had to learn online banking with help from their grandchildren.
For example, everybody knows that young people spend too much time online.
In my own city, for instance, the district library now runs free weekend classes where older residents learn to use government websites.
why: To'qilgan aniq raqam. Ishonarsiz, tekshirib bo'lmaydi va fikrni umuman ochmaydi.
Aniq (kim, nima, qanday foyda), ishonarli va fikrga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'liq.
Tasodifiy shaxsiy gap; undan umumiy xulosa chiqmaydi.
"Many studies" — manbasiz va noaniq; bu misol emas, fikrning takrori.
Aniq holat va kuzatiladigan natija bor.
Mashhur nom fikrni isbotlamaydi; na sabab, na natija ko'rsatilgan.
Sabab va oqibat ko'rinib turibdi; ishonarli.
"Everybody knows" — isbot emas, quruq umumiy gap.
Shaxsiy tajriba akademik ohangda va aniq detal bilan berilgan.
class_ex.note: Uchta belgi doskada tursin: ANIQ, ISHONARLI, MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ. Uchtasidan biri yo'q bo'lsa — misol zaif. Zaif kartochkalarni shu yerning o'zida og'zaki tuzattiring.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: To'qilgan raqam va shaxsiy gapni tuzating
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi xavfli gapni o'ngdagidek xavfsiz, akademik ifodaga aylantiring.
items: According to statistics, 78.4% of teenagers spend more than five hours a day online.
Research proves that online lessons are better than normal lessons.
My friend Dilnoza works in a bank and she says everyone uses the app now.
In my country we love our phones very much.
Scientists say that 9 out of 10 jobs will disappear because of robots.
I saw on the internet that online shopping is the biggest industry in the world.
answers: A large proportion of teenagers now spend several hours a day online.
Online lessons can be more effective than classroom teaching for some students.
Many bank customers now use a mobile banking app.
In my own city, it is now common to see people of all ages paying for their shopping by phone.
Many routine jobs may disappear or change significantly as automation spreads.
Online shopping has become an important part of retail in many countries.
why: To'qilgan foiz o'rniga ehtiyotkor miqdor ifodasi ("a large proportion", "several hours"). Ma'no saqlandi, xavf ketdi.
"Research proves" (manbasiz) va mutlaq "better" o'rniga ehtiyotkor akademik til: "can be more effective ... for some students" — ma'no saqlandi.
Shaxsiy gap umumiy holatga aylandi, "everyone" esa "many" ga yumshadi.
Bo'sh his-tuyg'u ("we love") o'rniga ko'z bilan ko'rinadigan dalil.
Ishonarsiz raqam ("9 out of 10") va manbasiz "Scientists say" olib tashlandi; "will disappear" o'rniga "may disappear or change" — ma'no saqlandi, ehtiyotkor akademik til.
Manbasiz mutlaq da'vo ("the biggest") o'rniga ishonarli, ehtiyotkor bayonot.
class_ex.note: Qoida: aniq raqamni bilmasang, yozma. "A large proportion", "in many cities", "many young people" ballni tushirmaydi — aksincha, ehtiyotkor akademik til sifatida baholanadi. Javoblar — NAMUNA (bittasi): ma'nosi saqlangan, to'qilgan raqam va mutlaq so'z (everyone, proves, the biggest, will) yumshatilgan boshqa variant ham to'g'ri.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Xatboshi anatomiyasi — qaysi gap qancha joy egallaydi
class_ex.instr: Namuna essayning 2-xatboshisini o'lchang: har gap qaysi bo'g'in, taxminan necha so'z. Misol xatboshining qancha qismini egallaganini hisoblang.
class_ex.answers: Namuna essayning 2-xatboshisi: 4 gap, 106 so'z, misol 1 gap (30 so'z) — ya'ni xatboshining chorak qismidan sal ko'prog'i, uchdan biridan kam. Shu nisbat me'yor deb olinadi.
class_ex.note: So'z sonlari taxminiy o'lchov, qat'iy qoida emas. Maqsad — misol xatboshini bosib ketmasligini ko'z bilan ko'rsatish.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — har fikr zanjir bilan ochilgan
readings.qtype: To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion — qisman qo'shilish)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi, Band 7.5 darajasi, 311 so'z — shu dars uchun yozilgan
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Many governments are now offering public services, such as paying bills and applying for official documents, on the internet. Some people believe that in the future these services should be available only online. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
text: In many countries, tasks that once required a visit to a government office, from paying an electricity bill to applying for a passport, can now be completed on a phone or a laptop. Although I agree that most public services should be available online, I do not believe that the internet should become the only way to use them.

The strongest argument for moving services online is the time it saves. Because an online form can be completed at any hour, people no longer need to take a day off work to stand in a queue, which means that dealing with the state becomes a short task rather than a major event. A small business owner who once had to visit several offices to register a company, for example, can now complete the same steps from home, often in a single afternoon. As a result, citizens and officials alike spend less time on paperwork and more time on the work that actually matters to them.

However, making the internet the only option would exclude those who rely on public services most. Many older people and residents of remote villages have neither a reliable connection nor the confidence to use complicated websites, so a pensioner without a smartphone would depend on relatives even to pay a bill. In districts where offices have stopped accepting payments in person, for instance, elderly residents often have to ask a grandchild to pay on their behalf. As a result, a system designed to make citizens more independent would leave its most vulnerable users less independent than before.

In conclusion, putting public services online brings clear gains in speed and convenience, and I support this trend. Even so, the internet should remain an additional route rather than the only one, so that no citizen has to ask someone else for help simply to deal with the state.
paraphrases: offering public services ... on the internet

paying bills and applying for official documents

To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Although I agree that most ... I do not believe that ... (1-xatboshi, pozitsiya) / I support this trend. Even so, ... (4-xatboshi, xulosa)

tasks.title: Har xatboshida zanjirni toping
tasks.instr: Namuna essayning ikkita body xatboshisini bo'g'inlarga ajrating. Avval matnda rangli marker bilan belgilang, keyin jadvalni to'ldiring.
tasks.answers: Ikkala xatboshi ham bir xil zanjir bo'yicha qurilgan. Bu tasodif emas — shu tartib har body xatboshida takrorlanadi.
tasks.note: Diqqat: 3-xatboshida "because" ham, "which means" ham yozilmagan, lekin ikkala BO'G'IN ham bor — ikkalasi bitta gapga sig'gan ("Many older people ... have neither a reliable connection nor the confidence ..., so a pensioner without a smartphone would depend on relatives ..."). Bog'lovchi shart emas, fikr harakati shart; shuni o'quvchiga alohida ko'rsating.

tasks.title: Essaydagi misollar nega kuchli
tasks.instr: Dastlabki to'rt qatorda har misolni uchta belgi bo'yicha tekshiring: aniqmi, ishonarlimi, mavzuga bog'liqmi. Oxirgi qator misol emas — u misoldan keyin fikrga qanday qaytilishini ko'rsatadi.
items: A small business owner who once had to visit several offices to register a company
can now complete the same steps from home, often in a single afternoon
In districts where offices have stopped accepting payments in person
elderly residents often have to ask a grandchild to pay on their behalf
a system designed to make citizens more independent would leave its most vulnerable users less independent
answers: ANIQ: kim (kichik biznes egasi), nima (kompaniyani ro'yxatdan o'tkazish), qanday farq (bir necha idora o'rniga uydan)
ISHONARLI: "often" — ehtiyotkor ifoda; "in a single afternoon" — hayotda bo'ladigan holat, to'qilgan soat yoki foiz emas
MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ: aynan "faqat onlayn bo'lsa, keksalar chetda qoladi" degan fikrni isbotlaydi
ANIQ: umumiy "keksalarga qiyin" o'rniga ko'z oldiga keladigan holat
why: Kompaniya yoki shahar nomi aytilmagan — shart emas, holat aniq bo'lsa yetadi.
"87.3% of business owners" deyilganda ishonch yo'qolardi.
Umumiy "some old people have problems" hech narsa isbotlamasdi.
Kichik, ko'rinadigan detal fikrni raqamsiz ham kuchaytiradi.
Misol aynan shu gap bilan fikrga qaytdi.
tasks.note: Essayda birorta ham aniq foiz yo'q. Shunga qaramay har fikr ochilgan — demak, raqam kerak emas, ANIQ HOLAT kerak.

tasks.title: Yassi variant va ochilgan variant
tasks.instr: Chapda shu essayning Band 6 darajasidagi yassi varianti, o'ngda asl matni. Farqni o'quvchi aytsin.
items: Online services are very good for people.
For example, many people use them.
But old people cannot use the internet.
This is bad for old people.
In conclusion, online services have advantages and disadvantages.
answers: Because an online form can be completed at any hour, people no longer need to take a day off work to stand in a queue, which means that dealing with the state becomes a short task rather than a major event.
A small business owner who once had to visit several offices to register a company, for example, can now complete the same steps from home, often in a single afternoon.

Many older people and residents of remote villages have neither a reliable connection nor the confidence to use complicated websites, so a pensioner without a smartphone would depend on relatives even to pay a bill.
As a result, a system designed to make citizens more independent would leave its most vulnerable users less independent than before.
Even so, the internet should remain an additional route rather than the only one, so that no citizen has to ask someone else for help simply to deal with the state.
why: Yassi gapda sabab ham, ma'no ham yo'q. O'ngda ikkalasi ham bor.
"Many people" o'rniga aniq kim va nima qilgani — noaniqlik aniqlikka aylandi.
Cheklov ham xuddi shunday ochilishi kerak: qarshi tomonni bir gap bilan tashlab ketish TR ni tushiradi.
Bir xil fikr, lekin sabab va oqibat aniq ko'rsatilgan.

Descriptor'dan eslang: noaniq yoki takroriy xulosa — Band 6 TR belgisi ("conclusions may become unclear or repetitive"); 37-darsdagi A essayning "It depends" xulosasi ham shunday edi. O'ngdagi xulosa aniq pozitsiya va shartni beradi.
tasks.note: Chapdagi yassi variantdagi g'oyalar o'ngdagi bilan BIR XIL. Yana bir bor: yangi g'oya kerak emas, borini ochish kerak.

homework_intro: Bugun biz yassi fikrni to'rt bo'g'in bilan ochdik: sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija — uyda xuddi shu zanjirni endi o'zingiz qurasiz.
Birinchi vazifada uchta yassi gap beriladi, har birini to'liq xatboshiga aylantirasiz: kamida to'rt gap va ichida bitta aniq misol bo'lsin, taxminan 25 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifada bitta savolga bitta to'liq body xatboshi yozasiz — 2-mashqdagi tartib bilan, 90-110 so'z, yana 20 daqiqa.

Uchinchi vazifa "misollar banki": daftaringizning oxirgi sahifasiga besh xil mavzu uchun beshta tayyor misol yozib qo'yasiz va har birining yoniga uchta belgini (aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq) qo'yasiz.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — sababni yozib to'xtab qolish; har xatboshidan keyin o'zingizga ayting: "va bu nimani anglatadi?", "oqibati nima?" — javobi yozilmagan bo'lsa, xatboshi hali tugamagan.

homework.title: Uchta yassi gapni zanjir bilan oching
homework.instr: Har gapni to'liq xatboshiga aylantiring (kamida 4 gap, ichida bitta aniq misol): 1) Online shopping is changing town centres. 2) Video calls help families who live apart. 3) Every school should teach pupils how to check information online.
homework.answers: Namuna (1-gap): Online shopping is changing town centres because many people now buy clothes, books and electronics without leaving home. This means that shops which depend on passing customers are losing trade, while services that cannot be delivered to the door are becoming more important. In many towns, for example, streets that once had several clothes shops now have gyms, hairdressers and coffee shops in their place. As a result, town centres are gradually becoming places that people visit to meet friends or use services rather than to shop. Namuna (2-gap): Video calls help families who live apart because they allow relatives to see each other's faces, not just hear their voices. This means that grandparents can watch a grandchild grow up even when they live in different countries. A mother working abroad, for instance, can still help with homework or read a bedtime story through a screen. As a result, long periods of separation, although still painful, become easier for both children and parents to bear. Namuna (3-gap): Every school should teach pupils how to check information online because false stories can spread very quickly on social media. This means that young people who cannot judge a source may easily be misled about health or money. A pupil who has learned to look for the original source of a news story, for example, is less likely to forward a fake medical cure to the family group chat. As a result, a few lessons on checking sources can protect not only the pupils themselves but also the people around them. Tekshiruv: sabab bormi, ma'nosi bormi, misol aniqmi, natija fikrga qaytdimi. Javoblar — NAMUNA (bittasi): o'quvchining boshqa sabab va misol bilan yozgan xatboshisi shu to'rt savolga "ha" javobini bersa va unda to'qilgan raqam yoki mutlaq da'vo (always, everyone, never) bo'lmasa, to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

homework.title: Bitta to'liq body xatboshi yozing
homework.instr: SAVOL: Some people believe that children under the age of twelve should not have their own smartphones. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Shu savolga BITTA body xatboshi yozing: 90-110 so'z, fikr + to'rt bo'g'in, aniq misol. Misol BITTA gap bo'lsin.
homework.answers: Namuna: Children under twelve are generally better off without a smartphone of their own, because the device gives them almost unlimited access to content that they are not yet able to judge. This means that parents lose much of their control over what their child sees and when. A ten-year-old with a phone in the bedroom, for example, can keep watching videos long after the lights are off without anyone noticing. As a result, a simple phone that can only make calls and send messages may be a safer choice until children are old enough to use the internet responsibly. (99 so'z; misol — bitta gap, 23 so'z.) Boshqa pozitsiya (qo'shilmaslik) ham to'g'ri, agar to'rt bo'g'in bo'lsa, misol bitta gap bo'lsa va to'qilgan raqam ishlatilmasa.

homework.title: Misollar banki: beshta tayyor misol
homework.instr: Daftaringizning oxirgi sahifasiga besh xil mavzu uchun beshta misol yozing (ta'lim, sog'liq, shahar hayoti, ish, madaniyat). Har birining yoniga uchta belgini qo'ying: aniq, ishonarli, mavzuga bog'liq.
homework.answers: Namuna (shahar hayoti): In one district where the main street was closed to cars, local shops reported steadier trade within a year. ANIQ (qayerda va qanday natija), ISHONARLI (hayotda bo'ladigan holat), MAVZUGA BOG'LIQ (transport va savdo haqidagi fikrni isbotlaydi). Ustoz tekshiradi: aniq foizli, manbasiz yoki tasodifiy shaxsiy misollar qaytariladi.

normativ: Har birida to'rt bo'g'in va aniq misol bor
Beshta misol, har biriga uchta belgi

kahoot.q: What is the key difference between a Band 6 and a Band 7 body paragraph in Task Response?
kahoot.explain: Band 6 da fikr AYTILADI, Band 7 da OCHILADI: sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija.

kahoot.q: After the topic sentence, which order does this lesson's chain follow?
kahoot.explain: Zanjir: sabab (because) → ma'nosi (which means) → misol (for example) → natija (as a result).

kahoot.q: Which phrase usually introduces the MEANING link of the chain?
kahoot.explain: "which means that" sababning amaliy ma'nosini ochadi.

kahoot.q: A student writes: 'Exercise is healthy because it is good for your health.' What is wrong?
options: It goes round in a circle
kahoot.explain: Sabab o'rniga fikrning o'zi takrorlangan — bu bo'sh aylana, fikr ochilmagan.

kahoot.q: Idea: 'Online banking saves time.' Which is the strongest example?
options: You can pay a bill at midnight from home
Online banking is used by a lot of people nowadays
My uncle really likes his banking app
Statistics say 83.2% of people use it
kahoot.explain: Kuchli misol aniq, ishonarli va aynan "vaqt tejaladi" fikrini isbotlaydi.

kahoot.q: What should replace an invented figure like '63.7% of drivers'?
kahoot.explain: Aniq raqamni bilmasangiz, ehtiyotkor ifoda yozing — ball tushmaydi, xavf yo'qoladi.

kahoot.q: In a 4–5 sentence body paragraph, how long should the example usually be?
kahoot.explain: Misol bitta gap (juda zarur bo'lsa ikkita qisqa gap) — aks holda fikr ko'milib ketadi.

kahoot.q: What should usually come straight AFTER the example?
options: a return to the main idea
a second example that is longer
kahoot.explain: Misoldan keyin "as a result" / "this suggests that" bilan fikrga qaytiladi.

kahoot.q: Idea: 'Children should learn to code.' Why is 'For example, Bill Gates is very rich' a weak example?
options: It does not prove the idea
Famous names are never allowed in essays
kahoot.explain: Mashhur nom fikrni isbotlamaydi: na sabab, na natija ko'rsatilgan.

kahoot.q: What is the best way to use personal experience in an IELTS essay?
options: Turn it into a general example
Quote exactly what a friend said
kahoot.explain: Shaxsiy tajriba akademik ohangda umumiy holatga aylantiriladi: "In my own city, ...".

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the most careful academic claim?
options: Many families now order food online.
Every family orders food online daily.
All families use food apps for 9 hours.
Nobody cooks at home any more.
kahoot.explain: "Many" — ehtiyotkor; every, all, nobody kabi mutlaq so'zlar va to'qilgan raqam xavfli.

kahoot.q: A student writes a topic sentence and a reason, then starts a new idea. What is missing?
options: a direct quotation from an expert
kahoot.explain: Sababdan keyin ma'nosi, misol va natija kelmasa, fikr "insufficiently developed" bo'lib qoladi.

kahoot.q: 'Offices have stopped accepting payments in person.' 'In person' means ...
kahoot.explain: in person — shaxsan, o'zi borib.

kahoot.q: 'She paid the bill on her grandmother's behalf.' She paid it ...
kahoot.explain: on someone's behalf — birovning nomidan, uning o'rniga.

kahoot.q: A 'reliable' internet connection is one that ...
options: works well most of the time
kahoot.explain: reliable — ishonchli, deyarli doim ishlaydigan.

kahoot.q: If a system EXCLUDES older people, it ...
kahoot.explain: exclude — chetda qoldirmoq, foydalanish imkonini bermaslik.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'easily harmed or badly affected'?
kahoot.explain: vulnerable — himoyasiz, zaif (masalan, keksalar yoki kasallar).

kahoot.q: A phone 'notification' is ...
options: a short alert that pops up
a monthly contract with a phone company
kahoot.explain: notification — ekranda chiqadigan qisqa bildirishnoma.

kahoot.q: 'People shop online mainly for convenience.' 'Convenience' is closest to ...
kahoot.explain: convenience — qulaylik, osonlik.

kahoot.q: Loud music can ___ you from your homework.
kahoot.explain: distract someone from something — kimnidir biror ishdan chalg'itmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: How to Stop Overgeneralising
lessons.grammar_topic: Mutlaq da'vodan aniq da'voga — hedging (yumshatish) va da'vo doirasini ko'rsatish
lessons.vocab_topic: "All people", "everyone knows", "always" — nega ball tushiradi va o'rniga nima yoziladi
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha gaplar, mashqlar va namuna essay Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan. Mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: "All people", "everyone knows", "always", "never" kabi mutlaq iboralar essayni nega zaiflashtirishini tushuntirib bera olish.
Hedging to'plamining sakkiz vositasini (tend to, are likely to, in many cases, particularly in, often, may, appear to, a number of) misol bilan ishlatish.
Mutlaq da'voni TASHLAMASDAN, uning doirasini ko'rsatib qayta yozish (kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan).
Berilgan xatboshidan barcha overgeneralisation'larni topib, har birini tuzatilgan variantga almashtirish.
Hedging Task Response va Lexical Resource mezonlarini qanday ko'tarishini band tili bilan ayta olish.
O'z xatboshini (5-6 gap) yozib, unda 3-4 ta (kamida uchta) turli yumshatish vositasini ishlatish.
materials: Namuna essay (quyidagi [reading] bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan nusxa, chetida bo'sh ustun: "hedging vositasi".
1-mashq jadvali (Hedging to'plami) — doskaga DARSDAN OLDIN uch ustun chizib qo'yiladi: Vosita | Ma'nosi | Misol. Ustunlar bo'sh, dars davomida to'ldiriladi.
4-mashqdagi besh gap (zaif xatboshi) — A4 ga yirik shriftda chop etiladi, har juftlikka bitta nusxa (guruh 12 kishi bo'lsa 6 nusxa).

Qirqiladigan kartochkalar 3-mashq uchun: bir to'plamda 8 kartochka, har kartochkaning bir tomonida mutlaq so'z, ikkinchi tomonida almashtiruvchisi — all/most; every/almost every; everyone/it is widely believed; always/usually (tend to); never/rarely (seldom); only/one of the main; nobody/few people; completely/largely. Har juftlikka bitta to'plam (guruh 12 kishi bo'lsa 6 to'plam).

37-darsdagi 12 tekshiruv savoli varaqasi — o'quvchilar daftarida bor; dars oxirida undan ikkitasi (TR 3-savol "har fikr sabab yoki misol bilan ochildimi?" va LR 3-savol "so'z birikmalari to'g'rimi?") o'qib eslatiladi.
Qizil ruchka har o'quvchida (5-mashq va uyga vazifa uchun): mutlaq so'zlar aynan qizil bilan aylantiriladi.
timeline: 37-darsdagi 4 mezon eslatiladi; doskaga "All students hate exams" yoziladi va guruh bitta istisno topadi
Mutlaq da'vo = himoyasiz da'vo; "everyone knows" nega dalil emas
Doskadagi uch ustunli jadval to'ldiriladi, 1-mashq daftarga ko'chiriladi
2-mashq juftlikda, keyin har juftlik bittadan gapni doskaga yozadi
Qualifying: kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan; 5-mashq bajariladi (4-mashqdan oldin — ataylab: 4-mashq darsning yakuniy mashqi)
Essay o'qiladi, hedging vositalari qizil bilan belgilanadi, ikkala task bajariladi
4-mashq: besh gapli zaif xatboshi tuzatiladi va qayta yoziladi
4- yoki 5-mashq tugamagan bo'lsa shu yerda tugatiladi, aks holda kartochka o'yini takrorlanadi
Almashtirish jadvali doskadan o'qiladi; 37-darsdagi TR va LR tekshiruv savollari eslatiladi; uyga vazifa kirish matni o'qiladi

intro: Task 2 da tekshiruvchi sizdan HAQIQATNI emas, ISBOTLANADIGAN da'voni kutadi. "All students hate exams" degan gapni bitta istisno yiqitadi; "Most students find exams stressful" degan gapni yiqitib bo'lmaydi.
Shuning uchun mutlaq ibora aslida kuchli emas, ZAIF: u o'zini himoya qila olmaydi. Yumshatilgan gap esa kichikroq maydonni egallaydi, lekin o'sha maydonni mustahkam ushlaydi.

"Everyone knows that ..." — eng qimmat xato. Bu ibora dalil o'rnini bosmaydi, aksincha, "menda dalil yo'q" degan signal beradi. 37-darsdagi TR tekshiruv savoli esda: har fikr sabab yoki misol bilan ochildimi?

Hedging = da'voni yumshatish. Qualifying = da'vo doirasini ko'rsatish (kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan). Ikkalasi birga ishlaydi: "Public transport is cheap" -> "Public transport is relatively cheap in most large cities".

DIQQAT: yumshatish fikrdan voz kechish EMAS. "Sugar taxes never work" degan o'quvchi da'vosini tashlamaymiz — uni "Sugar taxes alone rarely produce a large change in behaviour" deb aniqlashtiramiz. Fikr o'sha, lekin endi himoyalangan.

Ball nuqtai nazaridan: hedging TR ni ko'taradi (pozitsiya aniq, lekin haddan oshmagan) va LR ga xizmat qiladi (tend to, be likely to, appear to, relatively — descriptor'dagi aniqlik va moslashuvchanlik, ya'ni "precision" va "flexibility"). Ya'ni bitta ko'nikma ikki mezonga ishlaydi.

Teskari xavf ham bor: HAMMA gapni yumshatsangiz, pozitsiya yo'qoladi va TR tushadi. 37-darsdagi "It depends on the situation" xulosasi aynan shundan kelib chiqqan. Qoida: pozitsiya gaplari (kirish va xulosadagi fikringiz) aniq bo'ladi, tashqi dunyo haqidagi da'volar yumshatiladi.

Amaliy tartib: essayni yozib bo'lgach, qizil ruchka bilan faqat mutlaq so'zlarni qidiring (all, every, everyone, always, never, only, nobody, completely, totally). Har biri ustida to'xtang va so'rang: "Bunga bitta istisno topsam bo'ladimi?" Topilsa — almashtiring.

Oddiy almashtirish jadvali yod olinadi: all -> most / many; always -> usually / tend to; never -> rarely / seldom; everyone knows -> it is widely believed; the only reason -> one of the main reasons; nobody -> few people.

5-6 gapli xatboshida 3-4 ta yumshatish vositasi yetarli. Har gapda "maybe", "perhaps", "I think" takrorlansa — bu yumshatish emas, ishonchsizlik, va ball tushadi. Namuna essay o'quv maqsadida ataylab zich yozilgan (2-xatboshida 7 ta vosita bor) — o'z xatboshingizda 3-4 ta yetadi.
formulas: Guruh istisno topsin — da'vo shu zahoti yiqiladi
in most large cities, particularly in, where distances allow
Har hedging vositasi qizil bilan aylantiriladi
Jadvaldagi 10 tasi majburiy, qolgan 4 tasi bonus
Tuzatilgan xatboshi to'liq o'qib beriladi va doskada qoladi
presentation: Yumshatsam, fikrim kuchsiz ko'rinmaydimi?
Aksincha. Mutlaq gapni bitta istisno yiqitadi, yumshatilgan gapni yiqitib bo'lmaydi. Tekshiruvchi buni ehtiyotkorlik emas, aniqlik deb o'qiydi.
"I think" yozsam yumshatish bo'ladimi?
Faqat pozitsiya gapida, bir-ikki marta. Har gapda takrorlansa — ishonchsizlik, TR tushadi. Tashqi da'volar uchun tend to, are likely to ishlating.
Statistikani o'zim o'ylab topsam bo'ladimi?
Aniq raqam (73%, 2019-yilda) yozmang — tekshirib bo'lmaydi. O'rniga "a number of cities", "several studies suggest" deb yozing.
Xulosada ham yumshatamanmi?
Xulosada pozitsiya ANIQ bo'ladi, lekin natija va'dasi yumshatiladi: "I believe" aniq, "is likely to reduce" yumshoq.
Bitta xatboshida nechta yumshatish kerak?

5-6 gapli xatboshida uch-to'rtta turli vosita yetadi. Har gapga "maybe" yoki "perhaps" qo'shilsa yoki bitta da'voga bir nechta vosita qalashtirilsa ("may possibly perhaps"), xatboshi suvli bo'lib qoladi va fikr ko'rinmay ketadi. Namuna essaydagi zichlik (2-xatboshida 7 ta vosita) ataylab qilingan — vositalarni ko'rsatish uchun.
"Everyone knows" ni umuman ishlatmaymanmi?
Task 2 da ishlatmang. Kerak bo'lsa "it is widely believed that" yoki "it is often argued that" deb yozing.
Bu Lexical Resource ga ham ta'sir qiladimi?
Ha. tend to, be likely to, appear to, relatively, largely — to'g'ri ishlatilsa, da'voni aniq va moslashuvchan qiladi; LR descriptor'i aynan shu aniqlikni (precision) baholaydi.
Mutlaq gap umuman yomonmi?
Yo'q. Bahssiz faktlar mutlaq bo'lishi mumkin: "Sugary drinks are sold in almost every country." Yomon bo'lgani — odamlarning xatti-harakati haqidagi mutlaq da'vo.
notes: Bu dars 36- va 37-darslarga suyanadi: mezonlar u yerda tushuntirilgan, bu yerda faqat TR va LR ga tegadigan bitta ko'nikma chuqurlashtiriladi. Mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang, atigi eslatib o'ting.

MAVZU OILASI: darsning ASOSIY mavzusi — jamoat salomatligi va turmush tarzi (shirin ichimliklarga soliq, tez tayyor ovqat, uy ovqati, maktab ovqati, o'tirib ishlash). Namuna essay ham, 4-mashqdagi xatboshi ham shu oiladan. Qolgan mashqlarda BIR-IKKITA yakka gap boshqa mavzularga tegadi: ta'lim (uy vazifasi, ertalabki dars), texnologiya (onlayn xarid, ekran), transport (velosiped yo'llari, jamoat transporti), ish bandligi (ish soatlari). Bular ochib berilmagan, faqat mashq gapi — shuning uchun seriyadagi boshqa darslar bu mavzularni to'liq olsa, takror bo'lmaydi. Atrof-muhit mavzusi bu darsda umuman ishlatilmagan.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan qarshilik: "ustoz, men ishonchim komil edi, nega yumshatay?" Javob doskada tursin: ishonch POZITSIYADA bo'ladi, mutlaqlik DA'VODA bo'lmaydi.
3-mashqni tez sur'atda o'tkazing (har javobga 3 soniya). Sekinlashtirsangiz o'quvchi o'ylab, "xavfsiz" deb javob berib yuboradi; tezlikda esa ular mutlaq so'zni quloq bilan tanib olishni o'rganadi.
Qizil ruchka qoidasini majburiy qiling: bugundan boshlab har yozilgan essayda avval mutlaq so'zlar aylantiriladi, keyin topshiriladi. Bu odat ikki-uch haftada avtomatik bo'lib qoladi.
Kuchli guruhda qo'shimcha: yumshatishni HADDAN OSHIRGAN xatboshi yozdiring (har gapda "maybe", "perhaps", "some people think"), keyin uni o'zlari tuzatsin — teskari xatoni ko'rish juda foydali.
4-mashqdagi tuzatilgan xatboshi to'liq holda doskada qolsin: uyga vazifada o'quvchilar aynan shu namunaga qarab o'z xatboshisini yozadi.

Namuna essay tuzilishi: "Discuss both views" savolida 4-xatboshi — o'z fikringiz xatboshisi. Murosa sharti (soliqdan tushgan pul o'sha jamoaga qaytarilsa) shu yerda asoslanadi, shuning uchun unda misol (subsidised school meals) bor. Alohida xulosa xatboshisi yozilsa, u faqat umumlashtiradi — yangi dalil kiritilmaydi.
mistakes: "Everyone knows" dalil emas, dalil yo'qligining belgisi
Fikringiz aniq: I believe / In my view
Yumshoq xulosa "It depends" ga aylanadi, bu 6.0 belgisi
several studies suggest, a number of cities
Bitta sabab da'vosi eng oson yiqiladigan da'vo
"Poor people do not care" emas, "fresh food is often expensive" — TR ham, ohang ham saqlanadi

how: CORE — shu darsdagi namuna essay va mashqlardan olingan 14 ta so'z va ibora. Namuna essay tahlilidan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing: har o'quvchi ro'yxatdan 2 ta ibora olib, soliq yoki sog'liq mavzusida bitta yumshatilgan gap tuzadi.
core: Try not to overgeneralise about young people in your essay.
Essayingizda yoshlar haqida haddan tashqari umumlashtirmaslikka harakat qiling.
People tend to buy less when prices rise quickly.
Narxlar tez oshganda odamlar odatda kamroq xarid qiladi.
A tax on sugary drinks is likely to change shopping habits.
Shirin ichimliklarga soliq xarid odatlarini o'zgartirishi ehtimoli katta.
The new rules appear to have little effect on older shoppers.
Yangi qoidalar keksa xaridorlarga kam ta'sir qilayotganga o'xshaydi.
Some evidence suggests that sugar taxes change buying habits.
Ba'zi dalillar shakar solig'i xarid odatlarini o'zgartirishini ko'rsatadi.
Several cities have introduced a levy on sweetened drinks.
Bir qancha shaharlar shirin ichimliklarga maxsus soliq joriy qilgan.
Sugar consumption among teenagers has fallen in some countries.
Ba'zi mamlakatlarda o'smirlar orasida shakar iste'moli kamaygan.
A sudden rise in food prices can cause hardship for large families.
Oziq-ovqat narxining keskin oshishi katta oilalar uchun moddiy qiyinchilik tug'dirishi mumkin.
Subsidised school meals help children from poorer families eat well.
Davlat hisobidan arzonlashtirilgan maktab ovqatlari kambag'alroq oilalar bolalariga yaxshi ovqatlanishga yordam beradi.
Low-income households often spend a large share of their money on food.
Kam daromadli oilalar ko'pincha pulining katta qismini oziq-ovqatga sarflaydi.
Processed food is usually cheaper but higher in salt and sugar.
Qayta ishlangan oziq-ovqat odatda arzonroq, lekin tuz va shakari ko'proq.
A single tax is not a complete remedy for poor diets.
Birgina soliq noto'g'ri ovqatlanishga to'liq chora emas.
Low prices and healthy food are not incompatible goals.
Arzon narx va sog'lom ovqat bir-biriga zid maqsadlar emas.
A careful claim is more defensible than an absolute one.
Ehtiyotkor da'voni himoya qilish mutlaq da'voga qaraganda osonroq.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Hedging to'plami — sakkiz vosita
class_ex.type: Yozma, 15 daqiqa (jadval doskada to'ldiriladi va daftarga ko'chiriladi)
class_ex.instr: Doskadagi uch ustunli jadval birga to'ldiriladi va daftarga ko'chiriladi. Bu jadval butun kurs davomida ishlatiladi.
class_ex.answers: Jadvalning uchala ustuni ham javob — o'quvchi daftarida aynan shu ko'rinishda bo'lishi kerak. Uchinchi ustundagi sakkiz gapning HAMMASI namuna essaydan olingan, shuning uchun ustoz jadvalni to'ldirgach aytadi: "bu gaplarni bugun essayning o'zida topasiz". Tekshirish usuli: ustoz "ehtimoli yuqori" deydi, o'quvchi "are likely to" deb javob beradi va misolini aytadi.
class_ex.note: Sakkiztasini yod olish shart emas — daftarda tursin va har essay yozilganda ochib ishlatilsin. Ikki-uch haftada o'zi yodda qoladi.
head: Vosita
Ma'nosi (o'zbekcha)
Misol — namuna essaydan olingan gap
rows: Ko'pincha shunday bo'ladi, lekin doim emas
consumption tends to fall, at least in the short term
taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices
Rates of diet-related illness have risen sharply in many middle-income countries
particularly in areas where fresh food is expensive
cheap processed food is often the only realistic option
a higher price may cause real hardship
this effect appears to be strongest among younger buyers
Several cities ... have reported a measurable drop in sales

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Mutlaq da'voni qayta yozing
class_ex.type: Yozma, juftlikda, 15 daqiqa (12 daqiqa yozish + 3 daqiqa doskada tekshirish)
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi mutlaq gapni yumshatib qayta yozing. Fikrni TASHLAMANG — faqat himoyalanadigan qilib aniqlashtiring.
items: All young people today eat fast food every day.
Everyone knows that exercise prevents disease.
Sugar taxes never work.
People in poor areas cannot cook.
Advertising is the only reason children want sweets.
The government always ignores public health.
Fast food causes obesity.
Nobody reads nutrition labels.
answers: Many young people eat fast food several times a week.
Regular exercise is widely believed to reduce the risk of several diseases.
Sugar taxes alone rarely produce a large change in behaviour.
Families in low-income areas often have less time and less access to fresh ingredients.
Advertising is one of the strongest influences on what children ask for.
Governments have often been slow to act on public health.
A diet based mainly on fast food is one of the main causes of obesity.
Relatively few shoppers read nutrition labels carefully.
why: "All" va "every day" — ikkalasi ham bitta istisno bilan yiqiladi.
"Everyone knows" dalil o'rnini bosmaydi; "reduce the risk" aniqroq va to'g'riroq.
Fikr o'sha, lekin "alone" doirani ko'rsatdi, "rarely" mutlaqlikni oldi.
Odamni ayblash emas, sharoitni tasvirlash — TR ham ko'tariladi.
"The only reason" — eng oson yiqiladigan da'vo turi.
"always" -> "often", ustiga zamon ham aniqlashdi.
Sabab zanjiri aniqlashtirildi, bitta mahsulot ayblanmadi.
"Nobody" -> o'lchovli miqdor; "carefully" da'voni yanada aniqlashtiradi.
class_ex.note: Kalitdagi gaplar — NAMUNA (bittasi): fikr saqlangan va da'vo himoyalangan bo'lsa, boshqa vosita bilan yozilgan variant ham qabul qilinadi. Har juftlik bittasini doskaga yozadi. Tekshirishda ikki savol beriladi: 1) fikr saqlanib qoldimi? 2) endi bu gapni yiqitib bo'ladimi?

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Bu gap xavflimi yoki xavfsizmi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz gapni o'qiydi, o'quvchi 3 soniya ichida "xavfli" yoki "xavfsiz" deb javob beradi va sababini bitta jumlada aytadi.
items: Technology has changed the way we shop.
Everybody agrees that homework is useless.
Most students find it hard to concentrate at home.
Poor people do not care about their health.
Sugary drinks are sold in almost every country.
Any tax will immediately reduce consumption.
In many countries, fresh food costs more than processed food.
Children today are completely addicted to screens.
Cycling is safer than driving.
Working hours have increased in some sectors.
why: Umumiy, lekin bahssiz va tekshiriladigan fakt.
"Everybody agrees" isbotsiz; ustiga "useless" bo'sh baho.
"Most" o'lchovli — da'vo himoyalangan.
Ham mutlaq, ham hurmatsiz umumlashtirish — TR ni tushiradi.
Faktik da'vo, "almost" bilan yanada xavfsiz.
Ikkita mutlaq so'z birga: "any" va "immediately".
Doirasi ko'rsatilgan: "in many countries".
"Completely addicted" — tibbiy atama bo'sh ishlatilgan.
Qayerda, qanday sharoitda — ko'rsatilmagan, solishtiruvning o'zi ham bahsli; bu gap 5-mashqda tuzatiladi.
"Some sectors" doirani cheklaydi.
class_ex.note: Kartochkalar shu mashqda ishlatiladi. Gap "xavfli" deb topilgach, juftlik o'sha mutlaq so'z kartochkasini ko'taradi va orqa tomonidagi almashtiruvchisini ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (Everybody uchun "everyone" kartochkasi ishlatiladi). To'plamda yo'q so'zlar ham bor — "any tax", "immediately", "do not care": ularda kartochka ko'tarilmaydi, o'quvchi almashtiruvchisini o'zi aytadi (some taxes, over time, have less time and money). Ustoz bu uchtasini oldindan bilib tursin.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Xatboshidan overgeneralisation'larni toping
class_ex.type: Yozma, juftlikda, 15 daqiqa — namuna essay tahlilidan KEYIN bajariladi (darsning yakuniy mashqi)
class_ex.instr: Quyidagi besh gap — bitta zaif xatboshi (ketma-ket o'qilsa, to'liq xatboshi chiqadi). Har gapdagi mutlaq iborani qizil bilan aylantiring va tuzatilgan variantini yozing.
items: 1-gap: Everyone knows that office work is destroying our health.
2-gap: All office workers sit for eight hours and never move.
3-gap: This always leads to serious illness.
4-gap: Companies do nothing about the problem.
5-gap: Therefore, the only solution is to ban desk jobs.
answers: Mutlaq: "Everyone knows" va "destroying". Tuzatilgani: There is growing evidence that long periods of sitting at work can damage health.
Mutlaq: "All" va "never". Tuzatilgani: Many office workers sit for most of the day and move very little.
Mutlaq: "always" va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sabab. Tuzatilgani: Over time, this is likely to increase the risk of serious illness.
Mutlaq: "do nothing". Tuzatilgani: Employers, however, have often been slow to respond.
Mutlaq: "the only solution" va amalga oshmaydigan taklif. Tuzatilgani: A more practical response would be to redesign the working day so that staff move regularly.
why: Da'vo saqlandi, lekin endi dalil tilida yozilgan.
Miqdor realga aylandi, da'vo tekshiriladigan bo'ldi.
Sabab o'rniga ehtimollik — himoyalangan da'vo.
Ayblovdan kuzatuvga o'tildi; bog'lovchi gap ichiga kirdi.
Xulosa real taklifga aylandi.
class_ex.note: ZAIF XATBOSHI to'liq holda (ustoz aynan shuni doskaga yozadi yoki A4 da tarqatadi, javoblarsiz): "Everyone knows that office work is destroying our health. All office workers sit for eight hours and never move. This always leads to serious illness. Companies do nothing about the problem. Therefore, the only solution is to ban desk jobs." Qizil aylanadigan 7 ta ibora aniq: 1) Everyone knows 2) is destroying 3) All 4) never 5) always 6) do nothing 7) the only solution — o'quvchi shu yettitasini topsa, mashq bajarilgan. TUZATILGAN XATBOSHI ketma-ket o'qilganda: "There is growing evidence that long periods of sitting at work can damage health. Many office workers sit for most of the day and move very little. Over time, this is likely to increase the risk of serious illness. Employers, however, have often been slow to respond. A more practical response would be to redesign the working day so that staff move regularly." Ustoz uni doskaga yozib, dars oxirigacha qoldiradi (uyga vazifa uchun namuna).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Da'voni tashlamang — doirasini ko'rsating
class_ex.type: Yozma, 10 daqiqa — timeline bo'yicha 3-mashqdan keyin, 4-mashqdan OLDIN bajariladi
class_ex.instr: Bu safar yumshatish emas, ANIQLASHTIRISH: kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan. Har gapga kamida bitta doira qo'shing.
items: Public transport is cheap.
Students learn better in the morning.
Home cooking is healthier.
Sport is good for teenagers.
The tax will reduce obesity.
Cycling is safer than driving.
Everyone should walk to work.
answers: Public transport is relatively cheap in most large cities, though not in smaller towns.
Many students concentrate better in the morning, particularly in the first two hours of the day.
Meals cooked at home are usually lower in salt and sugar than ready-made alternatives.
Regular team sport appears to improve both fitness and social confidence among teenagers.
On its own, the tax is unlikely to reduce obesity, but it may slow the rise in consumption.
Cycling on separate cycle lanes is considerably safer than cycling on roads shared with cars.
Where distances allow, walking to work is one of the easiest ways to stay active.
why: Doira: qayerda. Istisno ham aytildi.
Doira: kim va qachon.
"Healthier" nimaga nisbatan — solishtiruv aniqlashtirildi.
Bo'sh "good" o'rniga ikkita aniq foyda.
Kutilgan natija kamtarona, shuning uchun ishonarli.

Doira qo'shildi (qayerda — alohida velosiped yo'laklarida) va solishtiruv aniqlashtirildi: "safer than driving" statistikada himoyalanmaydi (bir xil masofada velosipedchi ko'pincha ko'proq xavf ostida), yo'lak va aralash yo'l solishtiruvi esa himoyalanadi.
Buyruq shartli tavsiyaga aylandi.
class_ex.note: To'rt savolni doskada saqlang: KIM? QAYERDA? QACHON? NIMAGA NISBATAN? Har da'voni shu to'rt savoldan o'tkazish — bu darsning asosiy odati. Kalitdagi gaplar — NAMUNA: boshqa aniq doira (kim, qayerda, qachon, nimaga nisbatan) qo'shilgan to'g'ri gap ham qabul qilinadi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — hedging amalda
readings.qtype: Jony Academy namuna essayi, Band 7.5 darajasi
readings.source: Jony Academy uchun yangidan yozilgan (286 so'z). Essayda ataylab kamida 14 ta yumshatish va aniqlashtirish vositasi bor: o'quv maqsadida zich yozilgan (2-xatboshida 7 ta), vositalarni ko'rish oson bo'lsin deb. O'z yozuvingizda 5-6 gapli xatboshiga 3-4 ta vosita yetarli.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people think that governments should place heavy taxes on fast food and sugary drinks in order to improve public health. Others believe that such taxes punish ordinary families and achieve very little. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Rates of diet-related illness have risen sharply in many middle-income countries over the past two decades, and taxing fast food and sweetened drinks is often proposed as a remedy. Although such taxes are unlikely to solve the problem on their own, I believe that they can form a useful part of a wider public health strategy.

Supporters of taxation point to price sensitivity. Where a product becomes noticeably more expensive, consumption tends to fall, at least in the short term, and this effect appears to be strongest among younger buyers, who usually have the least money to spend. Several cities that have introduced a levy on sweetened drinks have reported a measurable drop in sales, and a number of manufacturers have responded by reducing the sugar content of their products rather than losing customers. Even a modest change of this kind, repeated across millions of purchases, is likely to matter more than campaigns that simply ask people to eat better.

Critics, however, raise a fair objection. A flat tax takes a larger share of income from poorer households, particularly in areas where fresh food is expensive or difficult to obtain. In such neighbourhoods a higher price may cause real hardship without changing behaviour very much, since cheap processed food is often the only realistic option. Taxation on its own, in other words, tends to treat the symptom rather than the cause.

In my view, these two positions are not incompatible. A tax is most defensible when the money it raises is returned to the communities that pay it, for instance through subsidised school meals or support for local markets. Used in this way, taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices without leaving low-income families worse off.
paraphrases: taxing fast food and sweetened drinks / a levy on sweetened drinks
a wider public health strategy / encourage healthier choices
takes a larger share of income from poorer households
unlikely to solve the problem on their own
glossary: flat tax — hamma uchun bir xil stavkali soliq

tasks.title: Essaydagi yumshatish vositalarini toping
tasks.instr: Har qatorni essaydan topib, qizil bilan aylantiring. Uchinchi ustunni avval o'quvchilar o'zi to'ldiradi, keyin solishtiriladi.
tasks.answers: Jadvalning ikkinchi va uchinchi ustunlari javob. Qolgan 4 vosita (jami 14 ta) 1-mashq jadvalida YO'Q — o'quvchi ularni mustaqil topadi: "is often proposed as a remedy" (often — chastota), "they can form a useful part of" (can — imkoniyat; "will solve" deyilmagan), "without changing behaviour very much" (natija yumshatilgan: "at all" emas), "A tax is most defensible when the money it raises is returned ..." (when + shart — da'vo doirasi). Qabul qilinadi ham: "over the past two decades" (vaqt doirasi), "Where a product becomes noticeably more expensive" (shart bilan doira). 1-mashq jadvalidagi ikki misol — "in many middle-income countries" va "taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices" — ham shu essaydan: ularni aylantirgan o'quvchi to'g'ri qilgan, lekin ular 14 talik sanoqqa kirmaydi (1-mashqda tayyor berilgan).
tasks.note: Kim 12 tadan ko'p topsa — maqtang. 14 tasining hammasi topilishi shart emas, muhimi: o'quvchi endi bu vositalarni matnda KO'RADI. MUHIM OGOHLANTIRISH: essaydagi "I believe" va "In my view" yumshatish vositasi EMAS — bu pozitsiya belgisi va u ataylab aniq qoldirilgan. Kimdir ularni qizil bilan aylantirsa, darhol to'g'rilang: pozitsiya aniq, da'volar yumshoq. "For instance" ham yumshatish emas — u misol keltirish vositasi.
