tasks.title: Agar mutlaq yozilganda nima bo'lardi?
tasks.instr: Chapda essaydagi gap, o'ngda uning mutlaq varianti. Har juftlikda so'rang: qaysi birini yiqitish oson?
items: Such taxes are unlikely to solve the problem on their own.
Consumption tends to fall, at least in the short term.
This effect appears to be strongest among younger buyers.
A higher price may cause real hardship without changing behaviour very much.
Cheap processed food is often the only realistic option.
Taxation is likely to encourage healthier choices.
answers: Mutlaq varianti: Such taxes do not work.
Mutlaq varianti: Consumption always falls when prices rise.
Mutlaq varianti: This effect is strongest among young people.
Mutlaq varianti: A higher price only causes hardship.
Mutlaq varianti: Poor people can only eat cheap food.
Mutlaq varianti: Taxation will make everyone healthy.
why: Bunday yozilsa, keyingi xatboshida soliqni yoqlash o'z-o'ziga zid bo'lib qolardi.
Bitta shahar misoli bu da'voni yiqitadi.
Dalilsiz qat'iy da'vo — tekshiruvchi "qayerdan bilasiz?" deb so'raydi.
"Only" bilan qarshi tomonning haqiqati yo'qoladi.
Hurmatsiz umumlashtirish: TR ni ham, ohangni ham buzadi.
Isbotlab bo'lmaydigan va'da — xulosani zaiflashtiradi.
tasks.note: XULOSA (doskaga yoziladi): yumshatilgan gapni yiqitib bo'lmaydi, mutlaq gapni bitta misol yiqitadi. Shuning uchun hedging — kuchsizlik emas, himoya.

homework_intro: Bugun biz bitta narsani o'rgandik: mutlaq da'vo himoyasiz, aniqlashtirilgan da'vo esa mustahkam — uyda xuddi shuni o'z yozuvingizda qilasiz.

Birinchi vazifa: 2-mashqdagi sakkiz mutlaq gapni ko'chirib, har birini BOSHQA yo'l bilan yumshating — sinfda ishlatgan vositangizdan farqli vosita tanlang (sinfda "many" ishlatgan bo'lsangiz, uyda "tend to" yoki "in most cases" bo'lsin) — 15 daqiqa; shunda ikki xil variant yonma-yon turadi.

Ikkinchi vazifa: 35-darsdagi mock Writing essayingizni yoki 36-44-darslarda daftarga yozgan xatboshilaringizni oling (jami kamida 150 so'z), qizil ruchka bilan HAMMA mutlaq so'zni aylantiring (all, every, everyone, always, never, only, nobody, completely) va har birining yoniga almashtiruvchisini yozing; nechta topganingizni varaq chetiga raqam qilib yozib qo'ying.

Uchinchi vazifa: bugungi savolga (tez tayyor ovqat va shirin ichimliklarga soliq) bitta body xatboshi yozing — 5-6 gap, ichida 3-4 ta (kamida uchta) turli yumshatish vositasi bo'lsin; doskadagi tuzatilgan namunaga qarab yozing.
Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — hamma gapni "maybe" bilan boshlab yuborish; yodda tuting: pozitsiyangiz aniq, da'volaringiz yumshoq.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; men ayniqsa qizil aylanalar soniga va xatboshidagi turli vositalarga (kamida uchta) qarayman.

homework.title: Sakkiz gapni ikkinchi yo'l bilan yumshating
homework.instr: Sakkiz mutlaq gapni ko'chiring va har birini sinfdagidan BOSHQA vosita bilan qayta yozing. Sinfdagi variantni yoniga yozib qo'ying, ikkalasi ko'rinib tursin.
homework.answers: Sinfdagi namunalar 2-mashqda. Tekshiruv oson: har gapda ikki xil variant bo'lsin va ulardagi vosita bir xil bo'lmasin. Masalan "All young people today eat fast food every day" uchun sinfda "Many young people eat fast food several times a week", uyda "Young people tend to eat fast food more often than their parents did". Asl fikr ikkala variantda ham saqlanishi shart.

homework.title: O'z essayingdagi mutlaq so'zlarni ovlang
homework.instr: 35-darsdagi mock Writing essayingizni yoki 36-44-darslarda daftarga yozgan xatboshilaringizni oling (jami kamida 150 so'z), hamma mutlaq so'zni qizil bilan aylantiring va yoniga almashtiruvchisini yozing. Topilgan sonni varaq chetiga yozing.
homework.answers: Ovlanadigan so'zlar ro'yxati: all, every, everyone, everybody, always, never, nobody, only, completely, totally, impossible. Almashtiruvchilar: most, many, usually, tend to, rarely, seldom, few, one of the main, largely, unlikely to. 250 so'zlik essayda odatda 4-8 ta topiladi.

homework.title: Bitta body xatboshi yozing
homework.instr: Bugungi savol bo'yicha (soliq tarafdori yoki unga qarshi) 5-6 gapli xatboshi yozing. Ichida 3-4 ta (kamida uchta) turli yumshatish vositasi bo'lsin va ular ostiga chizilsin.
homework.answers: Namuna — 4-mashqdagi tuzatilgan xatboshi (unda beshala gap asli mutlaq edi, shuning uchun deyarli har gapda bittadan vosita bor) va namuna essayning 2-xatboshisi (u o'quv maqsadida ataylab zich yozilgan, 7 ta vosita). Tekshiruv: kamida uchta vosita TURLI XIL bo'lsin (masalan tend to, particularly in, may); bitta vosita uch marta takrorlansa, bitta deb hisoblanadi. 3-4 ta turli vosita — me'yor; har gapni "maybe"/"perhaps" bilan boshlash yoki pozitsiyani (I believe) yumshatib yuborish — suvli xatboshi belgisi.

normativ: 5-6 gap, kamida 3 xil yumshatish vositasi ostiga chizilgan
Mock essay yoki 36-44-darslardagi xatboshilar (150+ so'z), qizil aylanalar va har biriga almashtiruvchi yozilgan
Har gapda ikki xil variant, vositalari bir xil emas

kahoot.q: Which claim is the easiest to defend in a Task 2 essay?
kahoot.explain: "Many" ni bitta istisno yiqitmaydi; "all", "every", "always" li da'voni bitta misol yiqitadi.

kahoot.q: Choose the hedged version of 'Tourism destroys local traditions.'
kahoot.explain: "can" imkoniyatni bildiradi; qolgan variantlarda mutlaq so'z (always, all, completely) bor.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Older people ___ read printed newspapers more than young people.'
kahoot.explain: Qolip: ega + tend to + fe'lning birinchi shakli; "are tend to" va "tend read" — xato.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'The new law is ___ to reduce the number of road accidents.'
kahoot.explain: Faqat "be likely to + fe'l" qolipi bor; probably, maybe, possibly bu qolipda ishlamaydi.

kahoot.q: Which phrase should replace 'Everyone knows that ...' in an academic essay?
kahoot.explain: "Everyone knows" dalil emas; "It is widely believed that" — ehtiyotkor va rasmiy ifoda.

kahoot.q: In which part of the essay should your own opinion be stated clearly, without hedging?
kahoot.explain: Pozitsiya (I believe / In my view) kirish va xulosada aniq turadi; tashqi dunyo haqidagi da'volar yumshatiladi.

kahoot.q: How many hedging devices are usually enough in a 5-6 sentence body paragraph?
kahoot.explain: 5-6 gapli xatboshida 3-4 ta turli vosita yetarli; har gapni "maybe" bilan boshlash yoki vositalarni qalashtirish xatboshini suvli qiladi.

kahoot.q: A student starts every sentence with 'maybe' or 'perhaps'. What is the effect?
options: The essay gets a higher TR
kahoot.explain: Haddan oshirilgan yumshatish ishonchsizlik belgisi — pozitsiya yo'qoladi va TR tushadi.

kahoot.q: Which phrase limits a claim to a particular PLACE?
kahoot.explain: "in most large cities" da'vo qayerda to'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatadi — bu da'vo doirasi (qualifying).

kahoot.q: Which is a safer way to say 'the only reason'?
options: the one and only true reason
kahoot.explain: Bitta sabab da'vosi eng oson yiqiladi; "one of the main reasons" boshqa sabablarni ham tan oladi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence can safely stay absolute because it is an undisputed fact?
kahoot.explain: Bahssiz ilmiy fakt mutlaq bo'lishi mumkin; odamlarning xatti-harakati haqidagi mutlaq da'vo esa xavfli.

kahoot.q: Why should you avoid invented statistics such as '73% of people ...' in Task 2?
kahoot.explain: O'ylab topilgan raqamni tekshirib bo'lmaydi; o'rniga "several studies suggest" yoki "a number of cities" yozing.

kahoot.q: A government puts a 'levy' on sugary drinks. What is a levy?
kahoot.explain: levy — ma'lum mahsulot yoki faoliyatga qo'yiladigan maxsus soliq, yig'im.

kahoot.q: 'Sugar consumption fell last year.' This means people ...
kahoot.explain: consumption — iste'mol: odamlar qancha yeyishi yoki ichishi.

kahoot.q: Families facing 'hardship' ...
options: struggle to pay for basic needs
work much shorter hours than most
kahoot.explain: hardship — moddiy qiyinchilik: asosiy ehtiyojlarga pul yetmasligi.

kahoot.q: 'Subsidised' school meals are ...
options: partly paid for by the state
cooked at home by the parents
sold at a much higher price
kahoot.explain: subsidised — narxining bir qismini davlat to'laydi, shuning uchun arzonroq.

kahoot.q: 'These two views are not incompatible.' This means the views ...
kahoot.explain: incompatible — bir-biriga zid; "not incompatible" — ikkalasi birga to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: A 'defensible' argument is one that ...
options: no one has ever thought of before
is based only on personal feelings
kahoot.explain: defensible — asosli, himoya qilsa bo'ladigan: dalil bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

kahoot.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'remedy' in 'a remedy for obesity'?
kahoot.explain: remedy — chora, davo (cure, solution); "cause" — sabab, ya'ni teskari ma'no.

kahoot.q: 'Low-income households' are homes where people ...
kahoot.explain: low-income — kam daromadli: oila daromadi o'rtachadan past.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Topic-related Vocabulary
lessons.grammar_topic: Mavzu lug'ati — Task 2 ning doimiy mavzulari uchun aniq so'z va so'z birikmalari (chunk)
lessons.vocab_topic: Noaniq gapdan aniq gapga: sog'liq, atrof-muhit, texnologiya, ta'lim, ish va hukumat lug'ati
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha misol gaplar, so'z banklari va namuna essay Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan; baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) ning Lexical Resource mezoni bo'yicha.
objectives: Task 2 da eng ko'p uchraydigan beshta mavzu oilasini (ta'lim, atrof-muhit, texnologiya, sog'liq, ish va hukumat) nomlash va har biriga tayyor so'z banki tuzish; boshqa oilalar (jinoyat va qonun, jamiyat va oila, madaniyat va media) ham borligini bilish.
Noaniq gapni ("Pollution is very bad") aniq gapga aylantirish: bo'sh sifat o'rniga zarar yoki foydaning nomini yozish.
So'zni yakka emas, CHUNK bo'lib yodlash: "pollution" emas — "to cut air pollution", "to impose strict limits".
O'rinsiz "katta so'z" ballni qanday tushirishini ko'rish va lug'atdan olingan sinonimni birikma bilan tekshirishni o'rganish.
Jony Academy namuna essayidan mavzu lug'atini ajratib olib, daftardagi "So'z banki" bo'limiga ko'chirish.
Dars oxirida har o'quvchining daftarida beshta mavzu bo'yicha to'ldirilgan jadval bo'lishi.
materials: Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi [reading]) — har o'quvchiga 1 ta, o'ng tomonida keng chekka qoldirilgan (essay lug'atini chiqarib yozish uchun).

4-mashq uchun "Mavzu lug'at banki" varaqasi — har juftlikka 1 ta A4: beshta bo'sh qator va to'rt ustun (Mavzu, Muammo, Yechim, Natija). Juftlik faqat o'ziga berilgan 1-2 mavzu qatorini to'ldiradi; ustoz mavzularni darsdan oldin juftliklarga bo'lib qo'yadi.

3-mashq uchun kartochkalar: 10 ta gap alohida qirqilgan (6 tasi xato so'z bilan, 4 tasi to'g'ri) — har 3-4 kishilik guruhga 1 to'plam; ustoz darsdan oldin qirqib keladi. Javoblar kartochkada YOZILMAYDI — ular faqat ustozda (3-mashq ro'yxati).
Doskada dars boshidan turadigan ikki ustun: chapda NOANIQ (very bad, a lot of people, a good thing, do something), o'ngda ANIQ — o'ng ustun 1-mashqda to'ldiriladi.
Ikki rangli marker yoki qalam har o'quvchida: essayda mavzu so'zlari bir rang, bog'lovchilar boshqa rang bilan belgilanadi (7-bosqich).
Har o'quvchining daftarida "So'z banki" bo'limi: oxirgi besh sahifa shu darsda ajratiladi va uyga vazifada davom etadi.
timeline: Doskaga ikki gap yoziladi — "This is very important thing for family." va "For many families, this financial security is the decisive consideration." — qaysi biri yuqori va NEGA

NOANIQ/ANIQ ustunlari ochiladi; "Parks mitigate the quality of city life" (XATO — ma'no buzilgan) va "Parks improve the quality of city life" doskada yoziladi; "ameliorate" kabi kitobiy, lekin to'g'ri so'z xato emasligi, faqat "tackle" tabiiyroq ekani aytiladi
Beshta mavzu oilasi va chunk qoidasi
Muammo, yechim, natija — uch qator; chunk misollari doskaga yoziladi
Avval o'quvchilar urinadi, keyin namuna beriladi
Og'zaki, zanjir bo'yicha; har javob daftarga birikma holida yoziladi
Kartochkalar guruhlarga tarqatiladi, guruh xatoni topadi
5 daq ovoz chiqarib o'qish, 5 daq ikki rangda belgilash, 10 daq ikkita task (lug'at jadvali va "xuddi shu fikr noaniq aytilsa")
Har juftlik 1-2 mavzu qatorini to'ldiradi (9-18 ibora), keyin doskada besh qator birlashtiriladi
Har gapda kamida ikkita chunk; bir nechtasi ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi
Har daftarda "So'z banki" bo'limi ochilgani tekshiriladi; uchala vazifa va coin qiymati aytiladi

intro: Lexical Resource — to'rt mezondan biri, ya'ni bahoning to'rtdan biri. 37-darsdagi A essay aynan shu mezonda 6.0 olgan edi: ma'no tushunarli, lekin "important" va "useful" takrorlangan.
Tekshiruvchi QIYIN so'zni emas, ANIQ so'zni qidiradi. "The decisive consideration" ifodasi "very important thing" dan yuqori turadi, chunki u aniqroq — qiyinroq bo'lgani uchun emas.

Task 2 savollari cheksiz emas: ular bir necha mavzu oilasi atrofida aylanadi. Bugun eng ko'p uchraydigan beshtasi bilan ishlaymiz: ta'lim, atrof-muhit, texnologiya, sog'liq, ish va hukumat. Boshqa tez-tez chiqadigan oilalar ham bor — jinoyat va qonun, jamiyat va oila, madaniyat va media; ular uchun ham bank xuddi shu usulda (muammo — yechim — natija) tuziladi.

Har mavzuda uch qator so'z kerak: MUAMMONING nomi (traffic congestion), YECHIMNING nomi (to expand public transport), NATIJANING nomi (cleaner air, lower fuel costs). Uch qator to'liq bo'lsa, xatboshi o'zidan yoziladi.
So'z yakka holda yodlanmaydi. "Awareness" so'zini bilish foyda bermaydi; "to raise public awareness of the risks" — bu ishlaydigan birlik. Shuning uchun daftarga yakka so'z emas, chunk yoziladi.

"Katta so'z" tuzog'i: lug'atdan olingan, lekin o'rni emas. "Parks mitigate the quality of city life" — "mitigate" faqat yomon narsani yengillashtiradi (mitigate the effects of pollution), o'quvchi esa "improve" demoqchi edi. Gap ma'no jihatdan XATO; to'g'risi "Parks improve the quality of city life". Bunday xato LR ni ko'tarmaydi, TUSHIRADI. Kitobiy, lekin to'g'ri so'z ("ameliorate the pollution problem", "utilise funds") esa xato emas — shunchaki oddiyroq "tackle pollution", "use funds" tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
Takrorlanish ham ballni ushlab turadi. Bitta tushuncha uchun uchta ifoda tayyor bo'lsin: problem — issue — challenge; important — significant — crucial.
Aniq so'z grammatikani ham yengillashtiradi: "damage public health" deb yozgan o'quvchiga uzun tushuntiruvchi gap kerak bo'lmaydi, demak xato qilish ehtimoli ham kamayadi.
Imtihonda so'z o'ylab topilmaydi — tayyori chiqadi. Shuning uchun bank dars davomida tuziladi va har hafta to'ldirib boriladi.
formulas: "This is very important thing for family." / "For many families, this financial security is the decisive consideration."
raise awareness, impose limits, ease pressure
Ta'lim, muhit, texnologiya, sog'liq, ish va hukumat
Uyga vazifa aynan shu bo'limda davom etadi
presentation: Qancha so'z yodlashim kerak?
Har mavzuga 20-25 ta ibora yetadi. Beshta mavzu — 100-125 ibora; bu bir oylik ish, imtihongacha ulguriladi.
Sinonim lug'atidan olsam bo'ladimi?
Olish mumkin, lekin birikmasini tekshirmasdan ishlatmang. "Make a mistake" bor, "do a mistake" yo'q — lug'at buni aytmaydi.
Katta so'z ishlatmasam ball tushadimi?

Aniq va o'rinli oddiy so'z ballni tushirmaydi. Lekin LR 7 uchun bir nechta kamroq uchraydigan ibora ham kerak va ular to'g'ri birikmada bo'lishi shart (masalan "a sedentary lifestyle", "overstretched hospitals"); o'rinsiz qiyin so'z esa ballni tushiradi.
Bir so'zni necha marta ishlatsam bo'ladi?
Bitta xatboshida bir marta yetarli. Ikkinchi marta kerak bo'lsa, ikkinchi ifodani ishlating — shuning uchun har tushunchaga uchta variant tayyorlaymiz.
Idioma va maqol yozsam bo'ladimi?
Task 2 rasmiy yozuv. "Every cloud has a silver lining" kabi iboralar bu yerda o'rinsiz va ballni tushiradi.
Mavzuni umuman bilmasam nima qilaman?
Uch qator qoidasi qutqaradi: muammoni nomlang, yechimni nomlang, natijani nomlang. Maxsus bilim talab qilinmaydi.
So'zni qanday yodlayman?
Chunk holida yozing va yoniga O'ZINGIZNING bitta gapingizni qo'ying. Gapsiz yozilgan so'z bir haftada unutiladi.
Imtihonda mutlaqo yangi mavzu chiqsa-chi?
Beshta oilaning lug'ati ko'chadi: "raise awareness", "impose limits", "long-term benefits" deyarli har mavzuga tushadi.
notes: Bu darsda ishlatilgan mavzular: namuna essay — SOG'LIQNI SAQLASH (davolash va kasallik oldini olish byudjeti); so'z banki — atrof-muhit, texnologiya, ta'lim, ish va hukumat. Ta'lim mavzusi 36 va 37-darslarda universitet yo'nalishini tanlash savolida to'liq ishlatilgan, shuning uchun bu yerda namuna essay ataylab boshqa oiladan olindi.
36-dars savol turlarini, 37-dars mezonlarni bergan. Bu dars faqat LEXICAL RESOURCE ustida ishlaydi — mezonlarni qaytadan tushuntirmang, kerak bo'lsa 37-darsdagi kartochkalarga ishora qiling.
Eng muhim daqiqa — 1-mashq. O'quvchilar avval o'zi urinib ko'rmasa, namuna ta'sir qilmaydi. Namunani vaqtidan oldin aytmang.
3-mashqdagi kartochkalar aniq maqsad uchun: o'quvchi "qiyin so'z = yuqori ball" degan ishonchdan voz kechishi kerak. Guruh xatoni topgandan keyin ustoz to'g'ri birikmani doskaga yozadi.
4-mashqdagi jadval — darsning mahsuloti. Juftliklar to'ldirgandan keyin doskada BITTA umumiy jadval yig'iladi va hamma o'z daftariga ko'chiradi. Shu jadval keyingi Writing darslarida ishlatiladi.
Kuchli guruhda 5-mashqda har o'quvchidan ikkita gap so'rang; zaif guruhda bitta gap yetarli, lekin ikkita chunk shart.

3-mashq collocation ga yaqin, lekin bugungi maqsad boshqa: o'rinsiz "katta so'z" ni ko'rsatish. Collocation to'liq 47-darsda ishlanadi — bu yerda cho'zmang: olti xatoni toping, to'g'ri variantini doskaga yozing va o'ting.
Ustoz diqqati: o'quvchi ilmiy atama to'plashga tushib ketmasin. "A heart attack" yozilsa yetarli, "myocardial infarction" kerak emas va g'alati ko'rinadi.
mistakes: "make a mistake" bor, "do a mistake" yo'q

how: CORE — shu darsdagi namuna essay va so'z bankidan olingan 14 ta ibora. 4-mashqdan KEYIN ko'rib chiqing: har o'quvchi ro'yxatdan 2 ta iborani chunk holida o'z so'z bankiga yozadi va yoniga o'z gapini qo'yadi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Noaniq gapni aniq qiling
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi gap noaniq. Uni o'ngdagidek qayta yozing: bo'sh sifat o'rniga zarar yoki foydaning nomini yozing. Avval o'zlari urinib ko'rishsin.
items: Pollution in big cities is very bad.
Technology has changed our life a lot.
The government must do something about health.
Many people are poor and it is a big problem.
Factories make the environment dirty.
Online learning is a good thing for students.
Fast food is bad for people.
Working from home has many advantages.
answers: Air pollution in many major cities has reached levels that damage public health.
Mobile technology has changed the way families keep in touch and the way people work.
The government should fund regular screening and nationwide vaccination campaigns.
A significant proportion of the population lives on a low and unstable income.
Poorly regulated factories release untreated waste into rivers and emit smoke into the air.
Online courses give students in remote areas access to qualified teachers.
A diet high in processed food raises the risk of obesity and heart disease.
Working from home removes the daily commute and gives employees more control over their hours.
why: "very bad" hech nima demaydi; "damage public health" aniq zararni aytadi.
"a lot" o'rniga NIMA o'zgargani yozildi.
"do something" — bo'sh; o'rniga ikkita aniq chora.
Miqdor va holat nomlandi.
"dirty" bolalarcha so'z; sanoat lug'ati aniqroq. "Poorly regulated" da'vo doirasini ko'rsatadi — hamma zavod emas.
"a good thing" o'rniga aniq foyda.
Tibbiy aniqlik; "bad" ketdi.
"many advantages" o'rniga ikkita aniq afzallik.
class_ex.note: Qoida: gapda "very + oddiy sifat" yoki "a lot of" uchrasa, gap noaniq. Uni qisqartirmang — OCHIB BERING. Doskadagi ANIQ ustuni shu mashqda to'ladi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Chunkni to'ldiring
class_ex.instr: Tushib qolgan so'zni toping. Javobni yakka so'z emas, BUTUN BIRIKMA holida daftarga yozing.
items: to raise public ___ of the risks of smoking
to ___ strict limits on factory emissions
traffic ___ in the city centre
to ___ the gap between rich and poor
to ___ the pressure on overcrowded hospitals
___ energy such as wind and solar
a ___ workforce that can use new software
to ___ waste at source
to ___ funding to prevention rather than treatment
long-term ___ for the whole economy
why: "raise awareness of" — tayyor birikma; sog'liq va muhit mavzularida ishlaydi.
"impose limits", "impose a ban", "impose a fine" — hukumat choralari lug'ati.
"traffic jam" og'zaki; "traffic congestion" yozuv uchun.
"narrow the gap" yoki "close the gap"; "make the gap small" emas.
"ease the pressure on" — sog'liq mavzusining asosiy chunki.
"renewable energy sources" — atrof-muhit yechimlari qatorida birinchi turadi.
"a skilled workforce" — ish va texnologiya mavzularini bog'laydi.
"reduce waste at source" — "recycle" dan kuchliroq yechim.
"Allocate funding to" — pulni aniq maqsadga ajratish. "Utilise money" xato emas, lekin kitobiy va noodatiy; bu gapda "allocate" eng aniq.
"long-term benefits" — deyarli har mavzuning natija qatoriga tushadi.
class_ex.note: Kalitda birinchi so'z — darsdagi asosiy chunk; "/" dan keyingilari ham to'g'ri va qabul qilinadi. Har javob daftarga to'liq birikma bo'lib yoziladi va yoniga o'quvchining O'Z gapi qo'shiladi. Yakka so'z yozilgan daftar tekshirilmaydi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Katta so'z tuzog'i
class_ex.instr: Kartochkadagi gapni o'qing. So'z o'rinlimi yoki yo'qmi? Xato bo'lsa, to'g'ri variantni ayting.
items: Traffic fumes exacerbate the health of city residents.
Cars emit harmful gases into the atmosphere.
Smoking gives many illnesses to people.
This policy would benefit low-income families.
Technology is developing in a very fast speed.
Plastic waste has a detrimental effect on marine life.
The company did a big investment in green energy.
Governments should invest more money on prevention.
Obesity is becoming a serious public health concern.
Schools must inculcate students with computer skills.
answers: XATO — to'g'risi: traffic fumes damage the health of city residents (yoki: traffic fumes exacerbate breathing problems among city residents).
XATO — to'g'risi: smoking causes a range of serious illnesses.
XATO — to'g'risi: technology is developing rapidly (yoki: at a rapid pace).
XATO — to'g'risi: the company made a substantial investment.
XATO — to'g'risi: governments should invest more (money) in prevention yoki allocate more funding to prevention.
XATO — to'g'risi: schools must equip students with computer skills.
why: "Exacerbate" faqat YOMON narsani yanada yomonlashtiradi (exacerbate a problem, exacerbate asthma); "health" yomon narsa emas — ma'no buzildi. Bu kitobiy emas, XATO.
"emit gases" — tabiiy va aniq birikma.
"Give an illness" degan birikma yo'q.
"Benefit" to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ob'ekt oladi, predlog kerak emas.

"Speed" bilan "in" emas, "at" ishlatiladi va "fast speed" emas, "high speed" deyiladi (at high speed); eng aniqi — bitta ravish: developing rapidly. O'zbekcha "tez sur'atda" ni so'zma-so'z tarjima qilmang.
"A detrimental effect on" — akademik va o'z joyida.
"Make an investment"; "do" bu yerda ishlamaydi.
"Invest" "in" predlogi bilan ishlatiladi: invest in prevention ("spend money on" bilan aralashtirmang). Eslatma: "utilise money" XATO emas — faqat kitobiy; oddiy "use" yoki "allocate" tabiiyroq.
"A public health concern" — sog'liq mavzusining tayyor ifodasi.
"Inculcate" g'oya va qadriyatlar uchun ishlatiladi (inculcate values), ko'nikma uchun emas; "equip students with skills" — to'g'ri chunk.
class_ex.note: Xulosa doskaga yoziladi: "Qiyin so'z emas, TO'G'RI SO'Z ball beradi". Har to'g'rilangan variant o'quvchining bankiga chunk bo'lib tushadi. Farqlang: XATO — ma'no yoki birikma buzilgan (exacerbate the health, invest on, in a fast speed); KITOBIY — to'g'ri, lekin juda rasmiy yoki noodatiy ("The government must ameliorate the pollution problem", "utilise funds"): bunday so'z xato hisoblanmaydi, lekin oddiy aniq so'z (tackle, use) tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — sog'liq mavzusidagi lug'at ishda
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some governments spend most of their health budget on treating patients in hospitals. Others argue that the money would be better spent on preventing illness before it begins. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
text: Health budgets are limited, and every country has to decide how to divide them. Some administrations put almost everything into hospitals, operating theatres and specialist staff, while others shift a growing share towards prevention. Although spending on emergency care cannot be reduced much, I believe that preventive programmes deserve a far larger proportion of public funding.

The argument for hospital spending is straightforward. When a person suffers a heart attack or a serious injury, no awareness campaign can help them; they need trained surgeons, modern equipment and an intensive care bed within minutes. Countries that have allowed their hospitals to become overstretched now report long waiting lists and exhausted staff, and that damage takes years to repair. Treatment, in other words, is the part of the system that people notice immediately when it fails.

Prevention, however, reduces the number of patients who ever reach that stage. A sedentary lifestyle, cheap processed food and heavy smoking are responsible for a large share of the chronic illnesses that fill hospital wards. Regular screening detects diabetes and several cancers while they are still cheap to treat, and subsidised sports facilities, clear food labelling and taxes on sugary drinks change the behaviour that causes the illness in the first place. These measures are unglamorous, but every patient who is never admitted frees a bed for somebody whose condition could not have been prevented.

In my view, the two forms of spending are not rivals but stages of the same system. Emergency services must be protected, yet a government that continues to fund treatment alone is likely to see the bill rise year after year. Shifting even a modest percentage of the budget into prevention is, ultimately, the cheaper way to keep a population healthy.

emergency care / operating theatres / an intensive care bed
preventive programmes / regular screening / change the behaviour that causes the illness

tasks.note: Muhim xulosa: o'ng ustundagi gaplarda lug'atdan (thesaurus) olingan "katta so'z" yo'q. "A sedentary lifestyle", "overstretched", "chronic illnesses" — mavzuning tabiiy va aniq birikmalari; LR descriptor'idagi "less common lexical items" aynan shunday bo'ladi: to'g'ri birikmada ishlatilgan mavzu so'zlari.

homework_intro: Bugun darsda beshta mavzu uchun so'z bankini birga to'ldirdik va har iborani chunk holida yozdik — uyda shu bankni o'zingiz kengaytirasiz.

Birinchi vazifa: ta'lim, atrof-muhit va texnologiya mavzulari uchun jadvalning uch qatorini daftaringizga ko'chiring va har katakka kamida uch tadan ibora yozing; darsdagi jadvaldan olishingiz mumkin, lekin kamida to'qqiztasi sizning yangi iborangiz bo'lsin — 25 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifa: sakkizta noaniq gapni 1-mashq usulida aniq qilib qayta yozing; har gapda bo'sh sifat o'rniga zarar yoki foydaning nomi tursin — 20 daqiqa.
Uchinchi vazifa: sog'liq mavzusida bitta xatboshi yozing — asosiy fikr, sabab, misol, natija; bankdan olingan kamida to'rtta chunkni ostiga chizib ko'rsating — 20 daqiqa.

Eng ko'p qilinadigan xato — yakka so'z yozib, gapsiz qoldirish; har ibora chunk bo'lsin va bank qatorida sizning bitta gapingiz tursin. Uchala vazifa daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi.

homework.title: Uch mavzu uchun so'z banki

homework.title: Sakkizta noaniq gapni aniq qiling
homework.instr: 1-mashq usulida qayta yozing. Har gapda bo'sh sifat o'rniga zarar yoki foydaning nomi tursin.
items: Cars are very bad for the environment.
Nowadays there are a lot of unemployed young people.
Computers help students very much.

Youth unemployment has risen sharply in towns where factories have closed.

"A lot of" o'rniga o'sish va sabab.
Aniq foyda ko'rsatildi.
Muammo nomlandi (traffic congestion) va oqibati aytildi; o'ylab topilgan raqam ("almost an hour") yozilmaydi — uni tekshirib bo'lmaydi.
Ikkita aniq natija.
Yordamning turi nomlandi.
Xavfning turi nomlandi.
"Very hard" o'rniga ishning aniq sharoiti (long shifts, few breaks) va oqibati nomlandi; to'qima raqam kerak emas.

homework.title: Sog'liq mavzusida bitta xatboshi
homework.instr: Namuna essayning 3-xatboshisi tartibida yozing: asosiy fikr, sabab, misol, natija. Kamida 4 gap. Bankdan olingan 4 ta chunkni ostiga chizing.

kahoot.explain: "alleviate" faqat og'riq, muammo, qashshoqlik kabi yomon narsani yengillashtiradi (alleviate poverty).

kahoot.q: You have used 'problem' three times in one paragraph. What should you do?
kahoot.explain: Har tushunchaga 2-3 ifoda tayyorlang: problem — issue — challenge.

kahoot.q: Is 'Every cloud has a silver lining' a good choice in a Task 2 essay?
kahoot.explain: Task 2 — rasmiy yozuv; maqol va og'zaki idiomalar o'rinsiz va ballni tushiradi.

kahoot.q: A topic bank collects three kinds of words for each topic. Which three?
kahoot.explain: Muammo, yechim va natija nomlari tayyor bo'lsa, xatboshi shu tartibda o'zidan yoziladi.

kahoot.q: For a general reader, which term is best in a Task 2 essay?
kahoot.explain: Oddiy va aniq atama yetarli; ilmiy atama g'alati ko'rinadi va xato ehtimolini oshiradi.

kahoot.q: Which phrase is the best formal replacement for 'a lot of people'?
options: a big amount of the peoples
kahoot.explain: Sanaladigan ot bilan "a large number of" ishlatiladi; "amount" va "much" sanalmaydigan otlar uchun.

kahoot.q: 'Technology is good.' What would make this sentence precise?
kahoot.explain: Bo'sh sifat o'rniga foydaning nomini yozing: masalan "helps farmers check weather forecasts".

kahoot.q: A 'sedentary' lifestyle involves ...
options: a great deal of long-distance travel
kahoot.explain: sedentary — kam harakatli: ko'p o'tirib, kam harakat qilish.

kahoot.q: 'Overstretched' hospitals ...
options: cost much less to run every year
kahoot.explain: overstretched — imkoniyatidan ortiq yuklangan: bemor ko'p, joy va xodim yetmaydi.

kahoot.q: A 'chronic' illness is one that ...
kahoot.explain: chronic — surunkali: uzoq davom etadigan kasallik (masalan, diabet).

kahoot.q: Regular health 'screening' means ...
kahoot.explain: screening — belgilar paydo bo'lmasdan oldin kasallikni aniqlash uchun profilaktik tekshiruv.

kahoot.q: 'Deforestation' is ...
kahoot.explain: deforestation — o'rmonlarni kesib yo'q qilish.

kahoot.q: 'Life expectancy' refers to ...
options: how far people travel to work
kahoot.explain: life expectancy — o'rtacha umr ko'rish davomiyligi.

kahoot.q: 'Youth unemployment' describes ...
options: young people who cannot find work
children who do not go to school at all
kahoot.explain: youth unemployment — yoshlar ishsizligi: ish topa olmayotgan yoshlar.

kahoot.q: 'Vocational courses' mainly teach ...
kahoot.explain: vocational — kasb-hunarga oid: aniq ish uchun amaliy ko'nikma beradi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: The Importance of Collocations
lessons.grammar_topic: Collocation (so'z juftligi) — Lexical Resource mezonining eng ko'p ball yo'qotadigan qismi
lessons.vocab_topic: Shahar transporti va tarixiy markazlarni saqlash — collocation amaliyoti
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — barcha misol gaplar, mashq bandlari va namuna essay shu dars uchun Jony Academy tomonidan yangidan yozilgan; mezon nomlari rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) dan olingan.
objectives: Collocation nima ekanini aniq ta'riflash: grammatikasi to'g'ri, lekin juftligi noto'g'ri gap ham ball yo'qotadi.
Task 2 essayda eng ko'p kerak bo'ladigan uch turni ajratish: fe'l + ot, sifat + ot, ot + ot.
"do a mistake", "make a research" kabi tanish xatolarni topib, to'g'ri juftlik bilan almashtirish.
Gapdagi bo'sh joyga to'g'ri sherik so'zni qo'yish — collocationni eslab qolish emas, ISHLATISH.
Tekshiruvchi noto'g'ri collocationni qanday o'qishini va u qaysi mezonga tushishini tushuntirish.
"Collocation daftari" ni ochib, so'zni yolg'iz emas, juftligi bilan yozib borish tartibini o'rnatish.
materials: 1-mashq uchun kesib tayyorlangan kartochkalar: 20 ta kartochka, har 3-4 kishilik guruhga bitta to'plam. Birinchi o'n tasiga birinchi so'z yoziladi — raise, take, play, heavy, serious, considerable, rush, public, government, city; qolgan o'n tasiga sherigi — awareness, action, a role, traffic, consequences, impact, hour, transport, funding, centre.
2-mashq uchun "Xato collocation" varaqasi — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa: 9 ta gap, har birining ostida bo'sh chiziq.
3-mashq uchun to'ldiriladigan 8 gap chop etilgan varaq — har juftlikka 1 nusxa; fe'llar ro'yxati ALOHIDA qog'ozda, faqat ustozda turadi (ro'yxat 3-mashq izohida yozilgan).
Namuna essay nusxasi (quyidagi [reading] bloki) — har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa, cheti keng bo'lsin: matn ustida belgilanadi. Sinfda 2-3 ta marker bo'lsin.
Doskada dars boshlanishidan oldin yozib qo'yiladigan uch ustun: VERB + NOUN, ADJECTIVE + NOUN, NOUN + NOUN — 1-mashq va 5-mashqda shu ustunlar to'ldiriladi.
Har o'quvchi daftarining oxirgi uch varag'i "Collocation daftari" deb ajratiladi — rangli qalam yoki stiker bilan belgilanadi (uyga vazifa shu yerda yuritiladi).
Uyga vazifadagi 10 ta xato gap — o'quvchi ilovasidagi uyga vazifada ko'rinadi; ilova bo'lmasa, har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa chop etib beriladi (dars oxirida doskaga yozishga vaqt ketmaydi).
timeline: 37-darsdagi LR mezoni eslatiladi; doskada "do a mistake" yozilib, "xatoni toping" deb so'raladi
Collocation nima va nega ball yo'qotadi
Ustoz tushuntiradi: grammatikasi to'g'ri, juftligi begona; qaysi mezonga tushadi

2-mashq: varaqa tarqatiladi, avval yakka, keyin birga tekshiriladi
3-mashq: juftlikda bajariladi, fe'llar ro'yxati faqat tekshiruvda aytiladi
4-mashq: har gap uchun mezon va ball ta'siri jadvalga yoziladi
Essay tarqatiladi, marker bilan belgilanadi, jadval to'ldiriladi
5-mashq: yozma, juftlikda; yaxshi variantlar doskaga chiqadi
Daftar ochiladi, birinchi 5 ta birikma sinfda yoziladi
Uch vazifa tushuntiriladi, 10 ta xato gap varaqda (yoki ilovada) beriladi, daftar namunasi ko'rsatiladi

intro: Collocation — ingliz tilida bir-biri bilan TABIIY yuradigan so'zlar juftligi. Qoidasi yo'q, odati bor: "make a mistake" deyiladi, "do a mistake" deyilmaydi, garchi ikkalasining grammatikasi ham to'g'ri bo'lsa ham.

37-darsda Lexical Resource mezonini ko'rgan edik. Rasmiy jadvalda 7 uchun "An awareness of style and collocation is evident" deyilgan — ya'ni collocation aynan NOM bilan yozilgan talab. 6 qatorida esa tavakkal qilib kam uchraydigan so'z ishlatgan yozuvchida "higher degrees of inaccuracy or inappropriacy" bo'lishi aytiladi: so'z bor-u, sherigi noto'g'ri. Demak 6 va 7 orasidagi chegara ko'p hollarda shu yerdan o'tadi.

Task 2 uchun uch tur yetarli: (1) fe'l + ot — make a mistake, play a role, raise awareness, take action; (2) sifat + ot — heavy traffic, serious consequences, considerable impact, public transport; (3) ot + ot — rush hour, traffic congestion, city centre, government funding.

Noto'g'ri collocation "xato" emas, "begona" bo'lib eshitiladi. Tekshiruvchi uni grammatika xatosi deb emas, SO'Z TANLASH xatosi deb belgilaydi — ya'ni ball Grammatical Range dan emas, Lexical Resource dan tushadi.

Eng qimmat tomoni shu: o'quvchi "kuchli so'z" izlab, birikmani buzadi. "very big problem" o'rniga "huge problem" deyish yaxshi; lekin "strong problem" deyish ballni "very big problem" dan ham pastga tushiradi, chunki bu juftlik ingliz tilida yo'q.
Shuning uchun qoida: ANIQLIK birinchi, kuch ikkinchi. Ishonmasangiz, sodda va to'g'ri juftlikni oling ("a serious problem"), o'ylab topilgan kuchli juftlikni emas.
Collocationni yodlashning yagona ishlaydigan yo'li — so'zni yolg'iz yozmaslik. Daftarga "research" deb emas, "to carry out research on air quality" deb yoziladi: ya'ni butun ibora, o'z gapi bilan.

Bir mavzu oilasi uchun 15-20 ta birikma yetadi. Bugun biz ikkita oila ustida ishlaymiz: shahar transporti va tirbandlik, hamda tarixiy markazlarni saqlash. Boshqa mavzular keyingi darslarda shu usul bilan yig'iladi.
Takrorlash tartibi: yozilgan birikma bir hafta ichida kamida uch marta ishlatilsa qoladi — bir marta gapda, bir marta xatboshida, bir marta essayda. Faqat o'qib chiqish ish bermaydi.
formulas: "He did a mistake." va "He made a mistake."
Har xato qaysi mezondan ball oladi
presentation: Collocationning qoidasi bormi?
Yo'q, qoidasi yo'q — odati bor. Shuning uchun u yodlanmaydi, yig'iladi va ishlatiladi.
"Do a mistake" ni tushunishadi-ku, nega ball tushadi?
Tushunish boshqa, tabiiylik boshqa. Jadvalda 7 uchun "awareness of collocation" deb yozilgan, ya'ni bu alohida talab.
Bu xato grammatikadanmi yoki lug'atdanmi?
Lug'atdan: Lexical Resource. Grammatikangiz toza bo'lsa ham, LR 6 da qolishi mumkin.
Qaysi biri xavfsizroq: oddiy so'zmi yoki kuchli so'zmi?
To'g'ri ishlatilgan oddiy so'z. Noto'g'ri juftlikdagi kuchli so'z ballni ko'taradi deb o'ylamang — tushiradi.
Lug'atdan sinonim olsam bo'ladimi?
Faqat birikmasi bilan ko'rsangiz. Sinonim ro'yxatidan olingan yolg'iz so'z ko'pincha noto'g'ri juftlikka tushadi.
Bir essayda nechta kuchli birikma kerak?
6-10 tasi yetadi (bugungi namuna essayda 10 ta). Hammasi kuchli bo'lsa, matn sun'iy ko'rinadi va xato ehtimoli oshadi.
Collocationni qanday yodlab qolaman?
Yolg'iz so'z emas, butun ibora va o'z gapingiz bilan yoziladi; bir hafta ichida uch marta ishlatiladi.
Mavzular ko'p-ku, hammasiga yetadimi?
Bir mavzu oilasiga 15-20 ta birikma yetarli. Mavzular sekin-asta yig'iladi, bir kunda emas.
Noto'g'ri yozib qo'ysam, o'chirib tashlaymi?
Yo'q — xato juftlikni ustiga chizib, yoniga to'g'risini yozing. Ko'z farqni aynan shunda eslab qoladi.
notes: Bu dars 36 va 37 ni takrorlamaydi: mezonlar u yerda tushuntirilgan, bu yerda faqat Lexical Resource ning bitta qismi — collocation — chuqurlashtiriladi. Mezon jadvalini qayta o'qib bermang, faqat LR qatoridagi "collocation" so'zini ko'rsating.

Mavzu oilasi: shahar transporti va tirbandlik, hamda tarixiy markazlarni saqlash (heritage). Bu mavzular blokda yangi emas: transport 39-41-darslarda, meros va muzeylar 43- va 48-darslarda ham bor (blokdagi boshqa mavzular: jinoyat va jazo — 36, ta'lim — 37, turizm — 38, ish — 42, texnologiya va onlayn xizmatlar — 44, sog'liq — 45-46). Tanish mavzu ataylab olingan: g'oyalar tayyor, shuning uchun diqqat faqat so'z juftligiga qaratiladi. Mashqlardagi hamma gap va namuna essay shu ikki mavzudan.
Ustoz diqqati: o'quvchilar "kuchli so'z" izlab birikmani buzishadi. Har tuzatishda "bu so'z shu ot bilan yuradimi?" deb so'rang, "bu so'z kuchlimi?" deb emas.
3-mashqda fe'llar ro'yxatini OLDINDAN bermang. Ro'yxat bilan bajarilsa mashq tanib olishga aylanadi; ro'yxatsiz bajarilsa eslab chiqarishga aylanadi va foydasi bir necha barobar ko'p.
2-mashqda ataylab bitta TO'G'RI gap qo'yilgan (oxirgi band). Kim uni ham "tuzatsa", demak juftlikni hali his qilmayapti — shu o'quvchi bilan alohida ishlang.
Namuna essayda birikmalar ataylab ajratib ko'rsatilmagan: o'quvchining o'zi topishi kerak. Ustoz avval topib bergan bo'lsa, mashqning ma'nosi qolmaydi.
Collocation daftarini har darsda 2 daqiqa tekshiring. Tekshirilmagan daftar ikki haftada to'xtaydi — buni oldindan biling.
Keyingi darslarda essaylarni tekshirayotganda xato juftlikni "LR" deb belgilang va grammatika xatosidan ajrating. O'quvchi farqni aynan shu belgidan o'rganadi.

Namuna essayning 4-xatboshisi — o'z fikri xatboshisi: unda murosa sharti (avval transport, keyin ta'mir) asoslanadi, shuning uchun u yerda yangi mulohaza ("A restored square surrounded by...") bo'lishi mumkin; xulosa vazifasini esa faqat oxirgi gap ("Once buses and trams run reliably...") bajaradi. 48-darsdagi tuzilmada 4-xatboshi sof xulosa bo'ladi: u yerga yangi dalil kiritilmaydi — pozitsiya takrorlanadi va bir gapda asoslanadi.
mistakes: make a mistake, carry out research
do va make chalkashuvi eng ko'p uchraydi
research va information sanalmaydi: artikl ham, -s ham olmaydi
Sifat otga mos kelishi shart, kuchli bo'lishi emas

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Uch tur — birikmani turiga ajrating
class_ex.type: Og'zaki va kartochka, 15 daqiqa (12 — juftlash, 3 — ustunlarni to'ldirish)
class_ex.instr: Har guruhga 20 ta kartochka beriladi: 10 tasida birinchi so'z, 10 tasida sherigi. Guruh juftlashtiradi, so'ng har birikma doskadagi uchta ustundan biriga yoziladi.
items: raise awareness
take action
play a role
heavy traffic
serious consequences
considerable impact
public transport
rush hour
government funding
city centre
why: "Xabardorlikni oshirmoq". "Up awareness" yoki "open awareness" deyilmaydi.
Artiklsiz ishlatiladi: "take an action" xato.
"Rol o'ynamoq". "Make a role" ingliz tilida yo'q.
"Zich tirbandlik". "Big traffic" ham, "strong traffic" ham emas.
"Jiddiy oqibatlar". "Hard consequences" deyilmaydi.
"Sezilarli ta'sir". "Considerable" ko'pincha impact, amount, expense bilan yuradi.
"Jamoat transporti". public — sifat (ot emas), shuning uchun bu juftlik ikkinchi ustunga (sifat + ot) tushadi.
"Eng gavjum soat". Ikki ot qo'shilib bitta tushuncha beradi.
"Davlat mablag'i". "Government money" ham tushunarli, lekin "funding" rasmiyroq.
Britaniya varianti; amerikacha "downtown" ham IELTS da qabul qilinadi.
class_ex.note: Kartochkalardan boshqa TO'G'RI juftlik ham chiqishi mumkin — "serious impact", "public funding", "government action", "raise funding", "considerable traffic". Ularni xato demang: ustunga qo'shib yozing, chunki maqsad juftlikni his qilish. Faqat "take awareness", "raise action", "rush transport" kabi begona juftliklar tuzatiladi. DIQQAT: "public transport" — sifat + ot (public — sifat), shuning uchun u ikkinchi ustunga tushadi; uchinchi ustun faqat ikkita OT dan iborat juftliklar uchun. Uchta ustun doskada qoladi va 5-mashqgacha o'chirilmaydi; har o'quvchi ustunlarni daftariga ko'chirib oladi — bu Collocation daftarining birinchi sahifasi bo'ladi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Xato juftlikni toping va tuzating
class_ex.instr: Varaqa tarqatiladi. Avval har kim yakka ishlaydi (7 daqiqa), keyin juftlikda solishtiriladi va birga tekshiriladi.
items: Many young drivers do a mistake when they enter the centre at eight in the morning.
Our university has made a research on air quality in the old quarter.
The city council must take an action before next winter.
A car-free square would make many benefits for the neighbourhood.
Tourists do a big influence on the historic centre.
The government should make attention to the tram network.
Traffic noise is a strong problem for families living near the ring road.
The council must do serious steps to protect the old quarter.
Free bus passes would make a real difference to low-income families.
answers: has carried out research / has conducted research
have a big / considerable influence on
Bu gap TO'G'RI, tuzatish shart emas
why: Ingliz tilida "mistake" make bilan yuradi: make a mistake. O'zbekcha "xato qilmoq"ni "do" deb tarjima qilmang.
"Research" sanalmaydi: "a research" ham, "researches" ham yo'q.
Bu ibora artiklsiz ishlatiladi.
"Make benefits" yo'q; foyda "bring / offer benefits to somebody" bo'ladi.
"Do an influence" yo'q; "have an influence / an impact on" bor. "Big" ham to'g'ri, "considerable" — rasmiyroq.
"Make attention" ingliz tilida yo'q; diqqat "pay" bilan yuradi ("give priority to" ham bo'ladi).
"Strong" ko'p otlar bilan yuradi (a strong argument, strong winds, a strong influence), lekin "problem" bilan emas: a serious / major problem.
"Do steps" yo'q; "take steps / take measures" bor.
"Make a difference to" — to'g'ri va kuchli juftlik. Bu diqqat mashqi.
class_ex.note: Oxirgi band ataylab to'g'ri. Kim uni ham "tuzatsa", demak hali juftlikni his qilmayapti; shu o'quvchiga uyga qo'shimcha 5 ta birikma bering.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Juftini toping — gapni to'ldiring
class_ex.instr: Fe'llar ro'yxati BERILMAYDI. Har juftlik o'zi o'ylab yozadi, keyin ustoz ro'yxatni o'qiydi va solishtiriladi.
items: Governments should ______ strict limits on the number of cars entering the centre.
Historic districts ______ a vital role in the economy of small cities.
Cheaper fares would ______ commuters to leave their cars at home.
Well-managed tourism ______ considerable revenue for the local budget.
The council has ______ a long-term plan for the old quarter.
Restoring a nineteenth-century building ______ enormous expense.
Poor planning can ______ irreversible damage to a historic street.
Free entry at weekends would ______ access to museums for poorer families.
answers: drawn up (qabul qilinadi: developed, adopted, approved, prepared)
why: "Impose limits / restrictions / a ban". "Set limits" ham to'g'ri, qabul qilinadi; "make limits" xato.
"Play a role" — o'zgarmas juftlik.
"Encourage somebody to do something" — tuzilmasi bilan birga yodlanadi.
"Generate revenue / income / jobs".
"Draw up a plan / a list / a contract".
"Involve expense / risk / effort".
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: "cause damage" va "do damage".
"Widen access" rasmiyroq va kuchliroq.
class_ex.note: Ustozdagi ro'yxat (tekshiruv vaqtida aralash tartibda o'qiladi): cause, draw up, encourage, generate, impose, involve, play, widen. Javoblar aytilgandan keyin o'quvchi o'z variantini o'chirmaydi — ustiga chizib, yoniga to'g'risini yozadi. Farqni ko'z shunda eslab qoladi. Kalitdagi "qabul qilinadi" variantlari ham to'g'ri — ularni xato demang; faqat begona juftlik ("make limits", "do revenue") tuzatiladi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Tekshiruvchi buni qanday o'qiydi?
class_ex.instr: Har gapni o'qing va uch ustunni birga to'ldiring: tekshiruvchi nimani ko'radi, qaysi mezon va ballga qanday ta'sir qiladi. Bitta gapga band qo'yilmaydi — faqat ta'sir yo'nalishi aytiladi.
class_ex.answers: Xulosa doskaga yoziladi: noto'g'ri collocation Grammatical Range dan emas, Lexical Resource dan ball oladi — grammatikangiz butunlay toza bo'lsa ham LR 6 da qolishi mumkin. Band bitta gapga emas, butun essayga qo'yiladi: jadvaldagi izohlar faqat ta'sir yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.
class_ex.note: 1- va 6-qatorni yonma-yon o'qing: biri xato juftlik bilan ("strong problem"), ikkinchisi xatosiz-u bo'sh ("very ... very"). Ikkalasi ham LR ni 7 ga olib chiqmaydi, lekin sabablari boshqa — o'quvchi shu farqni ko'rsin.
head: O'quvchining gapi
Tekshiruvchi ko'radigan narsa
Mezon va ball ta'siri
rows: The city has a strong problem with traffic.
Grammatikasi toza ;; lekin "strong problem" juftligi ingliz tilida yo'q
LR ;; kuchli so'z tanlangan, lekin juftligi noto'g'ri — bunday xatolar takrorlansa, LR 7 ga yetmaydi
The government must do a research about pollution.
Ikki xato bir gapda ;; "do" fe'li ham, "a research" sanaladigan shakl ham noto'g'ri
LR ;; ikki xato bir gapda — takrorlansa, LR 7 ga yetmaydi
Public transport plays an important role in the city centre.
Uchta tabiiy juftlik ;; "play a role", "public transport", "city centre"
LR ;; ijobiy belgi: tabiiy, xavfsiz juftliklar
Tourism does a big influence on old towns.
Fikri tushunarli ;; lekin "do an influence" birikmasi yo'q
LR ;; ma'no yetib boradi, ball tushadi
Heavy traffic imposes a real cost on residents.
Uch kuchli juftlik ketma-ket ;; "heavy traffic", "impose a cost on", "a real cost"
LR ;; ijobiy belgi: aniq va tabiiy juftliklar ("awareness of collocation")
Buildings must be saved because they are very old and very important.
Juftlik xato emas ;; lekin "very ... very" bo'sh va takroriy
LR ;; xato yo'q, lekin xilma-xillik ham yo'q — bunday gaplar ko'p bo'lsa, LR 7 ga yetmaydi

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Zaif gapni collocation bilan kuchaytiring
class_ex.instr: Chapdagi gapni qayta yozing: uzaytirmang, ANIQLASHTIRING. Har tuzatishdan keyin qaysi juftlik ishlatilganini ayting.
items: The city has big traffic every morning and people are late.
Old buildings are broken and nobody makes a repair.
The government must do something about the air because it is very bad.
Tourists give a lot of money to the city.
A new metro will make a good result for workers.
If we do not protect the old street, it will be broken forever.
answers: Heavy traffic brings the centre to a standstill every morning, and many commuters arrive late for work.
Historic buildings have been allowed to fall into disrepair, and no funds have been set aside for restoration.
The authorities must take action on air quality, which has deteriorated noticeably in recent years.
Visitors generate substantial revenue for local hotels, guides and craft workshops.
A new metro line would bring clear benefits to commuters and cut journey times across the city.
Unless the old street is protected, it is likely to suffer irreversible damage.
why: heavy traffic; bring something to a standstill; arrive late for work.
fall into disrepair; set aside funds.
take action on; air quality; deteriorate noticeably (yoki sharply).
generate revenue; substantial revenue.
bring benefits to; cut journey times.
suffer damage; irreversible damage; "is likely to" — da'vo yumshatilgan, mutlaq emas.
class_ex.note: Doskadagi uch ustunga qarab ishlansin. Qoida: gap uzaymaydi, ANIQ bo'ladi. Uzaytirilgan gap ko'pincha yangi xato olib keladi. Kalitdagi gaplar — NAMUNA (bittasi): boshqa to'g'ri juftlik ishlatilib, ma'no saqlansa, qabul qilinadi. To'qima raqam ("thousands of...", "over the past decade") va mutlaq da'vo ("no budget can ever...") qo'shilmaydi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — collocationlar ishlagan Band 7.5 essay
readings.qtype: Discuss both views va o'z fikri
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (shu dars uchun yozilgan, 299 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Many city centres are becoming crowded and expensive to live in. Some people believe that local governments should spend public money on improving public transport, while others argue that the money should go to restoring historic buildings and public spaces. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Rising rents and persistent congestion have made many historic city centres unpleasant places to live, and local councils are now under pressure to decide where limited public funds should go. One group argues for investment in public transport, while another insists that restoring old streets and squares matters more. Both cases are strong, but in my view transport should come first.

The argument for transport rests on daily reality. Heavy traffic imposes a real cost on residents: commuters lose several hours every week, shops lose passing customers, and air quality deteriorates to the point where local authorities have to issue health warnings. A reliable tram or bus network, by contrast, generates measurable benefits within a few years, because it encourages drivers to leave their cars at home and frees road space for deliveries and emergency vehicles. Money spent here largely pays for itself in higher productivity and lower medical bills.

Those who defend restoration, however, make a fair point about identity and income. Historic quarters attract visitors who spend money on hotels, guides and craft workshops, and this revenue often supports families with no connection to the tourist industry at all. Allowing such districts to fall into disrepair also causes irreversible damage: once a nineteenth-century facade has been demolished, no budget can bring it back. Preservation, in other words, protects an asset that cannot be replaced.

My own position is that these aims are not in conflict, but that transport must be funded first. A restored square surrounded by four lanes of stationary cars gives little pleasure to anyone, whereas a good network makes the old centre easy to reach and therefore worth restoring. Once buses and trams run reliably, a modest sum set aside each year for restoration will achieve far more than a large one spent today.
paraphrases: crowded and expensive to live in
Rising rents and persistent congestion ... unpleasant places to live
where limited public funds should go
investment in public transport / a reliable tram or bus network
restoring historic buildings and public spaces
restoring old streets and squares / preservation
in my view ... / My own position is that ...

tasks.title: Essaydan 10 ta collocationni toping va turiga ajrating
tasks.instr: Marker bilan belgilang, keyin jadvalni birga to'ldiring. Uchinchi ustun eng muhimi: nega aynan shu so'z.
tasks.answers: Yuqoridagi o'n qator — to'liq javob. O'quvchi kamida 7 tasini o'zi topsa, natija yaxshi hisoblanadi; qolganini ustoz ko'rsatadi. Essayda yana "rising rents", "passing customers", "pay for itself", "bring it back" ham bor — ularni topgan o'quvchini alohida maqtang.
tasks.note: Diqqat: essayda 10 ta kuchli birikma bor, qolgan gaplar oddiy. Aynan shu nisbat to'g'ri — har gapni "kuchaytirish" shart emas va xavfli.
head: Essaydagi birikma
Turi
Nega aynan shu so'z
rows: "Big traffic" yoki "strong traffic" deyilmaydi ;; "heavy" aynan tirbandlik, yomg'ir va yuk bilan yuradi
"Impose a cost / limits / a ban" ;; "make a cost" yo'q
Ikki ot bitta atama ;; "quality of air" ham to'g'ri, lekin essayda qisqasi kuchliroq
Rasmiy organ "issue" qiladi: warning, statement, permit ;; "give a warning" og'zaki uslub
"Generate benefits / revenue / income / jobs" — bitta oila ;; "make benefits" xato
Byudjet puli uchun rasmiy ibora (public — sifat, "public transport" dagi kabi) ;; "state money" so'zlashuv uslubi
Ibora butunligicha yodlanadi ;; "become disrepair" yoki "go to disrepair" xato
"Cause damage" va "do damage" — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri ;; "make damage" xato
"Attract visitors, investment, attention, criticism" ;; "bring visitors" zaifroq
Pulni ajratib qo'yish ;; "put aside" so'zlashuvda, "set aside" yozma uslubda

tasks.title: Zaif variant va essaydagi variant
tasks.instr: Chapdagi gap — o'quvchi odatda yozadigan oddiy variant; o'ngda essayda qanday yozilgani. Farqni o'quvchi aytsin.
items: The city has very big traffic in the morning.
The air is very bad now.
Buses will give good things to the city.
Tourists bring money.
The buildings are becoming very old and broken.
The government must put money for restoration every year.
answers: Heavy traffic imposes a real cost on residents.
air quality deteriorates to the point where local authorities have to issue health warnings
A reliable tram or bus network generates measurable benefits
Historic quarters attract visitors who spend money on hotels, guides and craft workshops
Allowing such districts to fall into disrepair
a modest sum set aside each year for restoration
why: Bo'sh "very big" ketdi; ikkita to'g'ri juftlik keldi.
Aniq atama va aniq oqibat.
"Give good things" bolalarcha; "generate benefits" rasmiy.
Kim, qayerga, nimaga — hammasi aniq.
Bitta ibora ikki gapning ishini bajardi.
"Put money for" o'rniga "set aside a sum for".
tasks.note: Chapdagi gaplarning hech birida GRAMMATIKA xatosi yo'q. Hammasi faqat juftlik sababli zaif — bu darsning asosiy xulosasi shu.

homework_intro: Bugun biz so'zni yolg'iz emas, juftligi bilan o'rganishni boshladik: "make a mistake", "heavy traffic", "fall into disrepair".

Birinchi vazifa — Collocation daftari: bugungi mashqlardan va namuna essaydan 20 ta birikma ko'chiring, har birini turiga ajrating va HAR BIRIGA o'zingiz bitta gap yozing; sinfdagi gapni ko'chirmang, o'z gapingiz bo'lsin — bunga taxminan 25 daqiqa ketadi.
Ikkinchi vazifa — 10 ta xato gap: ular sizga varaqda beriladi (ilovadagi uyga vazifada ham bor); uyda har birini tuzatasiz va yoniga "nega xato" deb bitta jumla yozasiz, 15 daqiqa.

Uchinchi vazifa — bitta xatboshi: bugungi savolga (transport yoki tarixiy markaz) 5-6 gaplik bitta body xatboshi yozasiz va ichida kamida 5 ta bugungi birikmani ishlatasiz; ishlatgan birikmangizning ostiga chizib qo'ying.
Uchala vazifa ham daftarda bajariladi va keyingi dars boshida yig'iladi; men avvalo ostiga chizilgan birikmalarni tekshiraman — o'z gapingizda to'g'ri ishlatilgani sinfda yodlangandan muhimroq.

homework.title: Collocation daftari — 20 ta birikma
homework.instr: Bugungi mashqlar va namuna essaydan 20 ta birikma ko'chiring. Har biri uchun: birikma, turi (fe'l+ot / sifat+ot / ot+ot), o'zbekcha ma'nosi va O'Z gapingiz.
homework.answers: Namuna qator — "fall into disrepair | fe'l + ot | qarovsiz qolib xarob bo'lmoq | Many old houses in our mahalla have fallen into disrepair since the last repairs." Ustoz asosan gaplarni tekshiradi: birikma o'z gapida to'g'ri ishlatilgan bo'lsa, vazifa bajarilgan hisoblanadi.

homework.title: 10 ta xato gapni tuzating
homework.instr: 10 gap ilovadagi uyga vazifada ko'rinadi; ilova bo'lmasa, ustoz ularni varaqqa chop etib beradi. Uyda har gapdagi noto'g'ri juftlikni toping, to'g'risini yozing va yoniga bitta jumla bilan "nega xato" deb izohlang. 1) Tourists often do a mistake when they visit the old quarter in July. 2) Our college has made a research on noise near the bus station. 3) The mayor promised to take an action before the end of the year. 4) Air pollution is a strong problem in many large cities. 5) Cheap tickets do a big influence on the number of passengers. 6) The council should make attention to the condition of the pavements. 7) A new library would make many benefits for families with small children. 8) Guides make an important role in the life of the old city. 9) The government must make strict limits on heavy lorries in the centre. 10) Careless building work can make serious damage to a historic street.
homework.answers: 1) do a mistake -> make a mistake. 2) has made a research -> has carried out / has conducted research (sanalmaydi, "a" tushadi). 3) take an action -> take action, artiklsiz. 4) a strong problem -> a serious problem. 5) do a big influence on -> have a big (yoki considerable) influence on. 6) make attention to -> pay attention to. 7) make many benefits for -> bring many benefits to. 8) make an important role -> play an important role. 9) make strict limits -> impose (yoki set) strict limits. 10) make serious damage -> cause / do serious damage.

homework.title: Bitta xatboshi: 5 ta birikma bilan
homework.instr: Bugungi savolga (shahar transporti yoki tarixiy markazni saqlash) 5-6 gaplik bitta body xatboshi yozing: asosiy fikr, sabab, misol, natija. Kamida 5 ta bugungi birikmani ishlating va ostiga chizing.
homework.answers: Namuna — "Improving public transport should be a top priority for most city councils. Heavy traffic imposes a real cost on ordinary families, who can lose a considerable amount of time in the rush hour. In our own city, for example, buses arriving every ten minutes would encourage many drivers to leave their cars at home. Such a network would also generate measurable benefits for shops in the centre, which currently lose passing customers. For this reason, a large share of public funds should, in my view, go to transport." Tekshiruv (ha/yo'q): 1) 5-6 gap, bitta asosiy fikr; 2) kamida 5 ta bugungi birikma ostiga chizilgan va to'g'ri ishlatilgan; 3) misol bor, to'qima raqam yo'q; 4) mutlaq so'zlar (all, any, never) yumshatilgan. Birikmalar 5 tadan kam bo'lsa, vazifa qayta yozdiriladi.

normativ: 20 ta birikma, turi va o'z gapi bilan
5-6 gap, kamida 5 ta birikma ostiga chizilgan

kahoot.q: What is a collocation?
options: Words that have the same meaning
Words that sound exactly the same
kahoot.explain: Collocation — tabiiy ravishda birga ishlatiladigan so'zlar (make a decision, strong coffee); qoidasi yo'q, odati bor.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'The city has ___ good progress in reducing traffic noise.'
kahoot.explain: make progress — o'zgarmas birikma; 'do progress' yoki 'take progress' deyilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Choose the natural collocation.
kahoot.explain: strong opposition / strong support — tabiiy juftlik; 'tall', 'hard' va 'weighty' bu ot bilan yurmaydi.

kahoot.q: Which mistake lowers Lexical Resource rather than Grammatical Range?
kahoot.explain: 'make a crime' — juftlik xatosi (to'g'risi: commit a crime), u LR dan ball oladi; qolgan uchtasi grammatika xatosi.

kahoot.q: You are not sure that a strong-sounding phrase is correct. What is the safest choice?
options: Use it anyway to impress the examiner
Replace it with a rare idiom
kahoot.explain: Aniqlik birinchi: ishonchingiz komil bo'lmagan 'kuchli' ibora o'rniga sodda va to'g'ri juftlikni oling.

kahoot.q: What is the best way to record a new collocation?
options: In a full sentence of your own
As a single word with no example
Next to a long list of synonyms
kahoot.explain: Butun ibora o'z gapingiz bilan yoziladi va bir hafta ichida uch marta ishlatiladi — shunda eslab qolinadi.

kahoot.q: Which pair is NOUN + NOUN?
kahoot.explain: road safety — ikki ot bitta tushuncha beradi; urban va busy — sifat, reduce — fe'l.

kahoot.q: Which pair is ADJECTIVE + NOUN?
kahoot.explain: high — sifat, fares — ot (yo'l haqi baland); 'ticket office' va 'car park' — ot + ot, 'cut costs' — fe'l + ot.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'After long talks, the two councils ___ an agreement.'
kahoot.explain: reach an agreement — kelishuvga erishmoq; 'do' yoki 'take an agreement' deyilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Fast cars in narrow streets ___ a real threat to children.'
kahoot.explain: pose a threat / a risk — xavf tug'dirmoq; 'make a threat' boshqa ma'no (tahdid qilmoq), 'do' va 'bring' bu ot bilan yurmaydi.

kahoot.q: Why does a wrong collocation cost marks even when the meaning is clear?
options: It counts as a grammar mistake
It makes the essay too short
kahoot.explain: Noto'g'ri juftlik 'begona' eshitiladi va Lexical Resource dan ball oladi, grammatikadan emas.

kahoot.q: How many strong collocations are usually enough in one Task 2 essay?
kahoot.explain: 6-10 ta aniq birikma yetadi (bugungi namunada 10 ta); hammasi 'kuchli' bo'lsa, matn sun'iy bo'lib, xato ehtimoli oshadi.

kahoot.q: A 'commuter' is someone who ...
options: lives in the old city centre
kahoot.explain: commuter — har kuni ishga (yoki o'qishga) qatnovchi odam.

kahoot.q: Choose the best synonym for 'congestion' in 'congestion on the ring road'.
kahoot.explain: congestion — tirbandlik (traffic jams).

kahoot.q: 'Irreversible damage' is damage that ...
kahoot.explain: irreversible — ortga qaytarib bo'lmaydigan: buzilgan narsani tiklab bo'lmaydi.

kahoot.q: Air quality often deteriorates in winter. 'Deteriorate' means ...
kahoot.explain: deteriorate — yomonlashmoq (get worse).

kahoot.q: 'Revenue' is closest in meaning to ...
kahoot.explain: revenue — daromad (income); expense — xarajat, teskari ma'no.

kahoot.q: Which word describes traffic that is not moving at all?
kahoot.explain: stationary — joyidan qimirlamaydigan; 'stationery' (e bilan) — kantselyariya mollari.

kahoot.q: The 'restoration' of an old mosque means ...
options: returning it to its original state
knocking it down and building a copy
turning it into a modern office block
closing it permanently to all visitors
kahoot.explain: restoration — qayta tiklash: binoni asl holiga qaytarish.

kahoot.q: 'The preservation of the historic quarter' is closest in meaning to ...
options: moving people out of the centre
kahoot.explain: preservation — saqlab qolish, muhofaza; quarter — shaharning mavzesi (qismi).

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Sample Essay Analizi — Discuss Both Views and Give Your Opinion
lessons.grammar_topic: Discuss both views and give your own opinion — bitta namuna essayning to'liq tahlili va doimiy tekshiruv ro'yxati
lessons.vocab_topic: Kursning yakuniy darsi: ikki qarash + aniq shaxsiy fikr; 36-47-darslarda o'rganilgan hamma narsa bitta essayda birlashtiriladi
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy materiali — savol ham, namuna essay ham Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan; baholash rasmiy IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (May 2023) bo'yicha.
objectives: "Discuss both views and give your own opinion" savoli AYNAN nimani talab qilishini ayta olish: ikkala qarash teng ochiladi VA o'z fikri aniq aytiladi.
Shu savol turi uchun eng xavfsiz 4 xatboshili tuzilmani yoddan chizib bera olish.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan ikki halokatli xatoni tanish: fikr umuman aytilmagan, yoki fikr tanadagi dalillarga qarshi chiqqan.
Bitta namuna essayni to'rt mezon bo'yicha (TR, CC, LR, GRA) baholash va har ballni dalil bilan asoslash.
Ikki qarashni kiritish va o'z pozitsiyasini bildirish uchun tayyor til qoliplarini to'g'ri ishlatish.
Kursdan keyin ham har bir essayda ishlatiladigan 10 bandli yakuniy tekshiruv ro'yxatini olib chiqish.
materials: Namuna essay (quyidagi reading bloki) — har o'quvchiga bittadan nusxa, o'ng chetida bo'sh ustun: "mezon va ball". 1- va 2-topshiriq shu nusxada bajariladi.

Doskada dars boshlanishidan oldin yozib qo'yiladi: savol matni (quyidagi reading blokidagi "SAVOL:" qatoridan so'zma-so'z ko'chiriladi) va ostida bo'sh to'rtta quti — Intro, Qarash A, Qarash B, Xulosa. 2-mashq shu qutilarga to'ldiriladi.
4-mashq uchun qirqiladigan kartochkalar: 10 ta zaif ibora bir to'plamda, 10 ta kuchli ibora ikkinchi to'plamda — har juftlikka bitta komplekt (jami 6-8 komplekt), oldindan qirqilgan holda.
5-mashqning yakuniy tekshiruv ro'yxati A5 formatda chop etilgan — har o'quvchiga bittadan, daftar muqovasiga yopishtirish uchun.
36-37-darslardagi 4 mezon kartochkalari (TR, CC, LR, GRA) — doskaning chetida turadi, 1-topshiriqda kerak bo'ladi.

Har o'quvchining 34 va 35-darslar orasidagi mock imtihonda yozgan Task 2 essayi — ustoz uni JonyOS dagi mock natijasidan olib, har o'quvchiga chop etib beradi (o'quvchi uni uyga olib ketadi); kimda yo'q bo'lsa — 47-darsdagi uyga vazifada yozgan body xatboshisi. Uyga vazifaning ikkinchi qismi shu ish ustida bajariladi, sinfga olib kelish oldingi darsda aytiladi.
timeline: Salomlashish; 36-42 (mezon va baholash, paraphrase, reja, kirish, body, xulosa) va 43-47 (bog'lovchi, misol, yumshatish, lug'at, birikma) uch gapda takrorlanadi; bugun hammasi bitta essayda birlashtiriladi
Doskadagi savol o'qiladi; ikkita buyruq ajratiladi; 1-mashq bajariladi
Doskadagi to'rtta quti 2-mashq bo'yicha to'ldiriladi; har xatboshining vazifasi yoziladi
3-mashq: ustoz holatni o'qiydi, o'quvchi tashxis qo'yadi va tuzatadi
4-mashq kartochkalari juftlikda teriladi, keyin doskada tekshiriladi
Ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi; hali ball qo'yilmaydi, faqat xatboshilar chetga belgilanadi
1-topshiriq: har mezonga ball va SABAB; avval o'quvchilar, keyin solishtiriladi
Nega aynan shu ball — dalil izlash
2- va 3-topshiriqlar: essaydan aniq ibora topiladi va mezonga bog'lanadi
5-mashq: 10 band o'qiladi, har bandga namuna essaydan javob topiladi
Ro'yxat daftarga yopishtiriladi; uyga vazifa kirish matni o'qiladi

intro: "Discuss both these views and give your own opinion" — bu bitta talab emas, IKKITA buyruq. Birinchisi: ikkala qarashni ham ochib ber. Ikkinchisi: o'zing qaysi tomondasan, ayt. Ikkitasidan birortasi bajarilmasa, Task Response 5 dan oshmaydi.

"Ikkala qarashni ochish" degani ularni sanab o'tish emas. Har qarash uchun kamida bitta sabab va bitta misol yoki natija bo'lishi kerak — 37-darsdagi "fikr, sabab, misol, natija" zanjiri shu yerda ham ishlaydi.

Ikki qarash taxminan TENG hajmda ochiladi. Bir tomonga o'n gap, ikkinchisiga bir-ikki gap yozilsa, ikkinchi qarash yetarli ochilmagan bo'ladi va TR 6 atrofida qoladi ("some may be more fully covered than others"); bir qarash butunlay tushib qolsa, savolning asosiy qismi bajarilmagan hisoblanadi — TR 5 dan oshmaydi.

O'z fikri alohida gap bo'lishi shart, "menimcha ikkalasi ham to'g'ri" emas. Aniq pozitsiya uch xil bo'ladi: A tomon, B tomon, yoki SHARTI aytilgan murosa ("A — bunday holatda, B — bunday holatda"). Shartsiz murosa pozitsiya sanalmaydi.

Eng ko'p uchraydigan halokatli xato ikkita: birinchisi — ikkala qarash yozilgan, lekin o'z fikri umuman yo'q; ikkinchisi — fikr bor, lekin u tanadagi dalillarga qarshi, masalan ikkala xatboshi ham pullik kirishni himoya qiladi, xulosada esa "shuning uchun bepul bo'lishi kerak" deyiladi.
Shaxsiy fikr kirishda ham, xulosada ham BIR XIL bo'lishi kerak. Tekshiruvchi kirishni o'qib pozitsiyani belgilab qo'yadi; xulosada boshqasini ko'rsa, bu "unclear position" deb yoziladi.

Xavfsiz tuzilma — 4 xatboshi: kirish (paraphrase va pozitsiya), Qarash A, Qarash B, xulosa (pozitsiya takrorlanadi va qisqa asoslanadi). Body xatboshilarining tartibi erkin, lekin ko'pchilik uchun O'ZI QO'SHILMAGAN qarashni oldin yozish qulay — shunda oxirgi body o'z pozitsiyasini kuchaytiradi.
"I think" xato emas, lekin butun essayda bir-ikki marta yetadi. "In my view", "I would argue that", "To my mind" — xilma-xillik LR ga ishlaydi.

Bugungi namuna essay 300 so'z — bu 44-47-darslarda yozgan body xatboshilaringizning to'rttasi, xolos. Yangi g'oya o'ylab topilmagan: oddiy g'oyalar to'g'ri ochib berilgan. 37-darsdagi xulosa shu yerda ham amal qiladi.
Bu kursning oxirgi darsi. Bugundan keyin har yozilgan essay 5-mashqdagi 10 bandli ro'yxat bo'yicha tekshiriladi — ustozsiz ham.
formulas: Discuss both views + give your own opinion
Intro, Qarash A, Qarash B, Xulosa
In my view, I would argue
presentation: Ikkala qarash ham o'zimniki emas-ku, qanday yozaman?
Yozayotganingiz o'z fikringiz emas — bu boshqalarning qarashi. "Supporters of X argue that ..." deb boshlang, o'z fikringizni esa kirish va xulosada ayting.
Xulosada ikkala tomonni ham qo'llab bo'ladimi?
Faqat SHARTI aytilsa. "Bepul — doimiy kolleksiyaga, pullik — vaqtinchalik ko'rgazmaga" — bu pozitsiya. "Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri" — bu pozitsiya emas.
Fikrimni kirishda aytsam, xulosada takrorlash zerikarli emasmi?
Yo'q, bu talab. Tekshiruvchi pozitsiya BIR XIL turganini ko'rishi kerak. Faqat so'zlarni o'zgartiring.
Bir qarashga ikki xatboshi yozsam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin ikkinchi qarashga ham shuncha joy kerak. Teng bo'lmasa TR tushadi.
Necha so'z yozay?
260-300. Bugungi namuna 300 so'z. 250 dan kam bo'lsa jarima bor, 350 dan oshsa xato ko'payadi.
Misolni o'ylab topsam bo'ladimi?
Ha. Misol ishonarli va aniq bo'lsa yetadi. Lekin aniq raqam yoki statistika to'qib yozmang — noto'g'ri fakt ballni ko'tarmaydi.
"I think" ni umuman ishlatmasam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin shart emas. Muhimi pozitsiya KO'RINSIN — "In my view", "I would argue that" ham shu ishni bajaradi.
Vaqt yetmasa nimani tashlab ketay?
Hech qachon xulosani emas. Bitta dalilni qisqartiring, lekin ikki gaplik xulosa albatta yozilsin — pozitsiyasiz essay eng ko'p ball yo'qotadi.
Bu ro'yxatni imtihonga olib kira olmayman-ku?
Shuning uchun uni hozir yodlaysiz. Uch-to'rt essaydan keyin ro'yxat o'zi boshda ishlaydi.
notes: Bu — kursning YAKUNIY darsi. Yangi qoida kiritilmaydi: 36-darsdagi mezonlar, 37-darsdagi baholash usuli va 38-47-darslardagi tuzilma mashqlari bugun bitta essayda birlashtiriladi. Agar guruh 36-37-darslarni o'tmagan bo'lsa, avval o'sha ikkitasini bering.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — Band 8.0 darajasi
readings.qtype: Discuss both views and give your own opinion
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (300 so'z); savol ham Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that museums and historic sites should be free to enter for everyone, while others argue that visitors should pay for admission. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: Many countries are now debating whether entry to museums and historic sites should cost anything. One side sees these places as public property; the other believes that those who come through the doors should help pay for what they see. In my view, permanent collections should remain open without charge, while the additional services built around them can reasonably carry a price.

The strongest argument for free entry is that price decides who comes. When a family on an average income must buy four tickets, a visit becomes a rare treat rather than an ordinary habit, and those kept outside usually have the least contact with their own history. Free access also changes the way a collection is used: a student can call in for twenty minutes, study one object and return next week, and that unhurried repetition is how genuine interest is built. In cities where school groups visit regularly, a young audience forms within a few years.

Those who defend admission fees, however, raise a practical objection. Heritage buildings are expensive to heat, repair and guard, and state funding is rarely guaranteed; an institution that depends on one budget line can lose much of its income in one difficult year. A small castle museum, for instance, can mend a leaking roof in the same season if its own ticket desk pays for it. Income collected at the door is visible and predictable, and it tends to be spent on the galleries that earned it rather than disappearing into general expenditure.

To my mind, these two aims need not conflict. Permanent collections, which the public has already paid for through taxation, should stay free, while temporary exhibitions, guided tours and special events are charged for. Such an arrangement protects these institutions financially without closing their doors to ordinary visitors.

help pay for what they see / admission fees / carry a price
these places / heritage buildings / these institutions / collections

Ikkinchi vazifa: mock imtihonda yozgan Task 2 essayingizni oling (ustoz JonyOS dagi natijangizdan beradi), uni ham shu 10 band bo'yicha tekshiring, so'ng faqat xulosa xatboshisini qaytadan yozing — pozitsiya aniq va kirishga mos bo'lsin; mock essayi yo'qlar 47-darsdagi body xatboshisini olib, o'sha savolga faqat kirish va xulosa yozadi.

Uchinchi vazifa qisqa: 4-mashqdagi o'ng ustundagi 10 ta iborani qolip sifatida daftaringizga ko'chiring va har biri bilan o'zingizdan bitta gap tuzing — muzey so'zlarini o'z mavzuingiz so'zlari bilan almashtirasiz, iboraning tuzilmasi esa saqlanadi.

homework.answers: Namuna tuzilma — bugungi namuna essay (mavzu boshqa, tuzilma bir xil: kirish + pozitsiya, qarash A, qarash B, xulosa). Ustoz avval 10 bandning belgilanganini tekshiradi: belgilanmagan ish qaytariladi. Keyin 1-topshiriqdagi jadval kabi baholanadi: har mezonga (TR, CC, LR, GRA) BUTUN ball (0-9) va essaydan bitta dalil-iqtibos; umumiy ball — to'rttasining o'rtachasi. Ustoz bahosi o'quvchining o'z belgilashi bilan solishtiriladi.

homework.title: Mock essayingizning xulosasini qayta yozing
homework.instr: 34 va 35-darslar orasidagi mock imtihonda yozgan Task 2 essayingizni oling (ustoz JonyOS dagi mock natijasidan beradi), 10 band bo'yicha tekshiring, so'ng faqat XULOSA xatboshisini qaytadan yozing: pozitsiya aniq, kirishga mos, yangi dalilsiz, 2-3 gap. Mock essayingiz bo'lmasa: 47-darsdagi body xatboshingizni oling va o'sha savolga faqat KIRISH (2-3 gap) va XULOSA (2-3 gap) yozing — ikkalasida pozitsiya bir xil bo'lsin.
homework.answers: To'g'ri xulosaning uchta belgisi: pozitsiya boshqa so'z bilan takrorlangan, bir gapda asoslangan, yangi dalil yo'q. Namuna — namuna essayning 4-xatboshisi ("To my mind, these two aims need not conflict ...").

homework.title: 10 ta pozitsiya iborasi bilan gap tuzing
homework.instr: 4-mashqning o'ng ustunidagi 10 iborani QOLIP sifatida ko'chiring (masalan "Supporters of X argue that ...", "Those who defend X raise a practical objection.", "In my view, this arrangement is the fairer one.", "It is widely accepted that ...") va har biri bilan bitta o'z gapingizni yozing. Mavzu ixtiyoriy: muzey so'zlarini o'z mavzuingiz so'zlari bilan almashtiring, iboraning tuzilmasi esa saqlansin.
homework.answers: Tekshiruv: qolip saqlangan va to'g'ri o'rinda ishlatilgan (masalan "Supporters of online learning argue that it saves time."). "In my view" dan keyin o'z fikri, "Supporters of ... argue that" dan keyin boshqalarning qarashi kelsin. Mavzu so'zlarini almashtirish — xato emas, talab.

normativ: Pozitsiya aniq, kirishga mos, yangi dalilsiz

kahoot.q: 'Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.' How many separate tasks does this instruction contain?
kahoot.explain: Ikkita buyruq: ikkala qarashni ochish VA o'z fikrini aytish — ikkalasi ham baholanadi.

kahoot.q: In this essay type, where should your own position appear?
options: In the intro and the conclusion
Only in the second body paragraph
Nowhere, because it must be neutral
kahoot.explain: Pozitsiya kirishda aytiladi va xulosada boshqa so'zlar bilan takrorlanadi — ikkalasi bir xil bo'lishi shart.

kahoot.q: Topic: working from home or in the office. Which conclusion states a clear position?
options: On balance, remote work suits most office staff.
Both views have their advantages and disadvantages.
It depends on the person and the situation.
There are many different opinions on this topic.
kahoot.explain: 'On balance, ...' aniq tomonni tanlaydi; 'it depends' yoki 'both have advantages' pozitsiya emas.

kahoot.q: Which compromise counts as a clear position?
options: Online classes for theory, campus classes for practice
Both online and campus classes are good in their own way
Everyone should simply choose what they like best
Each type of class has some good and bad points
kahoot.explain: Sharti aytilgan murosa (qachon A, qachon B) — aniq pozitsiya; shartsiz 'ikkalasi ham yaxshi' pozitsiya emas.

kahoot.q: In a four-paragraph essay, which view is usually more convenient to write about first?
kahoot.explain: Avval qo'shilmagan qarash, keyin qo'shilgan qarash yoziladi — oxirgi body pozitsiyangizni kuchaytiradi.

kahoot.q: One view gets eight sentences and the other only one. What usually happens?
kahoot.explain: Bir tomon yetarli ochilmasa TR tushadi (taxminan 6); butunlay tushib qolsa — 5 dan oshmaydi.

kahoot.q: What should a conclusion NOT contain?
kahoot.explain: Xulosa pozitsiyani takrorlaydi va umumlashtiradi; yangi dalil body xatboshisida ochilishi kerak.

kahoot.q: Which phrase introduces OTHER people's view, not your own?
options: Opponents of the plan point out that
In my own view, the plan clearly
I would strongly argue that the plan
To my mind, it is obvious that the plan
kahoot.explain: 'Opponents / Supporters of X argue...' — boshqalarning qarashi; 'In my view', 'I would argue', 'To my mind' — o'z fikringiz.

kahoot.q: Each IELTS Writing criterion (TR, CC, LR, GRA) is scored as ...
kahoot.explain: Har mezonga faqat butun ball (0-9) qo'yiladi; .5 faqat to'rt mezon o'rtachasida chiqishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: Your introduction supports free parking, but your conclusion supports paid parking. What is the problem?
kahoot.explain: Kirish va xulosadagi pozitsiya mos kelmasa — 'unclear position', TR tushadi.

kahoot.q: An example in a Task 2 essay should be ...
kahoot.explain: Misol aniq va ishonarli bo'lsa yetadi; to'qima raqam yoki statistika yozmang — noto'g'ri fakt ballni ko'tarmaydi.

kahoot.q: Why is starting every paragraph with 'Firstly', 'Secondly' and 'Finally' a problem?
kahoot.explain: Har xatboshini shu so'zlar bilan boshlash — mexanik bog'lanish (CC 6 belgisi); bog'lovchilarni xilma-xil ishlating.

kahoot.q: An 'admission fee' is money you pay to ...
kahoot.explain: admission fee — kirish haqi (muzey, galereya va h.k.).

kahoot.q: 'Expenditure' is closest in meaning to ...
kahoot.explain: expenditure — xarajat (spending); earnings — daromad.

kahoot.q: A museum's 'permanent collection' is ...
options: owned and kept by the museum
shown there for one month only
kahoot.explain: permanent collection — muzeyning o'ziga tegishli, doimiy saqlanadigan kolleksiya; vaqtincha ko'rgazma (ko'pincha boshqa muzeydan olinadi) esa temporary exhibition.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'a reason for disagreeing with something'?
kahoot.explain: objection — e'tiroz, qarshi fikr.

kahoot.q: 'Predictable income' is income that ...
options: you can plan for in advance
kahoot.explain: predictable — oldindan bilib bo'ladigan, barqaror; bunday daromadga reja tuzish oson.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'The old roof leaks, so the museum must ___ it before winter.'
kahoot.explain: mend — ta'mirlamoq (repair); mind — qarshi bo'lmoq, lend — qarz bermoq.

kahoot.q: Museums paid for 'through taxation' are funded by ...
kahoot.explain: taxation — soliq tizimi: muzey fuqarolar to'laydigan soliqlar hisobidan moliyalashtiriladi.

kahoot.q: An 'unhurried' visit to a gallery is ...
kahoot.explain: unhurried — shoshilmasdan, bamaylixotir qilinadigan.
